201.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਸੈਨ ਸਮਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਨਰੇਸ ਬਰੰ ॥
201.t: pun sain sami'tr nares bara(n) ||
201.e: The mighty and glorious king Sumitra,

201.g: ਜਿਹ ਜੁਧ ਲਯੋ ਮੱਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਸ ਹਰੰ ॥
201.t: jeh judh layo ma'dhr dhes hara(n) ||
201.e: who was the conqueror of the Madra nation.

201.g: ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਹ ਧਾਮ ਭਈ ਦੁਹਿਤਾ ॥
201.t: sumitraa teh dhaam bhiee dhuhitaa ||
201.e: He had a daughter named Sumitra in his home.

201.g: ਜਿਹ ਜੀਤ ਲਈ ਸਸ ਸੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ॥੧੨॥
201.t: jeh jeet liee sas soor prabhaa ||12||
201.e: She was more beautiful than the sun and moon. ||12||

201.g: ਸੋਊ ਬਾਰਿ ਸਬੁੱਧ ਭਈ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
201.t: souoo baar sabu'dh bhiee jab hee ||
201.e: When she grew of age,

201.g: ਅਵਧੇਸਹ ਚੀਨ ਬਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
201.t: avadheseh cheen bario tab hee ||
201.e: she also married the king of Oudh.

201.g: ਗਨ ਯਾਹ ਭਯੋ ਕਸਟੁਆਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ॥
201.t: gan yaeh bhayo kasaTuaar nirapa(n) ||
201.e: The same story happened with the king of Kekeya,

201.g: ਜਿਹ ਕੇਕਈ ਧਾਮ ਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੧੩॥
201.t: jeh kekiee dhaam su taas prabha(n) ||13||
201.e: who had a glorious daughter named Kaikeyi. ||13||

201.g: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਮੋ ਸੁਤ ਜਉਨ ਥੀਓ ॥
201.t: ein te greh mo sut jaun theeo ||
201.e: (When Dasaratha expressed his desire to marry Kaikeyi, the king, her father, said) From her your son who will be born (will be entitled to the kingdom as heir).

201.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਠ ਨਰੇਸ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੀਓ ॥
201.t: tab baiTh nares bichaar keeo ||
201.e: Dasrath considered this fact.

201.g: ਤਬ ਕੇਕਈ ਨਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੀ ॥
201.t: tab kekiee naar bichaar karee ||
201.e: After deep consideration, he took Kaikeyi as his wife.

201.g: ਜਿਹ ਤੇ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਧਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
201.t: jeh te sas sooraj sobh dharee ||14||
201.e: She, from which the moon and the sun were adorned. ||14||

201.g: ਤਿਹ ਬਯਾਹਤ ਮਾਗ ਲਏ ਦੁ ਬਰੰ ॥
201.t: teh bayaahat maag le dh bara(n) ||
201.e: On being married she asked for two gifts from the king (Dasrath).

201.g: ਜਿਹ ਤੇ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰੰ ॥
201.t: jeh te avadhes ke praan hara(n) ||
201.e: On being married she asked for two boons from the king, which ultimately resulted in his death.

201.g: ਸਮਝੀ ਨ ਨਰੇਸਰ ਬਾਤ ਹੀਏ ॥
201.t: samajhee na naresar baat he'ee ||

201.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਹ ਕੋ ਬਰ ਦੋਇ ਦੀਏ ॥੧੫॥
201.t: tab hee teh ko bar dhoi dhe'ee ||15||
201.e: At that time, the king could not understand the mystery (of the boons) and gave his consent for them.15.

201.g: ਪੁਨ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਜੁੱਧ ਪਰੋ ॥
201.t: pun dhev adhevan ju'dh paro ||

201.g: ਜਹ ਜੁੱਧ ਘਣੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਆਪ ਕਰੋ ॥
201.t: jeh ju'dh ghano nirap aap karo ||
201.e: Then once a war was waged between the gods and demons, in which the king gave a tough fight from the side of gods.

201.g: ਹਤ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਸਯੰਦਨ ਨਾਰ ਹਕਿਯੋ ॥
201.t: hat saarathee saya(n)dhan naar hakiyo ||

201.g: ਯਹ ਕੌਤਕ ਦੇਖ ਨਰੇਸ ਚਕਿਯੋ ॥੧੬॥
201.t: yeh kauatak dhekh nares chakiyo ||16||
201.e: Seeing this, the king was amazed. ||16||

201.g: ਪੁਨ ਰੀਝ ਦਏ ਦੋਊ ਤੀਅ ਬਰੰ ॥
201.t: pun reejh dhe dhouoo teea bara(n) ||
201.e: The king was so pleased, he gave her two more gifts.

201.g: ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਸੁ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਰੰ ॥
201.t: chit mo su bichaar kachhoo na kara(n) ||
201.e: He did not have any distrust in his mind.

201.g: ਕਹੀ ਨਾਟਕ ਮੱਧ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
201.t: kahee naaTak ma'dh charitr kathaa ||
201.e: This story was originally told in the Dramas of Hanuman and the Ramayana.

201.g: ਜਯ ਦੀਨ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਨਰੇਸ ਜਥਾ ॥੧੭॥
201.t: jay dheen sures nares jathaa ||17||
201.e: Detailing how king Dasrath helped Indra, the king of deities, to victory. ||17||

201.g: ਅਰਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਧੰ ॥
201.t: ar jeet anek anek bidha(n) ||
201.e: Conquering many many enemies,

201.g: ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ਨਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਕੀਨ ਸਿਧੰ ॥
201.t: sabh kaaj naresavair keen sidha(n) ||
201.e: The king fulfilled his heart’s desires.

201.g: ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣ ਬਿਹਾਰਤ ਮੱਧਿ ਬਣੰ ॥
201.t: dhin rain bihaarat ma'dh bana(n) ||
201.e: Day and night the king was in the jungles.

201.g: ਜਲ ਲੈਨ ਦਿਜਾਇ ਤਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ॥੧੮॥
201.t: jal lain dhijai tahaa sravana(n) ||18||
201.e: One day, a Brahmin named Sharvan Kumar was searching there for water. ||18||

201.g: ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤ ਤਜੇ ਦੋਊ ਅੰਧ ਭੂਯੰ ॥
201.t: pit maat taje dhouoo a(n)dh bhooya(n) ||
201.e: Leaving his blind parents on the ground,

201.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਜਲੁ ਲੈਨ ਸੁਯੰ ॥
201.t: geh paatr chaliyo jal lain suya(n) ||
201.e: The son had come for water, holding a pitcher in his hand.

201.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਨੋ ਦਿਤ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਧਾਰ ਤਹਾ ॥
201.t: mun no dhit kaal sidhaar tahaa ||
201.e: That Brahmin sage was sent there by Death.

201.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬੈਠ ਪਤਊਵਨ ਬਾਧ ਜਹਾ ॥੧੯॥
201.t: nirap baiTh patuoovan baadh jahaa ||19||
201.e: To the place where the king was resting in a tent. ||19||

201.g: ਭਭਕੰਤ ਘਟੰ ਅਤਿ ਨਾਦਿ ਹੁਅੰ ॥
201.t: bhabhaka(n)t ghaTa(n) at naadh hua(n) ||
201.e: The pitcher filling with water made a sound.

201.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਕਾਨ ਪਰੀ ਅਜ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਅੰ ॥
201.t: dhun kaan paree aj raaj sua(n) ||
201.e: The sound filled the king's ears.

201.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਾਣ ਸੁ ਬਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਨ ਧਨੰ ॥
201.t: geh paan su baaneh taan dhana(n) ||
201.e: The king loaded the arrow in the bow and pulled the bowstring back.

201.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਾਣ ਦਿਜੰ ਸਰ ਸੁੱਧ ਹਨੰ ॥੨੦॥
201.t: mirag jaan dhija(n) sar su'dh hana(n) ||20||
201.e: Thinking the Brahmin was a deer, he shot the arrow and killed him. ||20||

201.g: ਗਿਰ ਗਯੋ ਸੁ ਲਗੇ ਸਰ ਸੁੱਧ ਮੁਨੰ ॥
201.t: gir gayo su lage sar su'dh muna(n) ||
201.e: On being struck by the arrow, the ascetic fell down.

201.g: ਨਿਸਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਹਹਕਾਰ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
201.t: nisaree mukh te hahakaar dhuna(n) ||
201.e: A yelp came from his mouth.

201.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਨਾਤ ਕਹਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਾਇ ਲਹੈ ॥
201.t: miraganaat kahaa nirap jai lahai ||
201.e: The king went to find the spot where the deer had died.

201.g: ਦਿਜ ਦੇਖ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਦਾਤ ਗਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
201.t: dhij dhekh dhouoo kar dhaat gahai ||21||
201.e: But on seeing the Brahmin, he pressed his hands to his cheeks (literally teeth, in surprise). ||21||

201.g: ਸਰਵਣ ਬਾਚਿ ॥
201.t: saravan baach ||
201.e: Speech of Shravan :

201.g: ਕਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਹ ਮੱਧ ਤਨੰ ॥
201.t: kachh praan rahe teh ma'dh tana(n) ||

201.g: ਨਿਕਰੰਤ ਕਹਾ ਜੀਅ ਬਿੱਪ੍ਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ॥
201.t: nikara(n)t kahaa jeea bi'pr nirapa(n) ||
201.e: There were still some life-breath in the body of Shravan. In his final life-breaths, the Brahmin said to the kind:

201.g: ਮੁਰ ਤਾਤ ਰੁ ਮਾਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਚੱਛ ਪਰੇ ॥
201.t: mur taat r maat niracha'chh pare ||

201.g: ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨ ਪਿਆਇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਧ ਮਰੇ ॥੨੨॥
201.t: teh paan piaai nirapaadh mare ||22||
201.e: “My mother and father are blind and are lying on that side. You go there and make them drink water, so that I may die peacefully.”22.

201.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
201.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||
201.e: PADDHRAI STANZA

201.g: ਬਿਨ ਚੱਛ ਭੂਪ ਦੋਊ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ॥
201.t: bin cha'chh bhoop dhouoo taat maat ||

201.g: ਤਿਨ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਨ ਤੁਹ ਕਹੌਂ ਬਾਤ ॥
201.t: tin dheh paan tuh kahaua(n) baat ||
201.e: “O king! both my parents are without sight, listen to me and give them water.

202.g: ਮਮ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕਹੀਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
202.t: mam kathaa na tin kaheeyo prabeen ||

202.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਰਯੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤੇਊ ਹੋਹਿ ਛੀਨ ॥੨੩॥
202.t: sun marayo putr teuoo hoh chheen ||23||
202.e: “Do not say anything me to them, otherwise they will die in extreme agony.”23.

202.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਜਬੈ ਦਿਜ ਕਹੈ ਬੈਨ ॥
202.t: eeh bhaat jabai dhij kahai bain ||

202.g: ਜਲ ਸੁਨਤ ਭੂਪ ਚੁਐ ਚਲੇ ਨੈਨ ॥
202.t: jal sunat bhoop chuaai chale nain ||
202.e: When Shravan Kumar said these words to the king about giving (to his blind parents) then tears gushed out of his eyes.

202.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੋਹ ਜਿਨ ਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੁਕਰਮ ॥
202.t: dhirag moh jin su keeno kukaram ||

202.g: ਹਤਿ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਅਰੁ ਗਯੋ ਧਰਮ ॥੨੪॥
202.t: hat bhayo raaj ar gayo dharam ||24||
202.e: The king said, “It is a disgrace for me that I have done such a deed, my royal merit has been destroyed and I am devoid of Dharma.”24.

202.g: ਜਬ ਲਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਤਿਹ ਸਰ ਨਿਕਾਰ ॥
202.t: jab layo bhoop teh sar nikaar ||

202.g: ਤਬ ਤਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮੁਨ ਬਰ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
202.t: tab taje praan mun bar udhaar ||
202.e: When the king pulled out Shravan from the pool, then that ascetic breathed his last.

202.g: ਪੁਨ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਵ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
202.t: pun bhayo raav man mai udhaas ||

202.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪਲਟ ਜਾਨ ਕੀ ਤਜੀ ਆਸ ॥੨੫॥
202.t: gireh palaT jaan kee tajee aas ||25||
202.e: Then the king became very sad and abandoned the idea of returning to his home.25.

202.g: ਜੀਅ ਠਟੀ ਕਿ ਧਾਰੋ ਜੋਗ ਭੇਸ ॥
202.t: jeea ThaTee k dhaaro jog bhes ||

202.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬਸੌ ਜਾਇ ਬਨਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੇਸ ॥
202.t: kahoo(n) basau jai ban tiaag dhes ||
202.e: He thought in his mind that he may wear the garb of Yogi and abide in the forest forsaking his royal duties.

202.g: ਕਿਹ ਕਾਜ ਮੋਰ ਯਹ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ॥
202.t: keh kaaj mor yeh raaj saaj ||

202.g: ਦਿਜ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੀਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਅਸ ਕੁਕਾਜ ॥੨੬॥
202.t: dhij maar keeyo jin as kukaaj ||26||
202.e: My royal duties are now meaningless for me, when I have committed a bad deed by killing a Brahmin. ||26||

202.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਕਹੀ ਪੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
202.t: eeh bhaat kahee pun nirap prabeen ||

202.g: ਸਭ ਜਗਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਕਰਮੈ ਅਧੀਨ ॥
202.t: sabh jagat kaal karamai adheen ||
202.e: The king then uttered these words, ‘I have brought under my control the situations of all the world, but now what hath been committed by me?

202.g: ਅਬ ਕਰੋ ਕਛੂ ਐਸੋ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
202.t: ab karo kachhoo aaiso upai ||

202.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸੁ ਬਚੈ ਤਿਹ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਇ ॥੨੭॥
202.t: jaa te su bachai teh taat mai ||27||
202.e: ‘Now I should take such measures, that may cause his parents to survive.’27.

202.g: ਭਰਿ ਲਯੋ ਕੁੰਭ ਸਿਰ ਪੈ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
202.t: bhar layo ku(n)bh sir pai uThai ||

202.g: ਤੱਹ ਗਯੋ ਜਹਾ ਦਿਜ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਇ ॥
202.t: ta'h gayo jahaa dhij taat mai ||
202.e: The king filled the pitcher with water and lifted it on his head and reached at the spot, where the parents of Shravan had been lying.

202.g: ਜਬ ਗਯੋ ਨਿਕਟ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸੁ ਧਾਰ ॥
202.t: jab gayo nikaT tin ke su dhaar ||

202.g: ਤਬ ਲਖੀ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਵ ਚਾਰ ॥੨੮॥
202.t: tab lakhee dhuhoo(n) teh paav chaar ||28||
202.e: When the king reached near them with very slow steps, then they heard the voice of the moving footsteps.28.

202.g: ਦਿਜ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋਂ ॥
202.t: dhij baach raajaa so(n) ||
202.e: The speech of the Brahmin addressed to the King :

202.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
202.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||
202.e: PADDHRAI STANZA

202.g: ਕੱਹ ਕਹੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੀ ਅਵਾਰ ॥
202.t: ka'h kaho putr laagee avaar ||

202.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੋਨ ਭੂਪਤ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
202.t: sun rahio mon bhoopat udhaar ||
202.e: “O Son! Tell us the reason for so much delay. “Hearing these words the large-hearted king remained silent.

202.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਕਹਯੋ ਕਾਹਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਨ ਪੂਤ ॥
202.t: fir kahayo kaeh bolat na poot ||

202.g: ਚੁਪ ਰਹੇ ਰਾਜ ਲਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਸੂਤ ॥੨੯॥
202.t: chup rahe raaj leh kai kasoot ||29||
202.e: They again said, “O son! Why do you not speak?” The king, fearing his reply to be unfavorable, again remained silent.29.

202.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦੀਓ ਪਾਨ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
202.t: nirap dheeo paan teh paan jai ||

202.g: ਚਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਅੰਧ ਤਿਹ ਕਰ ਛੁਹਾਇ ॥
202.t: chak rahe a(n)dh teh kar chhuhai ||
202.e: Coming near them, the king gave them water  then on touching his hand those blind persons, .

202.g: ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੂ ਆਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
202.t: kar kop kahiyo too aaeh koi ||

202.g: ਇਮ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਬਦ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦਯੋ ਰੋਇ ॥੩੦॥
202.t: eim sunat sabadh nirap dhayo roi ||30||
202.e: Getting bewildered, asked angrily about his identity. Hearing these words, the king began to weep.30

202.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚ ਦਿਜ ਸੋਂ ॥
202.t: raajaa baach dhij so(n) ||
202.e: The speech of the King addressed to the Brahmin:

202.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
202.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||
202.e: PADDHRAI STANZA

202.g: ਹੱਉ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਘਾਤ ਤਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੇਸ ॥
202.t: ha'au putr ghaat tav brahamanes ||

202.g: ਜਿਹ ਹਨਿਯੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਤਵ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਦੇਸ ॥
202.t: jeh haniyo sravan tav sut sudhes ||
202.e: “O eminent Brahmin! I am the killer of your son, I am the one who hast killed your son.”

202.g: ਮੈ ਪਰਯੋ ਸਰਣ ਦਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ॥
202.t: mai parayo saran dhasarath rai ||

202.g: ਚਾਹੋ ਸੁ ਕਰੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿੱਪ ਆਇ ॥੩੧॥
202.t: chaaho su karo moh bi'p aai ||31||
202.e: “I am Dasrath, seeking your refuge, O Brahmin! Do to me whatever you wish.31.

202.g: ਰਾਖੈ ਤੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਤੁ ਮਾਰੁ ॥
202.t: raakhai ta raakh maarai ta maar ||

202.g: ਮੈ ਪਰੋ ਸਰਣ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
202.t: mai paro saran tumarai dhuaar ||
202.e: “If you want, you may protect me, otherwise kill me, I am under your shelter, I am here before you.”

202.g: ਤਬ ਕਹੀ ਕਿਨੋ ਦਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ॥
202.t: tab kahee kino dhasarath rai ||

202.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥੩੨॥
202.t: bahu kaasaT agan dhavai dhei ma(n)gai ||32||
202.e: Then the king Dasrath, on their bidding, asked some attendant to bring good deal of wood for burning.32.

202.g: ਤਬ ਲੀਯੋ ਅਧਿਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
202.t: tab leeyo adhik kaasaT ma(n)gai ||

202.g: ਚੜ ਬੈਠੇ ਤਹਾ ਸਲ੍ਰਹ੍ਰਹ ਕਉ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
202.t: chaR baiThe tahaa salrahreh kau banai ||
202.e: A great load of wood was brought, and they (the blind parents) got prepared the funeral pyres and sat on them.

202.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਦਈ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
202.t: chahoo(n) or dhiee juaalaa jagai ||

202.g: ਦਿਜ ਜਾਨ ਗਈ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਿਰਾਇ ॥੩੩॥
202.t: dhij jaan giee paavak sirai ||33||
202.e: The fire was lighted on all the four sides and in this way those Brahmins caused the end of their lives.33.

202.g: ਤਬ ਜੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਉਪ੍ਰਾਜ ॥
202.t: tab jog agan tan te upraaj ||

202.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਰਨ ਜਰਨ ਕੋ ਸਜਿਯੋ ਸਾਜ ॥
202.t: dhuhoo(n) maran jaran ko sajiyo saaj ||
202.e: They created the fire of Yoga form their bodies and wanted to be reduced to ashes.

203.g: ਤੇ ਭਸਮ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਬੀਚ ਆਪ ॥
203.t: te bhasam bhe teh beech aap ||

203.g: ਤਿਹ ਕੋਪ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦੀਯੋ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੩੪॥
203.t: teh kop dhuhoo(n) nirap dheeyo sraap ||34||
203.e: Both of them reduced themselves to ashes and in their final hour cursed the king in great anger.34.

203.g: ਦਿਜ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋਂ ॥
203.t: dhij baach raajaa so(n) ||
203.e: The speech of the Brahmin addressed to the King :

203.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
203.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||

203.g: ਜਿਮ ਤਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਮ ਸੁਤਿ ਬਿਛੋਹਿ ॥
203.t: jim taje praan ham sut bichhoh ||

203.g: ਤਿਮ ਲਗੋ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਸੁਨ ਭੂਪ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
203.t: tim lago sraap sun bhoop toh ||
203.e: “O king! The manner in which we are breathing our last, you will also experience the same situation.”

203.g: ਇਮ ਭਾਖ ਜਰਯੋ ਦਿਜ ਸਹਿਤ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
203.t: eim bhaakh jarayo dhij sahit naar ||

203.g: ਤਜ ਦੇਹ ਕੀਯੋ ਸੁਰਪੁਰ ਬਿਹਾਰ ॥੩੫॥
203.t: taj dheh keeyo surapur bihaar ||35||
203.e: Saying this, the Brahmin was burnt to ashes alongwith his wife and went to heaven.35.

203.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
203.t: raajaa baach ||

203.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
203.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||

203.g: ਤਬ ਚਹੀ ਭੂਪ ਹਉਾਂ ਜਰੋਂ ਆਜ ॥
203.t: tab chahee bhoop hauaa(n) jaro(n) aaj ||

203.g: ਕੈ ਅਤਿਥਿ ਹੋਊਾਂ ਤਜ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ॥
203.t: kai atith houooaa(n) taj raaj saaj ||
203.e: Then the king expressed this wish that either he would burn himself that day or forsaking his kingdom, he would go to the forest,

203.g: ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਜੈ ਕੈ ਕਰਹੋਂ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
203.t: kai greh jai kai karaho(n) uchaar ||

203.g: ਮੈ ਦਿਜ ਆਯੋ ਨਿਜ ਕਰ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥੩੬॥
203.t: mai dhij aayo nij kar sa(n)ghaar ||36||
203.e: ‘What will I say at home? That I am coming back after killing the Brahmin with my own hand! 36.

203.g: ਦੇਵ ਬਾਨੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
203.t: dhev baanee baach ||

203.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
203.t: paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||

203.g: ਤਬ ਭਈ ਦੇਵ ਬਾਨੀ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
203.t: tab bhiee dhev baanee banai ||

203.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਰੋ ਦੁੱਖ ਦਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ॥
203.t: jin karo dhu'kh dhasarath rai ||
203.e: Then there was an utterance from heavens: “O Dasrath! Do not be sad

203.g: ਤਵ ਧਾਮ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਨ ॥
203.t: tav dhaam hohige putr bisan ||

203.g: ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ਆਜ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਜਿਸਨ ॥੩੭॥
203.t: sabh kaaj aaj sidh bhe jisan ||37||
203.e: “Vishnu will take birth as son in your home and through him, the impact of the sinful deed of this day will end.37.

203.g: ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਮਾਵਤਾਰ ॥
203.t: havai hai su naam raamaavataar ||

203.g: ਕਰ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਸਕਲ ਜਗ ਕੋ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
203.t: kar hai su sakal jag ko udhaar ||
203.e: “He will be famous by the name of Ramavtar and he will redeem the whole world

203.g: ਕਰ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਤਨਕ ਮੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਨਾਸ ॥
203.t: kar hai su tanak mai dhusaT naas ||

203.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਕੀਰਤ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੩੮॥
203.t: eeh bhaat keerat kar hai prakaas ||38||
203.e: “He will destroy the tyrants in an instant and in this way his fame will spread on all the four sides.”38.

204.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
204.t: naraaj chha(n)dh ||
204.e: NARAAJ STANZA

204.g: ਨਚਿੰਤ ਭੂਪ ਚਿੰਤ ਧਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਆਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: nachi(n)t bhoop chi(n)t dhaam raam rai aai hai(n) ||
204.e: “O king! Forsake all anxiety and go to your home, the king Ram will come to your home

204.g: ਦੁਰੰਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਜੈਤ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: dhura(n)t dhusaT jeet kai su jait pa'tr pai hai(n) ||
204.e: On conquering the tyrants he will botain the deed of victory from all

204.g: ਅਖਰਬ ਗਰਬ ਜੇ ਭਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਗਰਬ ਘਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: akharab garab je bhare su sarab garab ghaal hai(n) ||
204.e: “He will shatter the pride of egoists

204.g: ਫਿਰਾਇ ਛੱਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਸ ਪੈ ਛਤੀਸ ਛੋਣ ਪਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੯॥
204.t: firai chha'tr sees pai chhatees chhon paal hai(n) ||39||
204.e: Having royal canopy over his head, he will sustain all.39.

204.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੈ ਅਡੰਡ ਡੰਡ ਦੰਡ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: akha(n)dd kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kai adda(n)dd dda(n)dd dha(n)dd hai(n) ||
204.e: “He will repudiate the mighty ones and punish those, whom none has been able to punish upto this day

204.g: ਅਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਰਾਜ ਮੰਡ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: ajeet jeet jeet kai bisekh raaj ma(n)dd hai(n) ||
204.e: He will extend his domains by conquering the unconquerable and removing all the blemishes

204.g: ਕਲੰਕ ਦੂਰ ਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਲੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
204.t: kala(n)k dhoor kai sabhai nisa(n)k la(n)k ghai hai(n) ||

204.g: ਸੁ ਜੀਤ ਬਾਹ ਬੀਸ ਗਰਬ ਈਸ ਕੋ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥੪੦॥
204.t: s jeet baeh bees garab iees ko miTai hai(n) ||40||
204.e: “He will definitely conquer Lanka and conquering Ravana, he will shatter his pride.40.

204.g: ਸਿਧਾਰ ਭੂਪ ਧਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਤੋ ਨ ਸੋਕ ਕੋ ਧਰੋ ॥
204.t: sidhaar bhoop dhaam ko ito na sok ko dharo ||

204.g: ਬੁਲਾਇ ਬਿੱਪ ਛੋਣ ਕੇ ਅਰੰਭ ਜੱਗ ਕੋ ਕਰੋ ॥
204.t: bulai bi'p chhon ke ara(n)bh ja'g ko karo ||
204.e: “O king! Go to your home forsaking the anxiety and begin the Yajna by calling the Brahmins.”

204.g: ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬੈਣ ਰਾਵ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀਐ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਅੰ ॥
204.t: suna(n)t bain raav raajadhaaneeaai sidhaareea(n) ||

204.g: ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕੋ ਸੁਧਾਰੀਅੰ ॥੪੧॥
204.t: bulai kai basisaT raajasooi ko sudhaareea(n) ||41||
204.e: Hearing these words, the king came to his capital and calling the sage Vasishtha, he determined to perform the Rajsuya Yajna.41.

204.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਨਰੇਸ ਬੋਲ ਕੈ ਲਏ ॥
204.t: anek dhes dhes ke nares bol kai le ||

204.g: ਦਿਜੇਸ ਬੇਸ ਬੇਸ ਕੇ ਛਿਤੇਸ ਧਾਮ ਆ ਗਏ ॥
204.t: dhijes bes bes ke chhites dhaam aa ge ||
204.e: He invited the kings of many countries and also the Brahmin of different garbs reached there.

204.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਤ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਾਨ ਬੋਲ ਕੈ ਲਏ ॥
204.t: anek bhaat maan kai dhivaan bol kai le ||

204.g: ਸੁ ਜੱਗ ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕੋ ਅਰੰਭ ਤਾ ਦਿਨਾ ਭਏ ॥੪੨॥
204.t: s ja'g raajasooi ko ara(n)bh taa dhinaa bhe ||42||
204.e: The king honoured all in many ways and the Rajsuya Yajna began.42.

204.g: ਸੁ ਪਾਦਿ ਅਰਘ ਆਸਨੰ ਅਨੇਕ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਕੈ ॥
204.t: s paadh aragh aasana(n) anek dhoop dheep kai ||

204.g: ਪਖਾਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੰ ਪ੍ਰਦੱਛਣਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਦੈ ॥
204.t: pakhaar pai brahamana(n) pradha'chhanaa bisekh dhai ||
204.e: Washing the feet of Brahmins and giving them their seats and buring the incenses and earthen lampas, the king circumambulated the Brahmins in a special manner.

204.g: ਕਰੋਰ ਕੋਰ ਦੱਛਨਾ ਦਿਜੇਕ ਏਕ ਕਉ ਦਈ ॥
204.t: karor kor dha'chhanaa dhijek ek kau dhiee ||

204.g: ਸੁ ਜੱਗ ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕੀ ਅਰੰਭ ਤਾ ਦਿਨਾ ਭਈ ॥੪੩॥
204.t: s ja'g raajasooi kee ara(n)bh taa dhinaa bhiee ||43||
204.e: He gave millions of coins to each Brahmin as religious gift and in this way, the Rajsuya Yajna begin.43.

204.g: ਨਟੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
204.t: naTes dhes dhes ke anek geet gaavahee ||

204.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸੋਭ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
204.t: ana(n)t dhaan maan lai bisekh sobh paavahee ||
204.e: The comedians and minstrels from various countries began to sing songs and obtaining various kinds of honours they were well-seated in a special manner.

204.g: ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੇ ਭਏ ਸੁ ਜਾਤ ਕਉਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੇ ॥
204.t: prasa(n)n log je bhe su jaat kaun te kahe ||

204.g: ਬਿਮਾਨ ਆਸਮਾਨ ਕੇ ਪਛਾਨ ਮੋਨ ਹੁਐ ਰਹੇ ॥੪੪॥
204.t: bimaan aasamaan ke pachhaan mon huaai rahe ||44||
204.e: The pleasure of the people is indescribable and there were so many air-vehicles in the sky that they could not be recognized.44.

204.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਜਿਤੀ ਅਪੱਛਰਾ ਚਲੀ ਸੁਵਰਗ ਛੋਰ ਕੈ ॥
204.t: hutee jitee apa'chharaa chalee suvarag chhor kai ||

204.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਹਾਇ ਭਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਚੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਮੋਰ ਕੈ ॥
204.t: bisekh hai bhai kai nacha(n)t a(n)g mor kai ||
204.e: The heavenly damsels, leaving the heaven, were turning their limbs in special postures and dancing.

204.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਭੂਪ ਰੀਝਹੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
204.t: bia(n)t bhoop reejhahee ana(n)t dhaan paavahee(n) ||

204.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਅੱਛਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਪੱਛਰਾ ਲਜਾਵਹੀਂ ॥੪੫॥
204.t: bilok a'chharaan ko apa'chharaa lajaavahee(n) ||45||
204.e: Many kings, in their pleasure were giving charities and seeing their beautiful queens, the heavenly damsel were feeling shy.45.

204.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਲਏ ॥
204.t: ana(n)t dhaan maan dhai bulai sooramaa le ||

204.g: ਦੁਰੰਤ ਸੈਨ ਸੰਗ ਦੈ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸਾ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ॥
204.t: dhura(n)t sain sa(n)g dhai dhaso dhisaa paThai dhe ||
204.e: Bestowing various types of gifts and honours, the king called many mighty heroes and sent them in all the ten directions alongwith he tough forces.

204.g: ਨਰੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੇਸ ਪਾਇ ਪਾਰੀਅੰ ॥
204.t: nares dhes dhes ke nirapes pai paareea(n) ||

204.g: ਮਹੇਸ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਸੁ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤ੍ਰ ਢਾਰੀਅੰ ॥੪੬॥
204.t: mahes jeet kai sabhai su chhatrapatr ddaareea(n) ||46||
204.e: They conquered the kings of many countries and made them subservient to Dasrath and in this why, conquering the kings of the whole world, brought them before the Sovereign Dasrath.46.

204.g: ਰੂਆਮਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
204.t: rooaamal chha(n)dh ||
204.e: ROOAAMAL STANZA

204.g: ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ਨਰੇਸੁਰ ਸੱਤ੍ਰ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
204.t: jeet jeet nirapa(n) naresur sa'tr mi'tr bulai ||

204.g: ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਸਿਸਟ ਤੇ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਰਿਖਰਾਇ ॥
204.t: bipr aadh bisisaT te lai kai sabhai rikharai ||
204.e: After conquering the kinds, the king Dasrath called together the enemies as well as friends, the sages like Vashisht and the Brahmins.

204.g: ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਜੁੱਧ ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਸੁਦੇਸ ॥
204.t: kru'dh ju'dh kare ghane avagaeh gaeh sudhes ||

204.g: ਆਨ ਆਨ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਲਾਗੀਅੰ ਅਵਨੇਸ ॥੪੭॥
204.t: aan aan avadhes ke pag laageea(n) avanes ||47||
204.e: Those who did not accept his supremacy, in great fury, he destroyed them and in this way the kings of all the earth became subservient to the king of Oudh.47.

204.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਦੈ ਲਏ ਸਨਮਾਨ ਆਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
204.t: bhaat bhaatin dhai le sanamaan aan nirapaal ||

204.g: ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬਨ ਦਰਬ ਦੈ ਗਜ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
204.t: arab kharaban dharab dhai gaj raaj baaj bisaal ||
204.e: All the kings were honoured in various ways  they were given the wealth, elephants and horses equivalent to millions and billions of gold coin.

204.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰਨ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਗਨ ਜਟਤ ਜੀਨ ਜਰਾਇ ॥
204.t: heer cheeran ko sakai gan jaTat jeen jarai ||

204.g: ਭਾਉ ਭੂਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਿਧ ਤੇ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
204.t: bhaau bhookhan ko kahai bidh te na jaat batai ||48||
204.e: The garments studded with diamonds and the saddles of horses studded with gems cannot be enumerated and even Brahma cannot describe the grandeur of the ornaments.48.

204.g: ਪਸਮ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿਕ ਦੀਏ ਭੂਪਨ ਭੂਪ ॥
204.t: pasam basatr paTa(n)baraadhik dhe'ee bhoopan bhoop ||

204.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਰੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੋਭਿਤ ਕਉਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਰੂਪੁ ॥
204.t: roop aroop saroop sobhit kaun i(n)dhr karoop ||
204.e: The woolen and silken garments were given by the king and seeing the beauty of all the people it seemed that even Indra was ugly before them.

204.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟ ਤ੍ਰਸੈ ਸਭੈ ਥਰਹਰਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਿਰਰਾਇ ॥
204.t: dhusaT pusaT trasai sabhai tharaharayo sun girarai ||

204.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿਨ ਦੈ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਾਟਿ ਬਾਟਿ ਲੁਟਾਇ ॥੪੯॥
204.t: kaaT kaaTin dhai mujhai nirap baaT baaT luTai ||49||
204.e: All the tyrants were frightened and even the Sumeru mountain trembled with fear that the king may not chop him and distribute his bits to the participants.49.

204.g: ਬੇਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਦਿਜ ਕੀਅਸ ਜੱਗ ਅਰੰਭ ॥
204.t: bedh dhun kar kai sabhai dhij keeas ja'g ara(n)bh ||

204.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਹੋਮਤ ਰਿੱਤ ਜਾਨ ਅਸੰਭ ॥
204.t: bhaat bhaat bulai homat ri't jaan asa(n)bh ||
204.e: All the Brahmins started the Yajna by reciting the Vedic performed the havan (fire-worship) in accordance with the mantras.

205.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿਬਰ ਜਉ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਿਧ ਪੂਰਬ ਹੋਮ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
205.t: adhik munibar jau keeyo bidh poorab hom banai ||

205.g: ਜਗ ਕੁੰਡਹੁ ਤੇ ਉਠੇ ਤਬ ਜਗ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਕੁਲਾਇ ॥੫੦॥
205.t: jag ku(n)ddahu te uThe tab jag purakh akulai ||50||
205.e: When many sages and hermits performed the havan in appropriate manner, then from the sacrificial pit arose the agitated sacrificial purushas.50.

205.g: ਖੀਰ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਢਾਇ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਆਨ ॥
205.t: kheer paatr kaddai lai kar dheen nirap ke aan ||

205.g: ਭੂਪ ਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਭਯੋ ਜਿਮੁ ਦਾਰਦੀ ਲੈ ਦਾਨ ॥
205.t: bhoop pai prasa(n)n bhayo jim dhaaradhee lai dhaan ||
205.e: They had a milkpot in their hands, which they gave to the king. The kiing Dasrath was so much pleased on obtaining it, just as a pauper is pleased on receiving a gift.

205.g: ਚਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਗ ਕਰਯੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਜ ਪਾਨ ਲੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥
205.t: chatr bhaag karayo tisai nij paan lai niraparai ||

205.g: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਦਯੋ ਦੁਹੂ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਇ ॥੫੧॥
205.t: ek ek dhayo dhuhoo treea ek ko dhui bhai ||51||
205.e: The king divided it into four parts with his own hands and gave one part each to two queen and two parts to the third one.51.

205.g: ਗਰਭਵੰਤ ਭਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਛੀਰ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਨ ॥
205.t: garabhava(n)t bhiee tirayo tiray chheer ko kar paan ||

205.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਰਾਖਤ ਭੀ ਭਲੋ ਦਸ ਦੋਇ ਮਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
205.t: taeh raakhat bhee bhalo dhas dhoi maas pramaan ||
205.e: The queens on drinking that milk, became pregnant and remained as such for twelve months.

205.g: ਮਾਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਉਦਸਮੋ ਚਢਯੋ ਤਬ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੇਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
205.t: maas triaudhasamo chaddayo tab sa(n)tan het udhaar ||

205.g: ਰਾਵਣਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਆਨ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੫੨॥
205.t: raavanaar pragaT bhe jag aan raam avataar ||52||
205.e: At the beginning of the thirteenth month, Ram, the enemy of Ravan incarnated for the protection of the saints.52.

205.g: ਭਰਥ ਲਛਮਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੁਘਨ ਪੁਨਿ ਭਏ ਤੀਨ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
205.t: bharath lachhaman satrughan pun bhe teen kumaar ||

205.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਬਾਜੀਯੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਜਨ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
205.t: bhaat bhaatin baajeeya(n) nirap raaj baajan dhuaar ||
205.e: Then the three princes named Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughan were born and various kinds of musical instruments were played at the gate of Dasrath’s palace.

205.g: ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਬਿੱਪਨ ਦੀਨ ਦਾਨ ਦੁਰੰਤਿ ॥
205.t: pai laag bulai bi'pan dheen dhaan dhura(n)t ||

205.g: ਸੱਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਸਤ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ਹੈਂ ਸਭ ਸੰਤ ॥੫੩॥
205.t: sa'tr naasat hohige sukh pai hai(n) sabh sa(n)t ||53||
205.e: Bowing at the feet of Brahmins, he gave them innumerable gifts and all the people felt that now the enemies will be destroyed nad the saints will attain peace and comfort.53.

205.g: ਲਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਟ ਰਿਖਬਰ ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
205.t: laal jaal pravesaT rikhabar baaj raaj samaaj ||

205.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਦੇਤ ਭਯੋ ਦਿਜ ਪਤਨ ਕੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ॥
205.t: bhaat bhaatin dhet bhayo dhij patan ko niraparaaj ||
205.e: Wearing the necklaces of diamonds and jewels, the sages are extending th royal glory and the king is presenting documents to the twice-born (dvijas) for gold and silver.

205.g: ਦੇਸ ਅਉਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਭੀਤਰ ਠਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਮਹੰਤ ॥
205.t: dhes aaur bidhes bheetar Thaur Thaur maha(n)t ||

205.g: ਨਾਚ ਨਾਚ ਉਠੇ ਸਭੈ ਜਨੁ ਆਜ ਲਾਗ ਬਸੰਤ ॥੫੪॥
205.t: naach naach uThe sabhai jan aaj laag basa(n)t ||54||
205.e: The chieftains of various places are exhibiting their delight and all the people are dancing like the frolicsome people in the spring season.54.

205.g: ਕਿੰਕਣੀਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਲ ਭੂਖਤਿ ਬਾਜ ਅਉ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥
205.t: ki(n)kaneen ke jaal bhookhat baaj aau gajaraaj ||

205.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਦਏ ਦਿਜੇਸਨ ਆਜ ਕਉਸਲ ਰਾਜ ॥
205.t: saaj saaj dhe dhijesan aaj kausal raaj ||
205.e: The network of bells is seen decorate on the elephants and horses nd such-like elephants and horses have been presented by the kings to Dasrath, the husband of Kaushalya.

205.g: ਰੰਕ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਘਨੇ ਤਹ ਰੰਕ ਰਾਜਨ ਜੈਸ ॥
205.t: ra(n)k raaj bhe ghane teh ra(n)k raajan jais ||

205.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਮਤ ਭਯੋ ਉਤਸਵ ਅਉਧ ਪੁਰ ਮੈ ਐਸ ॥੫੫॥
205.t: raam janamat bhayo utasav aaudh pur mai aais ||55||
205.e: There has been festival in Ayodhya on the birth of ram that the beggars laden with gifts have become kinglike.55.

205.g: ਦੁੰਦਭ ਅਉਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਤੂਰ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਤਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
205.t: dhu(n)dhabh aaur miradha(n)g toor tura(n)g taan anek ||

205.g: ਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਬਜੰਤ ਛੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਬਿਸੇਖ ॥
205.t: been been baja(n)t chheen prabeen been bisekh ||
205.e: The tunes of drums and clarionets are being heard alongwith the sound of flutes and lyres.

205.g: ਝਾਝ ਬਾਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੁਰਹੀ ਭੇਰਨਾਦਿ ਨਿਯਾਨ ॥
205.t: jhaajh baar tara(n)g turahee bheranaadh niyaan ||

205.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ ਸਰਬ ਬਯੋਮ ਬਿਵਾਨ ॥੫੬॥
205.t: moh moh gire dharaa par sarab bayom bivaan ||56||
205.e: The sound of bells, walrus and kettledrums are audible and these sound are so attaractive that the air-vehicles of gods, being impressed are coming down to the earth.56.

205.g: ਜੱਤ੍ਰ ਤੱਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਨ ਹੋਤ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ॥
205.t: ja'tr ta'tr bidhes dhesan hot ma(n)galachaar ||

205.g: ਬੈਠਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੇ ਸਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
205.t: baiTh baiTh karai lage sab bipr bedh bichaar ||
205.e: Here, there and everywhere the songs of praise are being sung and the Brahmins have begun the discussion on Vedas.

205.g: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਮਹੀਪ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਤ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
205.t: dhoop dheep maheep greh saneh dhet banai ||

205.g: ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਗਣ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਨ ਰਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
205.t: fool fool firai sabhai gan dhev dhevan rai ||57||
205.e: Because of the incense and earthen lamps, the palace of the king has become so impressive that Indra alongwith gods are moving hither and thither in their delight.57.

205.g: ਆਜ ਕਾਜ ਭਏ ਸਬੈ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਨ ॥
205.t: aaj kaaj bhe sabai ieh bhaat bolat bain ||

205.g: ਭੂੰਮ ਭੂਰ ਉਠੀ ਜਯਤ ਧੁਨ ਬਾਜ ਬਾਜਤ ਗੈਨ ॥
205.t: bhoo(n)m bhoor uThee jayat dhun baaj baajat gain ||
205.e: All the people are saying that on that day all their wishes have been fulfilled. The earth is filled with shouts of victory and the musical instruments are being played in the sky.

205.g: ਐਨ ਐਨ ਧੁਜਾ ਬਧੀ ਸਭ ਬਾਟ ਬੰਦਨਵਾਰ ॥
205.t: aain aain dhujaa badhee sabh baaT ba(n)dhanavaar ||

205.g: ਲੀਪ ਲੀਪ ਧਰੇ ਮੱਲਯਾਗਰ ਹਾਟ ਪਾਟ ਬਜਾਰ ॥੫੮॥
205.t: leep leep dhare ma'layaagar haaT paaT bajaar ||58||
205.e: There are small flags at all the places, there are greetings on all the paths and all shops and bazaars have been plastered with sandalwood.58.

205.g: ਸਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਤ ਦੀਨਨ ਦਾਨ ॥
205.t: saaj saaj tura(n)g ka(n)chan dhet dheenan dhaan ||

205.g: ਮਸਤ ਹਸਤਿ ਦਏ ਅਨੇਕਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੁਰਦ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
205.t: masat hasat dhe anekan i(n)dhr dhuradh samaan ||
205.e: The poor people are being given the horses decorated with gold, and many intoxicated elephants like Airavat (the elephant of Indra) are being given in charity.

205.g: ਕਿੰਕਣੀ ਕੇ ਜਾਲ ਭੂਖਤ ਦਏ ਸਯੰਦਨ ਸੁੱਧ ॥
205.t: ki(n)kanee ke jaal bhookhat dhe saya(n)dhan su'dh ||

205.g: ਗਾਇਨਨ ਕੇ ਪੁਰ ਮਨੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਆਵਤ ਬੁੱਧ ॥੫੯॥
205.t: gainan ke pur mano ieh bhaat aavat bu'dh ||59||
205.e: The horses studded with bells are being given as gifts  it appears that in the city of singers, the prudence is coming by itself.59.

205.g: ਬਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਦਏ ਇਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰ ॥
205.t: baaj saaj dhe ite jeh paieeaai nahee paar ||

205.g: ਦਯੋਸ ਦਯੋਸ ਬਢੈ ਲਗਯੋ ਰਨਧੀਰ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ॥
205.t: dhayos dhayos baddai lagayo ranadheer raamavataar ||
205.e: The innumerable horses and elephants were given as gifts by the king on one hand and Ram began to grow day by day on the other hand.

205.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੀ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਧ ਦੀਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁਧਾਰ ॥
205.t: sasatr saasatran kee sabhai bidh dheen taeh sudhaar ||

205.g: ਅਸਟ ਦਯੋਸਨ ਮੋ ਗਏ ਲੈ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਮਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੬੦॥
205.t: asaT dhayosan mo ge lai sarab raamakumaar ||60||
205.e: He was taught all the required wisdom of the arms and religious texts and Ram learned everything within eight days (i.e. a very short period).60.

205.g: ਬਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਬਿਹਰੰਤ ਸਰਜੂ ਤੀਰ ॥
205.t: baan paan kamaan lai bihara(n)t sarajoo teer ||

205.g: ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤ ਪਿਛੋਰ ਕਾਰਨ ਧੀਰ ਚਾਰਹੁੰ ਬੀਰ ॥
205.t: peet peet pichhor kaaran dheer chaarahu(n) beer ||
205.e: They began to roam on the banks of the Saryu river and all the four brother collected the yellow leaves and butterflies.

205.g: ਬੇਖ ਬੇਖ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹਰੰਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਸੰਗ ॥
205.t: bekh bekh nirapaan ke bihara(n)t baalak sa(n)g ||

205.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਧਰੇ ਤਨ ਚੀਰ ਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ॥੬੧॥
205.t: bhaat bhaatan ke dhare tan cheer ra(n)g tara(n)g ||61||
205.e: Seeing all the princes moving together, eh waves of Saryu exhibited many coloured garments.61.

205.g: ਐਸਿ ਬਾਤ ਭਈ ਇਤੈ ਉਹ ਓਰ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਮਿਤ੍ਰ ॥
205.t: aais baat bhiee itai uh or bisavaiaamitr ||

205.g: ਜੱਗ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਅਰੰਭਨ ਤੋਖਨਾਰਥ ਪਿਤ੍ਰ ॥
205.t: ja'g ko su kariyo ara(n)bhan tokhanaarath pitr ||
205.e: All this was going on this side and on the other side Vishwamitra began a Yajna for the worship of his manes.

206.g: ਹੋਮ ਕੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਉਠ ਧਾਤ ਦੈਤ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
206.t: hom kee lai baasanaa uTh dhaat dhait dhura(n)t ||

206.g: ਲੂਟ ਖਾਤ ਸਬੈ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਮਾਰ ਕੂਟਿ ਮਹੰਤ ॥੬੨॥
206.t: looT khaat sabai samagaree maar kooT maha(n)t ||62||
206.e: Attracted by the incense of fire-worship (Havana), the demons would come to the sacrificial pit and would eat the materials of Yajna, snatching it from the performer.62.

206.g: ਲੂਟ ਖਾਤਹ ਵਿਖਯ ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਪੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
206.t: looT khaateh vikhay je tin pai kachhoo na basai ||

206.g: ਤਾਕ ਅਉਧਹ ਆਇਯੋ ਤਬ ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
206.t: taak aaudheh aaiyo tab ros kai mun rai ||
206.e: Seeing the loot of the materials of the fire-worship and feeling himself helpless, the great sage Vishwamitra came to Ayodhya in great anger.

206.g: ਆਇ ਭੂਪਤ ਕੱਉ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ॥
206.t: aai bhoopat ka'au kahaa sut dheh mo kau raam ||

206.g: ਨਾਤ੍ਰ ਤੋ ਕੱਉ ਭਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਹੱਉ ਆਜ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਠਾਮ ॥੬੩॥
206.t: naatr to ka'au bhasam kar ha'au aaj hee ieh Thaam ||63||
206.e: On reaching (Ayodhya) he said to the king. “Give me your son Ram for a few days, otherwise I shall reduce you to ashes on this very spot.”63.

206.g: ਕੋਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੁਨੀਸ ਕੱਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਪੂਤ ਤਾ ਸੰਗ ਦੀਨ ॥
206.t: kop dhekh munees ka'au nirap poot taa sa(n)g dheen ||

206.g: ਜੱਗ ਮੰਡਲ ਕੱਉ ਚਲਯੋ ਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
206.t: ja'g ma(n)ddal ka'au chalayo lai taeh sa(n)g prabeen ||
206.e: Visualising the fury of the sage, the king asked his son to accompany him and the sage accompanied by Ram went to begin the Yajna again.

206.g: ਏਕ ਮਾਰਗ ਦੂਰ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਨੀਅਰ ਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
206.t: ek maarag dhoor hai ik neear hai sun raam ||

206.g: ਰਾਹ ਮਾਰਤ ਰਾਛਸੀ ਜਿਹ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਗਨਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੬੪॥
206.t: raeh maarat raachhasee jeh taarakaa gan naam ||64||
206.e: The sage said, “O Ram! listen, there are two routes, on the one the Yajna-spot is far away and on the other it is quit near, but on the later route there lives a demoness named Taraka, who kills the wayfares.64.

206.g: ਜਉਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਤੀਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਆਜ ॥
206.t: jaun maarag teer hai teh raeh chaalahu aaj ||

206.g: ਚਿੱਤ ਚਿੰਤ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਦਿਵ ਦੇਵ ਕੇ ਹੈਂ ਕਾਜ ॥
206.t: chi't chi(n)t na keejeeaai dhiv dhev ke hai(n) kaaj ||
206.e: Ram said, “Let us go by the small-distance-route, abandoning the anxiety, this work of killing the demons is the work of the gods.”

206.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਚਾਪੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈਂ ਤਬ ਲਉ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਆਨ ॥
206.t: baaT chaapai jaat hai(n) tab lau nisaachar aan ||

206.g: ਜਾਹੁਗੇ ਕਤ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਮਗਿ ਰੋਕਿਯੋ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੬੫॥
206.t: jaahuge kat raam keh mag rokiyo taj kaan ||65||
206.e: They began to move on that route and at the same time the demoness came and laid obstruction on the path saying, “O ram! how will you proceed and save yourself?”65.

206.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਸਾਚਰੀ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ॥
206.t: dhekh raam nisaacharee geh leen baan kamaan ||

206.g: ਭਾਲ ਮਧ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਿਯੋ ਸੁਰ ਤਾਨਿ ਕਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
206.t: bhaal madh prahaariyo sur taan kaan pramaan ||
206.e: On seeing the demoness Tarka, ram held his bow and arrows in his hand, and pulling the cow discharged the arrow on her head.

206.g: ਬਾਨ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਗਿਰੀ ਬਿਸੰਭਾਰੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
206.t: baan laagat hee giree bisa(n)bhaar dheh bisaal ||

206.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਭਯੋ ਪਾਪਨੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ॥੬੬॥
206.t: haath sree raghunaath ke bhayo paapanee ko kaal ||66||
206.e: On being struck by the arrow, the heavy body of the demoness fell down and in this way, he end of the sinner came at the hands of Ram.66.

206.g: ਐਸ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਜੱਗ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡ ॥
206.t: aais taeh sa(n)ghaar kai kar ja'g ma(n)ddal ma(n)dd ||

206.g: ਆਇਗੇ ਤਬ ਲਉ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਦੀਹ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
206.t: aaige tab lau nisaachar dheeh dhei pracha(n)dd ||
206.e: In this way, after killing the demoness, when the Yajna was started, two large-sized demons, Marich and Subahu, appeared there.

206.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਸਭੈ ਰਿਖ ਠਾਢ ਭੇ ਹਠਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
206.t: bhaaj bhaaj chale sabhai rikh Thaadd bhe haTh raam ||

206.g: ਜੁੱਧ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਤਿਹ ਠਉਰ ਸੋਰਹ ਜਾਮ ॥੬੭॥
206.t: ju'dh kru'dh kariyo tihoo(n) teh Thaur soreh jaam ||67||
206.e: Seeing them, all the sages ran away and only Ram persistently stood there and the war of those three was waged continuously for sixteen watches.67.

206.g: ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਦਾਨਵ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ॥
206.t: maar maar pukaar dhaanav sasatr asatr sa(n)bhaar ||

206.g: ਬਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੱਉ ਧਰਿ ਤਬਰ ਤਿੱਛ ਕੁਠਾਰਿ ॥
206.t: baan paan kamaan ka'au dhar tabar ti'chh kuThaar ||
206.e: Holding firmly their arms and weapons, the demons began to shout “kill, kill”  they caught hold of their axes, bows and arrows in their hands.

207.g: ਘੋਰਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸਾ ਨਹਿ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥ ॥
207.t: ghor ghor dhaso dhisaa neh soorabeer pramaath ||

207.g: ਆਇ ਕੈ ਜੂਝੇ ਸਬੈ ਰਣ ਰਾਮ ਏਕਲ ਸਾਥ ॥੬੮॥
207.t: aai kai joojhe sabai ran raam ekal saath ||68||
207.e: From all the ten directions, the demon warriors rushed forth for fighting only with Ram.68.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Seeing Ram, the Dharma-incarnate, in the battlefield and uttering various shouts from their mouth,
The demons rushed forth all the four directions and gathered together.69.
The musical instruments resounded violently and hearing their sounds, he clouds felt shy.
Fixing their banners on the earth  the demons, filled with enmity began to wage war.70.
The bows clattered and the swords struck.
There was great knocking on the shields and the swords falling on them performed the rite of love.71.
All the warriors were absorbed in the war so much like the werestlers in th wrestling arena.
The arrows were showered and there was the crackling of the bows.72.
Wishing for their victory, the demons showered their arrows.
Sabahu and Marich, knocking their teeth in fury, marched forward.73.
Both of them together pounced upon like a falcon, and,
They surrounded ram like the Cupid (Kamdev), surrounding the moon.74.
Ram was surrounded by the forces of demons like Shiva by the forces of Cupid (Kamdev).
Ram tarried there for war like Ganges on meeting the ocean.75.
Ram shouted so loudly in the war that the clouds felt shy
The warriors rolled in dust and mighty heroes fell on the earth.76.
Subadhu and Marich began to search for Ram, while twisting their whiskers,
And said, “Where will he go and save himself, we will catch him just now.”77.
Seeing the enemies Ram became persistent and serious,
And the eyes of that knower of the science of archery, reddened.78.
The bow of Ram raised a terrible sound and showered a volley of arrows.
The armies of the enemy were being destroyed, seeing which the gods smiled in heaven.79.

208.e: Marich saw his army running away,
And challenged his forces in great ire like the rage of a snake.80.
Ram discharge his arrow towards Marich, who ran towards the sea.
He adopted the garb of a Yogi, abandoning his kingdom and country.81.
He wore the garments of a Yogi on forsaking the beautiful royal dress,
And abandoning all inimical ideas, he began to live in a cottage in Lanka.82.
Subahu marched forward alongwith his soldiers in great rage,]
And in the war of arrows, he also heard the terrible sound.83.
In the bedecked forces, very swift horses began to run
The elephants roared in all the for directions and in front of their roars, the thunder of clouds appeared very dull.84.
The knocking on the shields was audible and the yellow and red shields looked impressive.
The warriors began to rise holding their weapons in their hands, and there was a continuous flow of shafts.85.
The fire-shafts were discharged and the weapons began to fall form the hands of the warriors .
The brave fighters saturated with blood appeared like the participants in a marriage party wearing red garments.86.
Many wounded people are roaming like a drunkard swinging in intoxication.
The warriors have caught hold of each other like a flower meeting the other flower joyfully.87.
The demon-king was killed and he attained his real form.
The musical instruments were played and listening to their sound, the clouds felt.88.
Many charioteers were killed and the horses began to roam in the battlefield unclaimed.
This war was so dreadful that even the meditation of Shiva was ruptured.89.
The resounding of the gongs, drums and tabors began.
The trumpets were sounded and the horses neighed.90.
Various sounds arose in the battlefield and there were knocking on the helmets.
The armours on the bodies were chopped and the heroes followed the discipline of Kshatriyas.91.

209.e: Ram was highly infuriated on seeing the continuance of the terrible war.
He chopped the arms of Subahu and killed him.92.
On seeing this, the frightened demons ran away and Ram thundered in the battlefield.
Ram lightened the burden of the earth and protected the sages.93.
All the saints were pleased over the victory.
The gods were worshipped and the discussion on Vedas began.94.
The Yajna (of Vishwamitra) was complete and all the sins were destroyed.
On seeing this, the gods were pleased and began to shower flowers.95.

209.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਰਾਮਾਵਤਾਰੇ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਬਾਹ ਮਰੀਚ ਬਧਹ ਜਗਯ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
209.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the raamaavataare kathaa subaeh mareech badheh jagay sa(n)pooran karana(n) samaapatam ||
209.e: End of the description of the story of the Killing of MARICH and SUBAHU and also the Completion of Yajna in Rama Avtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of the Swayyamvara of Sita :
RASAAVAL STANZA
The day of the Swayyamvara of Sita was fixed, who was extremely pure like Gita.
Her words were winsome like those of the nightingale. She had eyes like the eyes of the king of deer.96.
The chief sage Vishwamitra had heard about it.
He took with his Ram, the wise and beautiful Youngman of the country and went (to Jankpuri), the abode of righteousness.97.
“O dear Ram, listen, accompany me there
“The Swayyamvara of Sita has been fixed and the king (Janak) has called us.98.
“We may go there at day-dawn and conquer Sita
“Obey my saying, now it is upto you.99.
“With your beautiful and strong hands, break the bow
“Conquer and bring Sita and destroy all the demons.”100.
He (the sage) went with Ram and the quiver (of Ram) seemed impressive.
They went an stood there, their delight extended extremely.101.
The women of the city look (toward Ram), they considered him Kamdev (Cupid) in reality.
The inimical participants comprehend him as an enemy and the saintly persons consider him a saint.102.
For children he is a boy, the kings consider him a king.

210.e: The ascetics look towards him as Shiva, with sustenance of air, and the bard considers him a weapons-wielder.103.
For the night he is the moon and for day he is the sun.
The Ganas marked him as Rudra and the gods saw him as Indra.104.
The Vedas comprehended him as Brahman, the Brahmins considered him as Vyas.
Vishnu visualized him as the Immanent Lord, and Sita sees him as Ram.105.
Sita looks towards him as Ram, being pierced by Cupid’s arrow.
She fell down swinging on the earth like a roaming drunkeard.106.
She gained consciousness and arose like a great warrior.
She kept her eyes concentrated like that off a Chakori (a hill bird) on the moon.107.
Both were attached to each other and none on them faltered.
They stood firmly like the warrior in the battlefield.108.
The messengers were sent in the fort who went swiftly like Hanuman, the son of wind-god.

211.e: The saw was placed after showing it to the gathered kings.109.
Ram took it in his hand, the hero (Ram) was filled with pride.
He pulled it smilingly and broke it into two parts.110.
All the gods were pleased and a loot of flowers were showered.
Other kings felt shy and went back to their countries.111.
Then the princess, the most fortunate in three worlds.
Garlanded Ram and wedded him as her spouse.112.
BHUJNAG PRAYYAT STANZA

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਿਧੌ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਹੈ ॥
211.t: kidhau dhev ka(n)niaa kidhau baasavee hai ||

211.e: Sita appeared like the daughter of a god or Indra, daughter of a Naga, daughter of a Yaksha or daughter of a Kinnar.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੀ ਦੈਤ ਜਾ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਸੀ ॥
211.t: kidhau ga(n)dhrabee dhait jaa dhevataa see ||

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੂਰਜਾ ਸੁਧ ਸੋਧੀ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੀ ॥੧੧੩॥
211.t: kidhau soorajaa sudh sodhee sudhaa see ||113||
211.e: She looked like the daughter of a Gandharva, daughter of a demon or goddess. She appeared like the daughter of Sum or like the ambrosial light of the Moon.113.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਜੱਛ ਬਿੱਦਿਆ ਧਰੀ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੀ ਹੈ ॥
211.t: kidhau ja'chh bi'dhiaa dharee ga(n)dhrabee hai ||

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਭਾਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਚੀ ਹੈ ॥
211.t: kidhau raaganee bhaag poore rachee hai ||
211.e: She appeared like a Gandharva woman, having obtained the learning of Yakshas or a complete creation of a Ragini (musical mode).

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਪੁੱਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਹੈ ॥
211.t: kidhau suvaran kee chitr kee pu'trakaa hai ||

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਕਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੪॥
211.t: kidhau kaam kee kaamanee kee prabhaa hai ||114||
211.e: She looked like a golden puppet or the glory of a beautiful lady, full of passion.114.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਚਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਪੁੱਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਸੀ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
211.t: kidhau chi'tr kee pu'trakaa see banee hai ||

211.e: She appeared like a puppet exquisite a Padmini (different gradations of a woman).

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰਾਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਰੀ ਰਾਗ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
211.t: kidhau raag poore bharee raag maalaa ||

211.g: ਬਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਸੀਆ ਆਜ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੧੧੫॥
211.t: baree raam taisee seeaa aaj baalaa ||115||
211.e: She looked like Ragmala, studded completely with Ragas (musical modes), and Ram wedded such a beautiful Sita.115.

211.g: ਛਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਦੋਨੋ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਐਸੇ ॥
211.t: chhake prem dhono lage nain aaise ||

211.e: Having been absorbed in love for each other.

211.g: ਬਿਧੁੰ ਬਾਕ ਬੈਣੀ ਕਟੰ ਦੇਸ ਛੀਣੰ ॥
211.t: bidhu(n) baak bainee kaTa(n) dhes chheena(n) ||

211.e: Sita of sweet speech and slim waist and visually absorbed with Ram, is looking exquisitely beautiful.116.

211.g: ਜਿਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੀਤਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਸ੍ਰਉਣ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
211.t: jinee raam seetaa sunee sraun raama(n) ||

211.g: ਗਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਿਸਯੋ ਤਉਨ ਜਾਮੰ ॥
211.t: gahe sasatr asatra(n) risayo taun jaama(n) ||
211.e: When Parashuram heard this that Ram hath conquered Sita, he at that time, in great ire, held up his arms and weapons.

211.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਭਾਖਿਯੋ ਰਹੋ ਰਾਮ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
211.t: kahaa jaat bhaakhiyo raho raam Thaadde ||

211.g: ਲਖੋ ਆਜ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਏ ਬੀਰ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੧੧੭॥
211.t: lakho aaj kaise bhe beer gaadde ||117||
211.e: He asked Ram to stop there and challenged him saying.”I shall now see, what type of hero thou art.”117.
Bhakha Pingal Di (The language of prosody):
SUNDARI STANZA
The warriors raised loud shouts and the terrible trumpets resounded.
There were war-cries in the battlefield and the warriors, being pleased began to hurl their shields up and down.118.
The warriors with twined whiskers gathered together for war and fought with each other discharging dreadful shower of arrows.
The fighters drenched with blood began to fell and the horses were being crushed in the battlefield.119.
The sound of the drums of Yoginis was being heard and the double-edged daggers glistened.

212.e: The warriors were mumbling and falling as martyrs and the heroes wearing armours were rolling in dust.120.
The brave fighters thundered and the warriors wearing steel armours, being intoxicated, began to dance.
The terrible trumpets resounded and the warriors with dreadful whiskers began to fight in the war.121.
The warriors were fighting with each other while twisting their whiskers. The chopping heroes were jumping like the winged mountains.
The brave soldiers wearing armours are lying down on the earh.122.
The trumpets resounded upto distant places and the horses began to run hither and thither.
The heavenly damsels began to roam in the sky and bedecking themselves and putting collyrium in their eyes they began to see the war.123.
The thundering musical instruments were played in the war and the brave soldiers roared.
The warriors holding their spears in their hands began to strike them, the arms and weapons of the warriors were put to use.124.
The wounded warriors fell down and their bodies were chopped.
The armies thundered and the trumpets resounded, the restless horses neighed in the battlefield.125.
The vultures shrieked on all the four sides and they began to reduce already chopped bodies into bits.
In the jungle of that battlefield they began to play with the bits of flesh and the adepts and yogis wished for victory.126.
Just as the flowers blossom in the spring, in the same manner are seen the mighty warriors fighting in the war.
The trunks of the elephants began to fell in the battlefield and the whole earth was filled with hacked heads.127.
MADHUR DHUN STANZA
Parashuram, who had abandoned his desires created a sensation in all the four directions,
And began to discharge arrows like the brave fighers.128.
Observing his fury, the men of wisdom, meditated on the Lord,
And began to repeat the name of Lord, trembling with fear.129.
Agonised by extreme rage, the intellect was destroyed.
A stream of arrows flowed from his hands and with them the life-breath of opponents was removed.130.
Holding their arrows in their hand s and filled with pride,
The warriors are imposing them in the hearts of the enemies like the hoeing of the earth by the gardener.131.
All tremble on account of the fury by the warriors and because of their activities in respect of warfare.

213.e: The masters of the horses were being destroyed.132.
Every limb of the warriors was pierced by arrows,
And Parashuram began to shower a volley of his arms.133.
He who advances to that side goes straight to the feet of the Lord (i.e. he is killed).
Hearing the knocks on the shields, the god of death came down.134.
The superb enemies were killed and the eminent men were destroyed.
On the bodies of the enduring warriors, the arrows waved.135.
The eminent persons were destroyed and the remaining sped away.
The repeated Shiva’s name and created confusion.136.
Had power of to destroy all in the war, his arms were long.137.
The brave fighters struck blows and the rosary of skulls on the neck of Shiva looked impressive.

214.e: Ram stood firmly and within the whole place, there was turmoil.138.

214.g: ਚਰਪਟ ਛੀਗਾ ਕੇ ਆਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
214.t: charapaT chheegaa ke aadh kirat chha(n)dh ||
214.e: CHARPAT CHHIGA KE AAD KRIT STANZA
In the use of the sword the noteworthy and greatly wise persons are being seen.
Those with beautiful bodies are wearing armours which seen like portraits.139.
Those who are specialists in arm and scholars of Shastras
And also the famous warriors are busy in warfare in great rage.140.
The eminent warriors are filling others with fear
Wearing their arms they are destroying the enemies.141.
The brave fighters piercing the armours are boring the bodies
With the use of arms, the canopies of the kings are being destroyed.142.
Those who marched towards the battlefield,
They know the secrets of arms and wepons.143.
The warriors wandered in the battlefield like the gardeners of the forest who prune the plants, they began to destroy the reputation of the heroes.
In that battlefield the beautiful Ram, who is the abode of righteousness is looking glorious.144.
He is a hero with the quality of forbearance, he is the destroyer of warriors
Conqueror of war and eminently specialist in the use of weapons.145.
He has the gait of an elephant and an abode of Dharma
He is the master of yoga-fire and protector of the supreme light.146.
The Speech of Parachuram :
SWAYYA

214.g: ਤੂਣਿ ਕਸੇ ਕਟ ਚਾਪ ਧਰੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਕਹੀ ਦਿਜ ਰਾਮ ਅਹੋ ॥
214.t: toon kase kaT chaap dhare kar kop kahee dhij raam aho ||
214.e: Wearnig his bow and quiver, the Brahmin Parshuram in great rage said to Ram :

214.g: ਗ੍ਰਹ ਤੋਰਿ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ ਸੀਅ ਜਾਤ ਹਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਉਨ ਕਹੋ ॥
214.t: greh tor saraasan sa(n)kar ko seea jaat hare tum kaun kaho ||
214.e: “O the breaker of the bow of Shiva and the conqueror of Sita, who ate you?

214.g: ਬਿਨ ਸਾਚ ਕਹੇ ਨੇਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਬਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੰਠ ਕੁਠਾਰ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਸਹੋ ॥
214.t: bin saach kahe nehee praan bache jin ka(n)Th kuThaar kee dhaar saho ||
214.e: “Tell me the truth otherwise you will not he able to save yourself and you will have to bear the blow of the sharp edge of my axe on your neck.

214.g: ਘਰ ਜਾਹੁ ਚਲੇ ਤਜ ਰਾਮ ਰਣੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੋ ਪਲ ਠਾਢ ਰਹੋ ॥੧੪੭॥
214.t: ghar jaahu chale taj raam rana(n) jin joojh maro pal Thaadd raho ||147||
214.e: “It will be appropriate, if you leave the war-arena and run away to your home, otherwise if you stay here for another instant, you will have to die.”147.
SWAYYA

214.g: ਜਾਨਤ ਹੋ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਮੁਝੈ ਹਠਿ ਏਕ ਬਲੀ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਢ ਰਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.t: jaanat ho avilok mujhai haTh ek balee nahee Thaadd rahai(n)ge ||
214.e: “You know that no mighty warrior can stay here firmly on seeing me

214.g: ਤਾਤਿ ਗਹਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਦਾਤਨ ਤੇਨ ਕਹਾ ਰਣ ਆਜ ਗਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.t: taat gahayo jin ko tiran dhaatan ten kahaa ran aaj gahai(n)ge ||
214.e: “Those whose fathers and grandfathers held the blades of grass within their teeth on seeing me (i.e. they accepted defeat) what type of war will they wage with me now?

214.g: ਬੰਬ ਬਜੇ ਰਣ ਖੰਡ ਗਡੇ ਗਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਉਮਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.t: ba(n)b baje ran kha(n)dd gadde geh haath hathiaar kahoo(n) umahai(n)ge ||
214.e: “Even if there is waged a terrible war how can they be bold enough now to march forward for war by taking hold of their weapons again?

214.g: ਭੂਮ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਦੁਰੈਬੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੋ ਕਹਾ ਠਾਮ ਲਹੈਂਗੇ ॥੧੪੮॥
214.t: bhoom akaas pataal dhuraibe kau raam kaho kahaa Thaam lahai(n)ge ||148||
214.e: “Then tell me, O Ram, where will you find a place one earth, sky or netherworld to hide yourself?”148.
Speech of the Poet:

214.g: ਯੌ ਜਬ ਬੈਨ ਸੁਨੇ ਅਰਿ ਕੇ ਤਬ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਬਲਕਾਨੇ ॥
214.t: yau jab bain sune ar ke tab sree raghubeer balee balakaane ||
214.e: Hearing these words of the enemy (Parashuram), Ram looked like a mighty hero.

215.g: ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਨ ਲੌ ਗਰਵੇ ਗਿਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦੋਊ ਥਹਰਾਨੇ ॥
215.t: saat samu(n)dhran lau garave gir bhoom akaas dhouoo thaharaane ||
215.e: Visualising the serene posture of Ram, exhibiting the serenity of seven seas, the mountains, Sky and the whole world trembled.

215.g: ਜੱਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਡਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
215.t: ja'chh bhuja(n)g dhisaa bidhisaan ke dhaanav dhev dhuhoo(n) ddar maane ||
215.e: The Yakshas, Nagas, gods gods demons of all the four directions were frightened.

215.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਕਮਾਨ ਲੇ ਹਾਥ ਕਹੋ ਰਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਪੈ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੇ ॥੧੪੯॥
215.t: sree raghunaath kamaan le haath kaho ris kai keh pai sar taane ||149||
215.e: Getting hold of his bow in his hand, Ram said to Parashuram, “On whom you have stretched this arrow in anger?”149.

215.g: ਪਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ॥
215.t: paras raam baach raam so ||
215.e: Speech of Parashuram addressed to Ram :

215.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਬੈਨ ਕਹੇ ਸੁ ਕਹੇ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਕਹੇ ਤੁ ਪੈ ਜੀਤ ਨ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: jetak bain kahe su kahe ju pai fer kahe ta pai jeet na jaiho ||
215.e: “O Ram! whatever you have said, you have said and now if you say anything further, then you will not remain alive

215.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਗਹੇ ਸੁ ਗਹੇ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਗਹੇ ਤੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਲੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: haath hathiaar gahe su gahe ju pai fer gahe ta pai fer na laiho ||
215.e: “The weapon that you had to wield, you have wielded and if you try to wield anything more, your effort will be of no avail.”

215.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਿਸੈ ਰਣ ਮੈ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਕਹੋ ਭਜਿ ਕੈ ਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਬਚੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: raam risai ran mai raghubeer kaho bhaj kai kat praan bachaiho ||
215.e: Then getting furious Parashuram said to Ram, “Say, where will you run away now from war and how will you save your life?

215.g: ਤੋਰ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਅ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਪੈਹੋ ॥੧੫੦॥
215.t: tor saraasan sa(n)kar ko har seea chale ghar jaan na paiho ||150||
215.e: “O Ram! breaking the bow of Shiva and now wedding Sita you will not be able to reach your home.”150.

215.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਪਰਸੁਰਾਮ ਸੋ ॥
215.t: raam baach parasuraam so ||
215.e: Speech of Ram addressed to Parashuram:

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.t: savaiyaa ||
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਬੋਲ ਕਹੇ ਸੁ ਸਹੇ ਦਿਸ ਜੂ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਖ੍ਵੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: bol kahe su sahe dhis joo ju pai fer kahe te pai praan khavaiho ||
215.e: “O Brahmin! you have already said whatever you wanted to say and if you say anything more now, you will have to risk your life.

215.g: ਬੋਲਤ ਐਂਠ ਕਹਾ ਸਠ ਜਿਉ ਸਭ ਦਾਤ ਤੁਰਾਇ ਅਬੈ ਘਰਿ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: bolat aai(n)Th kahaa saTh jiau sabh dhaat turai abai ghar jaiho ||
215.e: “O fool! why do you speak with such pride, you will have to go now to your home after getting your teeth broken and after receiving good tharashin.

215.g: ਧੀਰ ਤਬੈ ਲਹਿਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਕੱਉ ਜਦ ਭੀਰ ਪਰੀ ਇਕ ਤੀਰ ਚਲੈਹੋ ॥
215.t: dheer tabai lahihai tum ka'au jadh bheer paree ik teer chalaiho ||
215.e: “I am seeing you with patience  if I consider it necessary, then I shall have to discharge only one arrow.

215.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਕਹੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਬਾਤਨ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਫਲਿ ਪੈਹੋ ॥੧੫੧॥
215.t: baat sa(n)bhaar kaho mukh te in baatan ko ab hee fal paiho ||151||
215.e: “Therefore talk with restraint, otherwise you will receive the reward for such talk just now.”151.

215.g: ਪਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ॥
215.t: paras raam baach ||
215.e: Speech of Parashuram :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.t: savaiyaa ||
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚ ਲਖੋ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਓ ॥
215.t: tau tum saach lakho man mai prabh jau tum raam vataar kahaao ||
215.e: “You should then deem it true that if you are called Ramvtar,

215.g: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਬਿਹੰਡੀਯ ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਬਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਓ ॥
215.t: rudhr kuva(n)dd biha(n)ddeey jiau kar tiau apano bal moh dhikhaao ||
215.e: “Then the way you have broken the bow of Shiva, show me your strength in the same way

215.g: ਤਉ ਹੀ ਗਦਾ ਕਰ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਲਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਕੀ ਉਰ ਮੱਧ ਸੁਹਾਓ ॥
215.t: tau hee gadhaa kar saara(n)g chakr lataa bhiragaa kee ur ma'dh suhaao ||
215.e: “Show me your mace, discus, bow and also the mark of the stroke of the foot of sage Bhrigu.

215.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਉਤਾਰ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਮੋਹੂ ਕੱਉ ਆਜ ਚੜਾਇ ਦਿਖਾਓ ॥੧੫੨॥
215.t: mero utaar kuva(n)dd mahaabal mohoo ka'au aaj chaRai dhikhaao ||152||
215.e: “Alongwith this dismount my mighty bow and pull its string.”152.

215.g: ਕਬਿ ਬਾਚ ॥
215.t: kab baach ||
215.e: Speech of the Poet :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.t: savaiyaa ||
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਿਰੋਮਨ ਸੂਰ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਲਯੋ ਕਰ ਮੈ ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.t: sree raghubeer siroman soor kuva(n)dd layo kar mai has kai ||
215.e: Ram, the supreme hero took the bow in his hand smilingly

215.g: ਲੀਅ ਚਾਪ ਚਟਾਕ ਚੜਾਇ ਬਲੀ ਖਟ ਟੂਕ ਕਰਯੋ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਕਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.t: leea chaap chaTaak chaRai balee khaT Took karayo chhin mai kas kai ||
215.e: Pulled its string and tightening the arrow, broke it into two pieces.

215.g: ਨਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਹਤੀ ਸਰ ਸੋ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਰਹੀ ਬਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.t: nabh kee gat taeh hatee sar so adh beech hee baat rahee bas kai ||
215.e: On breaking, the bow produced such a dreadful sound as if the arrow had struck the chest of the sky which gad burst.

215.g: ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਕਛੂ ਨਟ ਕੇ ਬਟ ਜਯੋਂ ਭਵ ਪਾਸ ਨਿਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਸਿ ਕੈ ॥੧੫੩॥
215.t: n basaat kachhoo naT ke baT jayo(n) bhav paas nisa(n)g rahai fas kai ||153||
215.e: The manner in which the dancer jumps on the rope, in the same way the whole universe shook on the breaking of the bow and remained entangled within the two pieces of the bow.153.

215.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੁੱਧ ਜਯਤ ॥੨॥
215.t: eit sree raam ju'dh jayat ||2||
215.e: End of the description of Ram’s victory in war.2.

215.g: ਅਥ ਅਉਧ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
215.t: ath aaudh praves kathana(n) ||
215.e: Now begins the description of the Entry in Oudh :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.t: savaiyaa ||
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਭੇਟ ਭੁਜਾ ਭਰਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਭਲੇ ਭਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਦੋਊ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥
215.t: bheT bhujaa bhar a(n)k bhale bhar nain dhouoo nirakhe raghuraiee ||
215.e: With tears of joy in both his eyes and meeting affectionately with his people Ram entered Ayodhya.

215.g: ਗੁੰਜਤ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕਪੋਲਨ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਗ ਲਵੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
215.t: gu(n)jat bhira(n)g kapolan uoopar naag lava(n)g rahe liv laiee ||
215.e: The black bees were humming on the cheeks and the braids of long hair of Sita were hanging like the Nagas looking towards her face.

215.g: ਕੰਜ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਕਲਾ ਨਿਧ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੇਰ ਹੀਏ ਹਹਰਾਈ ॥
215.t: ka(n)j kura(n)g kalaa nidh kehar kokil her he'ee haharaiee ||
215.e: The lotus, deer, moon, lioness and nightingale were perplexed in their minds and seeing her (eyes, agility, beauty, courage and sweet voice respectively).

215.g: ਬਾਲ ਲਖੈਂ ਛਬਿ ਖਾਟ ਪਰੈਂ ਨਹਿ ਬਾਟ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧੫੪॥
215.t: baal lakhai(n) chhab khaaT parai(n) neh baaT chalai nirakhe adhikaiee ||154||
215.e: The children, seeing her beauty, also were falling unconscious and the travelers abandoning their path, were looking at her.154.

215.g: ਸੀਅ ਰਹੀ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ਮਨੈ ਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਬਾਤ ਧਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.t: seea rahee murachhai manai ran raam kahaa man baat dharai(n)ge ||
215.e: Sita was getting worried on reflecting whether Ram will agree with her sayings or not

215.g: ਤੋਰਿ ਸਰਾਸਨਿ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ ਜਿਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਰਿਓ ਤਿਮ ਅਉਰ ਬਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.t: tor saraasan sa(n)kar ko jim moh bario tim aaur barai(n)ge ||
215.e: And also whether it can happen that Ram may wed another woman like wedding me on breaking the bow of Shiva.

215.g: ਦੂਸਰ ਬਯਾਹ ਬਧੂ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਨਾਥ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਡਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.t: dhoosar bayaeh badhoo ab hee man te muh naath bisaar ddarai(n)ge ||
215.e: If he thinks another marriage in his mind, then her Lord on forgetting her, will fill her life definitely with unrest.

215.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਹੌ ਨਿਜ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਬਿਧ ਆਜ ਕਹਾ ਇਹ ਠੌਰ ਕਰੈਂਗੇ ॥੧੫੫॥
215.t: dhekhat hau nij bhaag bhale bidh aaj kahaa ieh Thauar karai(n)ge ||155||
215.e: Let us see that is recorded in my fate and what he will do in future?155.

215.g: ਤਉ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਰਾਮ ਜਿਤੇ ਦਿਜ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਲ ਆਇ ਬਜਾਇ ਬਧਾਈ ॥
215.t: tau hee lau raam jite dhij kau apane dhal aai bajai badhaiee ||
215.e: At that same time, the groups of Brahmins came forward and began and thither in joy.

215.g: ਭੱਗੁਲ ਲੋਕ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਰਣ ਮੋ ਲਖਿ ਰਾਘਵ ਕੀ ਅਧਕਾਈ ॥
215.t: bha'gul lok firai sabh hee ran mo lakh raaghav kee adhakaiee ||
215.e: Hearing about the victory of Ram in the war, all the people ran hither and thither in joy.

215.g: ਸੀਅ ਰਹੀ ਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਿਤੇ ਅਵਧੇਸਰ ਬਾਤ ਜਬੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
215.t: seea rahee ran raam jite avadhesar baat jabai sun paiee ||
215.e: When Dasrath came to know that after conquering Sita, Ram has also conquered the war,

215.g: ਫੂਲਿ ਗ੍ਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਘਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਰਖਾਈ ॥੧੫੬॥
215.t: fool gayo at hee man mai dhan ke ghan kee barakhaa barakhaiee ||156||
215.e: Then his delight knew no bounds and he showered the wealth like the rain of clouds.156.

215.g: ਬੰਦਨਵਾਰ ਬਧੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਦਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੌ ਛਿਰਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
215.t: ba(n)dhanavaar badhee sabh hee dhar cha(n)dhan sau chhirake greh saare ||
215.e: The doors of all the subjects were bedecked with greetings and the sandalwood was sprinkled over all the houses.

215.g: ਕੇਸਰ ਡਾਰਿ ਬਰਾਤਨ ਪੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੁਰਹੂਤ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥
215.t: kesar ddaar baraatan pai sabh hee jan hui purahoot padhaare ||
215.e: Saffron was sprinkled over all the companions (of Ram) and it seemed that Indra was entering his city.

215.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਤਾਲ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਨਾਚਤ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਖਾਰੇ ॥
215.t: baajat taal mucha(n)g pakhaavaj naachat koTan koT akhaare ||
215.e: The drums and other musical instruments resounded and the dances of various kinds were arranged.

215.g: ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਅਗੂਆ ਸੁਤ ਕੱਉ ਪਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਪੁਰ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧੫੭॥
215.t: aan mile sabh hee agooaa sut ka'au pit lai pur aaudh sidhaare ||157||
215.e: All the people advanced to meet Ram and the father Dasrath took his son with him and reached Oudhpuri (in his palaces).157.

215.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
215.t: chauapiee ||
215.e: CHAUPAI

215.g: ਸਭਹੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਲ ਕੀਯੋ ਉਛਾਹਾ ॥
215.t: sabhahoo mil gil keeyo uchhaahaa ||

215.g: ਪੂਤ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਕਉ ਰਚਯੋ ਬਿਯਾਹਾ ॥
215.t: poot tihoo(n) kau rachayo biyaahaa ||
215.e: With great enthusiasm the marriage of the three remaining sons was fixed.

216.g: ਰਾਮ ਸੀਆ ਬਰ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
216.t: raam seeaa bar kai ghar aae ||

216.e: After the marriage of Ram and Sita, the congratulatory messages were received from various countries, when they returned to their home.158.
There was atmosphere of zest on all sides and the arrangements were being made for the celebration of the marriage of three sons.
On all sides the drums resounded in various tunes and many companies of dancers began to dance.159.
The warriors decorated with armours and the youthful soldiers marched forward.

216.g: ਭਏ ਜਾਇ ਇਸਥਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦਰ ਪਰ ॥
216.t: bhe jai isathat nirap dhar par ||

216.e: All these great charioteers and archers came and stood at the gate of the king Dasrath.160.
Many types of musical instruments resounded and the melodious sounds of the drums were heard.
The energetic women began to sing and reveal their joy by dancing their eyes and clapping their hands.161.

216.g: ਭਿੱਛਕਨ ਹਵਸ ਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ॥
216.t: bhi'chhakan havas na dhan kee rahee ||

216.e: The beggars had no more desire for wealth because the gift of gold flowed like a stream.
Anyone who asked for one thing, he would return to his home with twenty things.162.
The sons of king Dasrath playing in the forests appeared like the flowers bloomed in spring season.
The saffron sprinkled on the limbs appeared like the bliss gushing forth form the heart.163.

216.g: ਉਮਡ ਚਲਤ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
216.t: aumadd chalat jeh bidh kar ga(n)gaa ||
216.e: They are gathering their limitless fourfold army like the gushing forth of the Ganges.

217.g: ਭਲ ਭਲ ਕੁਅਰ ਚੜੇ ਸਜ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
217.t: bhal bhal kuar chaRe saj sainaa ||

217.g: ਕੋਟਕ ਚੜੇ ਸੂਰ ਜਨੁ ਗੈਨਾ ॥੧੬੪॥
217.t: koTak chaRe soor jan gainaa ||164||
217.e: With their armed forces the princes appear glorious like millions of suns in the sky.164.

217.g: ਭਰਥ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੋਭਤ ਸਭ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
217.t: bharath sahit sobhat sabh bhraataa ||

217.g: ਕਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
217.t: keh na parat mukh te kachh baataa ||
217.e: All the brothers along with Bharat seem in such splendour which cannot be described.

217.g: ਮਾਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਤ ਮੋਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: maatan man su(n)dhar sut mohai(n) ||

217.g: ਜਨੁ ਦਿਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਰਵਿ ਸਸ ਦੋਊ ਸੋਹੈਂ ॥੧੬੫॥
217.t: jan dhit greh rav sas dhouoo sohai(n) ||165||
217.e: The beautiful princes are alluring the minds of their mothers and appear like the sun and moon born in the house of Diti, increasing its magnificence.165.

217.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧ ਕੈ ਸਜ ਸੁੱਧ ਬਰਾਤਾ ॥
217.t: eeh bidh kai saj su'dh baraataa ||

217.g: ਕਛੁ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਕਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
217.t: kachh na parat keh tin kee baataa ||
217.e: In this way the beautiful wedding parties were emblished. Which are indescribable

217.g: ਬਾਢਤ ਕਹਤ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਬਾਤਨ ਕਰ ॥
217.t: baaddat kahat gra(n)th baatan kar ||

217.g: ਬਿਦਾ ਹੋਨ ਸਿਸ ਚਲੇ ਤਾਤ ਘਰ ॥੧੬੬॥
217.t: bidhaa hon sis chale taat ghar ||166||
217.e: By saying all this the volume of the book will be increased And all these children moved towards the place of their father for getting his permission to depart.166.

217.g: ਆਇ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮਾ ॥
217.t: aai pitaa kahu keen pranaamaa ||

217.g: ਜੋਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਠਾਢੇ ਬਨਿ ਧਾਮਾ ॥
217.t: jor paan Thaadde ban dhaamaa ||
217.e: They ll came and bowed before their father and stood there with folded hands.

217.g: ਨਿਰਖਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਦ ਮਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
217.t: nirakh putr aana(n)dh man bhare ||

217.g: ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਿੱਪਨ ਕਹ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੬੭॥
217.t: dhaan bahut bi'pan keh kare ||167||
217.e: The king was filled with joy on seeing his sons and he gave many things in charity to the Brahmins.167.

217.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਲੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
217.t: taat maat lai ka(n)Th lagaae ||

217.g: ਜਨ ਦੁਇ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਰਧਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
217.t: jan dhui ratan niradhanee paae ||
217.e: Hugging their children to their bosom the parents felt great pleasure like a poor man on acquiring the gems.

217.g: ਬਿਦਾ ਮਾਗ ਜਬ ਗਏ ਰਾਮ ਘਰ ॥
217.t: bidhaa maag jab ge raam ghar ||

217.g: ਸੀਸ ਰਹੇ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਰ ॥੧੬੮॥
217.t: sees rahe dhar charan kamal par ||168||
217.e: After taking permission for departure they reached the place of Ram and bowed their on his feet.168.

217.g: ਕਬਿੱਤ ॥
217.t: kabi't ||
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਰ ਚੂਮਯੋ ਪਾਨ ਪੀਠ ਧਰੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੋ ਭਰੇ ਲੈ ਤੰਬੋਰ ਆਗੇ ਧਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: raam bidhaa kare sir choomayo paan peeTh dhare aana(n)dh so bhare lai ta(n)bor aage dhare hai(n) ||
217.e: Ram kissed the heads of all and placed his hand on their back with love, He presented with betel leaf etc. and affectionately bade them farewell.

217.g: ਦੁੰਦਭੀ ਬਜਾਇ ਤੀਨੋ ਭਾਈ ਯੌ ਚਲਤ ਭਏ ਮਾਨੋ ਸੂਰ ਚੰਦ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਨ ਅਵਤਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: dhu(n)dhabhee bajai teeno bhaiee yau chalat bhe maano soor cha(n)dh koT aan avatare hai(n) ||
217.e: Playing on the drums and the musical instruments all the people moved as if millions of suns and moons have manifested on the earth.

217.g: ਕੇਸਰ ਸੋ ਭੀਜੇ ਪਟ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਐਸੀ ਭਾਤ ਮਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਭਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: kesar so bheeje paT sobhaa dhet aaisee bhaat maano roop raag ke suhaag bhaag bhare hai(n) ||
217.e: The garments saturated with saffron are looking splendid as if the beauty itself has materialized.

217.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕੇ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਐਸੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਕਾਮਜੂ ਨੇ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕਲਿਯੋਰਾ ਕੈਧੌ ਕਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੬੯॥
217.t: raajaa avadhes ke kumaar aaise sobhaa dhet kaamajoo ne koTik kaliyoraa kaidhau kare hai(n) ||169||
217.e: The princes of Dasrath the king of Oudh, appear splendid like the god of love alongwith his arts.169.

217.g: ਕਬਿੱਤ ॥
217.t: kabi't ||
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਅਉਧ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਰ ਚਲੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਲੇ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਲੇ ਪਲੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.t: aaudh te nisar chale leene sa(n)g soor bhale ran te na Tale pale sobhaa hoo(n) ke dhaam ke ||
217.e: All have moved out of Oudhpuri and all of them taken along with them the winsome warriors, who never retrace their steps in war.

217.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਸੋਭਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਤੀਨੋ ਲੋਗ ਮੱਧ ਕੀ ਮੁਹੱਯਾ ਸਭ ਬਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.t: su(n)dhar kumaar ur haar sobhat apaar teeno log ma'dh kee muha'yaa sabh baam ke ||
217.e: They are beautiful princes, bedecked with necklaces around their necks. They are all going to bring their wedded women.

217.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲੱਯਾ ਤੀਨੋ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਜਿਤੱਯਾ ਤੀਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਭੱਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਚਹੱਯਾ ਹਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.t: dhurajan dhala'yaa teeno lok ke jita'yaa teeno raam joo ke bha'yaa hai(n) chaha'yaa har naam ke ||
217.e: They are all the mashers of the tyrants, capable of conquering the three worlds, lovers of the name of the Lord and brothers of Ram.

217.g: ਬੁੱਧ ਕੇ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦਾਨ ਸੀਲ ਕੇ ਪਹਾਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਬਨੇ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ॥੧੭੦॥
217.t: bu'dh ke udhaar hai(n) si(n)gaar avataar dhaan seel ke pahaar kai kumaar bane kaam ke ||170||
217.e: They are magnanimous in wisdom, the incarnation of embellishment, the mountain of munificence and are just like Ram.170.

217.g: ਅਸ੍ਵ ਬਰਨਨੰ ॥
217.t: asavai baranana(n) ||
217.e: The description of horses :

217.g: ਕਬਿੱਤੁ ॥
217.t: kabi't ||
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਨਾਗਰਾ ਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਚਾਤਰਾ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਘੂਲਾ ਮਾਨੋ ਗੈਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਥਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: naagaraa ke nain hai(n) k chaataraa ke bain hai(n) baghoolaa maano gain kaise taise thaharat hai(n) ||
217.e: The horses, restless like the eyes of a women, swift like the swift utterances of a shrewd person an mercurial like the crane rising up in the sky, are vibrating hither and thither.

217.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਜੂਪ ਕੈਸੇ ਦਾਉ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਛਲ ਕੋ ਦਿਖਾਉ ਕੋਊ ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: niratakaa ke paau hai(n) k joop kaise dhaau hai(n) k chhal ko dhikhaau kouoo taise biharat hai(n) ||
217.e: They are swift like the feet of a dancer, they are the tactics of throwing the dice or even some hallucination.

217.g: ਹਾਕੇ ਬਾਜ ਬੀਰ ਹੈਂ ਤੁਫੰਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਤੀਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਅੰਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਧੀਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇ ਫਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: haake baaj beer hai(n) tufa(n)g kaise teer hai(n) k a(n)janee ke dheer hai(n) k dhujaa se faharat hai(n) ||
217.e: These brave horses are swift like arrow and gunshot, shrewd and mighty like Hanuman, the son of Anjani  they are roaming like the fluttering banners.

217.g: ਲਹਰੈਂ ਅਨੰਗ ਕੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਗੰਗ ਕੀ ਅਨੰਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਗ ਜਯੋਂ ਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਠਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੧॥
217.t: laharai(n) ana(n)g kee tara(n)g jaise ga(n)g kee ana(n)g kaise a(n)g jayo(n) na kahoo(n) Thaharat hai(n) ||171||
217.e: These horses are like the intense emotions of the god of love, or the swift waves of the Ganges. They have beautiful limbs like the limbs of cupid and are not stable at any one place.171.

217.g: ਨਿਸਾ ਨਿਸਨਾਥਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਿੱਛਕਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੇ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: nisaa nisanaath jaanai dhin dhinapat maanai bhi'chhakan dhaataa kai pramaane mahaa dhaan hai(n) ||
217.e: All the princes are being considered as moon by the night and sun by the day, they are known as great donors for the beggars, the ailments consider them as medicine.

217.g: ਅਉਖਧੀ ਕੇ ਰੋਗਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਜੋਗਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਕੈ ਬਿਯੋਗਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: aaukhadhee ke rogan ana(n)t roop jogan sameep kai biyogan mahes mahaa maan hai(n) ||
217.e: When they, consisting of endless beauty are nearby, them there is suspicion about their impending separation. They are all most honourable like Shiva.

217.g: ਸੱਤ੍ਰੈ ਖੱਗ ਖਯਾਤਾ ਸਿਸ ਰੂਪਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਹਾ ਗਯਾਨੀ ਗਯਾਨ ਗਯਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.t: sa'trai kha'g khayaataa sis roopan ke maataa mahaa gayaanee gayaan gayaataa kai bidhaataa kai samaan hai(n) ||
217.e: They are famous swordsmen, childlike for their mothers, the supreme knowledgeable for great sages, they appear apparently like probvidence.

217.g: ਗਨਨ ਗਨੇਸ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੁਰਨ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਜਾਨੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੇਖੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਈ ਲਖੇ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੨॥
217.t: ganan ganes maanai suran sures jaanai jaise pekhai taise iee lakhe biraajamaan hai(n) ||172||
217.e: All the Ganas consider them as Ganesh and all the gods as Indra. The sum and substance is this that they manifest themselves in the same form as one thinks about.172.

217.g: ਸੁਧਾ ਸੌ ਸੁਧਾਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਭਤ ਉਜਿਯਾਰੇ ਕਿਧੌ ਸਾਚੇ ਬੀਚ ਢਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: sudhaa sau sudhaare roop sobhat ujiyaare kidhau saache beech ddaare mahaa sobhaa kai sudhaar kai ||
217.e: Having bathed in ambrosia and the manifestation of beauty and glory, these very winsome princes appear as having been created in special mould.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਕੇ ਮੋਹਬੇ ਨਮਿੱਤ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਧਨਾ ਬਨਾਏ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਧ ਸੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: kidhau mahaa mohanee ke mohabe nami't beer bidhanaa banaae mahaa bidh so bichaar kai ||
217.e: It seems that in order to allure some most beautiful damsel the providence created these great heroes in a special way.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਦੈਤਨ ਬਿਬਾਦ ਛਾਡ ਬਡੇ ਚਿਰ ਮਥ ਕੈ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਛੀਰ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ਨਿਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: kidhau dhev dhaitan bibaadh chhaadd badde chir math kai samu(n)dhr chheer leene hai nikaar kai ||
217.e: They appear as having been taken out as gems by churning the ocean by the gods and demons on abandoning their disputes.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ ਜੂ ਬਨਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਪੇਖਬੇ ਕਉ ਅਉਰ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਐਸੀ ਸੂਰਤੈ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੩॥
217.t: kidhau bisavainaath joo banaae nij pekhabe kau aaur na sakat aaisee sooratai sudhaar kai ||173||
217.e: Or it seems that the Lord of the universe made improvement in the creation of their faces himself for having their continuous sight.173.

217.g: ਸੀਮ ਤਜਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਦੇਸ ਲਾਘ ਲਾਘ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਿਥਲੇਸ ਕੇ ਪਹੂਚੇ ਦੇਸ ਆਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: seem taj aapanee biraane dhes laagh laagh raajaa mithales ke pahooche dhes aan kai ||
217.e: Crossing the frontier of their kingdom and passing through other countries, all these princes reached the abode of king Janak of Mithila.

217.g: ਤੁਰਹੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਬਾਜੈ ਦੁੰਦਭੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਗਾਜੈ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਾਜਨ ਬਜਾਏ ਜੋਰ ਜਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: turahee ana(n)t baajai dhu(n)dhabhee apaar gaajai bhaat bhaat baajan bajaae jor jaan kai ||
217.e: On reaching there they caused the high-pitch resonance of the drums and other musical instruments.

217.g: ਆਗੈ ਆਨਿ ਤੀਨੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਠ ਲਾਇ ਲੀਨੇ ਰੀਤ ਰੂੜ ਸਭੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: aagai aan teenai nirap ka(n)Th lai leene reet rooR sabhai keene baiThe bedh kai bidhaan kai ||
217.e: The king came forward and hugged the all three to his bosom, all the Vedic rites were performed.

217.g: ਬਰਿਖਯੋ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਪਾਇਯਤ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਭਿੱਛਕ ਭਏ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਐਸੇ ਪਾਇ ਦਾਨ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੪॥
217.t: barikhayo dhan kee dhaar paiyat na paaraavaar bhi'chhak bhe nirapaar aaise pai dhaan kai ||174||
217.e: There was continuous chartable flow of wealth and on acquiring the alsm, the beggars became king-like.174.

217.g: ਬਾਨੇ ਫਹਰਾਨੇ ਘਹਰਾਨੇ ਦੁੰਦਭ ਅਰਰਾਨੇ ਜਨਕ ਪੁਰੀ ਕੌ ਨੀਅਰਾਨੇ ਬੀਰ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: baane faharaane ghaharaane dhu(n)dhabh araraane janak puree kau neearaane beer jai kai ||
217.e: The banners were unfurled and the drums resounded, the brave heroes began to shout loudly on reaching Janakpuri.

217.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚਉਰ ਢਾਰੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਰਣ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਾਟ ਜੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਛੰਦ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
217.t: kahoo(n) chaur ddaarai kahoo(n) chaaran uchaarai kahoo(n) bhaaT ju pukaarai chha(n)dh su(n)dhar banai kai ||
217.e: Somewhere the whisks are being swung, somewhere the minstrels are singing eulogies and somewhere the poets are reciting their beautiful stanza.

218.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੀਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਸਾਜੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਜੈ ਰਹੇ ਭਿੱਛਕ ਅਘਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
218.t: kahoo(n) been baajai kouoo baasuree miradha(n)g saajai dhekhe kaam laajai rahe bhi'chhak aghai kai ||
218.e: Somewhere the lyre is being played, somewhere flutes, drum and other musical instruments. On seeing all this the god of love is feeling shy and so mush charity was donated that the beggars feel satisfied.

218.g: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਸੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਏ ਆਸਿਖ ਅਸੇਖ ਦਏ ਮਾਗਤ ਨ ਭਏ ਫੇਰ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੫॥
218.t: ra(n)k te su raajaa bhe aasikh asekh dhe maagat na bhe fer aaiso dhaan pai kai ||175||
218.e: The poor became king-like and began to give blessings  after receiving alms, no tendency for begging was left.175.

218.g: ਆਨ ਕੈ ਜਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ਕੰਠ ਸੋ ਲਗਾਇ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਆਦਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਭਾਤਿ ਲਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.t: aan kai janak leeno ka(n)Th so lagai tihoo(n) aadhar dhura(n)t kai ana(n)t bhaat le hai(n) ||
218.e: Janak came and hugged all the three to his bosom and honoured them in various ways.

218.g: ਬੇਦ ਕੇ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਬਯਾਸ ਤੇ ਬਧਾਈ ਬੇਦ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸ੍ਵਰਨ ਦਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.t: bedh ke bidhaan kai kai bayaas te badhaiee bedh ek ek bipr kau bisekh savairan dhe hai(n) ||
218.e: The Vedic discipline was observed and the Brahmins recited the congratulatory Vedic mantras.

218.g: ਰਾਜਕੁਆਰ ਸਭੈ ਪਹਿਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਪਾਇਨ ਤੇ ਮੋਤੀਮਾਨ ਕਰਕੇ ਬਰਖ ਮੇਘ ਗਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.t: raajakuaar sabhai pahirai sirapain te moteemaan karake barakh megh ge hai(n) ||
218.e: The king gave the gift of gold to each Brahmin, the princes were given presents and there was shower of gems.

218.g: ਦੰਤੀ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਦੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿੰਧਲੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਵੀਨੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਤੀਨੋ ਬਯਾਹ ਕੈ ਪਠਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੬॥
218.t: dha(n)tee savaiet dheene kete si(n)dhalee ture naveene raajaa ke kumaar teeno bayaeh kai paThe hai(n) ||176||
218.e: The white elephants and the brisk horses of Sindhu were presented to the princes, in this way all the three princes moved black after their wedding.176.
DODHAK STANZA
After marrying the daughter of King Janak, the princes soon asked for permission to depart.
This group of kings accompanied by elephants and horses, having many desires in their mind, started (for back journey).177.
The dowry was given in such a great measure that even the Brahmins could not keep the same collectively.
Many types of horses and the thundering elephants in many garbs started moving.178.
The sound of fifes resounded and the mighty warriors thundered.
When Oudhpuri was nearby, then all were welcomed by Ram.179.
The mother drank water after its propitiatory offering to princes and the King Dasrath was highly pleased in his mind seeing this splendour.
On seeing the princes, the king hugged them to his bosom and all the people entered the city while dancing and singing.180.
When the princes came home after their marriage, then many kinds of congratulatory songs were sung.
Dasrath called Vasishtha and Sumantra and with them came several other sages.181.

218.g: ਚਾਰੋ ਦਿਸ ਦਿਗ ਦਾਹ ਲਖਿਯੋ ਸਭ ॥
218.t: chaaro dhis dhig dhaeh lakhiyo sabh ||
218.e: At that time the clouds gathered on all the four sides and all saw apparently the flames of fire in all the four directions.
On seeing this all the ministers and friends became worried and request the king in the following manner.182.
“O King! There are many cases of providential wrath, tumult on all the four sides, therefore give thought to them by calling all the sages and advisers.
“Call the Brahmins without delay and begin Krit Yajna.183.
“O King! give instant orders for starting the Krit Yajna without delay,
“In view of the great wisdom of friends and ministers.”184.

218.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬਡੇ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਨ ਮਹਾ ਦਿਜ ॥
218.t: bol badde rikh leen mahaa dhij ||

218.g: ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਬੋਲ ਲਯੋ ਜੁਤ ਰਿਤਜ ॥
218.t: hai tin bol layo jut ritaj ||
218.e: The king called he eminent sages and great friends soon.
The sacrificial pit was dug up there and a pillar of righteousness was established.185.
A horse was let off from the stable so that ending the glory of other king they may be conquered.
The kings several countries were sent alongwith the horse and all of them were persons of beauteous limbs and the enhancer of glory.186.
SAMAANKA STANZA

219.e: The king Dasrath made selection of other efficient kings and sent them with the horse.
They went having been completely embellished. These brave men were of very gentle demeanour.187.
