They roamed in several countries, both inland and foreign and at all the places they destroyed (the pride of) all with the blaze of their glory.
They caused their horse to revolve on all the four sides and in this way they enhanced the royal prestige of king Dasrath.188.
Many kings bowed at his feet and he removed all their agonies.
He completed his Yajna and in this way destroyed the anguish of his subjects.189.
Receiving the gifts of many kinds the Brahmins pleased and satisfied in their mind  they moved back to their places.
Giving the blessing of various kinds and singing the Vedic mantras.190.
The kings of the inland and foreign countries decorate themselves in various garbs,
And noticing the significant glory of the warriors, the beautiful and cultured women were allured towards them.191.
Millions of musical instruments were played and all the bedecked persons were full of love.
The idols of gods were established and all were bowing with respect to the gods, expressing their gratitude.192.
All the people prostrated and bowed at the feet of gods and were assuming significant emotions in their minds.
Therefore was recitation of mantras and yantras and the idols of Ganas were being fixed.193.
Beautiful women and heavenly damsels began to dance.
In this way there was the sway of Ram Rajya and there was no dearth of anything.194.
SARSWATI STANZA

219.g: ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਨ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਸਿਖਵੰਤ ਹੈਂ ਦਿਜ ਏਕ ॥
219.t: dhes dhesan kee kriaa sikhava(n)t hai(n) dhij ek ||
219.e: On one side the Brahmins are teaching about the activities of various countries,

219.g: ਬਾਨ ਅਉਰ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧ ਦੇਤ ਆਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
219.t: baan aaur kamaan kee bidh dhet aan anek ||
219.e: And on the other side the methods of archery are being reveled.

219.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਸੋਂ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ॥
219.t: bhaat bhaatan so(n) paRaavat baar naar si(n)gaar ||
219.e: Instructions are being given about various types of the embellishments of women.

219.g: ਕੋਕ ਕਾਬਯ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਯਾਕਰਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
219.t: kok kaabay paRai kahoo(n) bayaakaran bedh bichaar ||195||
219.e: The art of love, poetry, grammar and Vedic learning are being taught side by side.195.

219.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਬੰਸ ਕੇ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
219.t: raam param pavitr hai raghuba(n)s ke avataar ||
219.e: The incarnation of Ram of the clan of Raghu is extremely pure.

219.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੈਤਨ ਕੇ ਸੰਘਾਰਕ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
219.t: dhusaT dhaitan ke sa(n)ghaarak sa(n)t praan adhaar ||
219.e: He is the destroyer of tyrants and demons and is thus the support of the life-breath of the saints.

219.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਰੇਸ ਜੀਤ ਅਸੇਸ ਕੀਨ ਗੁਲਾਮ ॥
219.t: dhes dhes nares jeet ases keen gulaam ||
219.e: He has subordinate the king of various countries by conquering them,

219.g: ਜੱਤ੍ਰ ਤੱਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਜਾ ਬਧੀ ਜੈ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੯੬॥
219.t: ja'tr ta'tr dhujaa badhee jai pa'tr kee sabh dhaam ||196||
219.e: And his banners of victory are fluttering here, there and everywhere.196.

219.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਤੀਨ ਦਿਸਾ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਸੁਤ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
219.t: baaT teen dhisaa tihoo(n) sut raajadhaanee raam ||
219.e: The king gave his three sons the kingdoms of three directions and gave Ram the kingdom of his capital Ayodhya,

219.g: ਬੋਲ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਸਿਸਟ ਕੀਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੇਤਕ ਜਾਮ ॥
219.t: bol raaj bisisaT keen bichaar ketak jaam ||
219.e: After discussing for a long time with Vasishtha,

219.g: ਸਾਜ ਰਾਘਵ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਘਟ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਏਕ ॥
219.t: saaj raaghav raaj ke ghaT poor raakhas ek ||
219.e: There lived a demoness in the house of Dasrath in disguise,

219.g: ਆਂਬ੍ਰ ਮਉਲਨ ਦੀਸੁ ਉਦਕੰ ਅਉਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧੯੭॥
219.t: aa(n)br maulan dhees udhaka(n) aaur puhap anek ||197||
219.e: Who had asked for all this activity the fructifying mango dust, pure water of the stream and many flowers.197.

219.g: ਥਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨਾਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
219.t: thaar chaar apaar ku(n)kam cha(n)dhanaadh ana(n)t ||
219.e: Four adorned slavers containing saffron, sandalwood etc.,

219.g: ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਧਰੇ ਸਭੈ ਤਹ ਆਨ ਆਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
219.t: raaj saaj dhare sabhai teh aan aan dhura(n)t ||
219.e: Were kept with the king for the fulfillment of this function.

219.g: ਮੰਥਰਾ ਇਕ ਗਾਧ੍ਰਬੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪਠੀ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਲ ॥
219.t: ma(n)tharaa ik gaadhrabee brahamaa paThee teh kaal ||
219.e: At the same time Brahma sent a Gandharva woman named Manthra to the place,

220.g: ਬਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸਣੈ ਚੜੀ ਸਭ ਸੁਭ੍ਰ ਧਉਲ ਉਤਾਲ ॥੧੯੮॥
220.t: baaj saaj sanai chaRee sabh subhr dhaul utaal ||198||
220.e: Who embellished with all kinds of arts and wearing white garments started very quickly.198.

220.g: ਬੇਣ ਬੀਣ ਮ੍ਰਦੰਗ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਣੇ ਰਹੀ ਚਕ ਬਾਲ ॥
220.t: ben been mradha(n)g baadh sune rahee chak baal ||
220.e: She was surprised to listen to the sound of lyre, drum and other musical instruments,

220.g: ਰਾਮਰਾਜ ਉਠੀ ਜਯਤ ਧੁਨਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਭੂਰ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
220.t: raamaraaj uThee jayat dhun bhoom bhoor bisaal ||
220.e: And also saw on that wide plain the sound hailing the victory of ram Rajya was being heard.

220.g: ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਕਈ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬਾਤਿ ॥
220.t: jaat hee sa(n)g kekiee ieh bhaat bolee baat ||
220.e: Going near Kaikeyi she addressed her in this way :

220.g: ਹਾਥ ਬਾਤ ਛੁਟੀ ਚਲੀ ਬਰ ਮਾਗ ਹੈਂ ਕਿਹ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧੯੯॥
220.t: haath baat chhuTee chalee bar maag hai(n) keh raat ||199||
220.e: “When the opportunity will go out of hand, then for whom you will ask for the boons?”199.

220.g: ਕੇਕਈ ਇਮ ਜਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਭਈ ਦੁੱਖਤਾ ਸਰਬੰਗ ॥
220.t: kekiee im jau sunee bhiee dhu'khataa saraba(n)g ||
220.e: When Kaikeye heard all the account, she was completely full of anguish,

220.g: ਝੂਮ ਭੂਮ ਗਿਰੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਜਿਮ ਲਾਗ ਬਣ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
220.t: jhoom bhoom giree miragee jim laag ban sura(n)g ||
220.e: And fell down unconscious on the earth like the doe pierced by an arrow.

220.g: ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕੱਉ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਨ ॥
220.t: jaat hee avadhes ka'au ieh bhaat bolee bain ||
220.e: Going in the presence of king of Oudh, she said this :

220.g: ਦੀਜੀਏ ਬਰ ਭੂਪ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਕਹੇ ਦੁਇ ਦੈਨ ॥੨੦੦॥
220.t: dheeje'ee bar bhoop mo kau jo kahe dhui dhain ||200||
220.e: “O king! You had promised to grant me two boons, grant them to me just now.200.

220.g: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਮਮ ਪੂਤ ਕਉ ਨਿਜ ਰਾਜ ॥
220.t: raam ko ban dheejeeaai mam poot kau nij raaj ||
220.e: “Give exile to Ram and your kingdom, wealth, whisk an canopy-everything.

220.g: ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸੁ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਚਉਰ ਛੱਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
220.t: raaj saaj su sa(n)padhaa dhouoo chaur chha'tr samaaj ||
220.e: Give him ( Bharat) the kingdom, wealth, whisk and canopy-everything

220.g: ਦੇਸ ਅਉਰਿ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਇ ਦੈ ਸਭ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
220.t: dhes aaur bidhes kee Thakurai dhai sabh moh ||
220.e: “When you will grant me the ruling power over the inland and foreign countries,

220.g: ਸੱਤ ਸੀਲ ਸਤੀ ਜਤ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਤਉ ਪਛਾਨੋ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੨੦੧॥
220.t: sa't seel satee jat brat tau pachhaano toh ||201||
220.e: “Then I shall consider you the observer of truthfulness and recognizer of righteousness.”201.

220.g: ਪਾਪਨੀ ਬਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪੈ ਹੈਂ ਕਹਾ ਜਸ ਕਾਢ ॥
220.t: paapanee ban raam ko pai hai(n) kahaa jas kaadd ||
220.e: The king replied, “O sinful woman! What approbation you will gain by sending Ram to the forest?

220.g: ਭਸਮ ਆਨਨ ਤੇ ਗਈ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਕੇ ਅਸਿ ਬਾਢ ॥
220.t: bhasam aanan te giee keh kai sake as baadd ||
220.e: “By such surpassing utterance of yours the ash of magnificence on my forehead has flown down with the upcoming perspiration.”

220.g: ਕੋਪ ਭੂਪ ਕੁਅੰਡ ਲੈ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਇਹ ਕਾਲ ॥
220.t: kop bhoop kua(n)dd lai tuh kaaTeeaai ieh kaal ||
220.e: The king taking his bow in his hand said this angrily, “I would have chopped and thrown you just now,

220.g: ਨਾਸ ਤੋਰਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਤਕ ਛਾਡੀਐ ਤੁਹਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨੦੨॥
220.t: naas toran keejeeaai tak chhaaddeeaai tuh baal ||202||
220.e: “And destroyed you, but I let you go because you are a woman.”202.

220.g: ਨਗ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
220.t: nag saroopee chha(n)dh ||
220.e: NAG SWAROOPI STANZA

220.g: ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵ ਰਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
220.t: nar dhev dhev raam hai ||

220.g: ਅਭੇਵ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
220.t: abhev dharam dhaam hai ||
220.e: “The superb god amongst men is Ram who is certainly the abode of Dhrma,

220.g: ਅਬੁੱਧ ਨਾਰਿ ਤੈ ਮਨੈ ॥
220.t: abu'dh naar tai manai ||

220.g: ਬਿਸੁੱਧ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਭਨੈ ॥੨੦੩॥
220.t: bisu'dh baat ko bhanai ||203||
220.e: “O foolish woman! why are you uttering such contrary words?203.

220.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਨੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
220.t: agaadh dhev ana(n)t hai ||

220.g: ਅਭੂਤ ਸੋਭਵੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
220.t: abhoot sobhava(n)t hai ||
220.e: “He is unfathomable and infinite god and is highly seated beyond all elements.

221.e: “He is merciful and kind towards all and mercifully gives support to helpless and ferries them across.204.
“He is the saviour of many saints and is the basic cause of the gods and demons.
“He is also the king of gods and is the store of all powers.”205.
The queen said, “O king! Grant me the boons and fulfil thy sayins.
“Adandon the position of duality from your mind and do not fail in your promise.”206.
NAG SWAROOPI ARDH STANZA
“O king! Do not hesitate and run away from your promise, give exile to Ram.207.
“Bid farewell to Ram and take back the proposed rule from him. Don’t run away from your promise and be seated peacefully.208.
“O king! Cal Vasishtha and the royal priest and send Ram to the forest.”209.
The king heaved a long sigh, moved hither and thither and then fell down.210.
The king again came to his senses from the stupor and grievously heaved a long breath.211.
UGAADH STANZA
With tears in his eyes and anguish in his utterance,
The kin said to Kaikeyi, “You are a mean and evil woman.212.
“You are a blemish on womankind and a store of vices.
“You have no shame in your eyes and your words are ignominious.213.
“You are evil woman and are the destroyer of enhancement.
“You are performer of evil deeds and shameless in your Dharma.214.
“You are the abode of shamelessness and a woman forsaking hesitation (shyness).
“You are the performer of misdeeds and destroyer of glory.215.

222.e: “O shameless woman! you are the doer of evil acts,
“Impiety-incarnate and store of vicious works.216.
“O the basket of sins! evil-doer,
“You do not die even we wish you to die, you are the performer of misdeeds.”217.
The Speech of Kaikeyi:
“O king! Accept my saying and remember your words
“Whatever you have promised, grant me two boons according to that.218.
“Remember rightly and give whatever you have said.
“Do not forsake your Dharma and do not shatter my trust.219.
“Call Vasishtha, your unique spiritual head,
“Order the husband of Sita for his exile.220.
“Do not cuase any delay in the task and accept my saying
“Making Ram a sage, turn him out of the home ”221.
(The poet says) She was stubborn like a child and verged on madness.
She did not keep silent and was continuously speaking.222.
She was worthy of reproach and store of man acts.
She was evil-tongued queen and the cause of weakening the strength of the king.223.
She got the ouster of Ram, who was the pillar (support) of the house
And in this way she performed the evil act of killing her husband.224.
UGAATHA STANZA
(The poet says that the woman) conquered the unconquered, destroyed the indestructible, broke the unbreakable and (with her blaze) reduced to ashes the indeclinable.
She has slandered him who cannot be calumniated, she has given him a blow who cannot be farmed. She has deceived them who is beyond deception and has disjointed the compact one.225.
She has engrossed the detached one in action and her vision is so sharp that she can see providence. She can cause the unpunishable to be punished and uneatable to be eaten.
She has fathomed the unfathomable and has destroyed the indestructible. She has destroyed the indestructible and has moved the immovable as her vehicles.226.
She has dyed the dried one, blazed the incombustible. She has destroyed the indestructible and has moved the immovable.

223.e: She has disjoined the compact one and has punished the unpunishable. She can do whatever is not to be done and can corroborate the irrefutable.227.
She has blemished the unblemishabel and has stained the pure one  she as made thieves and thus the persons who are never deceptive
She has discriminated the indiscriminate and has broken the unbreakable. She has covered the naked ones and united the disjointed.228.
She has burnt the incombustible and can bend the unbendable. She has pulled the pulled the annullable and has untited the disjointed.
She has taken out those which can never be taken our and fashioned the unfashionable, she has wounded the unconquerable and has entrapped those who cannot be entrapped.229.
She performs all forbidden works and she protects all vicious acts. She creates the sense of friendship in detached ones and the stable one run away when they face her.
She teases the peaceful person and reveals a very mysterious one, she conquers the unconquerable and kills those cannot be killed.230.
She rips and breaks the hardest one, she establishes the unestablished and tears that which can’t be torn

She drives the immobile and makes a leper of a healthy person, she engages herself in battle with mighty ones an with whomsoever supremely strong person she fights, she lays obstructions in their art of war and finishes.231.
She has defeated the mighty ones and injured the invincible, she crushes those who cannot be crushed, she deceives the undeceivable
She frightens the fearless and destroys the indestructible, she break the unbreakable and turns into lepers those of healthy bodies.232.
She routs those who take a stand and pulls down those who are firm and stable  she breaks the unbreakable and ride over many, making them her slaves,

224.g: ਅਮੁੰਨ ਮੁੰਨੇ ਅਹੇਹ ਹੇਹੇ ॥
224.t: amu(n)n mu(n)ne aheh hehe ||

224.g: ਵਿਰਚੰਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਤ ਸੁੱਖ ਕੇਹੇ ॥੨੩੩॥
224.t: viracha(n)n naaree ta su'kh kehe ||233||
224.e: She deceives those who are undeceivable and makes the chaste ones licentious  the house in which the woman has the apprehension, how can there be peace?233.

224.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
224.t: dhoharaa ||
224.e: DOHRA

224.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੇਕਈ ਹਠ ਗਹਯੋ ਬਰ ਮਾਗਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਤੀਰ ॥
224.t: eeh bidh kekiee haTh gahayo bar maagan nirap teer ||
224.e: In this way Kaikeyi persisted in her demand for boons from the king

224.g: ਅਤਿ ਆਤਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਧਯੋ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨੩੪॥
224.t: at aatar kiaa keh sakai bidhayo kaam ke teer ||234||
224.e: The king became greatly agitated but because of the attachment with the winsome wife and under the impact of the god of love (Kamdev), he could not say anything.234.

224.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
224.t: dhoharaa ||
224.e: DOHRA

224.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਰ ਪਾਇਨ ਰਹੇ ਮੋਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
224.t: bahu bidh par pain rahe more bachan anek ||

224.g: ਗਹਿਅਉ ਹਠਿ ਅਬਲਾ ਰਹੀ ਮਾਨਯੋ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੨੩੫॥
224.t: gahiaau haTh abalaa rahee maanayo bachan na ek ||235||
224.e: The king in many ways holding the feet of the queen to back out from his promise, but that woman, showing her weakness (of fair sex) persisted in her demand and did not accept any request of the king.235.

224.g: ਬਰ ਦਯੋ ਮੈ ਛੋਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਤੈਂ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
224.t: bar dhayo mai chhore nahee tai(n) kar koT upai ||

224.g: ਘਰ ਮੋ ਸੁਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਬਨਬਾਸੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੩੬॥
224.t: ghar mo sut kau dheejeeaai banabaasai raghurai ||236||
224.e: “I shall not leave you without getting the boons, though you may make millions of efforts. Give the kingdom to my son and exile Ram.”236.

224.g: ਭੂਪ ਧਰਨਿ ਬਿਨ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਬਚਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਾਨ ॥
224.t: bhoop dharan bin bu'dh girayo sunat bachan tiray kaan ||

224.g: ਜਿਮ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੇਸ ਬਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਧਯੋ ਬਧ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਨ ॥੨੩੭॥
224.t: jim mirages ban ke bikhai badhayo badh kar baan ||237||
224.e: Hearing these words of his wife, the king became unconscious and fell down on the earth like a lion pierced by arrow in the forest.237.

224.g: ਤਰਫਰਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਪਰਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਨ ਰਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
224.t: tarafaraat pirathavee parayo sun ban raam uchaar ||

224.g: ਪਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਯਾਗੇ ਤਜਤ ਮੱਧਿ ਸਫਰਿ ਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੨੩੮॥
224.t: palak praan tayaage tajat ma'dh safar sar baar ||238||
224.e: Hearing about the exile or ram the king writhed and fell down on the earth like the pining of the fish out of water and breathing her last.238.

224.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਣਯੋ ਉਠਿ ਥਿਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
224.t: raam naam sravanan sunayo uTh thir bhayo suchet ||

224.g: ਜਨੁ ਰਣ ਸੁਭਟ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਉਠਯੋ ਗਹਿ ਅਸ ਨਿਡਰ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥੨੩੯॥
224.t: jan ran subhaT girayo uThayo geh as niddar suchet ||239||
224.e: Hearing again the name of Ram the king came to his senses and stood up like a warrior becoming unconscious and falling in war and standing up again holding his sword after becoming conscious.239.

224.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਤਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ ਸਹੋ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਛੋਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
224.t: praan patan nirap bar saho dharam na chhoraa jai ||

224.g: ਦੈਨ ਕਹੇ ਜੋ ਬਰ ਹੁਤੇ ਤਨ ਜੁਤ ਦਏ ਉਠਾਇ ॥੨੪੦॥
224.t: dhain kahe jo bar hute tan jut dhe uThai ||240||
224.e: The king accepted death rather than abandonment of his Dharma and the boons which he had promised, he granted them and exiled Ram.240.

224.g: ਕੇਕਈ ਬਾਚ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੋ ਬਾਚ ॥
224.t: kekiee baach nirapo baach ||
224.e: The speeches of Kaikeyi and the King.

224.g: ਬਸਿਸਟ ਸੋਂ ॥
224.t: basisaT so(n) ||
224.e: Addressed to Vasihthea :

224.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
224.t: dhoharaa ||
224.e: DOHRA

224.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਯਾਨੋ ਬਨ ਕਰੈ ਭਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਠਕੁਰਾਇ ॥
224.t: raam payaano ban karai bharath karai Thakurai ||
224.e: “Exile Ram and give the kingdom to Bharat

224.g: ਬਰਖ ਚਤਰ ਦਸ ਕੇ ਬਿਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੪੧॥
224.t: barakh chatar dhas ke bite fir raajaa raghurai ||241||
224.e: After fourteen year Ram will again become the king.”241.

224.g: ਕਹੀ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
224.t: kahee basisaT sudhaar kar sree raghubar so jai ||
224.e: Vasishtha said the same thing to Ram in an improved way,

224.g: ਬਰਖ ਚਤੁਰਦਸ ਭਰਥ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਪੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੪੨॥
224.t: barakh chaturadhas bharath nirap pun nirap sree raghurai ||242||
224.e: That for fourteen years Bharat shall rule and after that you will be the king.242.

224.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਕੋ ਬਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਸੋਗ ॥
224.t: sun basisaT ko bach sravan raghupat fire sasog ||
224.e: Listening to the words of Vasishtha, Ram (Raghuvir) left with a sad heart,

224.g: ਉਤ ਦਸਰਥ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਯੋ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਿਯੋਗ ॥੨੪੩॥
224.t: aut dhasarath tan ko tajayo sree raghubeer biyog ||243||
224.e: And on this side the king. Not enduring the separation of Ram, breathed his last.243.

224.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
224.t: soraThaa ||
224.e: SORTHA

224.g: ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਆਵਤ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ਸਭੁ ਧਨ ਦੀਯੋ ਲੁਟਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
224.t: greh aavat raghurai sabh dhan dheeyo luTai kai ||
224.e: On reaching his place Ram gave all his wealth in charity,

224.g: ਕਟਿ ਤਰਕਸੀ ਸੁਹਾਇ ਬੋਲਤ ਭੇ ਸੀਅ ਸੋ ਬਚਨ ॥੨੪੪॥
224.t: kaT tarakasee suhai bolat bhe seea so bachan ||244||
224.e: And binding his quiver to his waist he said to Sita 244

224.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੀਅ ਸੁਜਸ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਰਹੌ ਕੌਸੱਲਿਆ ਤੀਰ ਤੁਮ ॥
224.t: sun seea sujas sujaan rahau kauasa'liaa teer tum ||
224.e: “O wise Sita! You stay with Kaushalya.

224.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨ ਤੋਹਿ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਬਸਿ ॥੨੪੫॥
224.t: raaj karau fir aan toh sahit banabaas bas ||245||
224.e: “And I shall rule again alongwith you after exile.”245.

224.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋਂ ॥
224.t: seetaa baach raam so(n) ||
224.e: Speech of Sita addressed to Ram :

224.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
224.t: soraThaa ||
224.e: SORTHA

224.g: ਮੈ ਨ ਤਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੈਸੋਈ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਪੈ ਪਰੋ ॥
224.t: mai na tajo peea sa(n)g kaisoiee dhukh jeea pai paro ||
224.e: “I cannot forsake the company of my beloved even if I have to undergo a great suffering.

224.g: ਤਨਕ ਨ ਮੋਰਉ ਅੰਗਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਗ ਕਿਨ ॥੨੪੬॥
224.t: tanak na morau a(n)g a(n)g te hoi ana(n)g kin ||246||
224.e: “For this, undoubtedly, if my limbs are chopped, I shall not turn back a little and shall not deem it and anguish.”246.

224.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਸੀਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
224.t: raam baach seetaa prat ||
224.e: Speech of Ram addressed to Sita :

224.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
224.t: manohar chha(n)dh ||
224.e: MANOHAR STANZA

224.g: ਜਉ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸੋਦਰ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੋਹਿ ਪਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.t: jau na rahau sasuraar kirasodhar jaeh pitaa gireh toh paThai dhiau ||
224.e: “O lady of slim waist! If you do not like to stay with your in-laws, then I shall send you to your father’s house,

224.g: ਨੈਕ ਸੇ ਭਾਨਨ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਕੱਉ ਜੋਈ ਠਾਟ ਕਹੋ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਠ ਗਿਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.t: naik se bhaanan te ham ka'au joiee ThaaT kaho soiee gaaTh giThai dhiau ||
224.e: “And I shall make the arrangements that you like, there shall be no objection on my part

224.g: ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਹ ਕਰੋ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਟੁਕ ਮੋਹ ਕਹੋ ਸਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਉਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.t: je kichh chaeh karo dhan kee Tuk moh kaho sabh toh uThai dhiau ||
224.e: “If you want to have some wealth, then tell me clearly, I shall give you wealth according to your wishes

224.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਅਉਧ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਲੋਚਨ ਰੰਕ ਕੋ ਲੰਕ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਲੁਟੈ ਦਿਉ ॥੨੪੭॥
224.t: ketak aaudh ko raaj salochan ra(n)k ko la(n)k nisa(n)k luTai dhiau ||247||
224.e: “O lady of beautiful eyes! There is only a time factor. If you agree, I shall give in charity to the poor a city full of riches like the city of Lanka.247.

224.g: ਘੋਰ ਸੀਆ ਬਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਕਹੋ ਹਮ ਸੋਂ ਕਸ ਤੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
224.t: ghor seeaa ban too(n) su kumaar kaho ham so(n) kas tai nibahai hai ||
224.e: “O Sita! The forest life is full of troubles and you are a princess  you may tell me, how will you carry on there?

224.g: ਗੁੰਜਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਡਕਾਰਤ ਕੋਲ ਭਯਾਨਕ ਭੀਲ ਲਖੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਐਹੈ ॥
224.t: gu(n)jat si(n)gh ddakaarat kol bhayaanak bheel lakhai bhram aaihai ||
224.e: “The lions roar there, there are dreadful Kauls, Bhils, seeing whom one is frightened.

224.g: ਸੁੰਕਤ ਸਾਪ ਬਕਾਰਤ ਬਾਘ ਭਕਾਰਤ ਭੂਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਪੈਹੈ ॥
224.t: su(n)kat saap bakaarat baagh bhakaarat bhoot mahaa dhukh paihai ||
224.e: “The serpents hiss there, the tiger thunder and there are also extremely agonizing ghosts and fiends.

224.g: ਤੂੰ ਸੁ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਰਚੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਚਲੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਿਉਾਂ ਬਨਿ ਐਹੈ ॥੨੪੮॥
224.t: too(n) su kumaar rachee karataar bichaar chale tuh kiauaa(n) ban aaihai ||248||
224.e: “The Lord had made you a delicate one, think for a little while, why should you go to the forest?”248.

224.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਵਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋਂ ॥
224.t: seetaa vaach raam so(n) ||
224.e: Speech of Sita addressed to Ram :

224.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
224.t: manohar chha(n)dh ||
224.e: MANOHAR STANZA

225.g: ਸੂਲ ਸਹੋਂ ਤਨ ਸੂਕ ਰਹੋਂ ਪਰ ਸੀ ਨ ਕਹੋਂ ਸਿਰ ਸੂਲ ਸਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.t: sool saho(n) tan sook raho(n) par see na kaho(n) sir sool saho(n)gee ||
225.e: “If the thorns sting and the body pines away, I shall endure the hardship of the thorn on my head.

225.g: ਬਾਘ ਬੁਕਾਰ ਫਨੀਨ ਫੁਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਸੀਸ ਗਿਰੋ ਪਰ ਸੀ ਨ ਕਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.t: baagh bukaar faneen fukaar su sees giro par see na kaho(n)gee ||
225.e: ”If the tigers and serpents fall on my head, even then I shall not utter ‘oh’ or ‘alas’.

225.g: ਬਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਭਲੋ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਸ ਤਜੋ ਪੀਯ ਪਾਇ ਗਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.t: baas kahaa banabaas bhalo nahee paas tajo peey pai gaho(n)gee ||
225.e: “For me the exile in the forest is good for me than the palace, O beloved! bow at your feet.

225.g: ਹਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਇਹ ਉਦਾਸ ਸਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸ ਰਹੋ ਪਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਹੋਂਗੀ ॥੨੪੯॥
225.t: haas kahaa ieh udhaas samai gireh aas raho par mai na raho(n)gee ||249||
225.e: “Do not joke with me at this sad hour, I shall have hope and return to our home if I shall be with you, but I shall not live here without you.”249.

225.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਸੀਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
225.t: raam baach seetaa prat ||
225.e: Speech of ram addressed to Sita :

225.g: ਰਾਸ ਕਹੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਬਾਸ ਕਰੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
225.t: raas kaho tuh baas karo gireh saas kee sev bhalee bidh keejai ||
225.e: “O Sita! I am telling you the truth that you will be able to serve your mother-inlaw nicely while living in your home.

225.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਬਾਸ ਬਨੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋਂ ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਸੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
225.t: kaal hee baas banai mirag lochan raaj karo(n) tum so sun leejai ||
225.e: “O doe-eyed! The time will pass away quickly, I shall rule alongwith you.

225.g: ਜੌ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜੀਯ ਅਉਧ ਸੁਭਾਨਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਚ ਭਨੀਜੈ ॥
225.t: jau na lagai jeey aaudh subhaanan jaeh pitaa gireh saach bhaneejai ||
225.e: “If indeed, your mind does does not feel at home in Oudh, O winsome-faced! You go to your father’s house.

225.g: ਤਾਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਗਡੀ ਜੀਯ ਜਾਤ ਸਿਧਾਤ ਬਨੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਆਇਸ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨੫੦॥
225.t: taat kee baat gaddee jeey jaat sidhaat banai muh aais dheejai ||250||
225.e: “In my mind the instruction of my father abides, therefore you permit me to go to go to the forest.”250.

225.g: ਲਛਮਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
225.t: lachhaman baach ||
225.e: Speech of Lakshman :

225.g: ਬਾਤ ਇਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਤ ਭਈ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਇਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
225.t: baat itai ih bhaat bhiee sun aaige bhraat saraasan leene ||

225.g: ਕਉਨ ਕੁਪੂਤ ਭਯੋ ਕੁਲ ਮੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ਬਨੈ ਕਹੁ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
225.t: kaun kupoot bhayo kul mai jin raameh baas banai kahu dheene ||
225.e: This talk was going on when hearing it, Lakshman came with his bow in his hand and said, “Who can be that undutiful son in our clan who has asked for exile of Ram?

225.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਾਨ ਬਧਿਯੋ ਬਸ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਕੂਰ ਕੁਚਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨੇ ॥
225.t: kaam ke baan badhiyo bas kaaman koor kuchaal mahaa mat heene ||

225.g: ਰਾਡ ਕੁਭਾਡ ਕੇ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਕਿਯੋ ਕਪਿ ਨਾਚਤ ਨਾਚ ਛਰੀ ਜਿਮ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੨੫੧॥
225.t: raadd kubhaadd ke haath bikiyo kap naachat naach chharee jim cheene ||251||
225.e: “This foolish person (king) pierced by the arrows of the god of love, entrapped in cruel misconduct, under the impact of a foolish woman is dancing like a monkey understanding the sign of a stick.251.

225.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡ ਲੀਏ ਕਰ ਕੇਕਈ ਬਾਨਰ ਜਿਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਨਾਚ ਨਚਾਵੈ ॥
225.t: kaam ko dda(n)dd le'ee kar kekiee baanar jiau nirap naach nachaavai ||

225.g: ਐਠਨ ਐਠ ਅਮੈਠ ਲੀਏ ਢਿਗ ਬੈਠ ਸੂਆ ਜਿਮ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਾਵੈ ॥
225.t: aaiThan aaiTh amaiTh le'ee ddig baiTh sooaa jim paaTh paRaavai ||
225.e: “Taking the stick of lust in her hand Kaikeyi is causing the king to dance like a monkey  that proud woman has caught hold of the king and sitting with him she is teaching him lessons like a parrot.

225.g: ਸਉਤਨ ਸੀਸ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਈਸਕ ਈਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀਸ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਮ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
225.t: sautan sees havai ieesak iees pirathees jiau chaam ke dhaam chalaavai ||

225.g: ਕੂਰ ਕੁਜਾਤ ਕੁਪੰਥ ਦੁਰਾਨਨ ਲੋਗ ਗਏ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੨੫੨॥
225.t: koor kujaat kupa(n)th dhuraanan log ge paralok gavaavai ||252||
225.e: This woman is riding over the heads of her co-wives like a god of hods and for a short while is making current the coins of leather like the king (i.e. she is behaving to her liking). This cruel, inferior, ill-disciplined and ill-mouthed woman has not onl

225.g: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵ ਤਜੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਯੋ ਬਨ ਐਹੈ ॥
225.t: log kuTev lage un kee prabh paav taje muh kayo ban aaihai ||

225.g: ਜਉ ਹਟ ਬੈਠ ਰਹੋ ਘਰਿ ਮੋ ਜਸ ਕਯੋ ਚਲਿਹੈ ਰਘੁਬੰਸ ਲਜੈਹੈ ॥
225.t: jau haT baiTh raho ghar mo jas kayo chalihai raghuba(n)s lajaihai ||
225.e: “The people have begun to talk ill of both the king and the queen, how can I live by forsaking the feet of Ram, therefore I shall also go to the forests

225.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਉਚਾਰਤ ਕਾਲ ਗਯੋ ਇਹ ਕਾਲ ਸਭੋ ਛਲ ਜੈਹੈ ॥
225.t: kaal hee kaal uchaarat kaal gayo ieh kaal sabho chhal jaihai ||

225.g: ਧਾਮ ਰਹੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚ ਕਹੋਂ ਇਹ ਘਾਤ ਗਈ ਫਿਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥੨੫੩॥
225.t: dhaam raho nahee saach kaho(n) ieh ghaat giee fir haath na aaihai ||253||
225.e: “The whole time has passed in seeking an opportunity to serve ram and in this way the time will deceive all. I am telling the truth that I shall not stay at home and if this opportunity of service is lost, then I cannot avail it.”253.

225.g: ਚਾਪ ਧਰੈ ਕਰ ਚਾਰ ਕੁ ਤੀਰ ਤੁਨੀਰ ਕਸੇ ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
225.t: chaap dharai kar chaar k teer tuneer kase dhouoo beer suhaae ||

225.g: ਆਵਧ ਰਾਜ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਜਿਹ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੋਨ ਬਿਦਾ ਤਿਹ ਤੀਰ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
225.t: aavadh raaj treeyaa jeh sobhat hon bidhaa teh teer sidhaae ||
225.e: Holding the bow in one hand and tightening the quiver and holding three-four arrows in the other hand both the brothers are looking impressive  the side on which the

225.g: ਪਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਭਰ ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਭਰ ਮਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧ ਕੰਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
225.t: pai pare bhar nain rahe bhar maat bhalee bidh ka(n)Th lagaae ||

225.g: ਬੋਲੇ ਤੇ ਪੂਤ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਧਾਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਿਉ ਆਪਨ ਤੇ ਕਿਮੁ ਆਏ ॥੨੫੪॥
225.t: bole te poot na aavat dhaam bulai liau aapan te kim aae ||254||
225.e: They bowed before the mothers who hugging them with their bosoms said, “O son! you come with great hesitation when you are called but how you have come today yourself.”254.

225.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
225.t: raam baach maataa prat ||
225.e: Speech of Ram addressed to the Mother :

225.g: ਤਾਤ ਦਯੋ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਹਮੈ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹ ਰਜਾਇ ਅਬੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਊ ॥
225.t: taat dhayo banabaas hamai tum dheh rajai abai teh jaauoo ||

225.g: ਕੰਟਕ ਕਾਨ ਬੇਹੜ ਗਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਯੋਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਬਿਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਆਊ ॥
225.t: ka(n)Tak kaan behaR gaeh tirayodhas barakh bite fir aauoo ||
225.e: “The father has exiled me and now you permit us to depart for the forest, I shall come back on the fourteenth year after roaming in the forest stuffed with thorns for thirteen years.

225.g: ਜੀਤ ਰਹੇ ਤੁ ਮਿਲੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੀ ਬਖਸਾਊ ॥
225.t: jeet rahe ta milo fir maat mare ge bhool paree bakhasaauoo ||

225.g: ਭੂਪਹ ਕੈ ਅਰਿਣੀ ਬਰ ਤੇ ਬਸ ਕੇ ਬਲ ਮੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਊ ॥੨੫੫॥
225.t: bhoopeh kai arinee bar te bas ke bal mo fir raaj kamaauoo ||255||
225.e: “O mother! if I live, we shall meet again and if I die then for that purpose I have come to request you for forgiveness of my mistakes. On account of the boons granted by the king after residing in the forest, I shall rule again.”255.

225.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋਂ ॥
225.t: maataa baach raam so(n) ||
225.e: Speech of the Mother addressed to Ram:

225.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
225.t: manohar chha(n)dh ||
225.e: MANOHAR STANZA

225.g: ਮਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਜਬੈ ਤਬ ਰੋਵਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
225.t: maat sunee ieh baat jabai tab rovat hee sut ke ur laagee ||

225.g: ਹਾ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਿਰੋਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੱਉ ਕਤ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
225.t: haa raghubeer siroman raam chale ban kau muh ka'au kat tiaagee ||
225.e: When the mother heard these words, she clung to the neck of her son and said, “Alas, O Ram the superb person of Raghu clan! why are you going to the forest, leaving me here?”

225.g: ਨੀਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਮ ਮੀਨ ਦਸਾ ਤਿਮ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
225.t: neer binaa jim meen dhasaa tim bhookh piaas giee sabh bhaagee ||

225.g: ਝੂਮ ਝਰਾਕ ਝਰੀ ਝਟ ਬਾਲ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਦਵਾ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਉਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨੫੬॥
225.t: jhoom jharaak jharee jhaT baal bisaal dhavaa un kee ur laagee ||256||
225.e: The position which is felt by the fish on forsaking water, who was in the same condition and all her hunger and thurst ended, she fell unconscious with a jerk and her heart felt scorching blaze.256.

225.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੂਤ ਤਵਾਨਨ ਪੇਖ ਸੀਆ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੁਤ ਦੇਖ ਅਘਾਤੀ ॥
225.t: jeevat poot tavaanan pekh seeaa tumaree dhut dhekh aghaatee ||

225.g: ਚੀਨ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਜ ਕੀ ਛਬ ਕੋ ਸਭ ਸੋਕ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਹੀਏ ਹਰਖਾਤੀ ॥
225.t: cheen sumitraj kee chhab ko sabh sok bisaar he'ee harakhaatee ||
225.e: “O son! I live only on seeing your face and Sita also remains pleased on visualizing your divinity, on seeing the beauty of Lakshman, Sumitra remains pleased, forgetting all her sorrows.”

225.g: ਕੇਕਈ ਆਦਿਕ ਸਉਤਨ ਕੱਉ ਲਖਿ ਭਉਹ ਚੜਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਗਰਬਾਤੀ ॥
225.t: kekiee aadhik sautan ka'au lakh bhauh chaRai sadhaa garabaatee ||

225.g: ਤਾਕਹੁ ਤਾਤ ਅਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਆਜ ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥੨੫੭॥
225.t: taakahu taat anaath jiau aaj chale ban ko taj kai bilalaatee ||257||
225.e: These queens seeing Kaikeyi and other co-wives, and expressing their contempt, felt pride on account of their self-respect, felt pride on account of their self-respect, but see, today their sons are going to the forest, leaving them weeping like orphans,

225.g: ਹੋਰ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਰ ਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਰ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
225.t: hor rahe jan kor kiee mil jor rahe kar ek na maanee ||

225.g: ਲੱਛਨ ਮਾਤ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਠਾਨੀ ॥
225.t: la'chhan maat ke dhaam bidhaa kahu jaat bhe jeea mo ieh Thaanee ||
225.e: There were many other people also who collectively laid emphasis on not allowing Ram to leave for the forest, but he did not agree with anyone. Lakshman also went to the palace of her mother in order to bid farewell to her.

225.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਾਤ ਪਪਾਤ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ ਘਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
225.t: so sun baat papaat dharaa par ghaat bhalee ieh baat bakhaanee ||

225.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਸੇਲ ਸੁਮਾਰ ਲਗੇ ਛਿਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਸੂਰ ਵਡੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੨੫੮॥
225.t: jaanuk sel sumaar lage chhit sovat soor vadde abhimaanee ||258||
225.e: He said to his mother, The earth is full of sinful acts and this is the opportune time to live with Ram.” After hearing such words his mother fell down like the great and proud warrior who falls down with the blow of the spear and sleeps.258.

225.g: ਕਉਨ ਕੁਜਾਤ ਕੁਕਾਜ ਕੀਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਘਵ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥
225.t: kaun kujaat kukaaj keeyo jin raaghav ko ieh bhaat bakhaanayo ||

225.g: ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਨਨ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
225.t: lok alok gavai dhuraanan bhoop sa(n)ghaar tahaa sukh maanayo ||
225.e: “Which mean person has done this deed and said such things to Ram? He has lost his merit in this and the next world and who killing the king, has thought about the acquisition of supreme comfort.

225.g: ਭਰਮ ਗਯੋ ਉਡ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਯੋ ਘਟ ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
225.t: bharam gayo udd karam karayo ghaT dharam ko tiaag adharam pramaanayo ||

226.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟੀ ਨਿਰਲਾਜ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਪਾਤਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥੨੫੯॥
226.t: naak kaTee niralaaj nisaachar naeh nipaatat neh na maanayo ||259||
226.e: The trust and rightful acts have flown away from the world and authentically there remains only the impiety. This demoness has put the clan to disgrace and she does not feel sorrow on the death of her husband.”259.

226.g: ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
226.t: sumitraa baach ||
226.e: Speech of Sumitra,  Addressed to Lakshman :

226.g: ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਭਾਵ ਧਰੇ ਰਹੀਯੋ ਸੁਤ ਮਾਤ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੀਆ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੋ ॥
226.t: dhaas ko bhaav dhare raheeyo sut maat saroop seeaa pahichaano ||

226.g: ਤਾਤ ਕੀ ਤੁੱਲਿ ਸੀਆਪਤਿ ਕੱਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਸਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
226.t: taat kee tu'l seeaapat ka'au kar kai ieh baat sahee kar maano ||
226.e: “O son! always live like a servant (with your brother) and consider Sita as your mother and her husband Ram as your father and always keep these rightful facts in your mind.

226.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਕਾਨਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸੋ ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਤਨ ਪੈ ਅਨਮਾਨੋ ॥
226.t: jetak kaanan ke dhukh hai sabh so sukh kai tan pai anamaano ||

226.g: ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਇ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੀਯੋ ਬਨ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਬਨੁ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੨੬੦॥
226.t: raam ke pai gahe raheeyo ban kai ghar ko ghar kai ban jaano ||260||
226.e: “Endure all the troubles of the forest as comfort-like. Think always of the feet of Ram and consider the forest as home and the home as forest.”260.

226.g: ਰਾਜੀਵ ਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕੱਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਯੋ ॥
226.t: raajeev lochan raam kumaar chale ban ka'au sa(n)g bhraat suhaayo ||

226.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਨਿਛੱਤ੍ਰ ਸਚੀਪਤ ਚੱਉਕੇ ਚਕੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਦ ਬਢਾਯੋ ॥
226.t: dhev adhev nichha'tr sacheepat cha'auke chake man modh baddaayo ||
226.e: The lotus-eyed Ram moved alongwith his brother to the forest, on seeing this the gods were startled and the demons wondered,

226.g: ਆਨਨ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਰਯੋ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਪਰ ਫੈਲਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥
226.t: aanan bi(n)b parayo basudhaa par fail rahiyo fir haath na aayo ||

226.g: ਬੀਚ ਅਕਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕੀਯੋ ਤਿਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਯੰਕ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥੨੬੧॥
226.t: beech akaas nivaas keeyo tin taahee te naam maya(n)k kahaayo ||261||
226.e: And visualizing the end of demons Indra felt highly pleased, the moon also being pleased began to spread his reflection on the earth and being a resident within the sky, he became famous with the name of “Mayank.’261.

226.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
226.t: dhoharaa ||

226.g: ਪਿਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਤੇ ਬਨ ਚਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
226.t: pit aagiaa te ban chale taj greh raam kumaar ||

226.g: ਸੰਗ ਸੀਆ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਲੋਚਨੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨੬੨॥
226.t: sa(n)g seeaa mirag lochanee jaa kee prabhaa apaar ||262||
226.e: With the permission of his father, Ram left his home and went with the doe-eyed Sita who is infinitely glorious. ||262||

226.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਦੀਬੋ ॥
226.t: eit sree raam banabaas dheebo ||
226.e: End of the description of Exile of Ram.

226.g: ਅਥ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
226.t: ath banabaas kathana(n) ||
226.e: Now begins the description of the Exile:

226.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ ਬਾਚ ॥
226.t: seetaa anumaan baach ||
226.e: Speect about the charm of Sita:

226.g: ਬਿਜੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
226.t: bijai chha(n)dh ||

226.g: ਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਅੰਸ ਚਕੋਰਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੋਰਨ ਬਿੱਦੁਲਤਾ ਅਨਮਾਨੀ ॥
226.t: cha(n)dh kee a(n)s chakoran kai kar moran bi'dhulataa anamaanee ||
226.e: She was looking like moon to chakors and lightning in clouds to the peacocks.

226.g: ਮੱਤ ਗਇੰਦਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਧੂ ਭੁਨਸਾਰ ਛਟਾ ਰਵਿ ਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
226.t: ma't gi(n)dhan i(n)dhr badhoo bhunasaar chhaTaa rav kee jeea jaanee ||
226.e: She appeared as power-incarnate and the beauty of the sun at dawn to the intoxicated elephants.

226.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਤਾ ਅਰ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
226.t: dhevan dhokhan kee harataa ar dhevan kaal kirayaa kar maanee ||
226.e: To the gods she seemed like the destroyer of sufferings and the performer of the religious activities of all kinds.

226.g: ਦੇਸਨ ਸਿੰਧ ਦਿਸੇਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਿੰਧ ਜੋਗੇਸਨ ਗੰਗ ਕੈ ਰੰਗ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੨੬੩॥
226.t: dhesan si(n)dh dhisesan bira(n)dh jogesan ga(n)g kai ra(n)g pachhaanee ||263||
226.e: She appeared as the ocean to the earth, all-pervading to all the directions and pure like Ganges to the Yogis.263.

226.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
226.t: dhoharaa ||

226.g: ਉਤ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ ਸੀਅ ਸਹਿਤ ਤਜਿ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ॥
226.t: aut raghubar ban ko chale seea sahit taj greh ||
226.e: On that side leaving home alongwith Sita, Ram went to the foest,

226.g: ਇਤੈ ਦਸਾ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਈ ਸਕਲ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੨੬੪॥
226.t: eitai dhasaa jeh bidh bhiee sakal saadh sun leh ||264||
226.e: And on this side in Ayodhyapuri whatever happened, the saints may listen to that.264.

227.e: Speech of the Mother :
KABIT

227.g: ਸਭੈ ਸੁਖ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਗਏ ਗਾੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਦਸਰਥ ਜੂ ਕੱਉ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਆਜ ਪਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.t: sabhai sukh lai ke ge gaaRo dhukh dhet bhe raajaa dhasarath joo ka'au kai kai aaj paat ho ||
227.e: They had taken all the comforts with them and giving us great agony, they have left us to see also the agony of the death of king Dasrath.

227.g: ਅਜ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਬਾਤ ਮਾਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਰਾਜ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਹੋ ਕਾਜ ਕਉਨ ਕੌ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਨਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.t: aj hoo(n) na chheejai baat maan leejai raaj keejai kaho kaaj kaun kau hamaare sron naat ho ||
227.e: The king ram, seeing and listening to all this, is not softening, O Ram! accept now whatever we say, please tell, who is the survivor Lord here?

227.g: ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੌ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਜ ਕਹੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਆਜ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੱਉ ਸਿਧਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.t: raajasee ke dhaarau saaj saadhan kai keejai kaaj kaho raghuraaj aaj kaahe ka'au sidhaat ho ||
227.e: O Ram! take the reins of kingdom and do all the work. Tell us, why are you going now?

227.g: ਤਾਪਸੀ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਕੌ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਨਬਾਸੀ ਮੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੀਏ ਜਾਤ ਹੋ ॥੨੬੫॥
227.t: taapasee ke bhes keene jaanakee kau sa(n)g leene mere banabaasee mo udhaasee dhe'ee jaat ho ||265||
227.e: O exiled Ram in the garb of an ascetic and taking Janaki (Sita) with you, why are you giving me sadness?265.

227.g: ਕਾਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਕੌ ਛੋਰਿ ਦੇਸ ਤਾਪਸੀ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਭੇਸ ਸਾਥਿ ਹੀ ਸਿਧਾਰਿ ਹੌ ॥
227.t: kaare kaare kar bes raajaa joo kau chhor dhes taapasee ko kai bhes saath hee sidhaar hau ||
227.e: I shall also put on the black garb leaving the country of the king, and becoming an ascetic, I shall accompany you.

227.g: ਕੁਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਕਾਨ ਛੋਰੋਂ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੇ ਸਾਜ ਤੋਰੋਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਮੋਰੋਂ ਮੁਖ ਐਸੋ ਕੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਹੌ ॥
227.t: kul hoo(n) kee kaan chhoro(n) raajasee ke saaj toro(n) sa(n)g te na moro(n) mukh aaiso kai bichaar hau ||
227.e: I shall leave the family practice and abandon the royal splendour, but shall not turn my face away from you.

227.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨ ਧਾਰੌ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਪੈ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਡਾਰੌਂ ਹਠਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਹਾਰੌਂ ਪੂਤ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੌਂ ॥
227.t: mu(n)dhraa kaan dhaarau saare mukh pai bibhoot ddaaraua(n) haTh ko na haaraua(n) poot raaj saaj jaar haua(n) ||
227.e: I shall wear the rings in the ear and smear the ashes over my body. I shall live in persistence, O my son! I shall forsake all the royal paraphernalia.

227.g: ਜੁਗੀਆ ਕੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੇਸ ਕਉਸਲ ਕੇ ਛੋਰ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀ ਸਿਧਾਰਿ ਹੌਂ ॥੨੬੬॥
227.t: jugeeaa ko keeno bes kausal ke chhor dhes raajaa raamacha(n)dh joo ke sa(n)g hee sidhaar haua(n) ||266||
227.e: I shall adopt the garb of a yogi, and leaving Kaushal (country), I shall go with the king Ram.266.
APOORAV STANZA
Ram, the abode of religious action, went to the forest alongwith Lakshman and Janaki (Sita).267.
On that side the father breathed his last and left for heaven in and air-vehicle of gods. On this side, the ministers reflected on the situation.268.
The advice of vasishtha, the eminent Brahmin amongst all the Brahmins, was accepted. A letter was written and sent to Magadh.269.
A very brief discussion was held and several fast-moving messengers like Hanuman were sent.270.
Ten messengers, who were specialist in their task, were searched and sent to the place where Bharat resided.271.
Those messengers delivered the message and told that the king Dasrath had died, Bharat read the letter and accompanied them.272.
The anger blazed in his mind and the sense of Dharma and respect disappeared from it. They left Kashmir (and started on return journey) and began to remember the Lord.273.
The brave hero Bharat reached Oudh and saw the king Dasrath as dead.274.
Speech of Bharat addressed to Kaikeyi :
“O mother! when you saw that the worst had happened and then you called your son  you must be reproached, I feel ashamed. 275.

228.e: How is it that you lost all sense of shame ? That you have done such a bad deed; I shall go now where Ram has gone. '276.
KUSMA BACCHITAR STANZA

228.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
228.t: dhukh sukh sam kar sukh dhukh maanai ||
228.e: “The people residing in the forest, know Raghuvir Ram and consider his suffering and comfort as their own.

228.g: ਬਲਕਲ ਧਰ ਕਰ ਅਬ ਬਨ ਜੈਹੈਂ ॥
228.t: balakal dhar kar ab ban jaihai(n) ||

228.g: ਰਘੁਪਤ ਸੰਗ ਹਮ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਖੈਹੈਂ ॥੨੭੭॥
228.t: raghupat sa(n)g ham ban fal khaihai(n) ||277||
228.e: “Now I shall wear the rind of the tree and go to the forest and shall eat the forest fruit with ram.”277.

228.g: ਇਮ ਕਹਾ ਬਚਨਾ ਘਰ ਬਰ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
228.t: eim kahaa bachanaa ghar bar chhore ||

228.e: Saying this Bharat left his home and breaking the ornaments he threw them away and wore the bark-peel.

228.g: ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਪਗ ਤਰ ਕਰ ਘਰ ਮਾਡਿਯੋ ॥੨੭੮॥
228.t: raghupat pag tar kar ghar maaddiyo ||278||
228.e: He performed the death ceremony of king Dasrath and left Oudh and concentrated on abiding at the feet of Ram.278.

228.g: ਲਖਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਕਹ ਤਜਿ ਕੁਲ ਧਾਏ ॥
228.t: lakh jal thal keh taj kul dhaae ||

228.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਠਾ ਆਏ ॥
228.t: man man sa(n)g lai teh Thaa aae ||
228.e: The forest-dwellers, seeing the strong army of Bharat, came alongwith the sages and reached the place where Ram was staying.

228.g: ਲਖਿ ਬਲ ਰਾਮੰ ਖਲ ਦਲ ਭੀਰੰ ॥
228.t: lakh bal raama(n) khal dhal bheera(n) ||

228.g: ਗਹਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਣੰ ਸਿਤ ਧਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੨੭੯॥
228.t: geh dhan paana(n) sit dhar teera(n) ||279||
228.e: Seeing the strong force ram thought that some tyrants had come to attack, therefore he held the bow and arrows in his hands.279.

228.g: ਗਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਮੰ ਸਰ ਬਰ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
228.t: geh dhan raama(n) sar bar poora(n) ||

228.e: Ram taking his bow in his hand began to discharge arrow and seeing this Indra, sun etc. trembled with fear.

228.g: ਨਰ ਬਰ ਹਰਖੇ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਅਮਰੰ ॥
228.t: nar bar harakhe ghar ghar amara(n) ||

228.e: Seeing this the forest-dwellers felt pleased in their dwelling places, but the gods of Amarpura seeing this battle became anxious.280.
Then Bharat reflected in his mind that ram was thinking of starting the battle,

228.g: ਦਲ ਬਲ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਕਲੇ ਨਿਸਰੇ ॥
228.t: dhal bal taj kar ikale nisare ||

228.e: Therefore he left all his forces, went forward alone and seeing Ram all his sufferings ended.281.

228.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਬ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਭਟ ਮਣ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
228.t: dhirag jab nirakhe bhaT man raama(n) ||

228.g: ਸਿਰ ਧਰ ਟੇਕਯੰ ਤਜ ਕਰ ਕਾਮੰ ॥
228.t: sir dhar Tekaya(n) taj kar kaama(n) ||
228.e: When Bharat saw with his own eyes the mighty Ram, then abandoning all his desires, Bharat prostrated before him.

228.g: ਇਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਖਿ ਕਰ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
228.t: eim gat lakh kar raghupat jaanee ||

228.e: Seeing this, Ram realized that it was Bharat who had come leaving his capital.282.
Seeing Shatrughan and Bharat, Ram recognized them and it came into the mind of ram and Lakshman that king Dasrath had left this world
They abandoned their arrow and effacing their displeasure came down from the mountain.283.

228.g: ਦਲ ਬਲ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਲ ਰੋਏ ॥
228.t: dhal bal taj kar mil gal roe ||

228.g: ਦੁਖ ਕਸਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖ ਸਭ ਖੋਏ ॥
228.t: dhukh kas bidh dheeaa sukh sabh khoe ||
228.e: Leaving the army aside they hugged each other and wept. The providence had given such agony that they had lost all comforts.

228.g: ਤਜਿ ਹਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਭ ਪਗ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨੮੪॥
228.t: taj haTh laage sabh pag tere ||284||
228.e: Bharat said, “O Rahguvir, abandon your persistence and return to your home, because for this very reason all the people had fallen at your feet.”284.
Speech of Ram addressed to Bharat :
KANTH AABHUSHAN STANZA

228.g: ਜਾਹ ਘਰੈ ਨ ਹਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
228.t: jaeh gharai na hamai dhukh dheejai ||
228.e: “O Bharat! do not be obstinate, go to your home, do not give me more anguish by staying here

228.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਹਯੋ ਜੁ ਹਮੈ ਹਮ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
228.t: raaj kahayo ju hamai ham maanee ||

228.e: “Whatever permission has been given to me, I am acting according to that and accordingly I shall remain in the forest for thirteen years (and return in the fourteenth year).285.
“I shall return after thirteen years and sit on the throne under a canopy.
“Listen to my instruction and return home, your mothers must be weeping there.”286.
Speech of Bharat addressed to Ram :

229.e: KANTH AABHUSHAN STANZA

229.g: ਜਾਉ ਕਹਾ ਪਗ ਭੇਟ ਕਹਉ ਤੁਹ ॥
229.t: jaau kahaa pag bheT kahau tuh ||

229.g: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗਤ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੋ ਮੁਹ ॥
229.t: laaj na laagat raam kaho muh ||
229.e: “O Ram! where should I go now after touching your feet? Shall I not be ashmed?

229.g: ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤ ॥
229.t: mai at dheen maleen binaa gat ||

229.e: “I am extremely low, dirty and motionless. O Ram! manage your kingdom and glorify it with your ambrosial feet.”287.

229.g: ਤਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੀਰ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਪਗ ਭਰਥਰ ॥
229.t: tiau prabh teer girayo pag bharathar ||
229.e: Just as a bird become sightless fells down, in the same way Bharat fell down before Ram.

229.g: ਅੰਕ ਰਹੇ ਗਹ ਰਾਮ ਤਿਸੈ ਤਬ ॥
229.t: a(n)k rahe geh raam tisai tab ||

229.e: At the same time Ram hugged him to his bosom and there Lakshman and all the brother wept.288.
The brave Bharat was brought to his senses by giving water. Ram again said smilingly :
“After the elapse of thirteen years we shall return, now you go back because I have to fulfil some tasks in the forest.”289.

229.g: ਚੀਨ ਗਏ ਚਤੁਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਸਭ ॥
229.t: cheen ge chaturaa chit mo sabh ||

229.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਕਹੀ ਅਸ ਕੈ ਜਬ ॥
229.t: sree raghubeer kahee as kai jab ||
229.e: When Ram said this, then all the people understood its substance (that he had to kill the demons in the forest).

229.g: ਅਉਰ ਬਸੇ ਪੁਰ ਅਉਧ ਨ ਚੀਨੀ ॥੨੯੦॥
229.t: aaur base pur aaudh na cheenee ||290||
229.e: Submitting reverently to the instructions of Ram and with pleased mind Bharat took the sandals of Ram and forgetting the recognition of Ayodhya, he began to live out of its limits.290.

229.g: ਸੀਸ ਜਟਾਨ ਕੋ ਜੂਟ ਧਰੇ ਬਰ ॥
229.t: sees jaTaan ko jooT dhare bar ||

229.e: Wearing matted hair on his head he dedicated all the royal task to those sandals.
During the day he used to fulfil his royal duties with the support of those sandals and during the night he protected them.291.

229.g: ਜੱਜਰ ਭਯੋ ਝੁਰ ਝੰਝਰ ਜਿਉ ਤਨ ॥
229.t: ja'jar bhayo jhur jha(n)jhar jiau tan ||

229.e: The body of Bharat withered and become decrepit, but still he always kept the memory of Ram in his mind.
Alongwith this he destroyed the groups of enemies and instead of ornaments he wore rosaries as necklaces.292.
JHOOLA STANZA
On this side the king ram is doing the duties of gods by killing the demons  he looks like a mighty hero by taking the bow in his hand.293.
Where there were the trees of saal in the forest alongwith other trees and tans etc. its glory seemed heaven-like and was destroyer of all sorrows.294.
Ram stayed at that spot and looked like a mighty warrior, Sita was with him who was like a divine song.295.
She was a lady of sweet speech and her eyes were like the queen of deer, she had a slim and she looked like a fairy, a Padmini (amongst women).296.
JHOOLANA STANZA

229.g: ਚੜੈ ਪਾਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਧਰੇ ਸਾਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਚਛਾ ਬਾਨ ਸੋਹੈ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
229.t: chaRai paan baanee dhare saan maano chachhaa baan sohai dhouoo raam raanee ||
229.e: Ram looks glorious with the sharp arrows in his hands and Sita, the queen of Ram appears elegant with the beautiful arrows of her eyes.

229.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਖਿਆਲ ਸੋ ਏਕ ਹਵਾਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਾਨੀ ॥
229.t: firai khiaal so ek havaal setee chhuTe i(n)dhr setee mano i(n)dhr dhaanee ||
229.e: She roams with Ram, being absorbed into such thoughts as if having been ousted from his capital Indra was staggering hither and thither.

229.g: ਮਨੋ ਨਾਗ ਬਾਕੇ ਲਜੀ ਆਬ ਫਾਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਹਾਬ ਸੌ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
229.t: mano naag baake lajee aab faakai ra(n)ge ra(n)g suhaab sau raam baare ||
229.e: The loose hair of her braids, causing shyness to the glory of nagas, are becoming a sacrifice to Ram.

229.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਲਖੇ ਮੀਨ ਰੋਹੇ ਜਿਨੈ ਨੈਕ ਚੀਨੇ ਤਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੨੯੭॥
229.t: miragaa dhekh mohe lakhe meen rohe jinai naik cheene tino praan vaare ||297||
229.e: The deers looking at her are allured by her, the fishes looking at her beauty are feeling jealous of her  he, whoever had seen her, had sacrified himself for her.297.

229.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਕੂਕ ਕੇ ਕੋਕਲਾ ਕੋਪ ਕੀਨੇ ਮੁਖੰ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਚੰਦ ਦਾਰੇਰ ਖਾਈ ॥
229.t: sune kook ke kokalaa kop keene mukha(n) dhekh kai cha(n)dh dhaarer khaiee ||
229.e: The nightingale, listening to her speech, is getting angry on account of jealousy and the moon looking at her face is feeling shy like women,

230.g: ਲਖੇ ਨੈਨ ਬਾਕੇ ਮਨੈ ਮੀਨ ਮੋਹੈ ਲਖੇ ਜਾਤ ਕੇ ਸੂਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਛਾਈ ॥
230.t: lakhe nain baake manai meen mohai lakhe jaat ke soor kee jot chhaiee ||
230.e: The fish is allured by seeing her eyes and her beauty seems like the extension of sunlight.

230.g: ਮਨੋ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਝੂਲੇ ਲਖੇ ਲੋਗ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਨੇ ਜੋਰ ਐਸੇ ॥
230.t: mano fool foole lage nain jhoole lakhe log bhoole bane jor aaise ||
230.e: Seeing her eyes they appear like the blossomed lotus and all the people in the forest are extremely enchanted by her beauty.

230.g: ਲਖੇ ਨੈਨ ਥਾਰੇ ਬਿਧੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਸਾਰਾਬ ਸੁਹਾਬ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੨੯੮॥
230.t: lakhe nain thaare bidhe raam piaare ra(n)ge ra(n)g saaraab suhaab jaise ||298||
230.e: O Sita! seeing your intoxicated eyes Ram himself seems pierced by them.298.

230.g: ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਯੰ ਮੱਤ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਕਬੂਲਿ ਗੁੱਲਾਬ ਕੇ ਫੂਲ ਸੋਹੈਂ ॥
230.t: ra(n)ge ra(n)g raate maya(n) ma't maate makabool gu'laab ke fool sohai(n) ||
230.e: Your eyes are intoxicated, having been dyed in your love and it seems that they are lovely roses.

230.g: ਨਰਗਸ ਨੇ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਨਾਕ ਐਂਠਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤੈਂ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੈਂ ॥
230.t: naragas ne dhekh kai naak aai(n)Thaa mirageeraaj ke dhekhatai(n) maan mohai(n) ||
230.e: The narcissus flowers are expressing contempt with jealousy and the does on seeing her are feeling blow at their self-respect,

230.g: ਸਬੋ ਰੋਜ ਸਰਾਬ ਨੇ ਸੋਰ ਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਆਮ ਜਾਹਾਨ ਕੇ ਪੇਖ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
230.t: sabo roj saraab ne sor laiaa prajaa aam jaahaan ke pekh vaare ||
230.e: The wine in spite of all its strength is not feeling itself equivalent to thhe ardent passion of Sita in the whole world,

230.g: ਭਵਾ ਤਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਭਾਤ ਪਿਆਰੀਨਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਹੀ ਨੈਨ ਕੇ ਬਾਨ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੨੯੯॥
230.t: bhavaa taan kamaan kee bhaat piaareen kamaan hee nain ke baan maare ||299||
230.e: Her eyebrows are lovely like the bow and from those eyebrows she is discharging the arrows of her eyes.299.

230.g: ਊਚੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਾਲ ਜਹਾ ਲਾਬੇ ਬਟ ਤਾਲ ਤਹਾ ਐਸੀ ਠਉਰ ਤਪ ਕੱਉ ਪਧਾਰੈ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.t: uooche dhrum saal jahaa laabe baT taal tahaa aaisee Thaur tap ka'au padhaarai aaiso kaun hai ||
230.e: Where there are high saal trees and Banyan trees and the large tanks, who is the person who performs austerities

230.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛਬ ਦੇਖ ਦੁਤ ਖਾਡਵ ਕੀ ਫੀਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਭਾ ਤਕੀ ਨੰਦਨ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਭਜੇ ਮੌਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.t: jaa kee chhab dhekh dhut khaaddav kee feekee laagai aabhaa takee na(n)dhan bilok bhaje mauan hai ||
230.e: And seeing whose beauty, the beauty of Pandavas seems devoid of radiance and the forests of heaven feel it better to keep silent on observing his beauty?

230.g: ਤਾਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਹਾ ਨੈਕ ਨਭ ਨ ਨਿਹਰਾਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਜੋਤ ਤਹਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਕੀ ਨ ਜਉਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.t: taaran kee kahaa naik nabh na niharaayo jai sooraj kee jot tahaa cha(n)dhrakee na jaun hai ||
230.e: There is so much dense shade there that not to speak of the stars, the sky is also not seen there, the light of the sun and moon does not reach there.

230.g: ਦੇਵ ਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਯੋ ਕੋਊ ਦੈਤ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਰਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਪੰਛੀ ਕੀ ਨ ਗੰਮ ਜਹਾ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਗਉਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੦॥
230.t: dhev na nihaarayo kouoo dhait na bihaarayo tahaa pa(n)chhee kee na ga(n)m jahaa cheeTee ko na gaun hai ||300||
230.e: No god or demon lives and the birds and even an ant has no access there.300.
Seeing the ignorant persons )Ram-Laksman) as good food, a demon named Viradh came forwards and in this way there came a calamitous situation in their peaceful lives.301.
Ram saw him and holding his wapons he went towards him  keeping control of their weapons both the warriors began their battle.302.

231.g: ਅੱਛਰੋ ਉਛਾਹ ॥੩੦੩॥
231.t: a'chharo uchhaeh ||303||
231.e: The vultures shirked and the warriors faced each other. They were bedecked nicely and there was unending zeal in them.303.

231.g: ਪੱਖਰੇ ਪਵੰਗ ॥
231.t: pa'khare pava(n)g ||

231.g: ਮੋਹਲੇ ਮਤੰਗ ॥
231.t: mohale mata(n)g ||

231.g: ਚਾਵਡੀ ਚਿੰਕਾਰ ॥
231.t: chaavaddee chi(n)kaar ||

231.g: ਉਝਰੇ ਲੁਝਾਰ ॥੩੦੪॥
231.t: aujhare lujhaar ||304||
231.e: There were horses and intoxicated elephants bedecked with armours. The shrieks of the vultures were heard and the warriors were seen entangled with each other.304.

231.g: ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੰਧੂਰ ॥
231.t: si(n)dhare sa(n)dhoor ||

231.g: ਬੱਜਏ ਤੰਦੂਰ ॥
231.t: ba'je ta(n)dhoor ||

231.g: ਸੱਜੀਏ ਸੁੱਬਾਹ ॥
231.t: sa'je'ee su'baeh ||

231.g: ਅੱਛਰੋ ਉਛਾਹ ॥੩੦੫॥
231.t: a'chharo uchhaeh ||305||
231.e: The elephants serene like sea were there and the trumpets were resounding, the long-armed warriors with unparalleled enthusiasm looked impressive.305.

231.g: ਬਿੱਝੁੜੇ ਉਝਾੜ ॥
231.t: bi'jhuRe ujhaaR ||

231.g: ਸੰਮਲੇ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
231.t: sa(n)male sumaar ||
231.e: The warriors who never fell began to fall and also regain their control

231.g: ਹਾਹਲੇ ਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
231.t: haahale ha(n)kaar ||

231.g: ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅੰਗਾਰ ॥੩੦੬॥
231.t: a(n)kaRe a(n)gaar ||306||
231.e: There were egoistic attacks from all the four sides and the warriors blazed like embers.306.

231.g: ਸੰਮਲੇ ਲੁੱਝਾਰ ॥
231.t: sa(n)male lu'jhaar ||

231.g: ਛੁੱਟਕੇ ਬਿਸਿਯਾਰ ॥
231.t: chhu'Take bisiyaar ||

231.g: ਹਾਹਲੇਹੰ ਬੀਰ ॥
231.t: haahaleha(n) beer ||

231.g: ਸੰਘਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੩੦੭॥
231.t: sa(n)ghare su beer ||307||
231.e: The warriors were keeping their control and the weapons began to slip away from their hands like serpents.307.

231.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
231.t: anoop naraaj chha(n)dh ||
231.e: ANOOP NARAAJ STANZA

231.g: ਗਜੰ ਗਜੇ ਹਯੰ ਹਲੇ ਹਲਾ ਹਲੀ ਹਲੋ ਹਲੰ ॥
231.t: gaja(n) gaje haya(n) hale halaa halee halo hala(n) ||

231.g: ਬਬੱਜ ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ਛੁਟੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਕੇਵਲੰ ॥
231.t: baba'j si(n)dhare sura(n) chhuTa(n)t baan kevala(n) ||
231.e: The horses began to move and elephant roared, there was confusion on all the four-sides, the musical instruments resounded and the harmonious sound of the discharge of arrows was heard

231.g: ਪਪੱਕ ਪੱਖਰੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਭਭੱਖ ਘਾਇ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ॥
231.t: papa'k pa'khare ture bhabha'kh ghai niramala(n) ||

231.g: ਪਲੁੱਥ ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥਰੀ ਅਮੱਥ ਜੁੱਥ ਉੱਥਲੰ ॥੩੦੮॥
231.t: palu'th lu'th bi'tharee ama'th ju'th u'thala(n) ||308||
231.e: The horses vied with one another in speed and the pure blood gushed out of the wounds. In the turmoil of the war, the corpses rolling in dust, scattered hither and thither.308.

231.g: ਅਜੁੱਥ ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥਰੀ ਮਿਲੰਤ ਹੱਥ ਬੱਖਯੰ ॥
231.t: aju'th lu'th bi'tharee mila(n)t ha'th ba'khaya(n) ||

231.g: ਅਘੁੱਮ ਘਾਇ ਘੁੱਮ ਏ ਬਬੱਕ ਬੀਰ ਦੁੱਧਰੰ ॥
231.t: aghu'm ghai ghu'm e baba'k beer dhu'dhara(n) ||
231.e: Because of the blows of the sword being stuck on the waists, the corpses were scattered and the warriors, turning with difficulty, began to strike bows with double-edged dagger.

231.g: ਕਿਲੰ ਕਰੰਤ ਖੱਪਰੀ ਪਿਪੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਪਾਣਯੰ ॥
231.t: kila(n) kara(n)t kha'paree pipa(n)t sron paanaya(n) ||
231.e: The Yoginis while shrieking, and taking the blood in their hands began to drink it

231.g: ਹਹੱਕ ਭੈਰਵੰ ਸ੍ਰੁਤੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਜੁੱਧ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਯੰ ॥੩੦੯॥
231.t: haha'k bhairava(n) sruta(n) uTha(n)t ju'dh javaiaalaya(n) ||309||
231.e: The Bhairvas roamed themselves in the field and the fires of war blazed.309.

231.g: ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਤੀ ਫਿਰੰ ਰੜੰਤ ਗਿੱਧ ਬ੍ਰਿੱਧਣੰ ॥
231.t: fika(n)t fi(n)katee fira(n) raRa(n)t gi'dh bira'dhana(n) ||
231.e: The jackals and big vultures roamed in the battlefield hither and thither

231.g: ਡਹੱਕ ਡਾਮਰੀ ਉਠੰ ਬਕਾਰ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਲੰ ॥
231.t: ddaha'k ddaamaree uTha(n) bakaar beer baitala(n) ||
231.e: The vampires bellowed and the Baitals (ghosts) raised their shrill voice.

231.g: ਖਹੱਤ ਖੱਗ ਖੱਤ੍ਰੀਯੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਧਾਰ ਉੱਜਲੰ ॥
231.t: khaha't kha'g kha'treeya(n) khima(n)t dhaar u'jala(n) ||

231.g: ਘਣੰਕ ਜਾਣ ਸਾਵਲੰ ਲਸੰਤ ਬੇਗ ਬਿੱਜੁਲੰ ॥੩੧੦॥
231.t: ghana(n)k jaan saavala(n) lasa(n)t beg bi'jula(n) ||310||
231.e: The white-edged dagger in the hands of the Kshatriyas (Ram and Lakshman) was well-placed in their hands like the lightning in the dark clouds.310.

231.g: ਪਿਪੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਖੱਪਰੀ ਭਖੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਚਾਵਡੰ ॥
231.t: pipa(n)t sron kha'paree bhakha(n)t maas chaavadda(n) ||

231.g: ਹਕਾਰ ਵੀਰ ਸੰਭਿੜੈ ਲੁਝਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਦੁੱਧਰੰ ॥
231.t: hakaar veer sa(n)bhiRai lujhaar dhaar dhu'dhara(n) ||
231.e: The Yoginis with the bowls were drinking blood and the kites were eating flesh, the warriors keeping control of their double-edged spears were fighting, while shouting at their companions.

231.g: ਪੁਕਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਪਰੇ ਸਹੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭਾਰਯੰ ॥
231.t: pukaar maar kai pare saha(n)t a(n)g bhaaraya(n) ||

231.g: ਬਿਹਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਮੰਡਲੰ ਕਟੰਤ ਖੱਗ ਧਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੧॥
231.t: bihaar dhev ma(n)ddala(n) kaTa(n)t kha'g dhaaraya(n) ||311||
231.e: They were shouting “kill, kill” and bearing the burden of their weapons, some warriors were there in the cities of gods (i.e. they had died) and some are chopping other warriors.311.

231.g: ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੈਜ ਕੈ ਖੁਮਾਰਿ ਘਾਇ ਘੂਮਹੀ ॥
231.t: prachaar vaar paij kai khumaar ghai ghoomahee ||

231.g: ਤਪੀ ਮਨੋ ਅਧੋ ਮੁਖੰ ਸੁ ਧੂਮ ਆਗ ਧੂਮ ਹੀ ॥
231.t: tapee mano adho mukha(n) su dhoom aag dhoom hee ||
231.e: The warriors, hurling their blows, were roaming in intoxication like the ascetics performing austerities and swinging with their faces bent downward over the smoke

231.g: ਤੁਟੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗਯੰ ਬਹੰਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰਯੰ ॥
231.t: tuTa(n)t a(n)g bha(n)gaya(n) baha(n)t asatr dhaaraya(n) ||

231.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਛਿੱਛ ਇੱਛਯੰ ਪਿਪੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਹਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੨॥
231.t: auTha(n)t chhi'chh i'chhaya(n) pipa(n)t maas haaraya(n) ||312||
231.e: There is flow of arms and the broken limbs were falling down, the waves of the desire of victory are rising and the chopped flesh is falling.312.

231.g: ਅਘੋਰ ਘਾਇ ਅੱਘਏ ਕਟੇ ਪਰੇ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਨੰ ॥
231.t: aghor ghai a'ghe kaTe pare su praasana(n) ||

231.g: ਘੁਮੰਤ ਜਾਣ ਰਾਵਲੰ ਲਗੇ ਸੁ ਸਿੱਧ ਆਸਣੰ ॥
231.t: ghuma(n)t jaan raavala(n) lage su si'dh aasana(n) ||
231.e: The Aghori (Sadhus) seem pleased in eating the chopped limbs and the Siddhas and Rawalpanthis, the devourers of flesh and blood have taken seats with postures

231.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰਯੰ ॥
231.t: para(n)t a(n)g bha(n)g hui baka(n)t maar maaraya(n) ||

231.g: ਬਦੰਤ ਜਾਣ ਬੰਦੀਯੰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਪਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੩॥
231.t: badha(n)t jaan ba(n)dheeya(n) sukirat kirat apaaraya(n) ||313||
231.e: Shouting “kill, kill” the warriors are falling with broken limbs and because of their bravery, they are being greeted.313.

231.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਤਾਲ ਤੰਬੂਰੰ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਬੀਨ ਬੇਣਯੰ ॥
231.t: baja(n)t taal ta(n)boora(n) bisekh been benaya(n) ||

231.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਝਾਲਨਾ ਫਿਰੰ ਸਨਾਇ ਭੇਰ ਭੈ ਕਰੰ ॥
231.t: miradha(n)g jhaalanaa fira(n) sanai bher bhai kara(n) ||
231.e: The special sound obstructing the blows on the shields is being heard, the mixed sound of the harp, flute, drum, kettle-drum etc. is creating a dreadful atmosphere.

231.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਨਾਦਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਤੁਟੰਤ ਤਾਲ ਤੱਥਿਯੰ ॥
231.t: auTha(n)t naadh niramala(n) tuTa(n)t taal ta'thiya(n) ||

231.g: ਬਦੰਤ ਕਿੱਤ ਬੰਦੀਅੰ ਕਬਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਾਬਯ ਕੱਥਿਯੰ ॥੩੧੪॥
231.t: badha(n)t ki't ba(n)dheea(n) kabi(n)dhr kaabay ka'thiya(n) ||314||
231.e: The beautiful sounds also rearing the tunes of the blows of different kinds of weapons are arising in the battlefield, somewhere the servitors are busy in prayers and somewhere the poets are reciting their compositions.314.

231.g: ਢਲੰਤ ਢਾਲ ਮਾਲਯੰ ਖਹੰਤ ਖੱਗ ਖੇਤਯੰ ॥
231.t: ddala(n)t ddaal maalaya(n) khaha(n)t kha'g khetaya(n) ||

231.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਤੀਛਣੰ ਅਨੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਕੰਕਯੰ ॥
231.t: chala(n)t baan teechhana(n) ana(n)t a(n)t ka(n)kaya(n) ||
231.e: The sound of obstructing the shields and the sound of the striking swords are being heard and the sharp arrows destroying innumerable people are being discharged

232.g: ਸਿਮੱਟਿ ਸਾਗ ਸੁੰਕੜੰ ਸਟੱਕ ਸੂਲ ਸੇਲਯੰ ॥
232.t: sima'T saag su(n)kaRa(n) saTa'k sool selaya(n) ||

232.g: ਰੁਲੰਤ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡਯੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਅੱਝਲੰ ॥੩੧੫॥
232.t: rula(n)t ru(n)dd mu(n)ddaya(n) jhala(n)t jhaal a'jhala(n) ||315||
232.e: The daggers and spears are producing rustling sound and the chopped dead heads, having rolled in dust, are scattered here and there.315.

232.g: ਬਚਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਚਿੱਤ੍ਰਤੰ ਸਰੰ ਬਹੰਤ ਦਾਰੁਣੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
232.t: bachi'tr chi'trata(n) sara(n) baha(n)t dhaaruna(n) rana(n) ||

232.g: ਢਲੰਤ ਢਾਲ ਅੱਢਲੰ ਢੁਲੰਤ ਚਾਰੁ ਚਾਮਰੰ ॥
232.t: ddala(n)t ddaal a'ddala(n) ddula(n)t chaar chaamara(n) ||
232.e: The peculiar types of arrows, drawing pictures are being discharged in the battlefield and the knocking of the spears in the battlefield and the knocking of the spears in the shields is being heard.

232.g: ਦਲੰਤ ਨਿਰਦਲੋ ਦਲੰ ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਦਿਤੰ ॥
232.t: dhala(n)t niradhalo dhala(n) papaat bhootala(n) dhita(n) ||

232.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਗੱਦਿ ਸੱਦਯੰ ਨਿਨੱਦਿ ਨੱਦਿ ਦੁੱਭਰੰ ॥੩੧੬॥
232.t: auTha(n)t ga'dh sa'dhaya(n) nina'dh na'dh dhu'bhara(n) ||316||
232.e: The armies are being mashed and the earth is getting hot (because of the hot blood), the dreadful sound is being heard continuously form all four sides.316.

232.g: ਭਰੰਤ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਚਉਸਠੀ ਕਿਲੰਕ ਖੇਚਰੀ ਕਰੰ ॥
232.t: bhara(n)t pa'tr chausaThee kila(n)k khecharee kara(n) ||

232.g: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਹੂਰ ਪੂਰਯੰ ਬਰੰਤ ਦੁੱਧਰੰ ਨਰੰ ॥
232.t: fira(n)t hoor pooraya(n) bara(n)t dhu'dhara(n) nara(n) ||
232.e: Sixty-four Yoginis, shouting loudly, are filling their pots with colour and the heavenly damsels are moving on the earth in order to wed the great horses

232.g: ਸਨੱਧ ਬੱਧ ਗੋਧਯੰ ਸੁ ਸੋਭ ਅੰਗੁਲੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ॥
232.t: sana'dh ba'dh godhaya(n) su sobh a(n)gula(n) tirana(n) ||

232.g: ਡਕੰਤ ਡਾਕਣੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਭਖੰਤ ਆਮਿਖੰ ਰਣੰ ॥੩੧੭॥
232.t: ddaka(n)t ddaakanee bhrama(n) bhakha(n)t aamikha(n) rana(n) ||317||
232.e: The heroes, bedecking themselves are wearing armours on their hands and the vampires are roaring in the battlefield, eating flesh and bellowing.317.

232.g: ਕਿਲੰਕ ਦੇਵੀਯੰ ਕਰੰਡ ਹੱਕ ਡਾਮਰੂ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
232.t: kila(n)k dheveeya(n) kara(n)dd ha'k ddaamaroo sura(n) ||

232.g: ਕੜੱਕ ਕੱਤੀਯੰ ਉਠੰ ਪਰੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਪੱਖਰੰ ॥
232.t: kaRa'k ka'teeya(n) uTha(n) para(n)t dhoor pa'khara(n) ||
232.e: The loud voice of the goddess Kali, who drinks blood, and the sound of tabor are being heard, the dreadful laughter is being heard in the battlefield and the dust settled on armours is also being seen

232.g: ਬਬੱਜਿ ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਘਾਤ ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥੀਯੰ ॥
232.t: baba'j si(n)dhare sura(n) niraghaat sool saihatheeya(n) ||

232.g: ਭਭੱਜਿ ਕਾਤਰੋ ਰਣੰ ਨਿਲੱਜ ਭੱਜ ਭੂ ਭਰੰ ॥੩੧੮॥
232.t: bhabha'j kaataro rana(n) nila'j bha'j bhoo bhara(n) ||318||
232.e: The elephants and horses are creating noise on being struck with the blows of sword and abandoning their shyness and being helpless, they are running away from the war.318.

232.g: ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਨਿਧੰ ਜੁਝੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਜੁੱਧੰ ॥
232.t: s sasatr asatr sa(n)nidha(n) jujha(n)t jodhano ju'dha(n) ||

232.g: ਅਰੁੱਝ ਪੰਕ ਲੱਜਣੰ ਕਰੰਤ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੇਵਲੰ ॥
232.t: aru'jh pa(n)k la'jana(n) kara(n)t dhroh kevala(n) ||
232.e: Having been bedecked with arms and weapons the warriors are busy in war and not being stuck in the mud of shyness they are waging war

232.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਐ ਉਠੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਕਰਦਮੰ ॥
232.t: para(n)t a(n)g bha(n)g huaai uTha(n)t maas karadhama(n) ||

232.g: ਖਿਲੰਤ ਜਾਣੁ ਕਦਵੰ ਸੁ ਮੱਝ ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਗੋਪਿਕੰ ॥੩੧੯॥
232.t: khila(n)t jaan kadhava(n) su ma'jh kaanreh gopika(n) ||319||
232.e: Being filled with ire, the limbs and the bits of flesh of the warriors are falling on the earth like Krishna playing amongst Gopis by throwing up the ball from this to that side.319.

232.g: ਡਹੱਕ ਡਉਰ ਡਾਕਣੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਰੋਸੁਰੰ ॥
232.t: ddaha'k ddaur ddaakana(n) jhala(n)t jhaal rosura(n) ||

232.g: ਨਿਨੱਦ ਨਾਦ ਨਾਫਿਰੰ ਬਜੰਤ ਭੇਰਿ ਭੀਖਣੰ ॥
232.t: nina'dh naadh naafira(n) baja(n)t bher bheekhana(n) ||
232.e: The tabors and famous gestures of the vampires are being seen and the dreadful sound of drums and fifes is being heard.

232.g: ਘੁਰੰਤ ਘੋਰ ਦੁੰਦਭੀ ਕਰੰਤ ਕਾਨਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
232.t: ghura(n)t ghor dhu(n)dhabhee kara(n)t kaanare sura(n) ||

232.g: ਕਰੰਤ ਝਾਝਰੋ ਝੜੰ ਬਜੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਰੰ ॥੩੨੦॥
232.t: kara(n)t jhaajharo jhaRa(n) baja(n)t baasuree bara(n) ||320||
232.e: The terrible sound of big drums is being heard in the ears. The jingling of anklets and the sweet voice of flutes are also being heard in the battlefield.320.

232.g: ਨਚੰਤ ਬਾਜ ਤੀਛਣੰ ਚਲੰਤ ਚਾਚਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
232.t: nacha(n)t baaj teechhana(n) chala(n)t chaacharee kirata(n) ||

232.g: ਲਿਖੰਤ ਲੀਕ ਉਰਬੀਅੰ ਸੁਭੰਤ ਕੁੰਡਲੀ ਕਰੰ ॥
232.t: likha(n)t leek urabeea(n) subha(n)t ku(n)ddalee kara(n) ||
232.e: The swift horses are dancing and moving swiftly and with their gait they are creating coiled marks on the earth.

232.g: ਉਡੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਭੂਰਿਯੰ ਖੁਰੀਨ ਨਿਰਦਲੀ ਨਭੰ ॥
232.t: audda(n)t dhoor bhooriya(n) khureen niradhalee nabha(n) ||

232.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਭੂਰ ਭਉਰਣੰ ਸੁ ਭਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੰ ॥੩੨੧॥
232.t: para(n)t bhoor bhaurana(n) su bhaur Thaur jiau jala(n) ||321||
232.e: Because of the sound of their hoofs, the dust is rising upto the sky and seems like the whirlpool in water.321.

232.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਧੀਰ ਬੀਰਣੰ ਚਲੰਤ ਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਲੈ ॥
232.t: bhaja(n)t dheer beerana(n) chala(n)t maan praan lai ||

232.g: ਦਲੰਤ ਪੰਤ ਦੰਤੀਯੰ ਭਜੰਤ ਹਾਰ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
232.t: dhala(n)t pa(n)t dha(n)teeya(n) bhaja(n)t haar maan kai ||
232.e: The enduring warriors are fleeing with their honour and life-breath and the lines of the elephants have been destroyed

232.g: ਮਿਲੰਤ ਦਾਤ ਘਾਸ ਲੈ ਰਰੱਛ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਰੰ ॥
232.t: mila(n)t dhaat ghaas lai rara'chh sabadh uchara(n) ||

232.g: ਬਿਰਾਧ ਦਾਨਵੰ ਜੁਝਯੋ ਸੁ ਹੱਥਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ॥੩੨੨॥
232.t: biraadh dhaanava(n) jujhayo su ha'th raam niramala(n) ||322||
232.e: The demons inimical to Ram, taking the blades of grass in their teeth, have uttered the words “Protect us” and in this way the demons named Viradh has been killed.322.

232.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਰਾਧ ਦਾਨਵ ਬਧਹ ॥
232.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataar kathaa biraadh dhaanav badheh ||
232.e: End of the description of killing of the demon VIRADH in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

232.g: ਅਥ ਬਨ ਮੋ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
232.t: ath ban mo praves kathana(n) ||
232.e: Now begins the description regarding entry in the forest :

232.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
232.t: dhoharaa ||
232.e: DOHRA

232.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਰ ਬਿਰਾਧ ਕਉ ਬਨ ਮੇ ਧਸੇ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
232.t: eeh bidh maar biraadh kau ban me dhase nisa(n)g ||
232.e: In this way killing Viradh, Ram and Lakshman penetrated further into the forest.

232.g: ਸੁ ਕਬਿ ਸਯਾਮ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਜੁੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ॥੩੨੩॥
232.t: s kab sayaam ieh bidh kahiyo raghubar ju'dh prasa(n)g ||323||
232.e: The poet Shyam has described this incident in the above-mentioned way.323.

232.g: ਸੁਖਦਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
232.t: sukhadhaa chha(n)dh ||
232.e: SUKHDA STANZA

232.g: ਰਿਖ ਅਗਸਤ ਧਾਮ ॥
232.t: rikh agasat dhaam ||

232.g: ਗਏ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਮ ॥
232.t: ge raaj raam ||

232.g: ਧੁਜ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ॥
232.t: dhuj dharam dhaam ||

232.g: ਸੀਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਾਮ ॥੩੨੪॥
232.t: seeaa sahit baam ||324||
232.e: The king Ram went to the went to the hermitage of the sage Agastya and Sita was with him, who is the abode of Dharma.324.

232.g: ਲਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੀਰ ॥
232.t: lakh raam beer ||

232.g: ਰਿਖ ਦੀਨ ਤੀਰ ॥
232.t: rikh dheen teer ||

232.g: ਰਿਪ ਸਰਬ ਚੀਰ ॥
232.t: rip sarab cheer ||

232.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਪੀਰ ॥੩੨੫॥
232.t: har sarab peer ||325||
232.e: Seeing the great hero Ram, the sage advised him to kill all the enemies and remove the anguish of all the people.325.

232.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਬਿਦਾ ਕੀਨ ॥
232.t: rikh bidhaa keen ||

232.g: ਆਸਿਖਾ ਦੀਨ ॥
232.t: aasikhaa dheen ||

232.g: ਦੁਤ ਰਾਮ ਚੀਨ ॥
232.t: dhut raam cheen ||

232.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥੩੨੬॥
232.t: mun man prabeen ||326||
232.e: In this way giving his blessing, the sage recognizing the beauty and power of Ram dexterously in his mind, bade him farewell.326.

233.e: Ram, alongwith his winsome wife Sita and his brother moved fearlessly in the dense forest, forsaking all his anxieties.327.
With his sword tied by the waist and holding the arrows in him hand, the long-armed heroes started for the bath at pilgrim-stations.328.
He reached on the bank of Godavari alongwith his heroic brother and there Ram put off his clothes and took a bath, thus cleansing his body.329.­
Ram had a marvellous body, when he came out after bath, on seeing his beauty the official of the place went to the royal lady Surapanakha.330.
They said to her, “Please listen to us O royal lady! two strangers of unique bodies have come to our kingeom.”331.
When Surapanakha heard these words, she immediately started and reaching there,

234.e: She considered all of them as Cupid-incarnate and believed in her mind that no one equaled them in beauty.332.

234.g: ਜੈਸ ਨ੍ਰਿਲਾਜ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਕਿੱਹ ॥
234.t: jais niralaaj kahai na kouoo ki'h ||
234.e: Coming before Ram, without feeling ashamed, she said :

234.g: ਹਉ ਅਟਕੀ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਛਬਿ ਕੇ ਬਰ ॥
234.t: hau aTakee tumaree chhab ke bar ||

234.e: “I have halted here because of your beauty and my mind is dyed with the dye of your intoxicated eyes.”333.
Speech of Ram
SUNDARI STANZA
“You go to the place of my brother who will be bewitched on seeing your beautiful eyes

234.g: ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਖ ਸਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਕੱਉ ਘਰਿ ॥੩੩੪॥
234.t: kaise kai raakh sako tum ka'au ghar ||334||
234.e: “You can see that with me there is Sita of beautiful waist and in such a situation how can I keep you in my house.334.

234.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਯੋ ਮਨ ॥
234.t: maat pitaa keh moh tajayo man ||

234.g: ਸੰਗ ਫਿਰੀ ਹਮਰੇ ਬਨ ਹੀ ਬਨ ॥
234.t: sa(n)g firee hamare ban hee ban ||
234.e: “She has abandoned the attachment towards her parents and is roaming with me in the forest

234.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਤਜੌ ਕਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ॥
234.t: taeh tajau kas kai sun su(n)dhar ||

234.e: “O beautiful lady! How can I forsake her, you go there where my brother is sitting.”335.

234.g: ਜਾਤ ਭਈ ਸੁਨ ਬੈਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਹ ॥
234.t: jaat bhiee sun bain tirayaa teh ||

234.e: Hearing these words of Ram, that lady Surpanakha went there were Lakshman was sitting.

234.g: ਸੋ ਨ ਬਰੈ ਅਤਿ ਰੋਸ ਭਰੀ ਤਬ ॥
234.t: so na barai at ros bharee tab ||

234.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟਾਇ ਗਈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਸਭ ॥੩੩੬॥
234.t: naak kaTai giee gireh ko sabh ||336||
234.e: When he also refused to wed her, then she was filled with great rage and went to her home after getting her nose chopped.336.

234.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੂਪਨਖਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਕ ਕਾਟਬੋ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੫॥
234.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raam avataar kathaa soopanakhaa ko naak kaaTabo dhayai samaapatam sat subham sat ||5||
234.e: End of the chapter regarding the Chopping of the Nose of Surapanakha in the story of Rama Incarnation in BACHITTAR NATAK.
The beginning of the description of the battle with the demons Khar and Dusman :
SUNDARI STANZA

234.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰੇ ਦਨੁ ਬੰਸ ਬਲੀ ਸਭ ॥
234.t: ros bhare dhan ba(n)s balee sabh ||
234.e: When Surapanakha went weeping near Ravana, then the whole demon-clan was filled with fury.
The king of Lanka called his ministers for consultations and sent two demons Khar and Dushan for killing ram etc. 337.
Wearing their armours all the long-armed warriors marched forward with the resounding of musical instruments and the roaring of elephants.

234.g: ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਕੂਕੇ ॥
234.t: maar hee maar dhaso dhis kooke ||

234.g: ਸਾਵਨ ਕੀ ਘਟ ਜਯੋਂ ਘੁਰ ਢੂਕੇ ॥੩੩੮॥
234.t: saavan kee ghaT jayo(n) ghur ddooke ||338||
234.e: There was noise of “kill, kill” from all the four sides and the army gushed forward like the clouds of the month of sawan.338.
The mighty warriors thundered and stood firmly on the ground.

234.g: ਛਾਜਤ ਹੈ ਚਖ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤ ਸੋ ਸਰ ॥
234.t: chhaajat hai chakh sronat so sar ||

234.e: The pools of blood flourished and the warriors raised terrible shrieks.339.
TAARKAA STANZA
When the princes will begin the battle, there will be the dance of lances and shafts.
The warriors will roar on seeing the opposing forces and Ram will be absorbed in the fighting mood.340.
There will be showers of arrows and the fighters will roam in the battlefield fearlessly.
The tridents and arrows will be struck and the sons of demons will roll in dust.341.
They will discharge arrows undoubtedly and destroy the forces of the enemy.
The corpses will be scattered on the earth and the great warriors will uproot the trees.342.

235.g: ਗਲ ਗੱਜਿ ਹਠੀ ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
235.t: gal ga'j haThee ran ra(n)g fire ||
235.e: The musical notes of fifes were played and the persistent warriors began to roar like lions and roam in the fields.

235.g: ਲਗਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਾਹ ਦੁਸਾਰ ਕਢੇ ॥
235.t: lag baan sanaeh dhusaar kadde ||

235.g: ਸੂਅ ਤੱਛਕ ਕੇ ਜਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਮਢੇ ॥੩੪੩॥
235.t: sooa ta'chhak ke jan roop madde ||343||
235.e: The shafts were being taken out from quivers and the serpent-like arrows were struck like the messengers of death.343.

235.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਕ ਸਨਾਹਰਿ ਝਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
235.t: bin sa(n)k sanaahar jhaarat hai ||

235.g: ਰਣਬੀਰ ਨਵੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
235.t: ranabeer naveer prachaarat hai ||
235.e: The warriors are spraying arrows fearlessly and are challenging one another.

235.g: ਸਰ ਸੁੱਧ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਛੋਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
235.t: sar su'dh silaa sit chhorat hai ||

235.g: ਜੀਅ ਰੋਸ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਘੋਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੪॥
235.t: jeea ros halaahal ghorat hai ||344||
235.e: They are discharging shafts and stones and are drinking in the gearts the poison of indignation.344.

235.g: ਰਨ ਧੀਰ ਅਯੋਧਨੁ ਲੁੱਝਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
235.t: ran dheer ayodhan lu'jhat hai(n) ||

235.g: ਰਦ ਪੀਸ ਭਲੋ ਕਰ ਜੁੱਝਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
235.t: radh pees bhalo kar ju'jhat hai(n) ||
235.e: The conquering warriors have fought with one another in the battle and are fighting furiously.

235.g: ਰਣ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਨਿਹਾਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
235.t: ran dhev adhev nihaarat hai(n) ||

235.g: ਜਯ ਸੱਦ ਨਿਨੱਦਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੪੫॥
235.t: jay sa'dh nina'dh pukaarat hai(n) ||345||
235.e: Both the gods and demons are viewing the battle and are raising the sound of victory.345.

235.g: ਗਣ ਗਿੱਧਣ ਬ੍ਰਿੱਧ ਰੜੰਤ ਨਭੰ ॥
235.t: gan gi'dhan bira'dh raRa(n)t nabha(n) ||

235.g: ਕਿਲਕੰਤ ਸੁ ਡਾਕਣ ਉੱਚ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
235.t: kilaka(n)t su ddaakan u'ch sura(n) ||
235.e: The Ganas and large vultures are roaming in the sky and the vampires are shrieking violently.

235.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਛਾਡ ਭਕਾਰਤ ਭੂਤ ਭੂਅੰ ॥
235.t: bhram chhaadd bhakaarat bhoot bhooa(n) ||

235.g: ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਹਾਰਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਦੂਅੰ ॥੩੪੬॥
235.t: ran ra(n)g bihaarat bhraat dhooa(n) ||346||
235.e: The ghosts are laughing fearlessly and both the brother Ram and Lakshman are looking at this continued fight.346.

235.g: ਖਰਦੂਖਣ ਮਾਰ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਦਏ ॥
235.t: kharadhookhan maar bihai dhe ||

235.g: ਜਯ ਸੱਦ ਨਿਨੱਦ ਬਿਹੱਦ ਭਏ ॥
235.t: jay sa'dh nina'dh biha'dh bhe ||
235.e: Ram caused both Khar and Dushan flow down in the stream of death after killing them. The victory was greatly hailed from all the four sides.

235.g: ਸੁਰ ਫੂਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਰਖੇ ॥
235.t: sur foolan kee barakhaa barakhe ||

235.g: ਰਣ ਧੀਰ ਅਧੀਰ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਖੇ ॥੩੪੭॥
235.t: ran dheer adheer dhouoo parakhe ||347||
235.e: The gods showered the flowers and enjoyed the sight of both the victorious warriors Ram and Lakshman.347.

235.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਖਰ ਦੂਖਣ ਦਈਤ ਬਧਹ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬॥
235.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raam avataar kathaa khar dhookhan dhieet badheh dhiaai samaapatam sat ||6||
235.e: End of the story of the killing of KHAR and DUSHMAN in Ramvatar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

235.g: ਅਥ ਸੀਤਾ ਹਰਨ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
235.t: ath seetaa haran kathana(n) ||
235.e: Now begins the description of the abduction of Sita :

235.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
235.t: manohar chha(n)dh ||
235.e: MANOHAR STANZA

235.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਨੀਚ ਮਰੀਚ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬੀਚ ਗਏ ਬੱਧ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਨੈਹੈ ॥
235.t: raavan neech mareech hoo(n) ke gireh beech ge ba'dh beer sunaihai ||
235.e: Hearing about the killing of Khar and Dushan the vile Ravan went to the house of Marich.

235.g: ਬੀਸਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਗਹੇ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਰ ਮਨੈ ਦਸ ਸੀਸ ਧੁਨੈ ਹੈ ॥
235.t: beesahoo(n) baeh hathiaar gahe ris maar manai dhas sees dhunai hai ||
235.e: He held his weapons in all his twenty hands and was furiously muzzling his ten heads.

235.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਸੂਪਨਖਾ ਕਹਤਉ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਲਗੈ ਹੈ ॥
235.t: naak kaTayo jin soopanakhaa kahatau teh ko dhukh dhokh lagai hai ||
235.e: He said, “Those who have chopped the nose of Surapankha, their such action has agonised me

235.g: ਰਾਵਲ ਕੋ ਬਨੁ ਕੈ ਪਲ ਮੋ ਛਲ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੀ ਘਰਨੀ ਧਰਿ ਲਯੈ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੮॥
235.t: raaval ko ban kai pal mo chhal kai teh kee gharanee dhar layai hai ||348||
235.e: “I shall steal their wife in the garb of a Yogi form the forest in your company.”348.

235.g: ਮਰੀਚ ਬਾਚ ॥
235.t: mareech baach ||
235.e: Speech of Marich :

235.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
235.t: manohar chha(n)dh ||
235.e: MANOHAR STANZA

235.g: ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕੀਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਮੋਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਹ ਆਏ ॥
235.t: naath anaath sanaath keeyo kar kai at mor kirapaa keh aae ||
235.e: “O my Lord! You had been very kind to came to my place.

235.g: ਭਉਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਟੀ ਬਿਕਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਜ ਸਭੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
235.t: bhaun bha(n)ddaar aTee bikaTee prabh aaj sabhai ghar baar suhaae ||
235.e: “My stores are overflowing on your arrival, O my Lord!

235.g: ਦ੍ਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਨਾਥ ਬੁਰੋ ਮਤ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
235.t: dhavai kar jor karau binatee sun kai nirapanaath buro mat maano ||
235.e: “But with folded hands I request and kindly do not mind,

235.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਹੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਤਿਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੈ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥੨੪੯॥
235.t: sree raghubeer sahee avataar tinai tum maanas kai na pachhaano ||249||
235.e: “That is my supplication that Ram is in reality an incarnation, do not consider him as a man like yourself.”349.

235.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਸਭ ਅੰਗ ਜਰਯੋ ਮੁਖ ਰੱਤ ਕਰਯੋ ਜੁਗ ਨੈਨ ਤਚਾਏ ॥
235.t: ros bharayo sabh a(n)g jarayo mukh ra't karayo jug nain tachaae ||
235.e: Hearing these words, Ravan was filled with anger and his limbs began to burn, his face turned red and his eyes expanded with anger.

235.g: ਤੈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਹਮਰੇ ਸਠ ਬੋਲਨ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੁਐ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਗਨਾਏ ॥
235.t: tai na lagai hamare saTh bolan maanas dhuaai avataar ganaae ||
235.e: He said, “O fool! what are you speaking before me and considering those two men as incarnations

235.g: ਮਾਤ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਕਹੇ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਤ ਘ੍ਰਿਣਾ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਨਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
235.t: maat kee ek hee baat kahe taj taat ghiranaa banabaas nikaare ||
235.e: “Their mother spoke only once and their father indignantly sent them to the forest

235.g: ਤੇ ਦੋਊ ਦੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਜੁਗੀਯਾ ਕਸ ਕੈ ਭਿਰਹੈਂ ਸੰਗ ਆਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੩੫੦॥
235.t: te dhouoo dheen adheen jugeeyaa kas kai bhirahai(n) sa(n)g aan hamaare ||350||
235.e: “Both of them are lowly and helpless, how will they be able to fight against me.350.

235.g: ਜਉ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਤਹਾ ਕਹ ਤੈ ਸਠਿ ਤੋਰ ਜਟਾਨ ਕੋ ਜੂਟ ਪਟੈ ਹੌ ॥
235.t: jau nahee jaat tahaa keh tai saTh tor jaTaan ko jooT paTai hau ||
235.e: “O fool! if I had not come to ask you for going there, I would have uprooted and thrown your matted hair,

235.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਕੇ ਊਪਰ ਤੇ ਡਰ ਤੋਹਿ ਨਦੀਸਰ ਬੀਚ ਡੁਬੈ ਹੌ ॥
235.t: ka(n)chan koT ke uoopar te ddar toh nadheesar beech ddubai hau ||
235.e: “And from the top of this golden citadel I would have thrown you in the sea and get you drowned.”

235.g: ਚਿੱਤ ਚਿਰਾਤ ਬਸਾਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਰਿਸਾਤ ਚਲਯੋ ਮੁਨ ਘਾਤ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
235.t: chi't chiraat basaat kachhoo na risaat chalayo mun ghaat pachhaanee ||
235.e: Hearing these world and pining in his mind and in anger, realizing the gravity of the occasion, Marich left that place

235.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਮੀਚ ਅਧੋਗਤ ਰਾਘਵ ਪਾਨ ਪੁਰੀ ਸੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩੫੧॥
235.t: raavan neech kee meech adhogat raaghav paan puree sur maanee ||351||
235.e: He felt that the death and decadence of the vile Ravan is certain at the hands of Ram.351.

235.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਨਾ ਬਨ ਕੇ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਜਹ ਥੋ ਤਹ ਆਯੋ ॥
235.t: ka(n)chan ko haranaa ban ke raghubeer balee jeh tho teh aayo ||
235.e: He transformed himself into a golden deer and reached at the abode of Ram.

235.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਉਤ ਕੇ ਜੁਗੀਆ ਸੀਅ ਲੈਨ ਚਲਯੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੀਚ ਚਲਾਯੋ ॥
235.t: raavan havai ut ke jugeeaa seea lain chalayo jan meech chalaayo ||
235.e: On the other side Ravana put on the garb of a Yogi and went to abduct Sita, it seemed that death was driving him there.

235.g: ਸੀਅ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੀਰ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
235.t: seea bilok kura(n)k prabhaa keh moh rahee prabh teer uchaaree ||
235.e: Seeing the beauty of the golden deer, Sita came near Ram and said :

235.g: ਆਨ ਦਿਜੈ ਹਮ ਕੱਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਵਾਸੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩੫੨॥
235.t: aan dhijai ham ka'au mirag vaasun sree avadhes muka(n)dh muraaree ||352||
235.e: “O the king of Oudh and the destroyer of demons! Go and bring that deer for me.”352.

235.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ॥
235.t: raam baach ||
235.e: Speech of Ram :

235.g: ਸੀਅ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਨ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੈ ਨ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥
235.t: seea miragaa kahoo(n) ka(n)chan ko neh kaan sunayo bidh nai na banaayo ||
235.e: “O Sita! no one had heard about the golden deer and even the Lord hath not created it

235.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਛਲ ਦਾਨਵ ਕੋ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਜਿਹ ਆਨ ਤੁਮੈ ਡਹਕਾਯੋ ॥
235.t: bees bisave chhal dhaanav ko ban mai jeh aan tumai ddahakaayo ||
235.e: “This is certainly the deceit of some demon, who has caused this deception in you.”

235.g: ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੋ ਆਇਸ ਮੇਟ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਸੀਆ ਕਹੁ ਆਤੁਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
235.t: piaaree ko aais meT sakai na bilok seeaa kahu aatur bhaaree ||
235.e: Seeing the affliction of Sita, Ram could not put aside her wish

236.g: ਬਾਧ ਨਿਖੰਗ ਚਲੇ ਕਟਿ ਸੌ ਕਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਈਹਾ ਕਰਿਜੈ ਰਖਵਾਰੀ ॥੩੫੩॥
