236.t: baadh nikha(n)g chale kaT sau keh bhraat ieehaa karijai rakhavaaree ||353||
236.e: He tied his quiver and left for bringing the golden deer, leaving behind Lakshman for Sita’s protection.353.

236.g: ਓਟ ਥਕਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਸੰਘਾਰਯੋ ॥
236.t: oT thakayo kar koT nisaachar sree raghubeer nidhaan sa(n)ghaarayo ||
236.e: The demon Marich tried to put Ram in uncertainty by running away at a high speed, but ultimately he was tired and Ram killed him.

236.g: ਹੇ ਲਹੁ ਬੀਰ ਉਬਾਰ ਲੈ ਮੋਕਹ ਯੌ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਪੁਕਾਰਯੋ ॥
236.t: he lahu beer ubaar lai mokeh yau keh kai pun raam pukaarayo ||
236.e: But at the time of death he shouted loudly in the voice of Ram, “O Brother, save me.”

236.g: ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬੋਲ ਕੁਬੋਲ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਓਰ ਸੁਮਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਪਠਾਯੋ ॥
236.t: jaanakee bol kubol sunayo tab hee teh or sumi'tr paThaayo ||
236.e: When Sita heard this frightening cry, she sent the mighty Lakshman to that side,

236.g: ਰੇਖ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਢ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਇਤ ਰਾਵਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੩੫੪॥
236.t: rekh kamaan kee kaadd mahaabal jaat bhe it raavan aayo ||354||
236.e: Who before leaving drew a line there and then Ravana came in.354.

236.g: ਭੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਸੀਅ ਕੇ ਢਿਗ ਯੌ ॥
236.t: bhekh alekh uchaar kai raavan jaat bhe seea ke ddig yau ||
236.e: Wearing the garb of a Yogi and uttering the traditional invocation for alms, Ravan went near Sita,

236.g: ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਧਨੀ ਧਨਵਾਨ ਬਡੋ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਗ ਮੋ ਠਗ ਜਯੋ ॥
236.t: avilok dhanee dhanavaan baddo teh jai milai mag mo Thag jayo ||
236.e: Like a thug visiting a wealthy person and said,

236.g: ਕਛੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਭਿਛਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨੈਨ ਹਮੈ ਇਹ ਰੇਖ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਹਮੈ ਅਬ ਹੀ ॥
236.t: kachh dheh bhichhaa mirag nain hamai ieh rekh miTai hamai ab hee ||
236.e: “O doe-eyed, cross this line and give me some alms,”

236.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰੇਖ ਭਈ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਲਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਅ ਉਡਯੋ ਨਭਿ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥੩੫੫॥
236.t: bin rekh bhiee avilok liee har seea uddayo nabh kau tab hee ||355||
236.e: And when Ravan saw Sita crossing the line, he seized her and began to fly towards the sky.355.

236.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਰਾਮ ਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੀਤਾ ਹਰਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
236.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak raam vataar kathaa seetaa haran dhiaai samaapatam ||
236.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Abduction of Sita’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

236.g: ਅਥ ਸੀਤਾ ਖੋਜਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
236.t: ath seetaa khojabo kathana(n) ||
236.e: Now begin the description about the search for Sita :

236.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
236.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
236.e: TOTAK STANZA

236.g: ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਹਰੀ ਸੀਅ ਹੇਰ ਮਨੰ ॥
236.t: raghunaath haree seea her mana(n) ||

236.g: ਗਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਸੱਜਿ ਧਨੰ ॥
236.t: geh baan silaa sit sa'j dhana(n) ||
236.e: When Ram visualized in his mind about the abduction of Sita, he caught hold of his bow and arrows in his hand and sat down on a white rock.

236.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: chahoo(n) or sudhaar nihaar fire ||

236.g: ਛਿਤ ਊਪਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ॥੩੫੬॥
236.t: chhit uoopar sree raghuraaj gire ||356||
236.e: He saw once again on all the four sides, but ultimately he fell down on the earth in disappontment.356.

236.g: ਲਘੁ ਬੀਰ ਉਠਾਇ ਸੁ ਅੰਕ ਭਰੇ ॥
236.t: lagh beer uThai su a(n)k bhare ||

236.g: ਮੁਖ ਪੋਛ ਤਬੈ ਬਚਨਾ ਉਚਰੇ ॥
236.t: mukh pochh tabai bachanaa uchare ||
236.e: His younger brother clasped him and raised him and said while cleansing his face :

236.g: ਕਸ ਅਧੀਰ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ਧਰੋ ॥
236.t: kas adheer pare prabh dheer dharo ||

236.g: ਸੀਅ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਹ ਸੋਧ ਕਰੋ ॥੩੫੭॥
236.t: seea jai kahaa teh sodh karo ||357||
236.e: “O my Lord! Do not be impatient, keep your composure. Ruminate on the fact where Sita has gone.?”357.

236.g: ਉਠ ਠਾਢਿ ਭਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਮ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: auTh Thaadd bhe fir bhoom gire ||

236.g: ਪਹਰੇਕਕ ਲਉ ਫਿਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: paharekak lau fir praan fire ||
236.e: Ram got up but again swooned and came to consciousness again after some time.

236.g: ਤਨ ਚੇਤ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਉਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਯੌਂ ॥
236.t: tan chet suchet uThe har yaua(n) ||

236.g: ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੱਧਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਭਟ ਜਯੋਂ ॥੩੫੮॥
236.t: ran ma(n)ddal ma'dh girayo bhaT jayo(n) ||358||
236.e: He got up from the earth like a warrior slowly regaining consciousness in the battlefield.358.

236.g: ਛਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਬਕਾਰ ਥਕੇ ॥
236.t: chhahoo(n) or pukaar bakaar thake ||

236.g: ਲਘੁ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਝਥੇ ॥
236.t: lagh bhraat bahu bhaat jhathe ||
236.e: He grew tired on shouting on all the four sides and experienced great anguish alongwith his younger brother.

236.g: ਉਠ ਕੈ ਪੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਗਏ ॥
236.t: auTh kai pun praat isanaan ge ||

236.g: ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੈ ਜਰਿ ਛਾਰਿ ਭਏ ॥੩੫੯॥
236.t: jal ja(n)t sabhai jar chhaar bhe ||359||
236.e: He went to take bath early in the morning and with the impact of the heat of his agony, all the creatures in the water were burnt down and reduced to ashes.359.

236.g: ਬਿਰਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਓਰ ਸੁ ਦਿਸਟ ਧਰੈ ॥
236.t: birahee jeh or su dhisaT dharai ||

236.g: ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਪਲਾਸ ਅਕਾਸ ਜਰੈ ॥
236.t: fal fool palaas akaas jarai ||
236.e: The direction to which Ram saw in his state separation from his beloved, all the flowers and fruit as well us the trees of Palas and the sky burnt with the heat of his vision.

236.g: ਕਰ ਸੌ ਧਰ ਜਉਨ ਛੁਅੰਤ ਭਈ ॥
236.t: kar sau dhar jaun chhua(n)t bhiee ||

236.g: ਕਚ ਬਾਸਨ ਜਯੋਂ ਪਕ ਫੂਟ ਗਈ ॥੩੬੦॥
236.t: kach baasan jayo(n) pak fooT giee ||360||
236.e: Whenever he touched the earth with his hands, the earth cracked like a brittle vessel with his touch.360.

236.g: ਜਿਹ ਭੂਮ ਥਲੀ ਪਰ ਰਾਮ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: jeh bhoom thalee par raam fire ||

236.g: ਦਵ ਜਯੋਂ ਜਲ ਪਾਤ ਪਲਾਸ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: dhav jayo(n) jal paat palaas gire ||
236.e: The ground on which Ram rested, the Palas trees (on that ground) were burnt down and reduced to ashes like the grass.

236.g: ਟੁਟ ਆਸੂ ਆਰਣ ਨੈਨ ਝਰੀ ॥
236.t: TuT aasoo aaran nain jharee ||

236.g: ਮਨੋ ਤਾਤ ਤਵਾ ਪਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਰੀ ॥੩੬੧॥
236.t: mano taat tavaa par boo(n)dh paree ||361||
236.e: The continuous flow of his tears evaporated on falling down on the earth like the drops of water falling on the got plate.361.

236.g: ਤਨ ਰਾਘਵ ਭੇਟ ਸਮੀਰ ਜਰੀ ॥
236.t: tan raaghav bheT sameer jaree ||

236.g: ਤਜ ਧੀਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਾਝ ਦੁਰੀ ॥
236.t: taj dheer sarovar saajh dhuree ||
236.e: Even the cold mind burnt when it touched his body and controlling its coolness and forsaking its patience, it merged into the pool of water

236.g: ਨਹਿ ਤੱਤ੍ਰ ਥਲੀ ਸਤ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਰਹੇ ॥
236.t: neh ta'tr thalee sat pa'tr rahe ||

236.g: ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਪਰਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਦਹੇ ॥੩੬੨॥
236.t: jal ja(n)t paratiran patr dhahe ||362||
236.e: Even there the leaves of lotus could not survive and the creatures of water, grass, leaves etc. all were reduced to ashes with the geat of the state of separation of Ram.362.

236.g: ਇਤ ਢੂੰਢ ਬਨੇ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: eit ddoo(n)dd bane raghunaath fire ||

236.g: ਉਤ ਰਾਵਨ ਆਨ ਜਟਾਯੁ ਘਿਰੇ ॥
236.t: aut raavan aan jaTaay ghire ||
236.e: On this side Ram was roaming in the forest in search of Sita, on the other side Ravana was surrounded by Jatayu.

236.g: ਰਣ ਛੋਰ ਹਠੀ ਪਗ ਦੁਐ ਨ ਭਜਯੋ ॥
236.t: ran chhor haThee pag dhuaai na bhajayo ||

236.g: ਉਡ ਪੱਛ ਗਏ ਪੈ ਨ ਪੱਛ ਤਜਯੋ ॥੩੬੩॥
236.t: audd pa'chh ge pai na pa'chh tajayo ||363||
236.e: The persistent Jatayu did not yield in its fierce fighting even though its wings were chopped.363.

236.g: ਗੀਤਾ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
236.t: geetaa maalatee chha(n)dh ||
236.e: GEETA MALTI STANZA

236.g: ਪਛਰਾਜ ਰਾਵਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਸੀਤਹਿ ਲੈ ਗਯੋ ॥
236.t: pachharaaj raavan maar kai raghuraaj seeteh lai gayo ||
236.e: Ravana took away Sita after killing Jatayu,

236.g: ਨਭਿ ਓਰ ਖੋਰ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਜਟਾਉ ਸੀਅ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਦਯੋ ॥
236.t: nabh or khor nihaar kai su jaTaau seea sa(n)dhes dhayo ||
236.e: This message was communicated by Jatayu, when Ram saw towards the sky.

236.g: ਤਬ ਜਾਨ ਰਾਮ ਗਏ ਬਲੀ ਸੀਅ ਸੱਤ ਰਾਵਨ ਹੀ ਹਰੀ ॥
236.t: tab jaan raam ge balee seea sa't raavan hee haree ||
236.e: On meeting Jatayu Ram came to know for certain that Ravana had abducted Sita.

237.g: ਹਨਵੰਤ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਬ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਤਾ ਸੋਂ ਕਰੀ ॥੩੬੪॥
237.t: hanava(n)t maarag mo mile tab mi'trataa taa so(n) karee ||364||
237.e: Roaming on the paths (of the forest) Ram met Hanuman and they both became friends.364.

237.g: ਤਿਨ ਆਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਪਾਇਨ ਡਾਰਯੋ ॥
237.t: tin aan sree raghuraaj ke kapiraaj pain ddaarayo ||
237.e: Hanuman brought Sugriva the king of monkeys to fall at the feet of Ram.

237.g: ਤਿਨ ਬੈਠ ਗੈਠ ਇਕੈਠ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਯੋ ॥
237.t: tin baiTh gaiTh ikaiTh havai ieh bhaat ma(n)tr bichaarayo ||
237.e: And all of them unitedly held consultation amongst themselves,

237.g: ਕਪਿ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਸਧੀਰ ਕੇ ਭਟ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
237.t: kap beer dheer sadheer ke bhaT ma(n)tr beer bichaar kai ||
237.e: All the ministers sat down and gave their personal views.

237.g: ਅਪਨਾਇ ਸੁਗ੍ਰਿਵ ਕਉ ਚਲੁ ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਬਾਲ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੬੫॥
237.t: apanai sugirav kau chal kapiraaj baal sa(n)ghaar kai ||365||
237.e: Ram killed Bali, the king of monkeys and made Sugriva his permanent ally.365.

237.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬਾਲ ਬਧਹ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥੮॥
237.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the baal badheh dhiaai samaapatam ||8||
237.e: End of the chapter entitled Killing of Bali’ in BACHITTAR NATAK.

237.g: ਅਥ ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸੋਧ ਕੋ ਪਠੈਬੋ ॥
237.t: ath hanoomaan sodh ko paThaibo ||
237.e: Now begins the description of sending of Hanuman in search of Sita :

237.g: ਗੀਤਾ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
237.t: geetaa maalatee chha(n)dh ||
237.e: GEETA MALTI STANZA

237.g: ਦਲ ਬਾਟ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਪਠਯੋ ਹਨਵੰਤ ਲੰਕ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ॥
237.t: dhal baaT chaar dhisaa paThayo hanava(n)t la(n)k paThai dhe ||
237.e: The army of monkeys was divided into four parts and sent in all the four directions and Hanuman was sent to Lanka.

237.g: ਲੈ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਕਾ ਲਖ ਬਾਰਿਧੈ ਜਹ ਸੀ ਹੁਤੀ ਤਹ ਜਾਤ ਭੇ ॥
237.t: lai mudhrakaa lakh baaridhai jeh see hutee teh jaat bhe ||
237.e: Hanuman took the ring (of Rama) and immediately went and crossed the sea, he reached the place where Sita was kept (by Ravana).

237.g: ਪੁਰ ਜਾਰਿ ਅੱਛ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਛੈ ਬਨ ਟਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਫਿਰ ਆਇਯੋ ॥
237.t: pur jaar a'chh kumaar chhai ban Taar kai fir aaiyo ||
237.e: Destroying Lanka, killing Akshay Kumar and devastating Ashok Vatika, Hanuman came back,

237.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਾਰ ਜੋ ਅਮਰਾਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਭ ਰਾਮ ਤੀਰ ਜਤਾਇਯੋ ॥੩੬੬॥
237.t: kirat chaar jo amaraar ko sabh raam teer jataiyo ||366||
237.e: And presented before Ram the creations of Ravana, the ememy of gods.366.

237.g: ਦਲ ਜੋਰ ਕੋਰ ਕਰੋਰ ਲੈ ਬਡ ਘੋਰ ਤੋਰ ਸਭੈ ਚਲੇ ॥
237.t: dhal jor kor karor lai badd ghor tor sabhai chale ||
237.e: Now combining all the forces they all proceeded (with millions of fighters),

237.g: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਲਛਮਨ ਅਉਰ ਸੂਰ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇ ॥
237.t: raamacha(n)dhr sugreev lachhaman aaur soor bhale bhale ||
237.e: And there were mighty warriors like Ram, Sugriva, Lakshman,

237.g: ਜਾਮਵੰਤ ਸੁਖੈਨ ਨੀਲ ਹਣਵੰਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਕੇਸਰੀ ॥
237.t: jaamava(n)t sukhain neel hanava(n)t a(n)gadh kesaree ||
237.e: Jamvant, Sukhen, Neel, Hanuman, Angad etc. in their army.

237.g: ਕਪਿ ਪੂਤ ਜੂਥ ਪਜੂਥ ਲੈ ਉਮਡੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਕੈ ਝਰੀ ॥੩੬੭॥
237.t: kap poot jooth pajooth lai umadde chahoo(n) dhis kai jharee ||367||
237.e: The swarms of troops of the sons of monkeys, gushed forward like clouds from all the four directions.367.

237.g: ਪਾਟਿ ਬਾਰਿਧ ਰਾਜ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਟਿ ਲਾਘ ਗਏ ਜਬੈ ॥
237.t: paaT baaridh raaj kau kar baaT laagh ge jabai ||
237.e: When after splitting the sea and forming a passage they all crossed the sea.

237.g: ਦੂਤ ਦਈਤਨ ਕੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਤਬ ਦਉਰ ਰਾਵਨ ਪੈ ਗਏ ॥
237.t: dhoot dhieetan ke hute tab dhaur raavan pai ge ||
237.e: Then the messengers of Ravana fled towards him to convey the news.

237.g: ਰਨ ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਸਭੈ ਕਰੋ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
237.t: ran saaj baaj sabhai karo ik benatee man maaneeaai ||
237.e: They request him to get ready for war.

237.g: ਗੜ ਲੰਕ ਬੰਕ ਸੰਭਾਰੀਐ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਆਗਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੬੮॥
237.t: gaR la(n)k ba(n)k sa(n)bhaareeaai raghubeer aagam jaaneeaai ||368||
237.e: And protect the beautiful city of Lanka from the entry of Ram.368.

237.g: ਧੂਮ੍ਰ ਅੱਛ ਸੁ ਜਾਬਮਾਲ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਵੀਰ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ॥
237.t: dhoomr a'chh su jaabamaal bulai veer paThai dhe ||
237.e: Ravana called Dhumraksha and Jambumali and sent them for war.

237.g: ਸੋਰ ਕੋਰ ਕ੍ਰੋਰ ਕੈ ਜਹਾ ਰਾਮ ਥੇ ਤਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਭੇ ॥
237.t: sor kor kror kai jahaa raam the tahaa jaat bhe ||
237.e: Both them shouting terribly reached near Ram.

237.g: ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ਹਨਵੰਤ ਥਾ ਪਗ ਰੋਪ ਪਾਵ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀਯੰ ॥
237.t: ros kai hanava(n)t thaa pag rop paav prahaareeya(n) ||
237.e: Hanuman in great rage firmly stood on the earth on one foot,

237.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਬਲੀ ਸੁਰ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਝਿ ਬਿਹਾਰੀਯੰ ॥੩੬੯॥
237.t: joojh bhoom girayo balee sur lok maajh bihaareeya(n) ||369||
237.e: And attacked violently with his second foot with which the mighty Dhumraksha fell down and died.369.

238.g: ਜਾਬਮਾਲ ਭਿਰੇ ਕਛੂ ਪੁਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਐਸੇ ਈ ਕੈ ਲਏ ॥
238.t: jaabamaal bhire kachhoo pun maar aaise iee kai le ||
238.e: Then Jambumali fought in the war but he was also killed in the same manner

238.g: ਭਾਜ ਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਲੰਕ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੋ ਦਏ ॥
238.t: bhaaj keen praves la(n)k sa(n)dhes raavan so dhe ||
238.e: The demons accompanying him sped towards Lanka to give the news to Ravana,

238.g: ਧੂਮਰਾਛ ਸੁ ਜਾਬਮਾਲ ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਰਾਘਵ ਜੂ ਹਰਿਓ ॥
238.t: dhoomaraachh su jaabamaal dhuhahoo(n) raaghav joo hario ||
238.e: That both Dhumraksha and Jambumali had been killed at the hands of Rama.

238.g: ਹੈ ਕਛੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੇ ਹੀਏ ਸੁਭ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਆਵਤ ਸੋ ਕਰੋ ॥੩੭੦॥
238.t: hai kachhoo prabh ke he'ee subh ma(n)tr aavat so karo ||370||
238.e: They requested him, “O Lord! now whatever please you, take any other measure.”370.

238.g: ਪੇਖ ਤੀਰ ਅਕੰਪਨੈ ਦਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੈ ਸੁ ਪਠੈ ਦਯੋ ॥
238.t: pekh teer aka(n)panai dhal sa(n)g dhai su paThai dhayo ||
238.e: Seeing Akampan near him, Ravana sent him alongwith the forces.

238.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਜੇ ਬਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਨਿਨੱਦ ਸੱਦ ਪੁਰੀ ਭਯੋ ॥
238.t: bhaat bhaat baje baja(n)tr nina'dh sa'dh puree bhayo ||
238.e: On his departure, many kinds of musical instruments were played, which resounded in the whole city of Lanka.

238.g: ਸੁਰ ਰਾਇ ਆਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਸਤ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
238.t: sur rai aadh prahasat te ieh bhaat ma(n)tr bichaariyo ||
238.e: The ministers including Prahasta held consultation

238.g: ਸੀਅ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਕਸ ਰੋਸ ਰਾਵ ਸੰਭਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੩੭੧॥
238.t: seea dhe milo raghuraaj ko kas ros raav sa(n)bhaariyo ||371||
238.e: And thought that Ravana should return Sita to Ram and not offend him more.371.

238.g: ਛਪਯ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.t: chhapay chha(n)dh ||
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਝਲ ਹਲੰਤ ਤਰਵਾਰ ਬਜਤ ਬਾਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਧੁਨ ॥
238.t: jhal hala(n)t taravaar bajat baaja(n)tr mahaa dhun ||
238.e: The sound of musical instruments and the striking sound of the swords resounded,

238.g: ਖੜ ਹੜੰਤ ਖਹ ਖੋਲ ਧਯਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪਰਤ ਚਵਧ ਮੁਨ ॥
238.t: khaR haRa(n)t kheh khol dhayaan taj parat chavadh mun ||
238.e: And the meditation of the ascetics was distracted by the horrible voices of the battlefield.

238.g: ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਇੱਕ ਤਨ ਇੱਕ ਅਰੁੱਝੈ ॥
238.t: ei'k i'k lai chalai i'k tan i'k aru'jhai ||
238.e: The warriors came forward after one another and began to fight one to one.

238.g: ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਪਰ ਗਈ ਹੱਥਿ ਅਰ ਮੁੱਖ ਨ ਸੁੱਝੈ ॥
238.t: a(n)dh dhu(n)dh par giee ha'th ar mu'kh na su'jhai ||
238.e: There was such a terrible destruction that nothing could be recognized,

238.g: ਸੁਮੁਹੇ ਸੂਰ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਸਭ ਫਉਜ ਰਾਜ ਅੰਗਦ ਸਮਰ ॥
238.t: sumuhe soor saava(n)t sabh fauj raaj a(n)gadh samar ||
238.e: The mighty forces alongwith Angad are being seen,

238.g: ਜੈ ਸੱਦ ਨਿਨੱਦ ਬਿਹੱਦ ਹੂਅ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਪਤ ਸੁਰਪੁਰ ਅਮਰ ॥੩੭੨॥
238.t: jai sa'dh nina'dh biha'dh hooa dhan ja(n)pat surapur amar ||372||
238.e: And the hails of victory began to resound in the sky.372.

238.g: ਇਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਯੁਵਰਾਜ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਦਿਸ ਬੀਰ ਅਕੰਪਨ ॥
238.t: eit a(n)gadh yuvaraaj dhuteea dhis beer aka(n)pan ||
238.e: On this side the crown prince Angad and on that side the mighty Akampan,

238.g: ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਸਰ ਧਾਰ ਤਜਤ ਨਹੀ ਨੈਕ ਅਯੋਧਨ ॥
238.t: karat birasaT sar dhaar tajat nahee naik ayodhan ||
238.e: Are not feeling tired of showering their arrows.

238.g: ਹੱਥ ਬੱਥ ਮਿਲ ਗਈ ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥਰੀ ਅਹਾੜੰ ॥
238.t: ha'th ba'th mil giee lu'th bi'tharee ahaaRa(n) ||
238.e: The hands are meeting hands and the corpses are lying scattered,

238.g: ਘੁੱਮੇ ਘਾਇ ਅਘਾਇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੜੇ ਬਬਾੜੰ ॥
238.t: ghu'me ghai aghai beer ba(n)kaRe babaaRa(n) ||
238.e: The brave fighters are roaming and killing one another after challenging them.

238.g: ਪਿੱਖਤ ਬੈਠ ਬਿਬਾਣ ਬਰ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਜੰਪਤ ਅਮਰ ॥
238.t: pi'khat baiTh bibaan bar dha(n)n dha(n)n ja(n)pat amar ||
238.e: The gods are hailing them while sitting in their air-vehicles.

238.g: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿੱਖਯ ਭਵਾਨ ਮੋ ਅਬ ਲਗ ਲਖਯੋ ਨ ਅਸ ਸਮਰ ॥੩੭੩॥
238.t: bhav bhoot bhavi'khay bhavaan mo ab lag lakhayo na as samar ||373||
238.e: They are saying that they have never seen such-like horrible war earlier.373.

238.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮੁੰਡ ਪਿਖੀਅਹ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਕ ਰੁੰਡ ਪਰੇ ਧਰ ॥
238.t: kahoo(n) mu(n)dd pikhe'eeh kahoo(n) bhak ru(n)dd pare dhar ||
238.e: Somewhere the heads are being seen and somewhere the headless trunks are visible

238.g: ਕਿਤਹੀ ਜਾਘ ਤਰਫੰਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਉਛਰੰਤ ਸੁ ਛਬ ਕਰ ॥
238.t: kitahee jaagh tarafa(n)t kahoo(n) uchhara(n)t su chhab kar ||
238.e: Somewhere the legs are writhing and jumping

238.g: ਭਰਤ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਖੇਚਰੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਵੰਡ ਚਿਕਾਰੈਂ ॥
238.t: bharat pa'tr khechara(n) kahoo(n) chaava(n)dd chikaarai(n) ||
238.e: Somewhere the vampires are filling their vessels with blood

238.g: ਕਿਲਕਤ ਕਤਹ ਮਸਾਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਭੈਰਵ ਭਭਕਾਰੈਂ ॥
238.t: kilakat kateh masaan kahoo(n) bhairav bhabhakaarai(n) ||
238.e: Somewhere the shrieks of vultures are being heard

238.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਜੈ ਕਪਿ ਕੀ ਭਈ ਹਣਯੋ ਅਸੁਰ ਰਾਵਣ ਤਣਾ ॥
238.t: eeh bhaat bijai kap kee bhiee hanayo asur raavan tanaa ||
238.e: Somewhere the ghosts are shouting violently and somewhere the Bhairavas are laughing.

238.g: ਭੈ ਦੱਗ ਅਦੱਗ ਭੱਗੇ ਹਠੀ ਗਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦਾਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਾ ॥੩੭੪॥
238.t: bhai dha'g adha'g bha'ge haThee geh geh kar dhaatan tiranaa ||374||
238.e: In this way there was victory of Angad and he killed Akampan, the son of Ravana. On his death the frightened demons fled with the blades of grass in their mouths.374.

238.g: ਉਤੈ ਦੂਤ ਰਾਵਣੈ ਜਾਇ ਹਤ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਣਾਯੋ ॥
238.t: autai dhoot raavanai jai hat beer sunaayo ||
238.e: On that side the messengers gave the news of the death of Akampan to Ravana,

238.g: ਇਤ ਕਪਿਪਤ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਦੂਤ ਅੰਗਦਹਿ ਪਠਾਯੋ ॥
238.t: eit kapipat ar raam dhoot a(n)gadheh paThaayo ||
238.e: And on this side Angand the lord of monkeys was sent as envoy of Ram to Ravna.

238.g: ਕਹੀ ਕੱਥ ਤਿਹ ਸੱਥ ਗੱਥ ਕਰਿ ਤੱਥ ਸੁਨਾਯੋ ॥
238.t: kahee ka'th teh sa'th ga'th kar ta'th sunaayo ||
238.e: He was sent to tell all the facts to Ravna

238.g: ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਕਾਲ ਨਾਤਰ ਤੁਹਿ ਆਯੋ ॥
238.t: milahu dheh jaanakee kaal naatar tuh aayo ||
238.e: And also advise him to return Sita in order to stall his death.

238.g: ਪਗ ਭੇਟ ਚਲਤ ਭਯੋ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਪਾਨ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਧਰੇ ॥
238.t: pag bheT chalat bhayo baal sut pirasaT paan raghubar dhare ||
238.e: Angad, the son of Bali, went on his errand after touching the feet of Ram,

238.g: ਭਰ ਅੰਕ ਪੁਲਕਤ ਨ ਸਪਜਿਯੋ ਭਾਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਆਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ॥੩੭੫॥
238.t: bhar a(n)k pulakat na sapajiyo bhaat anik aasikh kare ||375||
238.e: Who bade him farewell by patting on his back and expressing many types of benedictions.375.

238.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉੱਤਰ ਸੰਬਾਦ ॥
238.t: prat u'tar sa(n)baadh ||
238.e: Responsive Dialogue :

238.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.t: chhapai chha(n)dh ||
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਦੇਹ ਸੀਆ ਦਸਕੰਧ ਛਾਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਪੈਹੋ ॥
238.t: dheh seeaa dhasaka(n)dh chhaeh nahee dhekhan paiho ||
238.e: Angad says, “O ten-headed Ravana! Return Sita, you will not be able to see her shadow (i.e. you will be killed).

238.g: ਲੰਕ ਛੀਨ ਲੀਜੀਐ ਲੰਕ ਲਖਿ ਜੀਤ ਨ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
238.t: la(n)k chheen leejeeaai la(n)k lakh jeet na jaiho ||
238.e: Ravana says, “None can conquer me ever after the seixure of Lanka.”

238.g: ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਿਨ ਘੋਰੁ ਪਿਖ ਕਸ ਜੁੱਧੁ ਮਚੈ ਹੈ ॥
238.t: kru'dh bikhai jin ghor pikh kas ju'dh machai hai ||
238.e: Angad says again, “Your intellect has been spoiled by your rage, how will you be able to wage the war.”

238.g: ਰਾਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਕਪਿ ਕਟਕ ਆਜ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਯਾਰ ਖਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
238.t: raam sahit kap kaTak aaj mirag sayaar khavai hai ||
238.e: Ravana replies, “I shall cause even today all the army of monkeys alongwith Ram to be devoured by the animals and jackals.”

238.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਰ ਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਸੁਣ ਮੂੜ ਮਤ ਗਰਬ ਗਵਾਇ ਘਨੇਰ ਘਰ ॥
238.t: jin kar su garab sun mooR mat garab gavai ghaner ghar ||
238.e: Angad says, “O Ravana, do not be egoistic, this ego has destroyed many houses.”

238.g: ਬਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਘਰ ਗਰਬ ਹਮ ਏ ਕਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਦੀਨ ਨਰ ॥੩੭੬॥
238.t: bas kare sarab ghar garab ham e kin meh dhavai dheen nar ||376||
238.e: Ravana replies. “I am proud because I have brought under control all with my own power, then what power these two human beings Ram and Lakshman can wield.”376.

238.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਬਾਚ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੋ ॥
238.t: raavan baach a(n)gadh so ||
238.e: Speech of Ravana addressed to Angad :

238.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.t: chhapai chha(n)dh ||
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਅਗਨ ਪਾਕ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਪਵਨ ਮੁਰ ਬਾਰ ਬੁਹਾਰੈ ॥
238.t: agan paak keh karai pavan mur baar buhaarai ||
238.e: The god of fire is my cook and the god of wind is my sweeper,

238.g: ਚਵਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਧਰੈ ਸੂਰ ਛੱਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਢਾਰੈ ॥
238.t: chavar cha(n)dhramaa dharai soor chha'treh sir ddaarai ||
238.e: The moon-god swings the fly-whisk over my head and the sun-god wields the canopy over my head

238.g: ਮਦ ਲਛਮੀ ਪਿਆਵੰਤ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥
238.t: madh lachhamee piaava(n)t bedh mukh braham uchaarat ||
238.e: Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, serves drinks to me and Brahma recites the Vedic mantras for me.

238.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਭਰੇ ਔਰ ਕੁਲੁਦੇਵ ਜੁਹਾਰਤ ॥
238.t: baran baar nit bhare aauar kuludhev juhaarat ||
238.e: Varuna is my water-carrier and pays obeisance in front of my family-god

238.g: ਨਿਜ ਕਹਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਲ ਦਾਨਵ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦੇਤ ਧਨੁਦਿ ਜਛ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰ ॥
238.t: nij kahat su bal dhaanav prabal dhet dhanudh jachh moh kar ||
238.e: This is my whole power-formation, besides them all the demon-forces are with me, for which reason the Yakshas etc. gladly present present all types of their wealth to me.

239.g: ਵੇ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੀਤ ਤੇ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੋਇ ਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਨਰ ॥੩੭੭॥
239.t: ve ju'dh jeet te jaahige kahaa dhoi te dheen nar ||377||
239.e: The person about whom you are talking, both of them are very low and helpless men, how shall then they win the war?377.

239.g: ਕਹਿ ਹਾਰਯੋ ਕਪਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਈਤ ਪਤਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
239.t: keh haarayo kap koT dhieet pat ek na maanee ||
239.e: Angad, the monkey-chief, advice Ravana several times, but he did not accept his advice.

239.g: ਉਠਤ ਪਾਵ ਰੁਪਿਯੋ ਸਭਾ ਮਧਿ ਸੋ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
239.t: auThat paav rupiyo sabhaa madh so abhimaanee ||
239.e: When he got up, he firmly planted his foot in the assembly and challenged them to remove his foot (from the floor)

239.g: ਥਕੇ ਸਕਲ ਅਸੁਰਾਰ ਪਾਵ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਨ ਉਚੱਕਯੋ ॥
239.t: thake sakal asuraar paav kinahoo(n) na ucha'kayo ||
239.e: None of the demons could do that and accepted defeat

239.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰਨ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ਬਿਮਨ ਦਾਨਵ ਦਲ ਥੱਕਯੋ ॥
239.t: gire dharan murachhai biman dhaanav dhal tha'kayo ||
239.e: Many of them fell down unconscious because of their spent-up strength.

239.g: ਲੈ ਚਲਯੋ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤਿਹ ਬਾਲ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਧੂਸਰ ਬਰਨ ॥
239.t: lai chalayo babheechhan bhraat teh baal putr dhoosar baran ||
239.e: That earthen-coloured Angad left the court of Ravana alongwith Vibhishan.

239.g: ਭਟ ਹਟਕ ਬਿਕਟ ਤਿਹ ਨਾ ਸਕੇ ਚਲਿ ਆਯੋ ਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਨ ॥੩੭੮॥
239.t: bhaT haTak bikaT teh naa sake chal aayo jit raam ran ||378||
239.e: When the demons tried to obstruct him, he routed and destroyed them and winning the battle in favour of Ram, he came to him.378.

239.g: ਕਹਿ ਬੁਲਯੋ ਲੰਕੇਸ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਜੀਵ ਲੋਚਨ ॥
239.t: keh bulayo la(n)kes taeh prabh raajeev lochan ||
239.e: Angad said on reaching, “O lotus-eyed Ram! the king of Lanka has called you for war.”

239.g: ਕੁਟਲ ਅਲਕ ਮੁਖ ਛਕੇ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੁਖ ਮੋਚਨ ॥
239.t: kuTal alak mukh chhake sakal sa(n)tan dhukh mochan ||
239.e: At that time some curly locks of hair were walking and looking at the beauty of his anguished face

239.g: ਕੁਪੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਬਿਜੈ ਪਹਲੀ ਰਣ ਚੱਖੀ ॥
239.t: kupai sarab kapiraaj bijai pahalee ran cha'khee ||
239.e: The monkeys who had been victorious over Ravana earlier, were highly enraged on listening to the word of Angad about Ravana.

239.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਲੰਕ ਗੜਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਦਿਸਾ ਦੱਛਣੀ ਪਰੱਖੀ ॥
239.t: firai la(n)k gaR gher dhisaa dha'chhanee para'khee ||
239.e: They marched towards the South in order to advance towards Lanka.

239.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੈ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਲੰਕਪਤਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਬਾਤਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਘਰਣਿ ॥
239.t: prabh karai babheechhan la(n)kapat sunee baat raavan gharan ||
239.e: When, on this side Mandodari, the wife of Ravana, learnt about the scheme of Ram for making Vibhishana the king of Lanka,

239.g: ਸੁੱਧਿ ਸੱਤ ਤੱਬਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਭਈ ਗਿਰੀ ਧਰਣ ਪਰ ਹੁਐ ਬਿਮਣ ॥੩੭੯॥
239.t: su'dh sa't ta'b bisarat bhiee giree dharan par huaai biman ||379||
239.e: She fell down unconscious on the earth.379.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: madhodharee baach ||
239.e: The Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਉਟੰਙਣ ਛੰਦ ॥
239.t: auTa(n)n(g)n chha(n)dh ||
239.e: UTANGAN STANZA

239.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰਾ ਸਜੇ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜੇ ਭਾਜ ਕੰਤਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
239.t: soorabeeraa saje ghor baaje baje bhaaj ka(n)taa sune raam aae ||
239.e: The warriors are decorating themselves and the horrible battle-drums are resounding, O my husband! You may flee for your safety because Ram has arrived

239.g: ਬਾਲ ਮਾਰਯੋ ਬਲੀ ਸਿੰਧ ਪਾਟਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੌ ਬੈਰਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
239.t: baal maarayo balee si(n)dh paaTayo jinai taeh sau bair kaise rachaae ||
239.e: He who has killed Bali, who has splitted the sea and created the passage, why have you created enmity with him?

239.g: ਬਯਾਧ ਜੀਤਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ ਜੰਭ ਮਾਰਯੋ ਉਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
239.t: bayaadh jeetayo jinai ja(n)bh maarayo unai raam aautaar soiee suhaae ||
239.e: He, who has killed Byadh and Jambasur, it is the same power, which has manifested itself as Ram

239.g: ਦੇ ਮਿਲੋ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਚਲਾਏ ॥੩੮੦॥
239.t: dhe milo jaanakee baat hai siaan kee chaam ke dhaam kaahe chalaae ||380||
239.e: Return Sita to him and see him, this is the only wise thing, do not try to introduce the coins of leather.380.

239.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: raavan baach ||
239.e: Speech of Ravana :

239.g: ਬਯੂਹ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਜੋ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਗਜੋ ਆਨ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
239.t: bayooh sainaa sajo ghor baaje bajo koT jodhaa gajo aan nere ||
239.e: Even if there is siege of army on all the four sides and there may be the resonance of horrible sound of war-drums and millions of warriors may roar near me

239.g: ਸਾਜ ਸੰਜੋਅ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਭੈ ਆਜ ਮਾਰੋ ਤਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
239.t: saaj sa(n)joa sa(n)booh sainaa sabhai aaj maaro tarai dhirasaT tere ||
239.e: Even then I shall, on wearing my armours, destroy them within your sight

239.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜੀਤੋ ਕਰੋ ਜੱਛ ਰੀਤੋ ਧਨੰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਬਰੰ ਜੀਤ ਜੁੱਧੈ ॥
239.t: ei(n)dhr jeeto karo ja'chh reeto dhana(n) naar seetaa bara(n) jeet ju'dhai ||
239.e: I shall conquer Indra and loot all she treasure of Yaksha and after winning the war, I shall wed Sita.

239.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਆਕਾਸ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਜਰੈ ਬਾਚਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੋਰ ਕ੍ਰੂੱਧੈ ॥੩੮੧॥
239.t: surag paataal aakaas juaalaa jarai baach hai raam kaa mor kraoo'dhai ||381||
239.e: If with the fire of my fury, when the sky, netherworld and heaven burn, then how Ram will remain safe before me?381.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: madhodharee baach ||
239.e: Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਤਾਰਕਾ ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਘਾਤ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਿਨੈ ਅਉਰ ਸੁਬਾਹ ਮਾਰੀਚ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
239.t: taarakaa jaat hee ghaat keenee jinai aaur subaeh maareech maare ||
239.e: He who has killed Taraka, Subahu and Marich,

239.g: ਬਯਾਧ ਬੱਧਯੋ ਖਰੰਦੂਖਣੰ ਖੇਤ ਥੈ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਸੋਂ ਬਾਲ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
239.t: bayaadh ba'dhayo khara(n)dhookhana(n) khet thai ek hee baan so(n) baal maare ||
239.e: And also killed Viradh and Khar-Dushan, and killed Bali with one arrow

239.g: ਧੁਮ੍ਰ ਅੱਛਾਦ ਅਉ ਜਾਬੁਮਾਲੀ ਬਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੀਣੰ ਕਰਯੋ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੈ ਕੈ ॥
239.t: dhumr a'chhaadh aau jaabumaalee balee praan heena(n) karayo ju'dh jai kai ||
239.e: He who has destroyed Dhumraksha and Jambumali in the war,

239.g: ਮਾਰਿਹੈਂ ਤੋਹਿ ਯੌ ਸਯਾਰ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਘ ਜਯੋ ਲੇਹਿਗੇ ਲੰਕ ਕੋ ਡੰਕ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥੩੮੨॥
239.t: maarihai(n) toh yau sayaar ke si(n)gh jayo lehige la(n)k ko dda(n)k dhai kai ||382||
239.e: He will conquer you by challenging you and kill you like a lion killing a jackal.382.

239.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: raavan baach ||
239.e: Speech of Ravana :

239.g: ਚਉਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰੰ ਕਰੰ ਛੱਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਰਰੰ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
239.t: chaur cha(n)dhra(n) kara(n) chha'tr soora(n) dhara(n) bedh brahamaa rara(n) dhuaar mere ||
239.e: The moon waves the fly-whisk over my head, the sun catches hold of my canopy and Brahma recites Vedas at my gate

239.g: ਪਾਕ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਰੰ ਨੀਰ ਬਰਣੰ ਭਰੰ ਜੱਛ ਬਿੱਦਿਆਧਰੰ ਕੀਨ ਚੇਰੇ ॥
239.t: paak paavak kara(n) neer barana(n) bhara(n) ja'chh bi'dhiaadhara(n) keen chere ||
239.e: The god of fire prepares my food, the god Varuna brings water for me and the Yakshas teach various sciences

239.g: ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬੰ ਪੁਰੰ ਚਰਬ ਸਰਬੰ ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰੌ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
239.t: arab kharaba(n) pura(n) charab saraba(n) kare dhekh kaise karau beer kheta(n) ||
239.e: I have enjoyed the comforts of millions of heavens, you may see how I kill the warriors

239.g: ਚਿੰਕ ਹੈ ਚਾਵਡਾ ਫਿੰਕ ਹੈ ਫਿੱਕਰੀ ਨਾਚ ਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ॥੩੮੩॥
239.t: chi(n)k hai chaavaddaa fi(n)k hai fi'karee naach hai beer baitaal preta(n) ||383||
239.e: I shall wage such a horrible war that the vultures will become happy, the vampires will roam and the ghosts and fiends will dance.383.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: madhodharee baach ||
239.e: Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਤਾਸ ਨੇਜੇ ਢੁਲੈ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਲੈ ਆਨ ਢੂਕੇ ॥
239.t: taas neje ddulai ghor baaje bajai raam leene dhalai aan ddooke ||
239.e: Look there, the swinging lances are visible, the terrible instruments are resounding and Ram has arrived with his mighty forces

239.g: ਬਾਨਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਚਿੰਕਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਕਰੰ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰੰ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਕੂਕੇ ॥
239.t: baanaree poot chi(n)kaar apaara(n) kara(n) maar maara(n) chahoo(n) or kooke ||
239.e: The sound of “kill, kill” is emanating form the army of monkeys from all the four sides

239.g: ਭੀਮ ਭੇਰੀ ਬਜੈ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਗਜੈ ਬਾਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਉ ਲੌ ॥
239.t: bheem bheree bajai ja(n)g jodhaa gajai baan chaapai chalai naeh jau lau ||
239.e: O Ravana! till the time the war-drums resound and the thundering warriors discharge their arrows

239.g: ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਘਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ਰਾਵਰੀ ਦੇਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਤ ਤਉ ਲੌ ॥੩੮੪॥
239.t: baat ko maaneeaai ghaat pahichaaneeaai raavaree dheh kee saat tau lau ||384||
239.e: Recognising the opportunity before that, accept my saying for the protection of your body (and leave the idea of war).384.

239.g: ਘਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਰੁਕੌ ਬਾਟ ਬਾਟੈ ਤੁਪੋ ਐਂਠ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਹਾ ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
239.t: ghaaT ghaaTai rukau baaT baaTai tupo aai(n)Th baiThe kahaa raam aae ||
239.e: Obstruct the movement of the armies on the sea-shore and other routes, because now ram has arrived,

239.g: ਖੋਰ ਹਰਾਮ ਹਰੀਫ ਕੀ ਆਂਖ ਤੈ ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਾਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
239.t: khor haraam hareef kee aa(n)kh tai chaam ke jaat kaise chalaae ||
239.e: Do all the work by removing the veil of heresy form your eyes and do not become self-willed.

239.g: ਹੋਇਗੋ ਖੁਆਰ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਖਾਨਾ ਤੁਰਾ ਬਾਨਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਜਉ ਲੌ ਨ ਗਜਿ ਹੈ ॥
239.t: hoigo khuaar biseeaar khaanaa turaa baanaree poot jau lau na gaj hai ||
239.e: If you remain in distress, your family will be destroyed  you can feel yourself protected till the army of monkeys does not begin its violent thunderings

239.g: ਲੰਕ ਕੋ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਫਾਧ ਕੈ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਲੈ ਘਾਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੫॥
239.t: la(n)k ko chhaadd kai koT ke faadh kai aasuree poot lai ghaas bhaj hai ||385||
239.e: After that all the son demos will flee, after jumping over the walls of th citadel and pressing the blades of grass in their mouths.385.

239.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.t: raavan baach ||
239.e: Speech of Ravana :

239.g: ਬਾਵਰੀ ਰਾਡ ਕਿਆ ਭਾਡਿ ਬਾਤੈ ਬਕੈ ਰੰਕ ਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡ ਰਾਸਾ ॥
239.t: baavaree raadd kiaa bhaadd baatai bakai ra(n)k se raam kaa chhodd raasaa ||
239.e: O foolish prostitute! why do you prattle Stop the praises of Ram

239.g: ਕਾਢਹੋ ਬਾਸਿ ਦੈ ਬਾਨ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ ਦੇਖਿਹੋ ਆਜ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
239.t: kaaddaho baas dhai baan baajeegaree dhekhiho aaj taa ko tamaasaa ||
239.e: He will only discharge very small arrows like incense-stick towards me, I shall see this sport today.

239.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਾਹੇ ਧਰੰ ਸੀਸ ਦਸਯੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਸੈਣ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
239.t: bees baahe dhara(n) sees dhasaya(n) sira(n) sain sa(n)booh hai sa(n)g mere ||
239.e: I have twenty arms and ten heads and all the forces are with me

239.g: ਭਾਜ ਜੈ ਹੈ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਟਿ ਪੈਹੈਂ ਊਹਾ ਮਾਰਿਹੌ ਬਾਜ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਟੇਰੇ ॥੩੮੬॥
239.t: bhaaj jai hai kahaa baaT paihai(n) uoohaa maarihau baaj jaise baTere ||386||
239.e: Ram will not even get passage for running away, wherever I shall find him, I shall kill him there like a flacon killing a quil.386.

240.g: ਏਕ ਏਕੰ ਹਿਰੈਂ ਝੂਮ ਝੂਮੰ ਮਰੈਂ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੰ ਗਿਰੈਂ ਹਾਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
240.t: ek eka(n) hirai(n) jhoom jhooma(n) marai(n) aap aapa(n) girai(n) haak maare ||
240.e: I shall search for each one and kill him, and all of them will fall down on listening to my challenge

240.g: ਲਾਗ ਜੈਹੱਉ ਤਹਾ ਭਾਜ ਜੈਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਫੂਲ ਜੈਹੈ ਕਹਾ ਤੈ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
240.t: laag jaiha'au tahaa bhaaj jaihai jahaa fool jaihai kahaa tai ubaare ||
240.e: Wherever they will run to, shall pursue them and reach there, they shall not be able to conceal themselves.

240.g: ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜੇ ਸਭੈ ਆਜ ਲੈਹੱਉਾਂ ਤਿਨੈ ਰਾਜ ਕੈਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਜ ਮੋ ਸੋ ॥
240.t: saaj baaje sabhai aaj laiha'auaa(n) tinai raaj kaiso karai kaaj mo so ||
240.e: After bedecking myself, I shall catch them today and my whole work will be accomplished by my men.

240.g: ਬਾਨਰੰ ਛੈ ਕਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਲੱਛੈ ਹਰੋ ਜੀਤ ਹੌ ਹੋਡ ਤਉ ਤਾਨ ਤੋ ਸੋ ॥੩੮੭॥
240.t: baanara(n) chhai karo raam la'chhai haro jeet hau hodd tau taan to so ||387||
240.e: I shall destroy the army of monkeys, I shall kill ram and Lakshman and after conquering them I shall break to pieces your arrogance.387.

240.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਾਤੈ ਗੁਨੀ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਕੋਪਿ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਪੁੱਤ ਪੱਠੈ ॥
240.t: koT baatai gunee ek kai naa sunee kop mu(n)ddee dhunee pu't pa'Thai ||
240.e: Many things were said but Ravana paid a deaf ear to them and highly infuriated, he sent his sons to war-arena

240.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਰਾਤ ਦੇਵਾਤ ਦੂਜੋ ਬਲੀ ਭੂਮ ਕੰਪੀ ਰਣੰਬੀਰ ਉੱਠੈ ॥
240.t: ek naaraat dhevaat dhoojo balee bhoom ka(n)pee rana(n)beer u'Thai ||
240.e: One of them was Narant and the other Devant, they were mighty warriors, on seeing whom the earth trembled,

240.g: ਸਾਰ ਭਾਰੰ ਪਰੇ ਧਾਰ ਧਾਰੰ ਬਜੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੈ ਲੋਹ ਕੀ ਛਿੱਟ ਛੁੱਟੈਂ ॥
240.t: saar bhaara(n) pare dhaar dhaara(n) bajee kroh kai loh kee chhi'T chhu'Tai(n) ||
240.e: The steel struck with steel and with the shower of arrows, there was splash of blood

240.g: ਰੁੰਡ ਧੁਕਧੁਕ ਪਰੈ ਘਾਇ ਭਕਭਕ ਕਰੈ ਬਿੱਥਰੀ ਜੁੱਥ ਸੋ ਲੁੱਥ ਲੁੱਟੈਂ ॥੩੮੮॥
240.t: ru(n)dd dhukadhuk parai ghai bhakabhak karai bi'tharee ju'th so lu'th lu'Tai(n) ||388||
240.e: The headless trunks writhed, the blood gushed out of the wounds and the corpses were scattered here and there.388.

240.g: ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਜੁੱਗਣ ਭਰੈ ਸੱਦ ਦੇਵੀ ਕਰੈ ਨੱਦ ਭੈਰੋ ਰਰੈ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
240.t: pa'tr ju'gan bharai sa'dh dhevee karai na'dh bhairo rarai geet gaavai ||
240.e: The Yoginis filled their bowls with blood and began to call out for the goddess kali, Bhairavas began to sing songs with terrible sounds.

240.g: ਭੂਤ ਔ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਬੈਤਾਲ ਬੀਰੰ ਬਲੀ ਮਾਸ ਅਹਾਰ ਤਾਰੀ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
240.t: bhoot aau pret baitaal beera(n) balee maas ahaar taaree bajaavai ||
240.e: The ghosts, fiends and other flesh-eaters clapped their hands

240.g: ਜੱਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਅਉ ਸਰਬ ਬਿੱਦਿਆਧਰੰ ਮੱਧਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਭਯੋ ਸੱਦ ਦੇਵੰ ॥
240.t: ja'chh ga(n)dhrab aau sarab bi'dhiaadhara(n) ma'dh aakaas bhayo sa'dh dheva(n) ||
240.e: The Yakshas, Gandharvas and gods specialist in all science moved in the sky

240.g: ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿਦੁੱਥਰੀ ਹੂਹ ਕੂਹੰ ਭਰੀ ਮੱਚੀਯੰ ਜੁੱਧ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਤੇਵੰ ॥੩੮੯॥
240.t: lu'th bidhu'tharee hooh kooha(n) bharee ma'cheeya(n) ju'dh anoop ateva(n) ||389||
240.e: The corpses were scattered and on all the four sides the atmosphere was filled with terrible din and in this way the terrible war made a unique advancement.389.

240.g: ਸੰਗੀਤ ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
240.t: sa(n)geet chhapai chha(n)dh ||
240.e: SANGEET CHHAPAI STANZA

240.g: ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕੁੱਪਯੋ ਕਪਿ ਕਟਕ ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬਾਜਨ ਰਣ ਬੱਜਿਯ ॥
240.t: kaagaRadhee ku'payo kap kaTak baagaRadhee baajan ran ba'jiy ||
240.e: The army of monkeys got infuriated and the terrible war instruments resounded

240.g: ਤਾਗੜਦੀ ਤੇਗ ਝਲਹਲੀ ਗਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੋਧਾ ਗਲ ਗੱਜਿਯ ॥
240.t: taagaRadhee teg jhalahalee gaagaRadhee jodhaa gal ga'jiy ||
240.e: There was the glitter of the swords and the warriors thundered like lions

240.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਮੁਹੇ ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਨੱਚਯੋ ॥
240.t: saagaRadhee soor sa(n)muhe naagaRadhee naaradh mun na'chayo ||
240.e: Seeing the warriors fighting with each other the sage Narad danced with joy

240.g: ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਾਲ ਆਗੜਦੀ ਆਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਰੱਚਯੋ ॥
240.t: baagaRadhee beer baitaal aagaRadhee aaran ra(n)g ra'chayo ||
240.e: The stampede of the brave fiends became violent and alongwith it the war also grew in intensity

240.g: ਸੰਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਭਟ ਨੱਚੇ ਸਮਰ ਫਾਗੜਦੀ ਫੁੰਕ ਫਣੀਅਰ ਕਰੈਂ ॥
240.t: sa(n)saagaRadhee subhaT na'che samar faagaRadhee fu(n)k faneear karai(n) ||
240.e: The warriors danced in the battlefield and the blood flowed from their bodies like the flow of poison from the thousands of hoods of Sheshanaga and they began to play holi

240.g: ਸੰਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਮਟੈ ਸੁੰਕੜੈ ਫਣਪਤਿ ਫਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਰੈਂ ॥੩੯੦॥
240.t: sa(n)saagaRadhee samaTai su(n)kaRai fanapat fan fir fir dharai(n) ||390||
240.e: The warriors sometimes recede like the hoods of serpents and sometimes strike while advancing forward.390.

240.g: ਫਾਗੜਦੀ ਫੁੰਕ ਫਿੰਕਰੀ ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਗਿੱਧ ਰੜੱਕੈ ॥
240.t: faagaRadhee fu(n)k fi(n)karee raagaRadhee ran gi'dh raRa'kai ||
240.e: There are splashes of blood on all the four side and there seems to be a show of holi  the vultures are seen in the battlefield

240.g: ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥੁਰੀ ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਭਟ ਘਾਇ ਭਭੱਕੈ ॥
240.t: laagaRadhee lu'th bi'thuree bhaagaRadhee bhaT ghai bhabha'kai ||
240.e: The corpses are lying scattered and the blood is gushing out of the bodies of the warriors

240.g: ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬਰੱਖਤ ਬਾਣ ਝਾਗੜਦੀ ਝਲਮਲਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣੰ ॥
240.t: baagaRadhee bara'khat baan jhaagaRadhee jhalamalat kirapaana(n) ||
240.e: There is shower of the arrows and the glimmer of the swords is visible

240.g: ਗਾਗੜਦੀ ਗੱਜ ਸੰਜਰੈ ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕੱਛੇ ਕਿੰਕਾਣੰ ॥
240.t: gaagaRadhee ga'j sa(n)jarai kaagaRadhee ka'chhe ki(n)kaana(n) ||
240.e: The elephants are thundering and the horses are running amuck

240.g: ਬੰਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬਹਤ ਬੀਰਨ ਸਿਰਨ ਤਾਗੜਦੀ ਤਮਕਿ ਤੇਗੰ ਕੜੀਅ ॥
240.t: ba(n)baagaRadhee bahat beeran siran taagaRadhee tamak tega(n) kaReea ||
240.e: The heads of the warriors are flowing in the stream of blood and there is glitter of the swords,

241.g: ਝੰਝਾਗੜਦੀ ਝੜਕ ਦੈ ਝੜ ਸਮੈ ਝਲਮਲ ਝੁਕਿ ਬਿੱਜੁਲ ਝੜੀਅ ॥੩੯੧॥
241.t: jha(n)jhaagaRadhee jhaRak dhai jhaR samai jhalamal jhuk bi'jul jhaReea ||391||
241.e: Which are falling with sound like the lightning from the sky.391.

241.g: ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨਾਰਾਤਕ ਗਿਰਤ ਦਾਗੜਦੀ ਦੇਵਾਤਕ ਧਾਯੋ ॥
241.t: naagaRadhee naaraatak girat dhaagaRadhee dhevaatak dhaayo ||
241.e: When Narantak fell down, Devantak ran forward,

241.g: ਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੁੱਧ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਮਲ ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਰਲੋਕ ਸਿਧਾਯੋ ॥
241.t: jaagaRadhee ju'dh kar tumal saagaRadhee suralok sidhaayo ||
241.e: And fighting bravely left for heven

241.g: ਦਾਗੜਦੀ ਦੇਵ ਰਹਸੰਤ ਆਗੜਦੀ ਆਸੁਰਣ ਰਣ ਸੋਗੰ ॥
241.t: dhaagaRadhee dhev rahasa(n)t aagaRadhee aasuran ran soga(n) ||
241.e: On seeing this the gods were filled with joy and there was anguish in the army of demos

241.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਿੱਧ ਸਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨਾਚਤ ਤਜਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
241.t: saagaRadhee si'dh sar sa(n)t naagaRadhee naachat taj joga(n) ||
241.e: The Siddhas (adepts) and saints, forsaking their Yoga contemplation, began to dance

241.g: ਖੰਖਾਗੜਦੀ ਖਯਾਹ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਖਲ ਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਪੁਹਪ ਡਾਰਤ ਅਮਰ ॥
241.t: kha(n)khaagaRadhee khayaeh bhe praapat khal paagaRadhee puhap ddaarat amar ||
241.e: There was destruction of the army of demons and the gods showered flowers,

241.g: ਜੰਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਕਲ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਪੈ ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਰਪੁਰਹਿ ਨਾਰ ਨਰ ॥੩੯੨॥
241.t: ja(n)jaagaRadhee sakal jai jai japai saagaRadhee surapureh naar nar ||392||
241.e: And the males and females of the city of gods hailed the victory.392.

241.g: ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਾਵਣਹਿ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਦੋਊ ਸੁਤ ਰਣ ਜੁੱਝੇ ॥
241.t: raagaRadhee raavaneh sunayo saagaRadhee dhouoo sut ran ju'jhe ||
241.e: Ravana also heard that both his sons, and many other warriors had died while fighting

241.g: ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਗਿਰੇ ਆਗੜਦੀ ਆਹਵਹਿ ਅਰੁੱਝੇ ॥
241.t: baagaRadhee beer bahu gire aagaRadhee aahaveh aru'jhe ||
241.e: The corpses lie scattered in the battlefield and the vultures, while tearing away the flesh, are shrieking

241.g: ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥੁਰੀ ਚਾਗੜਦੀ ਚਾਵੰਡ ਚਿੰਕਾਰੰ ॥
241.t: laagaRadhee lu'th bi'thuree chaagaRadhee chaava(n)dd chi(n)kaara(n) ||
241.e: The streams of blood have flowed in the battlefield,

241.g: ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨੱਦ ਭਏ ਗੱਦ ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਿਲਕਾਰੰ ॥
241.t: naagaRadhee na'dh bhe ga'dh kaagaRadhee kaalee kilakaara(n) ||
241.e: And the goddess Kali is raising horrible shots

241.g: ਭੰਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਭਯੰਕਰ ਜੁੱਧ ਭਯੋ ਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੂਹ ਜੁੱਗਣ ਜੁਰੀਅ ॥
241.t: bha(n)bhaagaRadhee bhaya(n)kar ju'dh bhayo jaagaRadhee jooh ju'gan jureea ||
241.e: There has been a frightening war and the Yoginis, having gathered for drinking blood,

241.g: ਕੰਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕਿਲੱਕਤ ਕੁਹਰ ਕਰ ਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤ ਭਰੀਅ ॥੩੯੩॥
241.t: ka(n)kaagaRadhee kila'kat kuhar kar paagaRadhee pa'tr sronat bhareea ||393||
241.e: And having filled their bowls, they are shrieking violently.393.

241.g: ਇਤਿ ਦੇਵਾਤਕ ਨਰਾਤਕ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੯॥
241.t: eit dhevaatak naraatak badheh dhiaai samaapatam sat ||9||
241.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘The Killin of Devantak Narantak’.

241.g: ਅਥ ਪ੍ਰਹਸਤ ਜੁੱਧ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
241.t: ath prahasat ju'dh kathana(n) ||
241.e: Now begins the description of the war with Prahasta :

241.g: ਸੰਗੀਤ ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
241.t: sa(n)geet chhapai chha(n)dh ||
241.e: SANGEET CHHAPAI STANZA

241.g: ਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਸਤ ਪਠਿਯੋ ਦਾਗੜਦੀ ਦੈਕੈ ਦਲ ਅਨਗਨ ॥
241.t: paagaRadhee prahasat paThiyo dhaagaRadhee dhaikai dhal anagan ||

241.g: ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕੰਪ ਭੂਅ ਉਠੀ ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਬਾਜੀਯ ਖੁਰੀਅਨ ਤਨ ॥
241.t: kaagaRadhee ka(n)p bhooa uThee baagaRadhee baajeey khureean tan ||
241.e: Then Ravana sent innumerable soldiers with Prahasta for waging the war and the earth trembled under the impact of horses hoofs.

241.g: ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨੀਲ ਤਿਹ ਝਿਣਯੋ ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਗਹਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਅ ॥
241.t: naagaRadhee neel teh jhinayo bhaagaRadhee geh bhoom pachhaaReea ||

241.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਮਰ ਹਹਕਾਰ ਦਾਗੜਦੀ ਦਾਨਵ ਦਲ ਭਾਰੀਅ ॥
241.t: saagaRadhee samar hahakaar dhaagaRadhee dhaanav dhal bhaareea ||
241.e: Neel entangled himself with him and threw him on the ground and there was great lamentation in the demon forces.

241.g: ਘੰਘਾਗੜਦੀ ਘਾਇ ਭਕਭਕ ਕਰਤ ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰੁਹਿਰ ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਬਹਿ ॥
241.t: gha(n)ghaagaRadhee ghai bhakabhak karat raagaRadhee ruhir ran ra(n)g beh ||

241.g: ਜੰਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੁਯਹ ਜੁੱਗਣ ਜਪੈ ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕਾਕ ਕਰ ਕਰਕਕਹ ॥੩੯੪॥
241.t: ja(n)jaagaRadhee juyeh ju'gan japai kaagaRadhee kaak kar karakakeh ||394||
241.e: The wounds were inflicted from which the blood oozed out and flowed. The gatherings of Yoginis began to recite (their mantras) and the cawing of the crows was heard.394.

241.g: ਫਾਗੜਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਸਤ ਜੁਝੰਤ ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲੈ ਚਲਯੋ ਅੱਪ ਦਲ ॥
241.t: faagaRadhee prahasat jujha(n)t laagaRadhee lai chalayo a'p dhal ||

241.g: ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਭੜਹੜੀ ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕੰਪੀ ਦੋਈ ਜਲ ਥਲ ॥
241.t: bhaagaRadhee bhoom bhaRahaRee kaagaRadhee ka(n)pee dhoiee jal thal ||
241.e: Fighting very bravely alongwith his forces, Prahasta advance forward and with his movement the earth and the water felt a sensation

241.g: ਨਾਗੜਦੀ ਨਾਦ ਨਿੱਹ ਨੱਦ ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਭੇਰਿ ਭਯੰਕਰ ॥
241.t: naagaRadhee naadh ni'h na'dh bhaagaRadhee ran bher bhaya(n)kar ||
241.e: There was dreadful sound and the dreadful resonance of drums was heard

241.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਾਗ ਝਲਹਲਤ ਚਾਗੜਦੀ ਚਮਕੰਤ ਚਲਤ ਸਰ ॥
241.t: saagaRadhee saag jhalahalat chaagaRadhee chamaka(n)t chalat sar ||
241.e: The lances glittered and the shining arrows were discharged

241.g: ਖੰਖਾਗੜਦੀ ਖੇਤਿ ਖੜਗ ਖਿਮਕਤ ਖਹਤ ਚਾਗੜਦੀ ਚਟਕ ਚਿਨਗੈਂ ਕਢੈ ॥
241.t: kha(n)khaagaRadhee khet khaRag khimakat khahat chaagaRadhee chaTak chinagai(n) kaddai ||
241.e: There was rattling of spears and with their blows on the shields the sparks arose

241.g: ਠੰਠਾਗੜਦੀ ਠਾਟ ਠੱਟ ਕਰ ਮਨੋ ਠਾਗੜਦੀ ਠਣਕ ਠਠਿਅਰ ਗਢੈ ॥੩੯੫॥
241.t: Tha(n)ThaagaRadhee ThaaT Tha'T kar mano ThaagaRadhee Thanak ThaThiar gaddai ||395||
241.e: Such a knocking sound was heard the sparks arose   such a knocking sound was heard as though a tinker was fashioning a utensil.395.

241.g: ਢਾਗੜਦੀ ਢਾਲ ਉਛਲਹਿ ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਬੀਰ ਬਬੱਕਹਿ ॥
241.t: ddaagaRadhee ddaal uchhaleh baagaRadhee ran beer baba'keh ||
241.e: The shields sprang up and the warriors began to shout at each other with one tone

241.g: ਆਗੜਦੀ ਇਕ ਲੈ ਚਲੈਂ ਇਕ ਕਹੁ ਇਕ ਉਚੱਕਹਿ ॥
241.t: aagaRadhee ik lai chalai(n) ik kahu ik ucha'keh ||
241.e: The weapons were struck and they rose high and then fell down.

241.g: ਤਾਗੜਦੀ ਤਾਲ ਤੰਬੂਰੰ ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਬੀਨ ਸੁ ਬੱਜੈ ॥
241.t: taagaRadhee taal ta(n)boora(n) baagaRadhee ran been su ba'jai ||
241.e: It appeared that the stringed musical instruments and lyers were played in one tune

241.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੰਖ ਕੇ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਗੜਦੀ ਗੈਵਰ ਗਲ ਗੱਜੈ ॥
241.t: saagaRadhee sa(n)kh ke sabadh gaagaRadhee gaivar gal ga'jai ||
241.e: The sound of the conches thundered all around

241.g: ਧੰਧਾਗੜਦੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਧੜ ਧੁਕਿ ਪਰਤ ਚਾਗੜਦੀ ਚਕਤ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਅਮਰ ॥
241.t: dha(n)dhaagaRadhee dharan dhaR dhuk parat chaagaRadhee chakat chit meh amar ||

241.g: ਪੰਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਰਖਾ ਕਰਤ ਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੱਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਬਰ ॥੩੯੬॥
241.t: pa(n)paagaRadhee puhap barakhaa karat jaagaRadhee ja'chh ga(n)dhrab bar ||396||
241.e: The heart of he beat and seeing the dreadfulness of war the gods also wondered and the Yakshas, Gandharvas etc. began to shower flowers.396.

241.g: ਝਾਗੜਦੀ ਝੁੱਝ ਭਟ ਗਿਰੈਂ ਮਾਗੜਦੀ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਰ ਉਚਾਰੈ ॥
241.t: jhaagaRadhee jhu'jh bhaT girai(n) maagaRadhee mukh maar uchaarai ||
241.e: The warriors even falling down began to shout “Kill, Kill” from their mouths

241.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੰਜ ਪੰਜਰੇ ਘਾਗੜਦੀ ਘਣੀਅਰ ਜਣੁ ਕਾਰੈ ॥
241.t: saagaRadhee sa(n)j pa(n)jare ghaagaRadhee ghaneear jan kaarai ||
241.e: Wearing their gauzy armours they appeared like the waving dark clouds

241.g: ਤਾਗੜਦੀ ਤੀਰ ਬਰਖੰਤ ਗਾਗੜਦੀ ਗਹਿ ਗਦਾ ਗਰਿਸਟੰ ॥
241.t: taagaRadhee teer barakha(n)t gaagaRadhee geh gadhaa garisaTa(n) ||

241.g: ਮਾਗੜਦੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੁਖ ਜਪੈ ਆਗੜਦੀ ਅੱਛਰ ਬਰ ਇਸਟੰ ॥
241.t: maagaRadhee ma(n)tr mukh japai aagaRadhee a'chhar bar isaTa(n) ||
241.e: There was shower of maces and arrows and the heavenly damsels began to recite mantras in order to wed their dear warriors.

241.g: ਸੰਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਮਰ ਕਰ ਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜੂਝ ਜੋਧਾ ਮਰਤ ॥
241.t: sa(n)saagaRadhee sadhaa siv simar kar jaagaRadhee joojh jodhaa marat ||

241.g: ਸੰਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਗਿਰਤ ਆਗੜਦੀ ਅਪੱਛਰਨ ਕਹ ਬਰਤ ॥੩੯੭॥
241.t: sa(n)saagaRadhee subhaT sanamukh girat aagaRadhee apa'chharan keh barat ||397||
241.e: The heroes remembered Shiva and died while fighting and on their falling down the heavenly damsels advanced to wed them.397.

241.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
241.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
241.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

241.g: ਇਤੈ ਉੱਚਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਲੰਕੇਸ ਬੈਣੰ ॥
241.t: eitai u'chare raam la(n)kes baina(n) ||

241.g: ਉਤੈ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਖੈ ਚੜੈ ਰਥ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
241.t: autai dhev dhekhai chaRai rath gaina(n) ||
241.e: On this side there is dialogue between Ram and Ravana and on the other side the gods mounted on their chariots in the sky are looking at this scene.

241.g: ਕਹੋ ਏਕ ਏਕੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
241.t: kaho ek eka(n) aneka(n) prakaara(n) ||

241.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਮੰਤੰ ਲੁੱਝਾਰੰ ॥੩੯੮॥
241.t: mile ju'dh jete sama(n)ta(n) lu'jhaara(n) ||398||
241.e: All those warriors who are fighting in the battlefield, they can be described one by one in various ways.398.

241.g: ਬਭੀਛਣ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ॥
241.t: babheechhan baach raam so ||
241.e: Speech of Vibhishana addressed to Ram :

241.g: ਧੁੰਨੰ ਮੰਡਲਾਕਾਰ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
241.t: dhu(n)na(n) ma(n)ddalaakaar jaa ko biraajai ||

241.g: ਸਿਰੰ ਜੈਤ ਪੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਛੱਤ੍ਰ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
241.t: sira(n) jait pa'tra(n) sita(n) chha'tr chhaajai ||
241.e: He, who has the spherical bow and on whose head the white canopy is rotating like a letter of victory

242.g: ਰਥੰ ਬਿਸਟਤੰ ਬਯਾਘ੍ਰ ਚਰਮੰ ਅਭੀਤੰ ॥
242.t: ratha(n) bisaTata(n) bayaaghr charama(n) abheeta(n) ||

242.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਨੋ ਹਠੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜੀਤੰ ॥੩੯੯॥
242.t: tisai naath jaano haThee i(n)dhr jeeta(n) ||399||
242.e: And who is sitting on the lion-skin fearlessly in the chariot, O Lord, he is the persistent Inderjit (Meghand).399.

242.g: ਨਹੈ ਪਿੰਗ ਬਾਜੀ ਰਥੰ ਜੇਨ ਸੋਭੈਂ ॥
242.t: nahai pi(n)g baajee ratha(n) jen sobhai(n) ||

242.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਇ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਭੈ ਦੇਵ ਛੋਭੈਂ ॥
242.t: mahaa kai pekhe sabhai dhev chhobhai(n) ||
242.e: He, with whose chariot there are brown horses and seeing whose broad body even the gods become fearful

242.g: ਹਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਗਰਬੰ ਧਨੰ ਪਾਲ ਦੇਵੰ ॥
242.t: hare sarab garaba(n) dhana(n) paal dheva(n) ||

242.g: ਮਹਾਕਾਇ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਹਾਬੀਰ ਜੇਵੰ ॥੪੦੦॥
242.t: mahaakai naamaa mahaabeer jeva(n) ||400||
242.e: And who has mashed the pride of all the gods, he is known as broad-bodies Kumbhkaran.400.

242.g: ਲਗੇ ਮਯੂਰ ਬਰਣੰ ਰਥੰ ਜੇਨ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
242.t: lage mayoor barana(n) ratha(n) jen baajee ||

242.g: ਬਕੈ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰੰ ਤਜੈ ਬਾਣ ਰਾਜੀ ॥
242.t: bakai maar maara(n) tajai baan raajee ||
242.e: The chariot with which the peacock-coloured horses are harnessed and who is showering arrows alongwith his shouts of “Kill, Kill”,

242.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੁੱਧ ਕੋ ਕਰ ਮਹੋਦਰ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
242.t: mahaa ju'dh ko kar mahodhar bakhaano ||

242.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਜੁੱਧ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੪੦੧॥
242.t: tisai ju'dh karataa baddo raam jaano ||401||
242.e: O Ram! his name is Mahodar and should be considered a very great warrior.401.

242.g: ਲਗੇ ਮੁਖਕੰ ਬਰਣ ਬਾਜੀ ਰਥੇਸੰ ॥
242.t: lage mukhaka(n) baran baajee rathesa(n) ||

242.g: ਹਸੈ ਪਉਨ ਕੇ ਗਉਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਰ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
242.t: hasai paun ke gaun ko chaar dhesa(n) ||
242.e: The chariot with which the white horses like the face are harnessed, and who, in gait, put the wind to shame

242.g: ਧਰੇ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ਕਿਧੋ ਕਾਲ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
242.t: dhare baan paana(n) kidho kaal roopa(n) ||

242.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਨੋ ਸਹੀ ਦਈਤ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੪੦੨॥
242.t: tisai raam jaano sahee dhieet bhoopa(n) ||402||
242.e: And who seems like death (KAL), catching hold of his arrows in his hand, O Ram! consider him as Ravana, the king of demons.402.

242.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਮੋਰ ਪੁੱਛੰ ਢੁਰੈ ਚਉਰ ਚਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: firai mor pu'chha(n) ddurai chaur chaara(n) ||

242.g: ਰੜੈ ਕਿੱਤ ਬੰਦੀ ਅਨੰਤੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: raRai ki't ba(n)dhee ana(n)ta(n) apaara(n) ||
242.e: He, on whom the fly-whisk of the feathers of a peacock is being waved and before whom many people many people are standing in the posture of salutation

242.g: ਰਥੰ ਸੁਵਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਕਣੀ ਚਾਰ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
242.t: ratha(n) suvaran kee ki(n)kanee chaar sohai ||

242.g: ਲਖੇ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਤੇਜ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੪੦੩॥
242.t: lakhe dhev ka(n)niaa mahaa tej mohai ||403||
242.e: He whose chariot the small bells of gold seem impressive and seeing whom the daughter of gods are getting enamoured.403.

242.g: ਛਕੈ ਮੱਧ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਜਾ ਸਾਰਦੂਲੰ ॥
242.t: chhakai ma'dh jaa kee dhujaa saaradhoola(n) ||

242.g: ਇਹੈ ਦਈਤ ਰਾਜੰ ਦੁਰੰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੂਲੰ ॥
242.t: eihai dhieet raaja(n) dhura(n) dhroh moola(n) ||
242.e: In the centre of whose banner there is the sign of a lion, he is Ravana, the king of demons and has ill-will for Ram in his mind

242.g: ਲਸੈ ਕ੍ਰੀਟ ਸੀਸੰ ਕਸੈ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਾ ਕੋ ॥
242.t: lasai kreeT seesa(n) kasai cha(n)dhr bhaa ko ||

242.g: ਰਮਾ ਨਾਥ ਚੀਨੋ ਦਸੰ ਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਤਾ ਕੋ ॥੪੦੪॥
242.t: ramaa naath cheeno dhasa(n) greev taa ko ||404||
242.e: He on whose crown there are the moon and the sun, O all-filling Lord! Recognise him, is the ten-headed Ravana.404.

242.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਬੱਜੇ ਬਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: dhuhoo(n) or ba'je baja(n)tra(n) apaara(n) ||

242.g: ਮਚੇ ਸੂਰਬੀਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: mache soorabeera(n) mahaa sasatr dhaara(n) ||
242.e: Many instruments began to resound form both sides and the warriors began to shower the current of great weapons.

242.g: ਕਰੈ ਅੱਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤੰ ਨਿਪਾਤੰਤ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
242.t: karai a'tr paata(n) nipaata(n)t soora(n) ||

242.g: ਉਠੇ ਮੱਧ ਜੁੱਧੰ ਕਮੱਧੰ ਕਰੂਰੰ ॥੪੦੫॥
242.t: auThe ma'dh ju'dha(n) kama'dha(n) karoora(n) ||405||
242.e: The arms were struck and the warriors fell and in this war the terrible headless trunks arose and moved.405

242.g: ਗਿਰੈ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਭਸੁੰਡੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: girai ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) bhasu(n)dda(n) apaara(n) ||

242.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ਸਮੰਤੰ ਲੁਝਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: rule a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) sama(n)ta(n) lujhaara(n) ||
242.e: The trunks, the heads and the trunks of elephants began to fall, and the chopped limas of the groups of warriors rolled in dust

242.g: ਪਰੀ ਕੂਹ ਜੂਹੰ ਉਠੇ ਗੱਦ ਸੱਦੰ ॥
242.t: paree kooh jooha(n) uThe ga'dh sa'dha(n) ||

242.g: ਜਕੇ ਸੂਰਬੀਰੰ ਛਕੇ ਜਾਣ ਮੱਦੰ ॥੪੦੬॥
242.t: jake soorabeera(n) chhake jaan ma'dha(n) ||406||
242.e: There were terrible and shouts in the battlefield and it appeared tehat having been intoxicated the warriors were swinging.406.

242.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਝੂਮ ਭੂਮੰ ਅਘੂਮੇਤਿ ਘਾਯੰ ॥
242.t: gire jhoom bhooma(n) aghoomet ghaaya(n) ||

242.g: ਉਠੇ ਗੱਦ ਸੱਦੰ ਚੜੇ ਚਉਪ ਚਾਯੰ ॥
242.t: auThe ga'dh sa'dha(n) chaRe chaup chaaya(n) ||
242.e: The wounded groups of warriors are swinging and being bewildered on falling on the earth and with double zeal they are getting up and striking with their maces.

242.g: ਜੁਝੈ ਬੀਰ ਏਕੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
242.t: jujhai beer eka(n) aneka(n) prakaara(n) ||

242.g: ਕਟੇ ਅੰਗ ਜੰਗੰ ਰਟੈਂ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰੰ ॥੪੦੭॥
242.t: kaTe a(n)g ja(n)ga(n) raTai(n) maar maara(n) ||407||
242.e: The warriors have begun the war in many way, the chopped limbs are falling, even then the warriors are shouting “Kill, Kill”.407.

242.g: ਛੁਟੈ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ਉਠੈਂ ਗੱਦ ਸੱਦੰ ॥
242.t: chhuTai baan paana(n) uThai(n) ga'dh sa'dha(n) ||

242.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਝੂਮ ਭੂਮੰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ਬਿਹੱਦੰ ॥
242.t: rule jhoom bhooma(n) su beera(n) biha'dha(n) ||
242.e: A dreadful sound is created with the discharge of arrows and the large-bodies warriors’ fall on the ground while swinging

242.g: ਨਚੇ ਜੰਗ ਰੰਗੰ ਤਤੱਥਈ ਤਤੱਥਿਯੰ ॥
242.t: nache ja(n)g ra(n)ga(n) tata'thiee tata'thiya(n) ||

242.g: ਛੁਟੈ ਬਾਨ ਰਾਜੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਛੂਛ ਹੱਥਿਯੰ ॥੪੦੮॥
242.t: chhuTai baan raajee firai chhoochh ha'thiya(n) ||408||
242.e: All are dancing to the tune of music in the fighting and many are roaming hither and thither, becoming empty-handed with the discharge of arrows.408.

242.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅੰਕੁਸੰ ਬਾਰਣੰ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
242.t: gire a(n)kusa(n) baarana(n) beer kheta(n) ||

242.g: ਨਚੇ ਕੰਧ ਹੀਣੰ ਕਬੰਧੰ ਅਚੇਤੰ ॥
242.t: nache ka(n)dh heena(n) kaba(n)dha(n) acheta(n) ||
242.e: The lances destroying the warriors are falling down and the unconscious headless trunks are dancing in the battlefield

242.g: ਭਰੈਂ ਖੇਚਰੀ ਪੱਤ੍ਰ ਚਉਸਠ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
242.t: bharai(n) khecharee pa'tr chausaTh chaaree ||

242.g: ਚਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਆਨੰਦਿ ਹੁਐ ਮਾਸਹਾਰੀ ॥੪੦੯॥
242.t: chale sarab aana(n)dh huaai maasahaaree ||409||
242.e: The sixty-eight Yoginis have filled their bowls with blood and all the flesh-eaters are roaming with great joy 409.

242.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬੰਕੁੜੇ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੁਦੇਸੰ ॥
242.t: gire ba(n)kuRe beer baajee sudhesa(n) ||

242.g: ਪਰੇ ਪੀਲਵਾਨੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਚਾਰ ਕੇਸੰ ॥
242.t: pare peelavaana(n) chhuTe chaar kesa(n) ||
242.e: The foppish warriors and beautiful horses are falling and on the other side the drivers of elephants are lying down with their disheveled hair.

242.g: ਕਰੈ ਪੈਜ ਵਾਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰੰਤ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
242.t: karai paij vaara(n) prachaara(n)t beera(n) ||

242.g: ਉਠੈ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਧਾਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਹਮੀਰੰ ॥੪੧੦॥
242.t: auThai sronadhaara(n) apaara(n) hameera(n) ||410||
242.e: The brave fighters are striking blows on their enemy with full strength, on account of which there is continuous flow of the blood.410.

242.g: ਛੁਟੈਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰੰਤ ਬਾਣੰ ॥
242.t: chhuTai(n) chaar chitra(n) bachitra(n)t baana(n) ||

242.g: ਚਲੇ ਬੈਠ ਕੈ ਸੂਰਬੀਰੰ ਬਿਮਾਣੰ ॥
242.t: chale baiTh kai soorabeera(n) bimaana(n) ||
242.e: Queer type of arrows, making beautiful paintings, are moving fastly while piercing the bodies and alongwith it the warriors are flying away in the air-vehicles of death.

243.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬਾਰੁਣੰ ਬਿੱਥਰੀ ਲੁੱਥ ਜੁੱਥੰ ॥
243.t: gire baaruna(n) bi'tharee lu'th ju'tha(n) ||

243.g: ਖੁਲੇ ਸੁਰਗ ਦੁਆਰੰ ਗਏ ਵੀਰ ਅਛੁੱਥੰ ॥੪੧੧॥
243.t: khule surag dhuaara(n) ge veer achhu'tha(n) ||411||
243.e: Because of the falling arrows, the clusters of corpses re lying scattered and the gates of haven have opened for the brave warriors.411.

243.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
243.t: dhoharaa ||

243.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਤ ਸੈਨਾ ਭਈ ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਬਿਰੁੱਧ ॥
243.t: eeh bidh hat sainaa bhiee raavan raam biru'dh ||

243.g: ਲੰਕ ਬੰਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਭਯੋ ਦਸਸਿਰ ਮਹਾ ਸਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ॥੪੧੨॥
243.t: la(n)k ba(n)k praapat bhayo dhasasir mahaa sakru'dh ||412||
243.e: In this way, the army opposing Ram was killed and Ravana, sitting in the beautiful citadel of Lanka got highly infuriated.412.

243.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
243.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||

243.g: ਤਬੈ ਮੁੱਕਲੇ ਦੂਤ ਲੰਕੇਸ ਅੱਪੰ ॥
243.t: tabai mu'kale dhoot la(n)kes a'pa(n) ||

243.g: ਮਨੰ ਬਚ ਕਰਮੰ ਸਿਵੰ ਜਾਪ ਜੱਪੰ ॥
243.t: mana(n) bach karama(n) siva(n) jaap ja'pa(n) ||
243.e: Then, remembering the name of Shiva through his mind, speech and action, Ranana, the king of Lanka, sent his messengers to Kumbhkaran.

243.g: ਸਭੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
243.t: sabhai ma(n)tr heena(n) samai a(n)t kaala(n) ||

243.g: ਭਜੋ ਏਕ ਚਿੱਤੰ ਸੁ ਕਾਲੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ॥੪੧੩॥
243.t: bhajo ek chi'ta(n) su kaala(n) kirapaala(n) ||413||
243.e: All of them were without the strength of mantra and knowing about their impending end, they were remembering the one Beneficent Immanent Lord.413.

243.g: ਰਥੀ ਪਾਇਕੰ ਦੰਤ ਪੰਤੀ ਅਨੰਤੰ ॥
243.t: rathee paika(n) dha(n)t pa(n)tee ana(n)ta(n) ||

243.g: ਚਲੇ ਪੱਖਰੇ ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ਸੁ ਭੰਤੰ ॥
243.t: chale pa'khare baaj raaja(n) su bha(n)ta(n) ||
243.e: The warriors on foot, on horses, on elephants and in chariots, wearing their armours, marched forward

243.g: ਧਸੇ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਮੱਝੰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
243.t: dhase naasakaa sron ma'jha(n) su beera(n) ||

243.g: ਬੱਜੇ ਕਾਨ੍ਹਰੇ ਡੰਕ ਡਉਰੂ ਨਫੀਰੰ ॥੪੧੪॥
243.t: ba'je kaanrahare dda(n)k ddauroo nafeera(n) ||414||
243.e: They all penetrated into the nose and of Kumbhkaran and began to play their tabors and other musical instruments.414.

243.g: ਬਜੈ ਲਾਗ ਬਾਦੰ ਨਿਨਾਦੰਤਿ ਵੀਰੰ ॥
243.t: bajai laag baadha(n) ninaadha(n)t veera(n) ||

243.g: ਉਠੈ ਗੱਦ ਸੱਦੰ ਨਿਨੱਦੰ ਨਫੀਰੰ ॥
243.t: auThai ga'dh sa'dha(n) nina'dha(n) nafeera(n) ||
243.e: The warriors played their musical instruments  which resounded at high pitch.

243.g: ਭਏ ਆਕੁਲੰ ਬਿਆਕਲੰ ਛੋਰਿ ਭਾਗਿਅੰ ॥
243.t: bhe aakula(n) biaakala(n) chhor bhaagia(n) ||

243.g: ਬਲੀ ਕੁੰਭਕਾਨੰ ਤਊ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਗਿਅੰ ॥੪੧੫॥
243.t: balee ku(n)bhakaana(n) tuoo naeh jaagia(n) ||415||
243.e: All of them, like children, fled in a state of perplexity, but even then the mighty Kumbhkaran did not awake.415.

243.g: ਚਲੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਆਸ ਪਾਸੰ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ॥
243.t: chale chhaadd kai aas paasa(n) niraasa(n) ||

243.g: ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਕੇ ਜਾਗਬੇ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸੰ ॥
243.t: bhe bhraat ke jaagabe te udhaasa(n) ||
243.e: Finding themselves helpless in not being able to awaken Kumbhkaran, all of them felt disappointed and started going away and become anxious on becoming unsuccessful in their endeavour

243.g: ਤਬੈ ਦੇਵਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਨੰ ॥
243.t: tabai dhevaka(n)niaa kariyo geet gaana(n) ||

243.g: ਉਠਯੋ ਦੇਵ ਦੋਖੀ ਗਦਾ ਲੀਸ ਪਾਨੰ ॥੪੧੬॥
243.t: auThayo dhev dhokhee gadhaa lees paana(n) ||416||
243.e: Then the daughters of gods i.e. Kumbhkaran awoke and took his mace in his hand.416.

243.g: ਕਰੋ ਲੰਕ ਦੇਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰਤਿ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
243.t: karo la(n)k dhesa(n) pravesa(n)t soora(n) ||

243.g: ਬਲੀ ਬੀਸ ਬਾਹੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
243.t: balee bees baaha(n) mahaa sasatr poora(n) ||
243.e: That mighty warrior entered Lanka, where there was the mighty hero Ravana of twenty arms, bedecked with great weapons.

244.e: They all held consultation together and talked to one another about the war.417.
Kumbhkaran used seven thousand metallic pitchers of water to cleanse his face

244.g: ਉਠਯੋ ਲੈ ਗਦਾ ਕੋ ਭਰਯੋ ਵੀਰ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੪੧੮॥
244.t: auThayo lai gadhaa ko bharayo veer maana(n) ||418||
244.e: He ate flesh to his fill and drank wine excessively. After all this that proud warrior got up with his mace and marched forware.418.

244.g: ਤ੍ਰਸੇ ਜੂਥ ਪੈ ਜੂਥ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥
244.t: trase jooth pai jooth jodhaa jujhaara(n) ||
244.e: Seeing him the innumerable army of monkeys fled away and many groups of gods became frightful

244.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਨੰ ਤੱਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪੧੯॥
244.t: firai ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) tana(n) ta'chh teera(n) ||419||
244.e: The terrible shouts of the warriors were heard and the truncated bodies pared by the arrows were seen moving.419.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

244.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਸੁ ਝੁੰਡੰ ਨਿਸਾਨੰ ॥
244.t: firai ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) su jhu(n)dda(n) nisaana(n) ||
244.e: The chopped trunks of the elephants are falling down and the torn banners are swinging hither and thither

244.g: ਉਠੀ ਕੂਹ ਜੂਹੰ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੈਣ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ॥੪੨੦॥
244.t: auThee kooh jooha(n) mile sain krodha(n) ||420||
244.e: The beautiful horses are rolling down and are warriors are sobbing in the battlefield, there is terrible lamination in the whole field.420.
There are fast knocking of the blows, exhibiting the glitter of swords and it seems that the lightning is flashing in the month of Bhason

244.g: ਢਲੀ ਢਾਲ ਮਾਲੰ ਸੁਭੇ ਤੱਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪੨੧॥
244.t: ddalee ddaal maala(n) subhe ta'chh teera(n) ||421||
244.e: The beautiful horses carrying warriors as neighing and the rosary of shields alongwith the sharp shafts look impressive.421.
BIRAAJ STANZA
A terrible war began in order in order to appease the goddess Kali
And the Bhairvas began to shout  the vultures shrieked and the vampires belched.422.
The bowls of Yoginis were being filled and the corpses scattered
The clusters were destroyed and there was tumult all around.423.
The heavenly damsels began to dance and the bugles sounded
, The shouts of “Kill, Kill” and the rustling of arrows were heard.424.
The warriors got entangled with one another and the fighters gushed forward
The tabors and other musical instruments were played in the battlefield.425.
RASAAVAL STANZA
There were blows of arms and the edges of the weapons were sharpened
The warriors repeated the shouts of “kill, kill” and the edge of the spears began to break.426.
There was continuous flow of blood and it also spattered
The flesh-eaters smiled and the jackals drank blood.427.
The beautiful fly-whiskers fell and on one side the defeated warriors ran away

245.e: Then were repetitions of the shouts of “Kill, Kill” on the other side and the horse-riders fell.428.
On one side the horse-riders started moving and altogether made and attack.
They drew out their weapons and began o wage a terrible war.429.
The striking sharp edges of the swords look impressive, the knocking on the shields and
The collision of the swords create sparks, which are being seen by the gods from the sky.430.
He, on whom the warriors attack, they thrust on him the sharp edges of their arms,
The shout of “Kill, Kill” is being raised and the warriors trembling with rage look impressive.431.
The great warriors have fought with one another and the armours are being torn by the arrows
The arrows are being discharged with crackling sound and the tinkling sound is being heard.432.
There is shower of arrows and it appears that the whole world is absorbed in the war
The warriors are knocking their blows in fury over one another and are chopping (the limbs).433.
The fallen shields are being picked up and the forces of the enemy are being torn asunder
The lances are overturning and being used miraculously.434.
Many people are lying down on the earth and many of those fallen down are getting up and
Being absorbed in the war, are excessively knocking and breaking their swords.435.
The warriors are fighting with warriors and are ripping them with their weapons
They are causing the weapons to fall down and inflicting wounds with their arms.436.
On this side the arrows are being discharged and on that side Kumbhkaran is doing his job of destroying the army,
But in the end that brother of Ravana fell down like the tree of saal.437.
Both his legs cracked and from them came out the continuous flow of blood.
Ram saw and shot an arrow, which killed Kumbhkaran.439.
In their joy she gods showered floweres. When Ranvana the king of Lanka,

246.e: Heard this news, he, in great anguish, threw his head on the earth.440.

246.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਕੁੰਭਕਰਨ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
246.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataar ku(n)bhakaran badheh dhayai samaapatam sat ||
246.e: End on the chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Kumbhkaran’ in Ramavtar in BACHHITTAR NATAK
Now begins the description of the war with Trimund :
RASAAVAL STANZA
Now Ravana sent the demon Trimund who marched at the head of the army
That warriors was unique like a portrait and a demon of supreme fury.441.
He shouted “Kill, Kill” and discharged a current of arrows,
With great rage Hanuman stood with a firm foot in the battlefield.442.
Hanuman seized the sword of that demon and with the same he gave a blow on his neck.
That six-eyed demon was killed, seeing whom the gods smiled in the sky.443.

246.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਮੁੰਡ ਬਧਹ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
246.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak raamavataar tiramu(n)dd badheh dhayai samaapatam sat ||
246.e: End on the chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Trimund’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begin the description of the war with the minister Mahodar :
RASAAVAL STANZA
When Ravana heard the news about the destruction of his warriors he held his forehead in extreme anguish.
(In order to forget his agony), he in his pride drank wine.444.
There was sound of the pulling of bows and the arrows were being showered,
The persistent warriors like Mahodar held their swords and stood firmly with forbearance.445.
MOHINI STANZA
The shields sounded like drums and there was being heard the agitated atmosphere of the war
The sound of fifes filled a all the four directions and small cymbals of different colors rang.446.
The kettledrums sounded like the resonance of the group of peacocks on seeing the clouds in the month of Sawan
The armoured horse jumped and the warriors were absorbed in war.447.
The elephants having trunks and tusks got intoxicated and the warriors of frightful whiskers danced
There was movement of all the forces and the gobs saw them from the sky.448.
The blows of very stern warriors are being endured  the fighters are falling in the battlefield and are flowing in the stream of blood
The wounded warriors are wandering circularly and are falling on the earth with downward faces.449.
In great fury they are killing others and are going on killing  the persistent warriors are tightening their weapons smilingly
And being enraged are churning the fighters and are raising the ire of others.450.

247.e: The warriors bedecked with weapons in the war are thundering and the arrows are being showered by repeatedly pulling their bows.
The brave heroes are destroying the forces by striking their weapons and are engaged in continuous fighting.451.
The warriors are being faced and killed and they are falling on the ground with armours and fly-whisks
The brave fighters are moving with their long lances like the Yogis of Raval Panth wearing matted locks.452.
The egoist sword-bearers are showing persistence and the armoured warriors are fighting
The magnificent heroes are exhibiting pride and on their bodies the armours of steel-strips look impressive.453.
The brave fighters are seen writhing, to whom all the gods and men are looking  it seems that the abode of Indra,
Filled with ghosts, fiends and ganas, has become the dwelling place of Shiva  all the people are looking at this scene.454.
There is shower of arrows and the bows are being pulled
People are leaving the city and this scene is being viewed by all.455.
The people are leaving the city very quickly, they are testing their own endurance and

248.e: Are leaving keeping their desire within their hearts.456.
The warriors are entangled among themselves and all are fighting with one another,
Some people are getting delighted and showering their arrows.457.
People who are afraid in their minds, are meditating on Shiva and
Remembering Shiva for their for their protection, they are trembling.458.
As soon as the sound rises, people go into their houses and
The warriors here are falling on the earth, moving like man-lion incarnation.459.
TILKARIYA STANZA
The blows of the swords are causing knocking sounds on the shields and the warriors are saving themselves from the shields
The weapons are being struck and (the warriors) are being killed by making them targets.460.
The heavenly damsels are moving in the battlefield and wedding the warriors, they are seeing the war and the warriors, who are desirous of obtaining them, are getting immensely infuriated.461.
The bowls are being filled with blood, the arms are breaking, the sparks of fire are looking like glow-worms.462.
The warriors are fighting, the armours are breaking, the spears are falling on the shields and the sparks are rising.463.
With the discharge of arrows, the directions have turned, there are blows and the sparks are rising.464.
The Kshatriyas, getting hold of arms in their hands, are fighting, they are discharging arrows and striking with swords.465.
DOHRA

248.g: ਲੁੱਥ ਜੁੱਥ ਬਿੱਥੁਰ ਰਹੀ ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਬਿਰੁੱਧ ॥
248.t: lu'th ju'th bi'thur rahee raavan raam biru'dh ||

248.g: ਹਤਯੋ ਮਹੋਦਰ ਦੇਖ ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਿ ਫਿਰਯੋ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ॥੪੬੬॥
248.t: hatayo mahodhar dhekh kar har ar firayo su kru'dh ||466||
248.e: In this war between Ram and Ravana the clusters of corpses scattered here and there and seeing Mahodar being killed Inderjit (Meghand) marched forward.466.

248.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਮਹੋਦਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
248.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataar mahodhar ma(n)tree badheh dhiaai samaapatam sat ||
248.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Mahodar Mantri’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of war with Inderjit :
SIRKHINDI STANZA
The trumpets sounded and the warriors faced one another and both the armies, prepared for war while thundering
They who performed very difficult tasks, fought with one another and the arrows were discharged like the frightful flying serpents.467.

249.e: The big chained trumpets sounded and the rows of soldiers began to fight with one another, the long-whiskered and tyrannical warriors marched forward

249.g: ਬੱਕੇ ਜਾਣ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਭੰਗਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੬੮॥
249.t: ba'ke jaan matavaale bha(n)gaa khai kai ||468||
249.e: Alongwith them the powerful fighters began to sob on falling in the battlefield.The warriors being intoxicated are shouting like someone shrieking in inebriation after eating hemp. 468
The proud warriors marched forward after causing the resonance of big trumpets and began to strike blows with their swords.

249.g: ਪਾਈ ਧੂੰਮ ਲੁਝਾਰੀ ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਦੀ ॥੪੬੯॥
249.t: paiee dhoo(n)m lujhaaree raavan raam dhee ||469||
249.e: With the shower of arrows a continuous stream of blood flowed and this war of Ram and Ravana became famours on all the four sides.469.
With the sounding of trumpets a terrible war began and the enemies wandered here and there on the fast-moving steeds
There on the sky the heavenly damsels gathered together with the zeal of wedding the brave warriors and came nearer in order to see them waging the war.470.
PAADHARI STANZA
Inderjit in great fury, holding his wide bow, began to discharge arrows
The corpses writhed and the arms of the warriors fluttered  the warriors began to fight and the heavenly damsels were filled with joy.471.
The discs glittered, the lances moved and the fighters with matted hair sped up to fight as if they are going to take a bath in the Ganges.
The wounded warriors were killed and on the other hand the warriors began to shower arrows with fourfold zeal.472.
The frightful warriors entangled in war are showering arrows like poisonous serpents

249.g: ਨਭਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਅਲੋਪ ਸਰ ਬਰਖ ਧਾਰ ॥
249.t: nabh havai alop sar barakh dhaar ||

249.e: With the shower of arrows the sky is not visible and there in no differentiation between high and low.473.
All the warriors specialize in the science of weaponry and locating the general they are showering arrows on them
Even Ram, the king of Raghu clan was beguiled and fell on the earth alongwith his army.474.
Then the messengers went to give the news to Ravana that the forces of monkeys have been defeated

249.g: ਸੀਅ ਭਜਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਹੁਐ ਕੈ ਨਿਚੀਤ ॥
249.t: seea bhajahu aaj huaai kai nicheet ||

249.e: And he could certainly wed Sita on that day because Inderjit has killed ram in the war.475.
Then Ravana called the demoness named Trajata and asked her to show the dead Ram to Sita

249.g: ਲੈ ਗਈ ਨਾਥ ਜਹਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਖੇਤ ॥
249.t: lai giee naath jeh gire khet ||

249.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਜਯੋ ਸੁਪਤ ਅਚੇਤ ॥੪੭੬॥
249.t: mirag maar si(n)gh jayo supat achet ||476||
249.e: She rook away Sita from that place with her tantric power to the place where ram was sleeping in unconscious state like a lion after killing the deer.476.

249.g: ਸੀਅ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਾਥ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਸਾਨ ॥
249.t: seea nirakh naath man meh risaan ||

249.e: Seeing Ram in such a state, the mind of Sita was filled with extreme agony because Ram was the store-house of fourteen arts and it was impossible to make her believe in such an event

249.g: ਪਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਜਯਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਭਯੋ ਹੁਲਾਸ ॥੪੭੭॥
249.t: pat bhraat jayai chit bhayo hulaas ||477||
249.e: Sita went near Ram reciting Nagmantra and reviving both Ram and Lakshman her mind was filled with joy.477.

249.g: ਦਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਜੁਤ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ॥
249.t: dhal sahit bhraat jut dharam dhaam ||
249.e: When Sita went back, Ram woke up alongwith his brother and forces.

249.g: ਬੱਜੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਦਿ ਗੱਜੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
249.t: ba'je su naadh ga'je su beer ||

249.e: The brave fighters thundered bedecking themselves with weapons and the great warriors with power of endurance began to run away from the battlefield.478.
The warriors with frightful prowess began to shower arrows in the war and being highly infuriated began to destroy even the trees

249.g: ਤਜਿ ਜੁੱਧ ਸੁੱਧ ਸੁਰ ਮੇਘ ਧਰਣ ॥
249.t: taj ju'dh su'dh sur megh dharan ||

250.e: At this time Inderjit Mehgnad forsook the war-arena and returned to perform the Hom Yajna (Sacrifice).479.

250.g: ਇਮ ਕਹੈ ਬੈਣ ਤਜ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਕਾਨ ॥
250.t: eim kahai bain taj bhraat kaan ||
250.e: Coming near the younger brother Vibhishan said that,

250.g: ਆਇ ਹੈ ਸੱਤ੍ਰੁ ਇਹ ਘਾਤ ਹਾਥ ॥
250.t: aai hai sa'tr ieh ghaat haath ||

250.e: At that time his supreme enemy and the mighty warrior Inderjit is wwithing your ambush.480.

250.g: ਨਿਜ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਟ ਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਮ ॥
250.t: nij maas kaaT kar karat hom ||

250.e: He is performing havana (sacrifice) by chopping his flesh, with which the whole earth is trembling and the sky is wondering.

250.g: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਧਨੁਖ ਕਟ ਕਸਿ ਨਿਖੰਗ ॥੪੮੧॥
250.t: kar dhare dhanukh kaT kas nikha(n)g ||481||
250.e: Hearing this, Lakshman went there fearlessly with bow in his hand and quiver tied to his back.481.
Inderjit began to recite for the manifestation of the goddess and Lakshman discharged his arrows and killed Inderjit into two halves.
Lakshman returned with his forces, playing on the drum and on the other side the demons ran away on seeing their general dead.482.

250.g: ਇਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਜੀਤ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
250.t: eit i(n)dhrajeet badheh dhiaai samaapatam sat ||
250.e: End of the chapter entitled “The Killing of Inderjit’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of the war with the demon Atkaaye :
The demon-king in great fury, began the war,
Calling his innumerable warriors, full of resentment and very wrathful.483.
Very swift-moving horses were brought who jumped hither and thither like and actor
Taking out their frightening weapons, the warriors began to fight with one another.484.

251.e: On this side, the warriors in the army of Ram, started fighting in great rage
The foolish Makrachh thundered, carrying his new banner.485.
There was one demon named Atkaaye in the demon forces who rushed with serious fury
Many warriors confronted him and began to fight with discriminating intellect.486.
There was huge shower of arrows which fell like rain-drops
The army looked like locusts and array of ants.487.
The warriors reached near Atkaaye in order to see him fighting.
The gods hailed him and the king uttered “Bravo, Bravo!”.488.
The terrible goddess Kali began to shout and great number of Yoginis roamed in the battlefield.
Innumerable Bhairvas and ghosts began to drink blood.489.
The tabors of vampires sounded and the inauspicious crows began to caw
On all the four sides there were heard and seen shrieks of vultures and leapings and hopping of ghosts and fiends.490.
The warriors felt weakness and then regained strength and in rage caught hold of their swords.491.
Seeing the discharge of arrows the clouds wondered  because of the arrows all the sides were hindered.492.
The arrows are being discharged in fury and the warriors are falling on the earth like the earth like the effacement of the through ones.493.
The frightened warriors, while wandering, are being wounded and great heroes are flying fast.494.
They are reciting the name of Shiva in order to kill the enemies with jealousy in their mind and they are tighting in the field wandering with fear.495.
The people are getting delighted with the falling of demons on the earth

252.e: The arrows are penetrating into the demons and the warriors are being crushed.496.
The wounded warriors are wandering and writhing in the battlefield
They are feeling shy in being entrapped, having been girdled.497.
The throbbing of the hearts continues, the arrows are being discharged intermittently and the directions are being hindered.498.
CHHAPAI STANZA

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਆਰੁਹੇ ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕਨ ਕਹੱ ਤੱਕੈ ॥
252.t: ei'k i'k aaruhe i'k i'kan kaha' ta'kai ||
252.e: The warriors excelling one another are coming and looking at each other one by one

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਇੱਕ ਕਹ ਇੱਕ ਉਚੱਕੈ ॥
252.t: ei'k i'k lai chalai i'k keh i'k ucha'kai ||
252.e: They are moving with each one and are being startle by each one

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਸਰ ਬਰਖ ਇੱਕ ਧਨ ਕਰਖ ਰੋਸ ਭਰ ॥
252.t: ei'k i'k sar barakh i'k dhan karakh ros bhar ||
252.e: On one side they are discharging arrows and on the other they are pulling their bows in rage

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਤਰਫੰਤ ਇੱਕ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ਗਏ ਤਰਿ ॥
252.t: ei'k i'k tarafa(n)t i'k bhav si(n)dh ge tar ||
252.e: On one side the fighters are writing and on the other side the dead ones are ferrying across the world-ocean

252.g: ਰਣਿ ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਭਿੜੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਹੁਐ ਬਿੱਝੜੇ ॥
252.t: ran i'k i'k saava(n)t bhiRai(n) i'k i'k huaai bi'jhaRe ||
252.e: The warriors excelling one another have fought and died

252.g: ਨਰ ਇੱਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਣ ਭਿੜੇ ਇੱਕ ਇੱਕ ਅਵਝੜ ਝੜੇ ॥੪੯੯॥
252.t: nar i'k anik sasatran bhiRe i'k i'k avajhaR jhaRe ||499||
252.e: All the warriors are alike, but the weapons are many and these weapons are striking blows on the soldiers like rain.499.

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਜੂਝ ਭਟ ਗਿਰੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਬਬਕੰਤ ਮੱਧ ਰਣ ॥
252.t: ei'k joojh bhaT girai(n) i'k babaka(n)t ma'dh ran ||
252.e: On one side the warriors have fallen and on the other they are shouting

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਦੇਵਪੁਰ ਬਸੈ ਇੱਕ ਭਜ ਚਲਤ ਖਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਣ ॥
252.t: ei'k dhevapur basai i'k bhaj chalat khai bran ||
252.e: On one side they have entered the city of gods and on the other, having been wounded, they have sped away

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਜੁੱਝ ਉੱਝੜੇ ਇੱਕ ਮੁਕਤੰਤ ਬਾਨ ਕਸਿ ॥
252.t: ei'k ju'jh u'jhaRe i'k mukata(n)t baan kas ||
252.e: Some are fighting in the war firmly and on the other side they are falling down having been chopped like trees

252.g: ਇੱਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਣ ਝਲੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਮੁਕਤੰਤ ਬਾਨ ਕਸਿ ॥
252.t: ei'k anik bran jhalai(n) i'k mukata(n)t baan kas ||
252.e: On one side many wounded are being endured and on the other the arrows are being discharged with full strength

252.g: ਰਣ ਭੂੰਮ ਘੂਮ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਮੰਡੈ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਾਇ ਲਛਮਣ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ॥
252.t: ran bhoo(n)m ghoom saava(n)t ma(n)ddai dheeragh kai lachhaman prabal ||
252.e: Diraghkaya and Lakshman have wounded and created such a situation in the battlefield,

252.g: ਥਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਉਪਵਨ ਕਿਧੋ ਉੱਤਰ ਦਿਸ ਦੁਐ ਅਚਲ ॥੫੦੦॥
252.t: thir rahe birachh upavan kidho u'tar dhis dhuaai achal ||500||
252.e: As if they are large trees in a forest or eternal and immovable pole-stars in the north.500.
AJBA STANZA
The warriors fought, the arrows were discharged, there was knocking on the shields and the death-like warriors were infuriated.501.
The drums sounded, the blows of the swords were heard and the weapons and arrows were struck.502.
Highly infuriated and with great understanding, the forces are being mashed, the warriors are thundering and showering arrows.503.
The warriors with red eyes are shouting, having been intoxicated they are fighting and the heavenly damsels are looking at them.504.
Having been pierced by arrows, the warriors are fleeing and (some) are fighting with arms, being highly enraged.505.
The warriors are swinging and the heavenly damsels, while wandering, are looking at them and are wondering on listening to their shouts of “Kill, Kill”.506.

253.e: The weapons, coming into contact with armours, are piercing the bodies
The spars are breaking and the sparks of fire are coming out from them.507.
The horses are dancing and the warriors are thundering
They are falling while discharging the arrows.508.
Seeing the heavenly damsels moving, the warriors are swinging and, being intoxicated, are discharging arrows.509.
In this way, the war ensued and many warriors fell in the field
On one side there is Lakshman, brother of Ram and on the other there is the demon Atkaaye and both these princes are fighting with each other.510.

253.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਅਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਰੋਸ ॥
253.t: tab raam bhraat at keen ros ||

253.g: ਜਿਮ ਪਰਤ ਅਗਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਤ ਜੋਸ ॥
253.t: jim parat agan ghirat karat jos ||
253.e: Then Lakshman became highly infuriated and increased it with zeal like the fire blazing fiercely when the ghee is poured over it
He discharged the scorching arrows like the terrible sunrays of eh month of Jyestha.511.

253.g: ਬਰਣੈ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਏਕ ॥
253.t: baranai na jaeh keh ek ek ||
253.e: Getting himself wounded he discharged so many arrows which are indescribable
These brave fighters are absorbed in fight and on the other hand, the gods are raising the sound of victory.512.
