276.g: ਕੁਸਾ ਹਾਥ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਰਚਯੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਲੰ ॥
276.t: kusaa haath lai kai rachayo ek baala(n) ||

276.g: ਤਿਸੀ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੰ ਅਨੂਪੰ ਉਤਾਲੰ ॥੭੨੭॥
276.t: tisee roop ra(n)ga(n) anoopa(n) utaala(n) ||727||
276.e: He created another boy quickly of the same colour and form like the first boy out of the Kusha grass held by him in his hand.727.

276.g: ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾਇ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਖਯੋ ॥
276.t: firee nai seetaa kahaa aan dhekhayo ||

276.g: ਉਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਬਾਲੰ ਸੁਪਾਲੰ ਬਸੇਖਯੋ ॥
276.t: auhee roop baala(n) supaala(n) basekhayo ||
276.e: When Sita came back, she saw another boy of the same form seated there  Sita said :

276.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੋਨ ਰਾਜੰ ਘਨੀ ਜਾਨ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
276.t: kirapaa mon raaja(n) ghanee jaan keeno ||

276.g: ਦੁਤੀ ਪੁੱਤ੍ਰ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਾਨ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੭੨੮॥
276.t: dhutee pu'tr taa te kirapaa jaan dheeno ||728||
276.e: “O great sage, you had been highly graceful towards me and given me she gift of two sons gracefully.”728.

276.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਉਤਪੰਨੇ ਧਯਾਇ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੧॥
276.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataar dhui putr utapa(n)ne dhayai dhayai samaapata(n) ||21||
276.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘The Birth of two Sons’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.21.

276.g: ਅਥ ਜਗ੍ਰਯ੍ਰਯਾਰੰਭ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
276.t: ath jagrayrayaara(n)bh kathana(n) ||

276.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
276.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
276.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

276.g: ਉਤੈ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਇਤੈ ਅਉਧ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
276.t: autai baal paalai itai aaudh raaja(n) ||

276.g: ਬੁਲੇ ਬਿੱਪ ਜਗਯੰ ਤਜਯੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਜੰ ॥
276.t: bule bi'p jagaya(n) tajayo ek baaja(n) ||
276.e: On that side the boys were brought up and on this side Ram, the king of Avadh called the Brahmins and performed a Yajna

276.g: ਰਿਪੰ ਨਾਸ ਹੰਤਾ ਦਯੋ ਸੰਗ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
276.t: ripa(n) naas ha(n)taa dhayo sa(n)g taa kai ||

276.g: ਬਡੀ ਫਉਜ ਲੀਨੇ ਚਲਯੋ ਸੰਗ ਵਾ ਕੈ ॥੭੨੯॥
276.t: baddee fauj leene chalayo sa(n)g vaa kai ||729||
276.e: And for this purpose he let off a horse, Shatrughan went with that horse with a huge army.729.

276.g: ਫਿਰਯੋ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੰ ਨਰੇਸਾਣ ਬਾਜੰ ॥
276.t: firayo dhes dhesa(n) naresaan baaja(n) ||

276.g: ਕਿਨੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਾਧਯੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਨ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
276.t: kinee naeh baadhayo mile aan raaja(n) ||
276.e: That horse reached in the territories of various kings, but none of them tied it

276.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਧਨਿਯਾ ਬਡੀ ਫਉਜ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
276.t: mahaa ugr dhaniyaa baddee fauj lai kai ||

276.g: ਪਰੇ ਆਨ ਪਾਯੰ ਬਡੀ ਭੇਟ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥੭੩੦॥
276.t: pare aan paaya(n) baddee bheT dhai kai ||730||
276.e: The great kings alongwith their great forces fell at the feet of Shatrughan with presence.730.

276.g: ਦਿਸਾ ਚਾਰ ਜੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਯੋ ਫੇਰਿ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
276.t: dhisaa chaar jeetee firayo fer baajee ||

276.g: ਗਯੋ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੰ ਰਿਖਿਸਥਾਨ ਤਾਜੀ ॥
276.t: gayo baalameeka(n) rikhisathaan taajee ||
276.e: Wandering in the four direction the horse also reached the hermitage of the sage Valmiki

276.g: ਜਬੈ ਭਾਲ ਪਤ੍ਰੰ ਲਵੰ ਛੋਰ ਬਾਚਯੋ ॥
276.t: jabai bhaal patra(n) lava(n) chhor baachayo ||

276.g: ਬਡੋ ਉਗ੍ਰਧੰਨਯਾ ਰਸੰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰਾਚਯੋ ॥੭੩੧॥
276.t: baddo ugradha(n)nayaa rasa(n) rudhr raachayo ||731||
276.e: Where Lava and his companions read the letter written on the head of the horse, they in great fury looked like Rudra.731.

276.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਛੰ ਬਾਜ ਬਾਧਯੋ ਲਖਯੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
276.t: birachha(n) baaj baadhayo lakhayo sasatr dhaaree ||

276.g: ਬਡੋ ਨਾਦ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
276.t: baddo naadh kai sarab sainaa pukaaree ||
276.e: They tied the horse with a tree and the whole army of Shatrughan saw it, the warriors of the army shouted :

276.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਲੀਨੇ ਤੁਰੰਗੰ ॥
276.t: kahaa jaat re baal leene tura(n)ga(n) ||

276.g: ਤਜੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਸਜੋ ਆਨ ਜੰਗੰ ॥੭੩੨॥
276.t: tajo naeh yaa ko sajo aan ja(n)ga(n) ||732||
276.e: “O boy! where are you taking this horse? Either leave it or wage a war with us. “732.

276.g: ਸੁਣਯੋ ਨਾਮ ਜੁੱਧੰ ਜਬੈ ਸ੍ਰਉਣ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
276.t: sunayo naam ju'dha(n) jabai sraun soora(n) ||

276.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਉਡੀ ਮਹਾ ਲੋਹ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
276.t: mahaa sasatr sauddee mahaa loh poora(n) ||
276.e: When those weapon-wielders heard the name of war, they showered arrows extensively

276.g: ਹਠੇ ਬੀਰ ਹਾਠੈ ਸਭੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
276.t: haThe beer haaThai sabhai sasatr lai kai ||

276.g: ਪਰਯੋ ਮੱਧਿ ਸੈਣੰ ਬਡੋ ਨਾਦਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥੭੩੩॥
276.t: parayo ma'dh saina(n) baddo naadh kai kai ||733||
276.e: All the warriors began to fight with persistence, holding their weapons, and here Lava jumped into the army raising a frightening thundering sound.733.

276.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਮਾਰੈ ਪਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
276.t: bhalee bhaat maarai pachaare su soora(n) ||

276.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੋਧਾ ਰਹੀ ਧੂਰ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
276.t: gire ju'dh jodhaa rahee dhoor poora(n) ||
276.e: Many warriors were killed, they fell down on the earth and the dust arose on all the four sides

276.g: ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰਤ ਵੀਰੰ ॥
276.t: auThee sasatr jhaara(n) apaara(n)t veera(n) ||

276.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਤਨੰ ਤੱਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੭੩੪॥
276.t: bhrame ru(n)dd mu(n)dd tana(n) ta'chh teera(n) ||734||
276.e: The warriors began to shower blows of their weapons and the trunks and heads of the warriors began to fly hither and thither.734.

276.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਲੁੱਥ ਪੱਥੰ ਸੁ ਜੁੱਥਤ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
276.t: gire lu'th pa'tha(n) su ju'that baajee ||

276.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਛੂਛ ਹਾਥੀ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਆਰ ਤਾਜੀ ॥
276.t: bhramai chhoochh haathee binaa suaar taajee ||
276.e: The path was filled with the corpses of the horses and the elephants,

276.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਬਿਅੱਸਤ੍ਰੰਤ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
276.t: gire sasatr heena(n) bia'satra(n)t soora(n) ||

276.g: ਹਸੇ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ਭ੍ਰਮੀ ਗੈਣ ਹੂਰੰ ॥੭੩੫॥
276.t: hase bhoot preta(n) bhramee gain hoora(n) ||735||
276.e: And horses began to run without drivers, the warriors fell being deprived of weapons and the ghosts, fiends and the heavenly damsels began to wander smilingly.735.

276.g: ਘਣੰ ਘੋਰ ਨੀਸਾਣ ਬੱਜੇ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
276.t: ghana(n) ghor neesaan ba'je apaara(n) ||

277.g: ਖਹੇ ਵੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥
277.t: khahe veer dheera(n) uThee sasatr jhaara(n) ||
277.e: The trumpets resounded violently, the warriors began to fight and the blows of weapons were showered
The arrows were discharged creating wondrous type of paintings and the mighty warriors moved in the battlefield being highly infuriated.736.
The sword arose, seemed, danced and was struck.737.
An illusion was created  the sword was shown again and the blow was struck tremblingly.738.
The swords were drawn, the warriors challenged and the blows wre struck with spears.740.
The warriors were raised, caused to fall and run and shown the way . 741.

278.e: The warriors were discharged, endured and the warriors were made fearful.742.

278.g: ਇਤਿ ਲਵ ਬਾਧਵੋ ਸਤ੍ਰੁਘਣ ਬਧਹਿ ਸਮਾਪਤ ॥
278.t: eit lav baadhavo satrughan badheh samaapat ||

278.e: When the arrows struck, then all ran away  the generals were killed and the warriors ran hither and thither.743.
Leaving their horses, they ran towards Ram and lamenting in various ways, they had no courage to come face to face.744.
(The soldiers said to Ram :) “Lava, killing the enemies, has defeated your army
Those two boys are fearlessly waging the war and have gained victory,”745.
Ram asked Lakshman to take a huge army and sent him
He said to him, “Do not kill those boys, but catch hold of them and show them to me.”746.
Hearing the words of Raghuvir, Lakshman started, decorating his forces and sharing the waters and the planes.747.
The sky was filled with dust because of the movement of army, all the soldiers rushed forth from all the four directions and began to remember the name of the Lord.748.
The staggering soldiers began to shower arrows, the banners waved and the arms fought with one another.749.
Coming near smilingly they shouted loudly, “O boys! forsake your persistence quickly.”750.

278.g: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤਯਾਗਤ ਬਾਜ ਬਰ ਸੁਣਿ ਲਛਮਨਾ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
278.t: ham nahee tayaagat baaj bar sun lachhamanaa kumaar ||

278.g: ਅਪਨੋ ਭਰ ਬਲ ਜੁੱਧ ਕਰ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਸੰਕ ਬਿਸਾਰ ॥੭੫੧॥
278.t: apano bhar bal ju'dh kar ab hee sa(n)k bisaar ||751||
278.e: The boys said, “O Lakshman! we shall not unfasten the horse, abandoning all your doubts you come forward to fight with all your might.”751.
Catching hold of his very huge bow Lakshman thundering like clouds, showered a volley of arrows.752.

279.e: From the other side the gods are seeing the war and the sound of “Bravo, Bravo” is being heard. On this side the arrows are being discharged and bits of flesh are being chopped.753.
The warriors are thundering, the drums are resounding, the arrows are being discharge, but still they are not retreating from the war-arena.754.
The speech of Lakshman addressed to the boys :
“O boys! listen and do not wage the war, meet me while bringing the horse, because you have inadequate strength.755.
“Come after forsaking your persistence and do not confront me, have no fear, come and meet me.”756.
The boys did not agree because they were proud their strength, they caught hold of their bows and roared and did not retrace even two steps.757.
Both the brother were absorbed in war and showering their arrows, they tested the strength of the soldiers.758.
The warriors fell in the battlefield being chopped into bits, and the limbs of the fighting soldiers were cut.759.
The pools of blood waved with the shower of arrows
Many enemies were killed and many were filled with fear.760.
The superb warriors began to fall in the battlefield while swinging
The wounds on the bodies were inflicted but still there was no dearth of zeal in them.761.
The number of died is unaccountable, how many of them were killed and how many of them were defeated.762.
Feeling ashamed in their mind all ran away and absorbed in fear they went away, saving their lives.763.

280.e: Those who returned, were killed, many were wounded and many fled away.764.
The boys were victorious and the warriors were frightened, they being highly infuriated waged the war.765.
Both the brothers who were specialists in swordsmanship, in great fury were engrossed in great war.766.
They pulled their bows and discharged the armour and seeing these warriors absorbed in a terrible war, the clusters of forces fled away.767.
After getting their limbs chopped, the warriors fled away and the remaining ones fought in the war.768.
The army, being confounded, fled away, then Laksman retuned with composure.769.

281.e: Lava, stretching his bow, discharge and arrow toward the enemy, which struck Lakshman on the forehead and he fell like a tree.770.
End of the chapter entitled ‘Killing of Lakshman’ in Ramvtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
AROOHAA STANZA

281.g: ਭਾਗ ਗਯੋ ਦਲ ਤ੍ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
281.t: bhaag gayo dhal traam kai kai ||

281.e: Making a sacrifice of Lakshman in the war, his army, being frightened fled away
Te warriors reached the place where Ram was standing.771.
When all the events were related to him, he was in great anguish
Hearing their word the mighty sovereign remained silent like a portrait, becoming like a stone-slab.772.
Then sitting down, he held consultations and addressing Bharat, he asked him to go, saying,
“Do not kill the boys of the sages, but bring them and show them to me.”773.
Bharat decorating his army marched to the place where the boys were standing ready (for war)
They were ready to kill the warriors by striking blows with many types of arrows.774.
Alongwith Sugriva, Vibhishan, Hanuman, Angad, Jambvant,
And with their various types of forces, Bharat went forward towards the brave boys.775.
When Bharat reached the battlefield, he saw both the boys of sages
Both boys looked impressive and both the gods and demons were allured on seeing them.776.
Speech of Bharat addressed to Lava :
AKRAA STANZA
“O boys of the sages! forsake your pride, come and meet me
“I shall dress you and take you to (Raghava) Ram.”777.
Hearing these words the boys were filled with pride and being enraged they pulled their bows
They discharged many arrows like the clouds of the month of Sawan.778.
Those, whom those arrows struck, fell down and overturned
Somewhere those arrows chopped the limbs and somewhere they penetrated through the fly-whisk and armour.779.
Somewhere they created portraits on coming out of the beautiful bows and somewhere they pierced the limbs of the warriors
Somewhere the wound of the limbs burst open and somewhere the stream of blood overflowed.780.

282.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਭਕੰਤ ॥
282.t: kahoo(n) bhoot pret bhaka(n)t ||

282.g: ਸੁ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਮੱਧ ਉਠੰਤ ॥
282.t: s kahoo(n) kama'dh uTha(n)t ||
282.e: Somewhere the ghosts and fiends shouted and somewhere the headless trunks began to rise in the battlefield

282.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਚ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਾਲ ॥
282.t: kahoo(n) naach beer baitaal ||

282.g: ਸੋ ਬਮਤ ਡਾਕਣਿ ਜੁਆਲ ॥੭੮੧॥
282.t: so bamat ddaakan juaal ||781||
282.e: Somewhere the brave Baitals danced and somewhere the Vampires raised flames of fire.781.

282.g: ਰਣ ਘਾਇ ਘਾਏ ਵੀਰ ॥
282.t: ran ghai ghaae veer ||

282.g: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਭੀਗੇ ਚੀਰ ॥
282.t: sabh sron bheege cheer ||
282.e: The garments of warriors were saturated with blood, on being wounded in the battlefield

282.g: ਇਕ ਬੀਰ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੰਤ ॥
282.t: eik beer bhaaj chala(n)t ||

282.g: ਇਕ ਆਨ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੁਟੰਤ ॥੭੮੨॥
282.t: eik aan ju'dh juTa(n)t ||782||
282.e: On one side the warriors are running away and on the other side they are coming and fighting in the war.782.

282.g: ਇਕ ਐਂਚ ਐਂਚ ਕਮਾਨ ॥
282.t: eik aai(n)ch aai(n)ch kamaan ||

282.g: ਤਕ ਵੀਰ ਮਾਰਤ ਬਾਨ ॥
282.t: tak veer maarat baan ||
282.e: On one side, the warriors are stretching their bows and discharging arrows

282.g: ਇਕ ਭਾਜ ਭਾਜ ਮਰੰਤ ॥
282.t: eik bhaaj bhaaj mara(n)t ||

282.g: ਨਹੀ ਸੁਰਗ ਤਉਨ ਬਸੰਤ ॥੭੮੩॥
282.t: nahee surag taun basa(n)t ||783||
282.e: On the other side they are running away and brathing their last, but not getting a place in the heaven.783.

282.g: ਗਜ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
282.t: gaj raaj baaj anek ||

282.g: ਜੁੱਝੇ ਨ ਬਾਚਾ ਏਕ ॥
282.t: ju'jhe na baachaa ek ||
282.e: Many elephants and horses died and not even one was saved

282.g: ਤਬ ਆਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਨਾਥ ॥
282.t: tab aan la(n)kaa naath ||

282.g: ਜੁੱਝਯੋ ਸਿਸਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੭੮੪॥
282.t: ju'jhayo sisan ke saath ||784||
282.e: Then Vibhishan, the Lord of Lanka, fought with the boys.784.

282.g: ਬਹੋੜਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
282.t: bahoRaa chha(n)dh ||
282.e: BAHORA STANZA

282.g: ਲੰਕੇਸ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਮੋ ਤਕ ਬਾਨ ॥
282.t: la(n)kes ke ur mo tak baan ||

282.g: ਮਾਰਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਸਤ ਜਿ ਕਾਨ ॥
282.t: maarayo raam sisat j kaan ||
282.e: The sons of Ram pulling their bows shot an arrow in the heart of the king of Lanka

282.g: ਤਬ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਦਾਨਵ ਸੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਮੱਧ ॥
282.t: tab girayo dhaanav su bhoom ma'dh ||

282.g: ਤਿਹ ਬਿਸੁਧ ਜਾਣ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਯੋ ਬੱਧ ॥੭੮੫॥
282.t: teh bisudh jaan nahee keeyo ba'dh ||785||
282.e: That demon fell down on the earth and considering him unconscious, the boys did not kill him.785.

282.g: ਤਬ ਰੁਕਯੋ ਤਾਸ ਸੁਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਆਨ ॥
282.t: tab rukayo taas sugreev aan ||

282.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਪੈਸ ਜਾਨ ॥
282.t: kahaa jaat baal nahee pais jaan ||
282.e: Then Sugriva came and stopped there and said, “O boys! where are you going? You cannot get away and remain safe.”

282.g: ਤਬ ਹਣਯੋ ਬਾਣ ਤਿਹ ਭਾਲ ਤੱਕ ॥
282.t: tab hanayo baan teh bhaal ta'k ||

282.g: ਤਿਹ ਲਗਯੋ ਭਾਲ ਮੋ ਰਹਯੋ ਚੱਕ ॥੭੮੬॥
282.t: teh lagayo bhaal mo rahayo cha'k ||786||
282.e: Then the boys of the sage made a target of his forehead and shot his arrow which struck his forehead and feeling the sharpness of the arrow, he became actionless.786.

282.g: ਚਪ ਚਲੀ ਸੈਣ ਕਪਣੀ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ॥
282.t: chap chalee sain kapanee su kru'dh ||

282.g: ਨਲ ਨੀਲ ਹਨੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੁ ਜੁੱਧ ॥
282.t: nal neel hanoo a(n)gadh su ju'dh ||
282.e: On seeing this the whole army was pressed and in great fury, they began to fight alongwith Nal, Neel, Hanuman and Angad

282.g: ਤਬ ਤੀਨ ਤੀਨ ਲੈ ਬਾਲ ਬਾਨ ॥
282.t: tab teen teen lai baal baan ||

282.g: ਤਿਹ ਹਣੋ ਭਾਲ ਮੋ ਰੋਸ ਠਾਨ ॥੭੮੭॥
282.t: teh hano bhaal mo ros Thaan ||787||
282.e: Then the boys took three arrows each and shot them on the foreheads of all.787.

282.g: ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੂਰ ਸੋ ਰਹੇ ਖੇਤ ॥
282.t: jo ge soor so rahe khet ||

282.g: ਜੋ ਬਚੇ ਭਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੁਇ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
282.t: jo bache bhaaj te hui achet ||
282.e: Those who remained in the field, they embraced death an those who survived lost their senses and ran away

282.g: ਤਬ ਤਕਿ ਤਕਿ ਸਿਸ ਕੱਸਿ ਬਾਣ ॥
282.t: tab tak tak sis ka's baan ||

282.g: ਦਲ ਹਤਯੋ ਰਾਘਵੀ ਤੱਜਿ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੭੮੮॥
282.t: dhal hatayo raaghavee ta'j kaan ||788||
282.e: Then those boys tightly shot their arrows on their arrows on their targets and destroyed fearlessly the forces of Ram.788.

282.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
282.t: anoop naraaj chha(n)dh ||
282.e: ANOOP NIRAAJ STANZA

282.g: ਸੁ ਕੋਪਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬਲੰ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਰਾਘਵੀ ਸਿਸੰ ॥
282.t: s kop dhekh kai bala(n) su kru'dh raaghavee sisa(n) ||

282.g: ਬਚਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਚਿੱਤ੍ਰਤ ਸਰੰ ਬਬਰਖ ਬਰਖਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
282.t: bachi'tr chi'trat sara(n) babarakh barakhano rana(n) ||
282.e: Seeing the strength and rage of the boys (sons) of Ram and visualizing that volley of arrows in that wonderful type of war,

282.g: ਭਭੱਜਿ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਤੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੇਕਰੀ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
282.t: bhabha'j aasuree suta(n) uTha(n)t bhekaree dhuna(n) ||

282.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਕੁੰਡਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਪਪੀੜ ਦਾਰਣੰ ਸਰੰ ॥੭੮੯॥
282.t: bhrama(n)t ku(n)ddalee kirata(n) papeeR dhaarana(n) sara(n) ||789||
282.e: The army of demons, raising terrible sound, fled away and wandered circularly.789.

282.g: ਘੁਮੰਤ ਘਾਇਲੋ ਘਣੰ ਤਤੱਛ ਬਾਣਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥
282.t: ghuma(n)t ghailo ghana(n) tata'chh baanano bara(n) ||

282.g: ਭਭੱਜ ਕਾਤਰੋ ਕਿਤੰ ਗਜੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਜੁੱਧੰ ॥
282.t: bhabha'j kaataro kita(n) gaja(n)t jodhano ju'dha(n) ||
282.e: Many wounded warriors after being shot by sharp arrows began to wander and many warriors began to wander and many warriors began to roar and many of them becoming helpless breathed their last

282.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਤੀਛਣੋ ਅਸੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਧਾਰ ਉੱਜਲੰ ॥
282.t: chala(n)t teechhano asa(n) khima(n)t dhaar u'jala(n) ||

282.g: ਪਪਾਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਕੇਸਰੀ ਹਨੂ ਵ ਸੁਗ੍ਰਿਵੰ ਬਲੰ ॥੭੯੦॥
282.t: papaat a(n)gadh kesaree hanoo v sugirava(n) bala(n) ||790||
282.e: The sharp sword of white edges were struck in the battlefield, the strength of Angad, Hanuman, Sugriva etc. began to wean away.790.

282.g: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਆਮੁਰੰ ਰਣੰ ਭਭਰਮ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸਿਸੰ ॥
282.t: gira(n)t aamura(n) rana(n) bhabharam aasuree sisa(n) ||

282.g: ਤਜੰਤ ਸੁਆਮਣੋ ਘਰੰ ਭਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਲੇ ਭਟੰ ॥
282.t: taja(n)t suaamano ghara(n) bhaja(n)t praan le bhaTa(n) ||

282.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧਣੋ ਕਬੰਧ ਬੰਧਤੰ ਕਟੰ ॥
282.t: auTha(n)t a(n)dh dhu(n)dhano kaba(n)dh ba(n)dhata(n) kaTa(n) ||

282.g: ਲਗੰਤ ਬਾਣਾਣੋ ਬਰੰ ਗਿਰੰਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਹਵਯੰ ॥੭੯੧॥
282.t: laga(n)t baanaano bara(n) gira(n)t bhoom ahavaya(n) ||791||

282.g: ਪਪਾਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਛਣੰ ਧਰੰ ਬਬੇਗ ਮਾਰ ਤੁੱਜਣੰ ॥
282.t: papaat birachhana(n) dhara(n) babeg maar tu'jana(n) ||

282.g: ਭਰੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਭੂਰਣੰ ਬਮੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤੰ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
282.t: bhara(n)t dhoor bhoorana(n) bama(n)t sronata(n) mukha(n) ||
282.e: The warriors being shot by arrows quickly began to fall on the earth, the dust clung to their bodies and the blood oozed out from their mouths

283.g: ਚਿਕਾਰ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਨਭੰ ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਰੀ ਫਿਰੰ ॥
283.t: chikaar chaavaddee nabha(n) fika(n)t fi(n)karee fira(n) ||

283.g: ਭਕਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਣੰ ਡਿਕਾਰ ਡਾਕਣੀ ਡੁਲੰ ॥੭੯੨॥
283.t: bhakaar bhoot pretana(n) ddikaar ddaakanee ddula(n) ||792||
283.e: The vultures shrieked and roamed circularly in the sky , the ghosts and fiends began to shout in the battlefield and the vampires roamed while belching. 792.

283.g: ਗਿਰੈ ਧਰੰ ਧੁਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਰਾ ਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਜਿਵੰ ॥
283.t: girai dhara(n) dhura(n) dhara(n) dharaa dhara(n) dhara(n) jiva(n) ||

283.g: ਭਭੱਜਿ ਸ੍ਰਉਣਤੰ ਤਣੈ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੈ ਕਰੀ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
283.t: bhabha'j sraunata(n) tanai uTha(n)t bhai karee dhuna(n) ||
283.e: The warriors, on whatever side of the earth they were, began to fal, the blood flowed from the bodies of the fleeing warriors and there were terrible shouts

283.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਗੱਦ ਸੱਦਣੰ ਨਨੱਦ ਨਿਫਿਰੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
283.t: auTha(n)t ga'dh sa'dhana(n) nana'dh nifira(n) rana(n) ||

283.g: ਬਬਰਖ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਘੁਮੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਬ੍ਰਣੰ ॥੭੯੩॥
283.t: babarakh saika(n) sita(n) ghuma(n)t jodhano brana(n) ||793||
283.e: The resonance of fifes filled the battlefield and the clusters of warriors showering the arrows and being inflicted with wounds began to wander.793.

283.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਭੈ ਧਰੰ ਭਟੰ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਭਰਥਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
283.t: bhaja(n)t bhai dhara(n) bhaTa(n) bilok bharathano rana(n) ||

283.g: ਚਲਯੋ ਚਿਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਪੀ ਬਬਰਖ ਸਾਇਕੋ ਸਿਤੰ ॥
283.t: chalayo chirai kai chapee babarakh saiko sita(n) ||
283.e: Seeing the war of Bharat, many warriors began to run away fearfully. On this side, in great fury, Bharat began to shower arrows.

283.g: ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਸੰ ਬਬੱਧ ਭਾਲਣੋ ਭਟੰ ॥
283.t: s kru'dh saika(n) sisa(n) baba'dh bhaalano bhaTa(n) ||

283.g: ਪਪਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀਯੰ ਹਠੀ ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰ ਮੰਗਤੰ ॥੭੯੪॥
283.t: papaat pirathaveeya(n) haThee mamoh aasr ma(n)gata(n) ||794||
283.e: The sons of the sage in great ire showered a volley of arrows and caused Bharat to fall on the earth.794.

283.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਾਵਤਾਰੇ ਭਰਥ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
283.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamaavataare bharath badheh dhiaai samaapata(n) ||

283.g: ਭਭੱਜਿ ਭੀਤਣੋ ਭਟੰ ਤਤੱਜਿ ਭਰਥਣੋ ਭੂਅੰ ॥
283.t: bhabha'j bheetano bhaTa(n) tata'j bharathano bhooa(n) ||

283.g: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਲੁੱਥਤੰ ਉਠੰ ਰੁਰੋਦ ਰਾਘਵੰ ਤਟੰ ॥
283.t: gira(n)t lu'thata(n) uTha(n) rurodh raaghava(n) taTa(n) ||
283.e: The warriors fled leaving Bharat fallen on the earth and rising and falling over corpses they came to Ram.

283.g: ਜੁਝੇ ਸੁ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਭਰਥਣੋ ਸੁਣੰਤ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਪਤੰ ॥
283.t: jujhe su bhraat bharathano suna(n)t jaanakee pata(n) ||

283.g: ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਮਿਣੋ ਤਲੰ ਅਪੀੜ ਪੀੜਤੰ ਦੁਖੰ ॥੭੯੫॥
283.t: papaat bhoomino tala(n) apeeR peeRata(n) dhukha(n) ||795||
283.e: When Ram came to Know of the death of Bharat, then highly anguished with sorrows he fell down of the earth.795.

283.g: ਸਸੱਜ ਜੋਧਣੰ ਜੁਧੀ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਬੱਧਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥
283.t: sasa'j jodhana(n) judhee su kru'dh ba'dhano bara(n) ||

283.g: ਤਤੱਜਿ ਜੱਗ ਮੰਡਲੰ ਅਦੰਡ ਦੰਡਣੋ ਨਰੰ ॥
283.t: tata'j ja'g ma(n)ddala(n) adha(n)dd dha(n)ddano nara(n) ||
283.e: Ram himself started for war in great fury after decorating his army of warriors in order to kill the brave fighters and punish the unpunished

283.g: ਸੁ ਗੱਜ ਬੱਜ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੈ ਧਰੀ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
283.t: s ga'j ba'j baajano uTha(n)t bhai dharee sura(n) ||

283.g: ਸਨੱਧ ਬੱਧ ਖੈ ਦਲੰ ਸਬੱਧ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥੭੯੬॥
283.t: sana'dh ba'dh khai dhala(n) saba'dh jodhano bara(n) ||796||
283.e: Hearing the voices of the elephants and the horses, the gods also became fearful and in this army there were several heroes who could destroy the bedecked forces.796.

283.g: ਚਚੱਕ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਨਭੰ ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਰੀ ਧਰੰ ॥
283.t: chacha'k chaavaddee nabha(n) fika(n)t fi(n)karee dhara(n) ||

283.g: ਭਖੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਹਾਰਣੰ ਬਮੰਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਦੁਰਗਯੰ ॥
283.t: bhakha(n)t maas haarana(n) bama(n)t javaiaal dhuragaya(n) ||
283.e: Roaming in he sky, the vultures began to move on the earth, the goddess Durga, appeared showering innumerable fires and eating the flesh.

283.g: ਪੁਅੰਤ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਸਿਰੰ ਨਚੰਤ ਈਸਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
283.t: pua(n)t paarabatee sira(n) nacha(n)t ieesano rana(n) ||

283.g: ਭਕੰਤ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਣੋ ਬਕੰਤ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਲੰ ॥੭੯੭॥
283.t: bhaka(n)t bhoot pretano baka(n)t beer baitala(n) ||797||
283.e: It seemed that Shiva, the lord of Parvati, was engaged in Tandava dance in the battlefield. The heinous shouts of ghosts, fiends and brave Vaitals are being heard.797.
The warriors began to fight, the arrows were showered, the limbs were chopped and the saddles of the horses were torn.798.
The warriors began to run on being shot by arrows  the sbode of Dharma (Ram) saw all this.799.
Being enraged the warriors began to fight and said, “Arrest and bind these boys quickly.”800.
The soldiers rushed forth and besieged both the death-like radiant boy.801.
The boys fearlessly discharged arrows with which the warriors fell and very enduring ones fled away.802.

284.e: The warriors of chopped limbs fell in the field, they were looking extremely magnificent.803.
They are running away without seeing anything  they are leaving even Ram, the abode of Dharma.804.
The warriors, disguising themselves, loosening their hair and forsaking their weapons, are running away by the sides of the battlefield.805.

284.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਿਸਨ ਜੋਧਾ ਹਰੈ ਪਰਯੋ ਜੁੱਧ ਦੁਐ ਜਾਮ ॥
284.t: dhuhoo(n) dhisan jodhaa harai parayo ju'dh dhuaai jaam ||
284.e: The warriors of both sides were killed and for two pehars (about six houts) the war continued

284.g: ਜੂਝ ਸਕਲ ਸੈਨਾ ਗਈ ਰਹਿਗੇ ਏਕਲ ਰਾਮ ॥੮੦੬॥
284.t: joojh sakal sainaa giee rahige ekal raam ||806||
284.e: All the forces of Ram were killed and now he survived alone.806.

284.g: ਤਿਹੂ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਹਨਯੋ ਅਰ ਸਭ ਦਲਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥
284.t: tihoo bhraat bin bhai hanayo ar sabh dhaleh sa(n)ghaar ||
284.e: Lava and Kusha killed the three brothers and

284.g: ਲਵ ਅਰੁ ਕੁਸ ਜੂਝਨ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਲੀਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਹਕਾਰ ॥੮੦੭॥
284.t: lav ar kus joojhan nimit leeno raam hakaar ||807||
284.e: Their forces fearlessly and now they challenged Ram.807.

284.g: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਜੁਝਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਤਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਛਪ ਜਾਇ ॥
284.t: sainaa sakal jujhai kai kat baiThe chhap jai ||
284.e: The boys (of the sage) said to Ram, “O, the King of Kaushal!

284.g: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹੂੰ ਲਰੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਉਸਲ ਰਾਇ ॥੮੦੮॥
284.t: ab ham so tumahoo(n) laro sun sun kausal rai ||808||
284.e: You have got all your army killed and where are you hiding now? Now come and fight with us.”808.

284.g: ਨਿਰਖ ਬਾਲ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹੇ ਬੈਨ ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ॥
284.t: nirakh baal nij roop prabh kahe bain musakai ||

284.g: ਕਵਨ ਤਾਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਤੁਮੈ ਕਵਨ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੮੦੯॥
284.t: kavan taat baalak tumai kavan tihaaree mai ||809||
284.e: Seeing the children as his own replica, Ram asked smilingly, “O boys! who are your parents?”809.
“Sita, the daughter of the king Janak of Mithilapur is beautiful like a propitious song 810

285.e: “O the king of Raghu clan! she has come to the forest and given birth to us and we are two brothers.”811.
When Sita heard and came to know about Ram, she then, even recognizing him, did not utter a word from her mouth.812.
She forbade her sons and told them, “Ram is extremely mighty, you are persistently waging a war against him.” Saying this even Sita did not say the whole thing.813.
Those boys did not retreat and accept defeat and discharged their arrows with full force after stretching their bows.814.
Al the limbs of Ram were pierced and his whole body eroded, the whole army came to know this that Ram had passed away.815.
When Ram passed away, then the whole army began to flee accordingly in front of those two boys.816.
They were not even turning around to see Ram, and being helpless they fled away to whichever side they could.817.
Then both the boys without any anxiety, looked towards the battlefield like Rudra surveying the forest
The banners were cut and attached to the trees and the unique ornaments of the soldiers were removed from their limbs and thrown away.818.

285.g: ਬਾਜ ਸਹਿਤ ਤਹ ਗੇ ਜਹ ਮਾਈ ॥
285.t: baaj sahit teh ge jeh maiee ||
285.e: Those who were unconscious, the boys raised them and reached the place alongwith the horses, where Sita was sitting

285.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਸੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਰੋ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
285.t: dhekh seeaa pat mukh ro dheenaa ||

285.e: Seeing her dead husband Sita said, “O sons! you have made me a widow.”819.

285.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਲਵ ਬਾਜ ਬਾਧਵੇ ਰਾਮ ਬਧਹ ॥
285.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataar lav baaj baadhave raam badheh ||

285.g: ਅਥ ਸੀਤਾ ਨੇ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਏ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
285.t: ath seetaa ne sabh jeevaae kathana(n) ||
285.e: The description of the Revival of all by Sita :
The description of the Revival of all by Sita :

285.g: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਾਸਟ ਦੇ ਆਨਾ ॥
285.t: ab mo kau kaasaT dhe aanaa ||

285.e: “Bring wood for me so that I may get myself reduced to ashes with my husband.”

285.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਏ ॥
285.t: sun mun raaj bahut bidh roe ||

285.e: Hearing this the great sage (Valmiki) lamented greatly and said, “These boys have destroyed all our comforts.”820.

285.g: ਜਬ ਸੀਤਾ ਤਨ ਚਹਾ ਕਿ ਕਾਢੂੰ ॥
285.t: jab seetaa tan chahaa k kaaddoo(n) ||

285.e: When Sita said this that she would forsake her body by emanating the Yoga-fire from his own body,

285.g: ਤਬ ਇਮ ਭਈ ਗਗਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
285.t: tab im bhiee gagan te baanee ||

285.e: Then there was heard this speech from heaven, “O Sita, why are you acting childlike.”821.

286.e: AROOPA STANZA
Sita heard the speech and took water in her hand.822.
Address of Sita to her mind :
DOHRA

286.g: ਜਉ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਅਉਰ ॥
286.t: jau man bach karaman sahit raam binaa nahee aaur ||
286.e: If in my mind, speech and action someone else except Ram had not been there at any time,

286.g: ਤਉ ਏ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਜੀਐ ਕਹਯੋ ਸੀਆ ਤਿਹ ਠਉਰ ॥੮੨੩॥
286.t: tau e raam sahit jeeaai kahayo seeaa teh Thaur ||823||
286.e: Then at this time all the dead alogwith Ram may be reanimated.823.
AROOPA STANZA
All the dead were reanimated, the illusion of all was removed and all leaving their persistence fell at the feet of SIta.824.
Sita was accepted as queen of the world and a sati, the source of Dharma.825.
Ram loved her and considering her a sati, he hugged her to his bosom.826.
DOHRA

286.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੀਅਹਿ ਸਮੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਅਜੁਧਿਆ ਦੇਸ ॥
286.t: bahu bidh se'eeh samodh kar chale ajudhiaa dhes ||

286.g: ਲਵ ਕੁਸ ਦੋਊ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਸਹਿਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਨਰੇਸ ॥੮੨੭॥
286.t: lav kus dhouoo putran sahit sree raghubeer nares ||827||
286.e: Instructing Sita in many ways and taking Lava and Kusha with him Raghuvir Ram started for Ajodhya.827.
CHAUPAI
The children were also instructed in many ways and Sita and ram moved towards Oudh.
All the there were carrying weapons in different styles and it seemed that three Rams were walking.828.

286.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰੇ ਤਿਹੂ ਭਿਰਾਤਨ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਹਿਤ ਜੀਬੋ ॥
286.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake raamavataare tihoo bhiraatan sainaa sahit jeebo ||
286.e: End of the chapter entitled The Reanimation of the Three Brothers alongwith their forces in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

286.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਦੁਹੂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਪੁਰੀ ਅਵਧ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
286.t: seetaa dhuhoo putran sahit puree avadh praves kathana(n) ||
286.e: The description of the Entry of Sita alongwith her two sons in Oudhpuri :
CHAUPAI
All the three mothers hugged all of them to their bosoms and Lava and Kusha came forward to touch their feet

286.g: ਮਿਟ ਗਈ ਤਹੀਂ ਦੁਖਨ ਕੀ ਘਰੀ ॥੮੨੯॥
286.t: miT giee tahee(n) dhukhan kee gharee ||829||
286.e: Sita also touched their feet and it appeared that the time of suffering had ended.829lkh,
Raghuvir Ram completed the Ashavamedha Yajna (horse-sacrifice)
And in his house, his two sons seemed very impressive who had come back home after conquering many countries.830.
All the rituals of Yajna were performed according to Vedic rites, s

286.g: ਚਟ ਪਟ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਉਠਿ ਭੱਗਾ ॥੮੩੧॥
286.t: chaT paT chakr i(n)dhr uTh bha'gaa ||831||
286.e: Even Yajnas were performed at one place, seeing which Indra wondered and fled away.831.
Ten Rajsu Yajnas and twenty-one kinds of Ashvamedha Yajna were performed.

287.e: Go-medh, Ajmedh and Bhoop-medh several types of Yajnas were performed.832.
Six Nagmedh Yajnas were performed which bring victory in life
To what extent I should enumerate them because there is fear of the Granth becoming voluminous.833.
Ram ruled in Avadphpuri for ten thousand and ten years,
Then according to time schedule, the death beat its drum.834.

287.g: ਜਿਨ ਜਗ ਜੀਤ ਕਰਯੋ ਬਸ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
287.t: jin jag jeet karayo bas saaraa ||
287.e: I bow before death in various ways, which has conquered the whole world and keeping it under its control.

287.g: ਜੀਤ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੮੩੫॥
287.t: jeet na sakaa ra(n)k ar raajaa ||835||
287.e: The drum of death beats on everyone’s head and no king or pauper had been able to conquer it.835.

287.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਰ ਦੈ ਲਏ ਬਚਾਇ ॥
287.t: je tin kee saranee pare kar dhai le bachai ||

287.g: ਜੌ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਚਿਆ ਕਿਸਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੮੩੬॥
287.t: jau nahee kouoo baachiaa kisan bisan raghurai ||836||
287.e: He, who came under its refuge, it saved him and he, who did not go under its refuge, he could not be saved whether he was Krishna or Vishnu or Ram.836.

287.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੋ ਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
287.t: bahu bidh karo raaj ko saajaa ||

287.e: Performing his royal duties in many ways and practising Sama, Dama, Dand and Bhed and other methods of administration, Ram conquered other kings of many countries.837.
He caused every caste to do its duties and set in motion Varnashram Dharma

288.e: Kshatriyas began to serve the Brahmin and the Vaishyas considered the Kshatriyas as gods.838.

288.g: ਜਹ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤਹੀ ਵਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
288.t: jeh koiee kahai tahee veh dhaavai ||
288.e: The Shudras began to serve all and they went wherever they were sent
Ram always talked from his mouth about practicing administration according to Vedas.839.

288.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਜ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੮੪੦॥
288.t: eeh bidh raaj jagat mai keeno ||840||
288.e: Ram ruled by killing the tyrants like Ravana, by emancipating different devotees and attendants (ganas) and by collecting the taxes of Lanka.840.
DOHRA STANZA

288.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖਨ ਲਉ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਾ ਅਰ ਟਾਲ ॥
288.t: bahu barakhan lau raam jee raaj karaa ar Taal ||

288.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਰੰਧ੍ਰ ਕਹ ਫੋਰ ਕੈ ਭਯੋ ਕਉਸਲਿਆ ਕਾਲ ॥੮੪੧॥
288.t: brahamara(n)dhr keh for kai bhayo kausaliaa kaal ||841||
288.e: In this way, Ram ruled for a long time and on one day Kaushalya breathed her last on the bursting of her nerve Brahm-Randhra.841.
CHAUPAI
The ritual which is performed on the death of someone, the same was performed according to the Vedas
The benign son Ram went to the home (and himself being an incarnation) he had no shortage of any type.842.

288.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
288.t: bahu bidh gat keenee prabh maataa ||

288.e: Many rituals were performed for the salvation of the mother and by that time Kaikeyi had also passed away.
After her death, look at the doing of KAL (death). Sumitra also died.843.
One day explaining to women, Sita drew the portrait of Ravana on the wall,
When Ram saw this, he said somewhat angrily.844.
Speed of Ram in his mind :

288.g: ਯਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੋ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
288.t: yaa ko kachh raavan so hotaa ||

288.e: She (Sita) must have had some love for Ravana, that is the reason why she is looking at his portrait drawn by her
Sita became angry on hearing these words and said that even then Ram had been accusing her.845.
DOHRA

288.g: ਜਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਤ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥
288.t: jau mere bach karam kar hiradhai basat raghurai ||
288.e: “If Ram the king Raghu clan abides ever in my heart, in my speech and action then,

288.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਪੈਂਡ ਮੁਹਿ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮੪੬॥
288.t: pirathee pai(n)dd muh dheejeeaai leejai moh milai ||846||
288.e: O mother earth! you give me some place and merge me in yourself.”846.
CHAUPAI
Hearing these words the earth tore asunder and Sita merged in it
Seeing this Ram wondered and in this suffering he ended all hope of ruling.847.
DOHRA

288.g: ਇਹ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਅਰੋ ਧਉਲਹਰਿ ਕਿਹ ਕੇ ਆਯੋ ਕਾਮ ॥
288.t: eeh jag dhooaro dhaulahar keh ke aayo kaam ||
288.e: This world is the palace of smoke which had been of no value to anyone

288.g: ਰਘੁਬਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਅ ਨਾ ਜੀਐ ਸੀਅ ਬਿਨ ਜੀਐ ਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੮੪੮॥
288.t: raghubar bin seea naa jeeaai seea bin jeeaai na raam ||848||
288.e: Sita could not live without Ram and it is impossible for Ram to remain alive without Sita.848.
CHAUPAI
Ram said to Lakshman, “You sit on the gate and do not let anyone to come in.” Ram himself went into the palace and abandoning his body left this abode of death.849.
DOHRA

288.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਤੀ ਹਿਤ ਅਜ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਜਿਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜ ਲੀਅ ਜੋਗ ॥
288.t: ei(n)dhr matee hit aj nirapat jim gireh taj leea jog ||

289.g: ਤਿਮ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬਿਯੋਗ ॥੮੫੦॥
289.t: tim raghubar tan ko tajaa sree jaanakee biyog ||850||
289.e: The way in which the king Aja had accepted Yoga for Indumati and left his home, in the same manner, Ram abandoned his body on having been separated from Sita.850.

289.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰੇ ਸੀਤਾ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਲੋਕ ਸੇ ਗਏ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
289.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak raamavataare seetaa ke het mirat lok se ge dhiaai samaapata(n) ||
289.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Forsaking the abode of Death for Sita’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

289.g: ਅਥ ਤੀਨੋ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਤ੍ਰੀਅਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਮਰਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
289.t: ath teeno bhraataa treean sahit marabo kathana(n) ||
289.e: The description of the Death of the Three Brothers alongwith their wives :
CHAUPAI
There was great tumult in the whole city and none of the residents was in his senses
The men and women staggered like the warriors writhing after falling during fight in the battlefield.851.

289.g: ਸਗਰ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਗਈ ਰਉਰਾ ॥
289.t: sagar nagar meh par giee rauraa ||

289.e: There was uproar throughout the city and the elephants and horses also began to fall, being worried, what type of sport has been played by Ram?
Thinking about this thing the men and women remained under depression.852.
Bharat also produced Yoga fire in his body by practising Yoga and

289.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੌ ਚਲਤ ਅੰਗ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੮੫੩॥
289.t: prabh sau chalat a(n)g nahee moraa ||853||
289.e: With a jerk got his Brahmrandhra burst and definitely went towards Ram.853.
Lakshman alos did this, practicing all types of Yoga he gave up his life.
Then the Brahmrandhra of Shatrughan also burst and he breathed his last to be at the feet of the Lord.854.

289.g: ਲਵ ਕੁਸ ਦੋਊ ਤਹਾ ਚਲ ਗਏ ॥
289.t: lav kus dhouoo tahaa chal ge ||

289.e: Lava and Kusha both came forward and performed the funeral rites of Ram and Sita

289.g: ਅਰ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਕਹ ਦਹਾ ॥
289.t: ar pit bhraat tihoo(n) keh dhahaa ||

289.g: ਰਾਜ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਲਵ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਰਹਾ ॥੮੫੫॥
289.t: raaj chhatr lav ke sir rahaa ||855||
289.e: They also performed the funeral rites of the brothers of their father and in this way Lava assumed the royal canopy over his head.855.
The wives of the three brothers came there and they also became Satis and left for the heavenly abode.

289.g: ਲਵ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਕਾ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
289.t: lav sir dharaa raaj kaa saajaa ||

289.e: Lava assumed the kingship and made the three (cousins) the kings of three directions.856.
Kusha himself ruled over the north, the son of Bharat was given the kingship of the south and the son of Shatrughan the kingship of the west.857.
DOHRA

289.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਅਟਲ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਭਾਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥
289.t: raam kathaa jug jug aTal sabh koiee bhaakhat net ||

289.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਕਰਾ ਸਗਰੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਮੇਤ ॥੮੫੮॥
289.t: surag baas raghubar karaa sagaree puree samet ||858||
289.e: The story of Ram remain immortal throughout the ages and in this way Ram went to abide in heaven alongwith (all the resident of) the city.858.

289.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਭਿਰਾਤ ਤ੍ਰੀਅਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਗਏ ਅਰ ਸਗਰੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਗਏ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
289.t: eit raam bhiraat treean sahit surag ge ar sagaree puree sahit surag ge dhiaai samaapatam ||
289.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Ram went to Heaven alongwith brothers and their wives He went alongwith all the residents of the city’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
CHAUPAI

289.g: ਜੋ ਇਹ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
289.t: jo ieh kathaa sunai ar gaavai ||

289.g: ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਤਿਹ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
289.t: dhookh paap teh nikaT na aavai ||

289.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਏ ਫਲ ਹੋਈ ॥
289.t: bisan bhagat kee e fal hoiee ||

289.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਯਾਧਿ ਛ੍ਵੈ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮੫੯॥
289.t: aadh bayaadh chhavai sakai na koi ||859||
289.e: He, who will listen to this story and sing it, he will be free from the sufferings and sins. The reward of the devotion to Vishnu (and his incarnation Ram) that no ailment of any kind will touch him.859.
This Granth (book) has been complete (and improved)
In Vadi first in the month of Asaarh in the year
Seventeen hundred and fifty-five
If there has remained any error in it, then kindly correct it.860.
DOHRA

289.g: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਤੁੰਗ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤਰ ਸਤਦ੍ਰੱਵ ਤੀਰ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
289.t: netr tu(n)g ke charan tar satadhra'v teer tara(n)g ||

289.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਯੋ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ॥੮੬੧॥
289.t: sree bhagavat pooran keeyo raghubar kathaa prasa(n)g ||861||
289.e: The story of Raghuvir Ram was complete by the Grace of God on the bank of Sutlej in the valley of the mountain.861.

290.g: ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਿ ॥
290.t: saadh asaadh jaano nahee baadh subaadh bibaadh ||
290.e: The saint be not considered as unsaintly ever and the debate as controversial ever

290.g: ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਕਲ ਪੂਰਣ ਕੀਯੋ ਭਗਵਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੮੬੨॥
290.t: gra(n)th sakal pooran keeyo bhagavat kirapaa prasaadh ||862||
290.e: This whole Granth (book) has been completed by the Grace of God.862.
SWAYYA

290.g: ਪਾਇ ਗਹੇ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਆਂਖ ਤਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਨਯੋ ॥
290.t: pai gahe jab te tumare tab te kouoo aa(n)kh tare nahee aanayo ||
290.e: O God! the day when I caught hold of your feet, I do not bring anyone else under my sight

290.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਹੈਂ ਮਤ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
290.t: raam raheem puraan kuraan anek kahai(n) mat ek na maanayo ||
290.e: None other is liked by me now   the Puranas and the Quran try to know Thee by the names of Ram and Rahim and talk about you through several stories,

290.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ਕਹੈ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
290.t: si(n)mirat saasatr bedh sabhai bahu bhedh kahai ham ek na jaanayo ||
290.e: The Simritis, Shastras and Vedas describe several mysteries of yours, but I do not agree with any of them.

290.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸਿਪਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਕਹਯੋ ਸਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥੮੬੩॥
290.t: sree asipaan kirapaa tumaree kar mai na kahayo sabh toh bakhaanayo ||863||
290.e: O sword-wielder God! This all has been described by Thy Grace, what power can I have to write all this?.863.
DOHRA

290.g: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਗਹਯੋ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
290.t: sagal dhuaar kau chhaadd kai gahayo tuhaaro dhuaar ||
290.e: O Lord! I have forsaken all other doors and have caught hold of only Thy door.

290.g: ਬਾਹਿ ਗਹੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਅਸਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਹਾਰ ॥੮੬੪॥
290.t: baeh gahe kee laaj as gobi(n)dh dhaas tuhaar ||864||
290.e: O Lord! Thou has caught hold of my arm. I, Govind, am Thy serf, kindly take (care of me and) protect my honour.864.

290.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਾਇਣ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
290.t: eit sree raamain samaapatam sat subham sat ||
290.e: BENIGN END OF THE RAMAYANA.
CHAUBIS AVTAR(Contd.)
The Lord is one and the Victory is of the Lord.
The Lord is one and the Victory is of the Lord.
Now begins the description of KRISHNA INCARNATION, the twenty-first incarnation
CHAUPAI
No I describe the Krishna incarnation as to how he assumed the physical form
The earth, with unsteady gait, reached near the Lord.1.
Amidst the milk-ocean, where the Immanent Lord was seated, Brahma reached there
The Lord called Vishnu near Him and said, “You go to the earth and assume the form of Krishna incarnation.2.
DOHRA

290.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੇਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
290.t: kaal purakh ke bachan te sa(n)tan het sahai ||

290.g: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਧਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
290.t: mathuraa ma(n)ddal ke bikhai janam dharo har rai ||3||
290.e: Vishnu took birth in Mathura area for the welfare of saints, on receiving the orders of the Loard.3.
CHAUPAI
The sportive plays exhibited by Krishna, have been described in the tenth skandh
There are eleven thousand and ninety-two stanzas in respect of Krishna incarnation in the tenth skandh.4.

290.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
290.t: ath dhevee joo kee usatat kathana(n) ||
290.e: Now begins the description in praise of the goddess
SWAYYA

290.g: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਹਮ ਪੈ ਤੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਗਨੰ ਗੁਨ ਹੀ ਧਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.t: hoi kirapaa tumaree ham pai ta sabhai sagana(n) gun hee dhar ho(n) ||
290.e: On receiving Thy Grace, I shall assume all the virtues

290.g: ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਤਬੈ ਬਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨੰ ਗੁਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.t: jeea dhaar bichaar tabai bar budh mahaa agana(n) gun ko har ho(n) ||
290.e: I shall destroy all the vices, ruminating on Thy attributes in my mind

290.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਚੰਡਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਅਛਰ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.t: bin cha(n)dd kirapaa tumaree kabahoo(n) mukh te nahee achhar hau kar ho(n) ||
290.e: O Chandi! I cannot utter a syllable from my mouth without Thy Grace

290.g: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਧੋ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਿਮ ਬਾਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥੫॥
290.t: tumaro kar naam kidho tulahaa jim baak samu(n)dhr bikhai tar ho(n) ||5||
290.e: I can ferry across the ocean of Poesy, on only the boat of Thy Name.5.
DOHRA

290.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰਦਾ ਅਨਗਨ ਗੁਨ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
290.t: re man bhaj too(n) saaradhaa anagan gun hai jaeh ||
290.e: O mind! Remember the goddess Sharda of innumerable qualities

290.g: ਰਚੌ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਇਹ ਭਾਗਵਤ ਜਉ ਵੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
290.t: rachau gra(n)th ieh bhaagavat jau vai kirapaa karaeh ||6||
290.e: And if she be kind, I may compose this Granth (based on) Bhagavata.6.
KABIT

290.g: ਸੰਕਟ ਹਰਨ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਚੰਡ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.t: sa(n)kaT haran sabh sidh kee karan cha(n)dd taaran taran ar lochan bisaal hai ||
290.e: The large-eyed Chandika is the remover of all sufferings, the donor of powers and support of the helpless in ferrying across the fearful ocean of the world

290.g: ਆਦਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਹਮ ਹੈ ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.t: aadh jaa kai aaham hai a(n)t ko na paaraavaar saran ubaaran karan pratipaal hai ||
290.e: It is difficult to know her beginning and end, she emancipates and sustains him, who takes refuge in her,

290.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰਨ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਛਡਾਏ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.t: asur sa(n)ghaaran anik dhukh jaaran so patit udhaaran chhaddaae jam jaal hai ||
290.e: She destroys the demons, finishes various types of desires and saves from the noose of death

290.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਬਰੁ ਲਾਇਕ ਸੁਬੁਧਿ ਹੂ ਕੀ ਦਾਇਕ ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਰੁ ਪਾਇਕ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਹਾਲ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
290.t: dhevee bar laik subudh hoo kee dhaik su dheh bar paik banaavai gra(n)th haal hai ||7||
290.e: The same goddess is capable of bestowing the boon and good intellect  by her Grace this Granth can be composed.7.
SWAYYA

290.g: ਅਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਤਾ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤਨਯਾ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਰਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੋਊ ॥
290.t: adhr sutaa hoo(n) kee jo tanayaa mahikhaasur kee marataa fun jouoo ||
290.e: She, who is the daughter of the mountain and the destroyer of Mahishasura

291.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਹਿ ਕੀ ਦਵੈਯਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਧ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭਹਿ ਦੋਊ ॥
291.t: ei(n)dhr ko raajeh kee dhavaiyaa karataa badh su(n)bh nisu(n)bheh dhouoo ||
291.e: She, who is the bestower of the kingdom on India by killing Sumbh and Nisumbh

291.g: ਜੋ ਜਪ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਰੁ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਇਛਤ ਸੋਊ ॥
291.t: jo jap kai ieh sev karai bar ko su lahai man ichhat souoo ||
291.e: He, who remembers and serves her, he receives the reward to his heart’s desire,

291.g: ਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਹ ਕੀ ਸਮਤੁਲ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਨ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਊ ॥੮॥
291.t: lok bikhai uh kee samatul gareeb nivaaj na dhoosar kouoo ||8||
291.e: And in the whole world, none other is the supporter of the poor like her.8.

291.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
291.t: eit sree dhevee joo kee usatat samaapata(n) ||
291.e: End of the praise of the goddess,

291.g: ਅਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਭਈ ॥
291.t: ath pirathamee brahamaa peh pukaarat bhiee ||

291.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
291.t: savaiyaa ||

291.g: ਦਈਤਨ ਕੇ ਭਰ ਤੇ ਡਰ ਤੇ ਜੁ ਭਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰਹਿੰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: dhieetan ke bhar te ddar te ju bhiee pirathamee bahu bhaarahi(n) bhaaree ||

291.g: ਗਾਇ ਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਤਬੈ ਧਰ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਰਿਖਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: gai ko roop tabai dhar kai brahamaa rikh pai chal jai pukaaree ||
291.e: When the earth was overburdened by the weight and fear of the demons, she assumed the form of a cow and went to the sage Brahma

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੂੰ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਜਹ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਤਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: braham kahiyo tum hoo(n) ham hoo(n) mil jaeh tahaa jeh hai bratidhaaree ||

291.g: ਜਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਤਿਹ ਕੀ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਸੁਨੋ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
291.t: jai karai binatee teh kee raghunaath suno ieh baat hamaaree ||9||
291.e: Brahma said, “We two will go to the supreme Vishnu in order to request him to listen to our supplication.”9.

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੋ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਸਭੈ ਧਰ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਤਹਾ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ ਤਨ ਕੇ ਤਨੀਆ ॥
291.t: braham ko agr sabhai dhar kai su tahaa ko chale tan ke taneeaa ||
291.e: All the powerful people went there under the leadership of Brahma

291.g: ਤਬ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕਰੀ ਤਿਹ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਰੋਵਤ ਤਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਜ੍ਯੋ ਹਨੀਆ ॥
291.t: tab jai pukaar karee teh saamuh rovat taa mun jayo haneeaa ||
291.e: The sages and others began to weep before the supreme Vishnu as if someone had beaten them

291.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਬਿ ਨੇ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰ ਯੌ ਗਨੀਆ ॥
291.t: taa chhab kee at hee upamaa kab ne man bheetar yau ganeeaa ||
291.e: The poet mentioning the beauty of that spectacle says that those people appeared

291.g: ਜਿਮ ਲੂਟੇ ਤੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਜ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਕੈ ਕੁਟਵਾਰ ਪੈ ਕੂਕਤ ਹੈ ਬਨੀਆ ॥੧੦॥
291.t: jim looTe tai agraj chaudharee kai kuTavaar pai kookat hai baneeaa ||10||
291.e: Like a trader crying before a police officer having been plundered at the instance of the headman.10.

291.g: ਲੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੁਰ ਸੈਨ ਸਭੈ ਤਹ ਦਉਰਿ ਗਏ ਜਹ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: lai brahamaa sur sain sabhai teh dhaur ge jeh saagar bhaaree ||

291.g: ਗਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਕਰੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਲਖਿ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਪਖਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: gai pranaam karo tin ko apune lakh baar nivaar pakhaaree ||
291.e: Brahma reached the milk-ocean alongwith the gods and the forces and washed the feet of the supreme Vishnu with water

291.g: ਪਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਨਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਮਾਨ ਤਹਾ ਬ੍ਰਤਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
291.t: pai pare chaturaanan taeh ke dhekh bimaan tahaa bratidhaaree ||

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਲੈ ਮੈ ਜਰ ਦੈਤਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
291.t: braham kahiyo brahamaa kahu jaahu avataar lai mai jar dhaitan maaree ||11||
291.e: Seeing that supreme Immanent Lord, the four-headed Brahma fell at his feet whereupon the Lord said, “You may leave, I shall incarnate and destroy the demons.”11.

291.g: ਸ੍ਰਉਨਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਬੈ ਮਨ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਖਾਨੇ ॥
291.t: sraunan mai sun braham kee baat sabai man dhevan ke harakhaane ||

291.g: ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਚਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਲੋਕ ਸਭੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
291.t: kai kai pranaam chale gireh aapan lok sabhai apune kar maane ||
291.e: Listening to the words of the Lord, all the gods were pleased and went back to their places after paying their obeisance to him

291.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਚ ਮਹਾ ਕਬਿ ਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ॥
291.t: taa chhab ko jas uch mahaa kab ne apune man mai pahichaane ||

291.g: ਗੋਧਨ ਭਾਤਿ ਗਯੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਮਨੋ ਸੁਰ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੋਰ ਕੈ ਆਨੇ ॥੧੨॥
291.t: godhan bhaat gayo sabh lok mano sur jai bahor kai aane ||12||
291.e: Visualising that spectacle the poet said that they were going back like a herd of cows.12.

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
291.t: brahamaa baach ||

291.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
291.t: dhoharaa ||

292.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਹ ਆਗਿਆ ਦਈ ਦੇਵਨ ਸਕਲ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
292.t: fir har ieh aagiaa dhiee dhevan sakal bulai ||

292.g: ਜਾਇ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮ ਹੂੰ ਧਰੋ ਹਉ ਹੂੰ ਧਰਿ ਹੌ ਆਇ ॥੧੩॥
292.t: jai roop tum hoo(n) dharo hau hoo(n) dhar hau aai ||13||
292.e: Then the Lord called all the gods and ordered them to incarnate before him.13.

292.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਵਤਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
292.t: baat sunee jab dhevatan koT pranaam ju keen ||

292.g: ਆਪ ਸਮੇਤ ਸੁ ਧਾਮੀਐ ਲੀਨੇ ਰੂਪ ਨਵੀਨ ॥੧੪॥
292.t: aap samet su dhaameeaai leene roop naveen ||14||
292.e: When the gods heard this, they bowed and assumed the new forms of cowherds alongwith their wives.14.

292.g: ਰੂਪ ਧਰੇ ਸਭ ਸੁਰਨ ਯੌ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਾਇ ॥
292.t: roop dhare sabh suran yau bhoom maeh ieh bhai ||

292.g: ਅਬ ਲੀਲਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹੋ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
292.t: ab leelaa sree dhevakee mukh te kaho sunai ||15||
292.e: In this way, all the gods assumed new forms on the earth and now I narrate the story of Devaki.15.

292.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹ੍ਵੈਬੋ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
292.t: eit sree bisan avataar havaibo baranana(n) samaapata(n) ||
292.e: End of the description about the decision of Vishnu to incarnate.

292.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
292.t: ath dhevakee ko janam kathana(n) ||
292.e: Now begins the description about the Birth of Devaki

292.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
292.t: dhoharaa ||
292.e: DOHRA

292.g: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕੀ ਕੰਨਿਕਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਤਾਸ ॥
292.t: augrasain kee ka(n)nikaa naam dhevakee taas ||

292.g: ਸੋਮਵਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਜਠਰ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੧੬॥
292.t: somavaar dhin jaThar te keeno taeh prakaas ||16||
292.e: The birth of the daughter of Ugrasain named Devaki took place on Monday.16.

292.g: ਇਤਿ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
292.t: eit dhevakee ko janam baranana(n) piratham dhiaai samaapatam ||
292.e: End of the first Chapter regarding the description about the Birth of Devaki.

292.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਬਰੁ ਢੂੰਢਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
292.t: ath dhevakee ko bar ddoo(n)ddabo kathana(n) ||
292.e: Now Begins the description about the search of the match for Devaki

292.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
292.t: dhoharaa ||
292.e: DOHRA

292.g: ਜਬੈ ਭਈ ਵਹਿ ਕੰਨਿਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਰ ਕੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
292.t: jabai bhiee veh ka(n)nikaa su(n)dhar bar kai jog ||

292.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਹੀ ਬਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਢੂੰਢਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਲੋਗ ॥੧੭॥
292.t: raaj kahee bar ke nimit ddoo(n)ddahu apanaa log ||17||
292.e: When that beautiful girl reached the marriageable age, then the king asked his men to search for a suitable match for her.17.

292.g: ਦੂਤ ਪਠੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਰਖ੍ਰਯੋ ਹੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ॥
292.t: dhoot paThe tin jai kai nirakhrayo hai basudhev ||

292.g: ਮਦਨ ਬਦਨ ਸੁਖ ਕੋ ਸਦਨੁ ਲਖੈ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ॥੧੮॥
292.t: madhan badhan sukh ko sadhan lakhai tat ko bhev ||18||
292.e: The consul was sent, who approved the selection of Vasudev, whose face was like cupid and who was the abode of all comforts and master of discriminating intellect.18.

292.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
292.t: kabit ||
292.e: KABIT

292.g: ਦੀਨੋ ਹੈ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਜਾਇ ਭਾਲਿ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ਨਾਰੀਏਰ ਗੋਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੈ ਅਸੀਸ ਕੌ ॥
292.t: dheeno hai tilak jai bhaal basudhev joo ke ddaariyo naare'er godh maeh dhai asees kau ||
292.e: Putting a cocoanut in the lap of Vasudev and blessing him, a frontal mark was put on his forehead

292.g: ਦੀਨੀ ਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ਪੈ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਮੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਉਰ ਈਸਨ ਕੇ ਈਸ ਕੌ ॥
292.t: dheenee hai baddaiee pai miThaiee hoo(n) te meeThee sabh jan man bhaiee aaur ieesan ke iees kau ||
292.e: He eulogized him, sweeter than the sweetmeats, which was even liked by the Lord

292.g: ਮਨ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਆਈ ਸੋ ਤੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਮਨ ਮਧ ਘਰਨੀਸ ਕੋ ॥
292.t: man ju pai aaiee so to keh kai sunaiee taa kee sobhaa sabh bhaiee man madh gharanees ko ||
292.e: Coming home, he fully appreciated him before the women of the house

292.g: ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗ ਗਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਈ ਸੋ ਤੋ ਏਕ ਲੋਕ ਕਹਾ ਲੋਕ ਭੇਦੇ ਬੀਸ ਤੀਸ ਕੋ ॥੧੯॥
292.t: saare jag gaiee jin sobhaa jaa kee gaiee so to ek lok kahaa lok bhedhe bees tees ko ||19||
292.e: His praises were sung in the whole world, which echoed not only in this world but also penetrated into twenty thirty other regions.19.

292.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
292.t: dhoharaa ||
292.e: DOHRA

292.g: ਕੰਸ ਬਾਸਦੇਵੈ ਤਬੈ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਯਾਹ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
292.t: ka(n)s baasadhevai tabai jorio bayaeh samaaj ||
292.e: On this side Kansa and on that side Vasudev made arrangements for the marriage

292.g: ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਿ ਮੈ ਬਾਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਾਜ ॥੨੦॥
292.t: prasa(n)n bhe sabh dharan mai baajan laage baaj ||20||
292.e: All the people of the world were filled with joy and the musical instruments were played.20.

292.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਬ੍ਯਾਹ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
292.t: ath dhevakee ko bayaeh kathana(n) ||
292.e: Description of the Marriage of Devaki

292.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
292.t: savaiyaa ||
292.e: SWAYYA

292.g: ਆਸਨਿ ਦਿਜਨ ਕੋ ਧਰ ਕੈ ਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਵਾਇ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠਾਯੋ ॥
292.t: aasan dhijan ko dhar kai tar taa ko navai lai jai baiThaayo ||

292.g: ਕੁੰਕਮ ਕੋ ਘਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ ਬੇਦਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਹ ਲਾਯੋ ॥
292.t: ku(n)kam ko ghas kai kar purohit bedhan kee dhun siau teh laayo ||
292.e: The seats were presented to Brahmins respectfully, who, reciting Vedic mantras and rubbing saffron etc. applied it on the forehead of Vasudev

292.g: ਡਾਰਤ ਫੂਲ ਪੰਚਾਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਛਤ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ਭਇਓ ਮਨ ਭਾਯੋ ॥
292.t: ddaarat fool pa(n)chaamirat achhat ma(n)galachaar bhio man bhaayo ||

292.g: ਭਾਟ ਕਲਾਵੰਤ ਅਉਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਸਭ ਲੈ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਹਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਯੋ ॥੨੧॥
292.t: bhaaT kalaava(n)t aaur gunee sabh lai bakhasees mahaa jas gaayo ||21||
292.e: They mixed also the flowers and panchamrit and sang songs of praise. On this occasion the ministrels, artists and talented persons eulogized them and received awards.21.

292.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
292.t: dhoharaa ||
292.e: DOHRA

292.g: ਰੀਤਿ ਬਰਾਤਿਨ ਦੁਲਹ ਕੀ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਭ ਕੀਨ ॥
292.t: reet baraatin dhuleh kee baasudhev sabh keen ||

292.g: ਤਬੈ ਕਾਜ ਚਲਬੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੨॥
292.t: tabai kaaj chalabe nimit mathuraa mai man dheen ||22||
292.e: Vasudev made all the preparations for wedding and made arrangements for going to Mathura.22.

292.g: ਬਾਸਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਆਗਮਨ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
292.t: baasadhev ko aagaman ugrasain sun leen ||

292.g: ਚਮੂ ਸਬੈ ਚਤੁਰੰਗਨੀ ਭੇਜਿ ਅਗਾਊ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੩॥
292.t: chamoo sabai chatura(n)ganee bhej agaauoo dheen ||23||
292.e: When Ugarsain came to know of the arrival of Vasudev, he sent his four types of forces to welcome him, in advance.23.

292.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
292.t: savaiyaa ||
292.e: SWAYYA

292.g: ਆਪਸ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਹਿਤ ਕਉ ਦਲ ਸਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਧੁਜਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਐਸੇ ॥
292.t: aapas mai milabe hit kau dhal saaj chale dhujanee pat aaise ||

292.g: ਲਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਪਟ ਪੈ ਡਰ ਕੇਸਰ ਰੰਗ ਭਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
292.t: laal kare paT pai ddar kesar ra(n)g bhare pratinaa pat kaise ||
292.e: The forces of both sides moved for mutual union  all of them had tied red turbans and they looked very impressive filled with joy and gaiety

292.g: ਰੰਚਕ ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਲਈ ਕਬਿ ਨੈ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਭੀਤਰ ਮੈ ਸੇ ॥
292.t: ra(n)chak taa chhab ddoo(n)dd liee kab nai man ke fun bheetar mai se ||

292.g: ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉਤਕਿ ਬਿਆਹਹਿ ਕੋ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਇਹੁ ਕੁੰਕੁਮ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੨੪॥
292.t: dhekhan kautak biaaheh ko nikase ih ku(n)kum aana(n)dh jaise ||24||
292.e: The poet briefly mentioning that beauty says that they seemed like the beds of saffron coming out of their abode in order to see this delightful spectacle of the wedding.24.

292.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
292.t: dhoharaa ||
292.e: DOHRA

292.g: ਕੰਸ ਅਉਰ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ ਆਪਸਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਗ ॥
292.t: ka(n)s aaur basudhev joo aapas mai mil a(n)g ||

292.g: ਤਬੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੇਵਨ ਲਗੇ ਗਾਰੀ ਰੰਗਾ ਰੰਗ ॥੨੫॥
292.t: tabai bahur dhevan lage gaaree ra(n)gaa ra(n)g ||25||
292.e: Kansa and Vasudev hugged each other to his bosom and then began to shower gifts of various types of colourful satires.25.

292.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
292.t: soraThaa ||
292.e: SORTHA

292.g: ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਤਬੈ ਬਜਾਇ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ॥
292.t: dhu(n)dhabh tabai bajai aae jo mathuraa nikaT ||

292.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਖਾਇ ਹਰਖ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੨੬॥
292.t: taa chhab ko nirakhai harakh bhio harikhai kai ||26||
292.e: Beating their drums, they came near Mathura and all the people were pleased to see their elegance.26.

293.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
293.t: savaiyaa ||
293.e: SWAYYA

293.g: ਆਵਤ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
293.t: aavat ko sun kai basudheveh roop saje apune tan naaree ||

293.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਗੀਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਤਾਲਿ ਦਿਵਾਵਤਿ ਆਵਤ ਨਾਗਰਿ ਗਾਰੀ ॥
293.t: gaavat geet bajaavat taal dhivaavat aavat naagar gaaree ||
293.e: Hearing the arrival of Vasudev, all the bedecked women began to sing in tune and showered satires on the coming marriage party

293.g: ਕੋਠਨ ਪੈ ਨਿਰਖੈ ਚੜਿ ਤਾਸਨਿ ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
293.t: koThan pai nirakhai chaR taasan taa chhab kee upamaa jeea dhaaree ||

293.g: ਬੈਠਿ ਬਿਵਾਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਮੇਤ ਸੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
293.t: baiTh bivaan kuTa(n)b samet su dhekhat dhevan kee mahataaree ||27||
293.e: The poet, mentioning the beauty of the women seeing from their roofs said that they appeared like the mothers of the gods seeing the marriage party from their airvehicles.27.

293.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
293.t: kabit ||
293.e: KABIT

293.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਜੈ ਮੰਡਲ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਨਨ ਨਿਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.t: baasudhev aaio raajai ma(n)ddal banaio man mahaa sukh paio taa ko aanan nirakh kai ||
293.e: On the arrival of Vasudev, the king got the pavilion constructed, and he was very much pleased on seeing his beautiful face

293.g: ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਲਗਾਯੋ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਇਨਨ ਗਾਯੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਬਹੁਤ ਦਿਵਾਯੋ ਬਰ ਲਿਆਯੋ ਜੋ ਪਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.t: suga(n)dh lagaayo raag gainan gaayo tisai bahut dhivaayo bar liaayo jo parakh kai ||
293.e: The fragrances were sprinkled on all  the songs were sung and consul who had approved the selection, was greatly awarded

293.g: ਛਾਤੀ ਹਾਥ ਲਾਯੋ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਆਯੋ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਤਬੈ ਆਦਰ ਪਠਾਯੋ ਪੂਜ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.t: chhaatee haath laayo sees niaayo ugrasain tabai aadhar paThaayo pooj man mai harakh kai ||
293.e: Ugarsain worshipped the match by putting his hand on his breast, joyfully bowing his head and getting pleased in his mind

293.g: ਭਯੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੰਗਨ ਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰ ਬਾਦਰ ਸੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਗਯੋ ਕੰਚਨ ਬਰਖ ਕੈ ॥੨੮॥
293.t: bhayo jan ma(n)gan na bhoom par baadhar so raajaa ugrasain gayo ka(n)chan barakh kai ||28||
293.e: At this time the king Ugarsain appeared like the heavenly cloud showering gold, he gave in charity innumerable gold coins to the beggars.28.

293.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
293.t: dhoharaa ||
293.e: DOHRA

293.g: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਤਬ ਕੰਸ ਕੋ ਲਯੋ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
293.t: augrasain tab ka(n)s ko layo hajoor bulai ||

293.g: ਕਹਿਓ ਸਾਥ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਖੁਲਾਇ ॥੨੯॥
293.t: kahio saath tum jai kai dheh bha(n)ddaar khulai ||29||
293.e: Then Ugarsain called Kansa near him and said, “Go and open the doors of the stores for charity.”29.

293.g: ਅਉਰ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਅੰਨ ਕੀ ਲੈ ਜਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
293.t: aaur samagaree a(n)n kee lai jaa taa ke paas ||

293.g: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਤਬੈ ਇਉ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩੦॥
293.t: kar pranaam taa ko tabai iau kariyo aradhaas ||30||
293.e: Bringing the materials like corn etc. and bowing down, he requested Vasudev thus.30.

293.g: ਕਾਲ ਰਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਬ੍ਯਾਹ ਹੈ ਕੰਸਹਿ ਕਹੀ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
293.t: kaal raatr ko bayaeh hai ka(n)seh kahee sunai ||

293.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ ਕਹੀ ਭਲੀ ਜੁ ਤੁਮੈ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
293.t: baasudhev purohit kahee bhalee ju tumai suhai ||31||
293.e: Kansa said, “The marriage has been fixed for the night of Amavas (the dark night) ” on this the priest of Vasudev gave his acceptance saying “as you please”.31.

293.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਹਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਤਬ ਸਬੈ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ॥
293.t: ka(n)s kahio kar jor tab sabai baat ko bhev ||

293.g: ਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਅਸ ਮਾਨੀ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ॥੩੨॥
293.t: saadh saadh pa(n)ddit kahiyo as maanee basudhev ||32||
293.e: Then coming on this side, Kansa with folded hands related all the happenings and when the Pundits came to know that the people of vasudev had accepted the date and time of wedding, then all gave their blessings to him within their minds.32.

293.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
293.t: savaiyaa ||
293.e: SWAYYA

293.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਭਈ ਅਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਭਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਬੈ ਚੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
293.t: raat biteet bhiee ar praat bhiee fir raat tabai chaR aae ||

293.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਦਏ ਹਥਿ ਫੂਲ ਹਜਾਰ ਦੋ ਊਭੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਧਰ ਐਸਿ ਫਿਰਾਏ ॥
293.t: chhaadd dhe hath fool hajaar dho uoobhuch prayodhar aais firaae ||
293.e: The night passed, the day dawned and again the night fell and then during that night, the fireworks were displayed, scattering the colour of thousands of flowers

293.g: ਅਉਰ ਹਵਾਈ ਚਲੀ ਨਭ ਕੋ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਬਿ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
293.t: aaur havaiee chalee nabh ko upamaa tin kee kab sayaam sunaae ||

293.g: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਉਤਕ ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਮਨੋ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੩॥
293.t: dhekheh kautak dhev sabai teh te mano kaagadh koT paThaae ||33||
293.e: Seeing the flying fireworks in the sky, the poet Shyam says this figuratively that it appear to him that the gods were flying the citadels of paper in the sky, seeing this miracle.33.

293.g: ਲੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ ਕੰਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਚਲਿ ਧਾਮ ਗਏ ਹੈ ॥
293.t: lai basudhev ko agr purohit ka(n)seh ke chal dhaam ge hai ||

293.g: ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਇਕ ਲੇਹਿਸ ਗਾਗਰ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਡਾਰਿ ਦਏ ਹੈ ॥
293.t: aage te naar bhiee ik lehis gaagar pa(n)ddit ddaar dhe hai ||
293.e: The priests taking Vasudev with them, are going towards the home of Kansa and seeing a beautiful woman in front of them, the Pundits caused her metallic pitcher to fall

293.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਦਏ ਲਡੂਆ ਗਹਿ ਝਾਟਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੋਊ ਵੇ ਤੋ ਭਛ ਗਏ ਹੈ ॥
293.t: ddaar dhe laddooaa geh jhaaTan taa ko souoo ve to bhachh ge hai ||

293.g: ਜਾਦਵ ਬੰਸ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਅਨੇਕਿਕ ਹਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ॥੩੪॥
293.t: jaadhav ba(n)s dhuhoo(n) dhis te sun kai su anekik haas bhe hai ||34||
293.e: From which the sweetmeats have fallen out with a jerk  they have taken up and eaten these sweetmeats   knowing all about it, both the sides of Yadava clan have been ridiculed in various ways.34.

293.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
293.t: kabit ||
293.e: KABIT

293.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਸੁ ਗਾਰਨ ਦਿਵਾਖਤ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਹਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਮੰਦ ਮੰਦ ਗਾਵਤੀ ॥
293.t: gaavat bajaavat su gaaran dhivaakhat aavat suhaavat hai ma(n)dh ma(n)dh gaavatee ||
293.e: The women singing and playing their musical instruments and chanting their satirical songs look very impressive

293.g: ਕੇਹਰਿ ਸੀ ਕਟਿ ਅਉ ਕੁਰੰਗਨ ਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਜ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਾਲ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਤ ਸੁ ਆਵਤੀ ॥
293.t: kehar see kaT aau kura(n)gan se dhirag jaa ke gaj kaisee chaal man bhaavat su aavatee ||
293.e: They have slim waist like lions, eyes like does and gait like elephants.

293.g: ਮੋਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਉਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੇ ਖਾਰੇ ਧਰੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਤਬੈ ਦੋਊ ਦੂਲਹਿ ਦੁਲਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਤੀ ॥
293.t: motin ke chauk kare laalan ke khaare dhare baiThe tabai dhouoo dhooleh dhulahee suhaavatee ||
293.e: Within the square of gems and on the seats of diamonds and jewels, the bride and bridegroom both look splendid

293.g: ਬੇਦਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਦਛਨਾ ਦਿਜਨ ਦੀਨੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਤ ਭਾਵਰੈ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੇ ਸੋਭਾਵਤੀ ॥੩੫॥
293.t: bedhan kee dhun keenee bahu dhachhanaa dhijan dheenee leenee saat bhaavarai jo bhaavate sobhaavatee ||35||
293.e: Within the chanting of Vedic mantras and giving and taking of religious gifts, the marriage ceremony was completed with seven matrimonial rounds by God’s will. 35.

293.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
293.t: dhoharaa ||
293.e: DOHRA

293.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਭਏ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਹਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
293.t: raat bhe basudhev joo keeno tahaa bilaas ||

293.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਭਏ ਉਠ ਕੈ ਤਬੈ ਗਇਓ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩੬॥
293.t: praat bhe uTh kai tabai gio sasur ke paas ||36||
293.e: During the night Vasudev stayed at some place and getting up in the morning, he went to meet his father-in-law Ugarsain.36.

293.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
293.t: savaiyaa ||
293.e: SWAYYA

293.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਮੇਤ ਦਏ ਗਜ ਆਯੁਤ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ ਦਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣੀ ਰਥਨਾਰੇ ॥
293.t: saaj samet dhe gaj aayut su aaur dhe tiragunee rathanaare ||

293.g: ਲਛ ਭਟੰ ਦਸ ਲਛ ਤੁਰੰਗਮ ਊਟ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਰੇ ਜਰ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
293.t: lachh bhaTa(n) dhas lachh tura(n)gam uooT anek bhare jar bhaare ||
293.e: Bedecked elephants and horses and threefold chariots were given (in marriage), one lakh warriors, ten lakhs of horses and many camels laden with gold were given

293.g: ਛਤੀਸ ਕੋਟ ਦਏ ਦਲ ਪੈਦਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਧੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
293.t: chhatees koT dhe dhal paidhal sa(n)g kidho tin ke rakhavaare ||

293.g: ਕੰਸ ਤਬੈ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੋ ਆਪ ਭਏ ਰਥ ਕੇ ਹਕਵਾਰੇ ॥੩੭॥
293.t: ka(n)s tabai teh raakhan kau mano aap bhe rath ke hakavaare ||37||
293.e: Thirty-six crores of soldiers on foot were given, who seemed to be given for the protection of all and Kansa himself became the charioteer of Devaki and Vasudev and for the protection of all.37.

293.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
293.t: dhoharaa ||
293.e: DOHRA

293.g: ਕੰਸ ਲਵਾਏ ਜਾਤ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਲ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
293.t: ka(n)s lavaae jaat tin sakal prabal dhal saaj ||

293.g: ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਨੀ ਬਿਧ ਕੀ ਅਸੁਭ ਅਵਾਜ ॥੩੮॥
293.t: aage te sravanan sunee bidh kee asubh avaaj ||38||
293.e: When Kansa was going with all the forces, he heard, on going forward, an invisible and inauspicious voice.38.

293.g: ਨਭਿ ਬਾਨੀ ਬਾਚ ਕੰਸ ਸੋ ॥
293.t: nabh baanee baach ka(n)s so ||
293.e: The heavenly speech addressed to Kansa:

293.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
293.t: kabit ||
293.e: KABIT

293.g: ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਹਰਿਨ ਬਿਧ ਸਿਧਿ ਕੇ ਕਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਧਰਨ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
293.t: dhukh ko harin bidh sidh ke karan roop ma(n)gal dharan aaiso kahiyo hai uchaar kai ||
293.e: The Lord, remover of suffering, performer of austerities for great powers and bestower of prosperity, said through the heavenly speech,

293.g: ਲੀਏ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਤਿ ਆਠਵੋ ਗਰਭ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਡਾਰੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
293.t: le'ee kahaa jaat tero kaal hai re mooR mat aaThavo garabh yaa ko to ko ddaarai maar hai ||
293.e: “O fool! where are you taking your death? The eighth son of this (Devaki) will be the cause of your death

294.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਮਾਨ ਲੀਨੋ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਇਹ ਕਾਢ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਡਾਰੋ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
294.t: acharaj maan leeno man mai bichaar ieh kaadd kai kirapaan ddaaro in hee sa(n)ghaar kai ||
294.e: Being greatly astonished Kansa ruminated in his mind whether they be killed by taking out the sword

294.g: ਜਾਹਿੰਗੇ ਛਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਬਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਡਾਰੋ ਜਰ ਹੀ ਉਖਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥੩੯॥
294.t: jaahi(n)ge chhapai kai su jaanee ka(n)s man maeh ihai baat bhalee ddaaro jar hee ukhaar kai ||39||
294.e: Till what time, this fact will be kept concealed? And he will be able to save himself? Therefore, he will be within his right to destroy instantly this very root of fear.39.

294.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
294.t: dhoharaa ||

294.g: ਕੰਸ ਦੋਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਨਮਿਤ ਲੀਨੋ ਖੜਗ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥
294.t: ka(n)s dhohoo(n) ke badh namit leeno khaRag nikaar ||

294.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਡਰੇ ਦੋਊ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੪੦॥
294.t: baasudhev ar dhevakee ddare dhouoo nar naar ||40||
294.e: Kansa took out his sword in order to kill both of them and seeing this both husband and wife were frightened.40.

294.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਬਾਚ ਕੰਸ ਸੋ ॥
294.t: baasudhev baach ka(n)s so ||
294.e: Speech of Vasudev addressed to Kansa:

294.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
294.t: dhoharaa ||

294.g: ਬਾਸਦੇਵ ਡਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਹੀ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
294.t: baasadhev ddar maan kai taa so kahee sunai ||

294.g: ਜੋ ਯਾ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਕਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
294.t: jo yaa hee te janam hai maarahu taakahu rai ||41||
294.e: Absorbed in fear, Vasudev said to Kansa, “Do not kill Devaki, but O king! whosoever will be born to her, you may kill him.”41.

294.g: ਕੰਸ ਬਾਚ ਮਨ ਮੈ ॥
294.t: ka(n)s baach man mai ||
294.e: Speech of Kansa in his mind:

294.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
294.t: dhoharaa ||

294.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਭਾਵ ਸੌ ਮਤਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ਛਪਾਇ ॥
294.t: putr het ke bhaav sau mat ieh jai chhapai ||

294.g: ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਇਨ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਇ ॥੪੨॥
294.t: ba(n)dheekhaanai dheau in ihai bichaaree rai ||42||
294.e: May it not happen that under the impact of her affection for her son, she may hide offspring from me, therefore I feel that they may be imprisoned.42.

294.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਕੈਦ ਕੀਬੋ ॥
294.t: ath dhevakee basudhev kaidh keebo ||
294.e: Description about the Imprisonment of Devaki and Vasudev

294.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
294.t: savaiyaa ||

294.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਜੰਜੀਰ ਲਏ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਨ ਪੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਯੋ ॥
294.t: ddaar ja(n)jeer le tin pain pai fir kai mathuraa meh aayo ||

294.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਕਥਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬੁਰੋ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਨਿਕਰਾਯੋ ॥
294.t: so sun kai sabh log kathaa at naam buro jag mai nikaraayo ||
294.e: Putting chains in their feet Kansa brought them back to Mathura and when the people came to know about it, they greatly talked ill of Kansa

294.g: ਆਨਿ ਰਖੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਪਨ ਮੈ ਰਖਵਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਲੋਗ ਬੈਠਾਯੋ ॥
294.t: aan rakhai gireh aapan mai rakhavaaree ko sevak log baiThaayo ||

294.g: ਆਨਿ ਬਡੇਨ ਕੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਦਈ ਕੁਲ ਭੀਤਰ ਆਪਨੋ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਯੋ ॥੪੩॥
294.t: aan badden kee chhaadd dhiee kul bheetar aapano raeh chalaayo ||43||
294.e: Kansa dept them imprisoned in his own house and forsaking the traditions of his elders, he engaged servants to keep a watch over them and bound them to submit to his orders, remaining fully under his control.43.

294.g: ਕਬਿਯੋ ਬਾਚ ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
294.t: kabiyo baach dhoharaa ||

294.g: ਕਿਤਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਬੀਤੇ ਜਬੈ ਕੰਸ ਰਾਜ ਉਤਪਾਤ ॥
294.t: kitak dhivas beete jabai ka(n)s raaj utapaat ||

294.g: ਤਬੈ ਕਥਾ ਅਉਰੈ ਚਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਰੇਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੪੪॥
294.t: tabai kathaa aaurai chalee karam rekh kee baat ||44||
294.e: Many days passed during the tyrannical rule of Kansa and in this way, according to the line of fate, the story took a new turn.44.

294.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
294.t: pratham putr dhevakee ke janam kathana(n) ||
294.e: Description of the birth of the first son of Devaki

294.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
294.t: dhoharaa ||

295.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਤ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
295.t: putr bhio dhevakee kai keerat mat teh naam ||

295.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੌ ਗਯੋ ਕੰਸ ਕੈ ਧਾਮ ॥੪੫॥
295.t: baasudhev lai taeh kau gayo ka(n)s kai dhaam ||45||
295.e: The first son named Kiratmat was born to Devaki and Vasudev took him to the house of Kansa.45.

295.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
295.t: savaiyaa ||
295.e: SWAYYA

295.g: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਤ ਕੋ ਤਾਤ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੈ ਦਰ ਊਪਰ ਆਇਓ ॥
295.t: lai kar taat ko taat chaliyo jab hee nirap kai dhar uoopar aaio ||

295.g: ਜਾਇ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਦਰਵਾਨਨ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਭੀਤਰ ਜਾਇ ਜਨਾਇਓ ॥
295.t: jai kahiyo dharavaanan so tin bol kai bheetar jai janaio ||
295.e: When the father reached the gate of the palace, he asked the gatekeeper to inform Kansa about it

295.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਰੀ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਸਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਤੁਮ ਕੋ ਬਖਸਾਇਓ ॥
295.t: ka(n)s karee karunaa sis dhekh kahio ham hoo(n) tum ko bakhasaio ||

295.g: ਫੇਰ ਚਲਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਤਊ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪੬॥
295.t: fer chalio gireh ko basudhev tuoo man mai kachh na sukh paio ||46||
295.e: Seeing the baby and taking pity Kansa said, “I have forgiven you.” Vasudev started back to his house, but there was no cheerfulness in his mind.46.

295.g: ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਬਾਚ ਮਨ ਮੈ ॥
295.t: basudhev baach man mai ||
295.e: Speech of Vasudev in his mind:

295.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
295.t: dhoharaa ||
295.e: DOHRA

295.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਆਪਨੇ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
295.t: baasudhev man aapane keeno ihai bichaar ||

295.g: ਕੰਸ ਮੂੜ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਯਾ ਕੌ ਡਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
295.t: ka(n)s mooR dhuramat baddo yaa kau ddar hai maar ||47||
295.e: Vasudev thought in his mind that Kansa was a man of vicious intellect, with fear, he will definitely kill the infant.47.

295.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਾਚ ਕੰਸ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
295.t: naaradh rikh baach ka(n)s prat ||
295.e: Speech of the sage Narada address to Kansa:

295.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
295.t: dhoharaa ||
295.e: DOHRA

295.g: ਤਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਆਯੋ ਕੰਸ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਕਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
295.t: tab mun aayo ka(n)s gireh kahee baat sun rai ||

295.g: ਅਸਟ ਲੀਕ ਕਰ ਕੈ ਗਨੀ ਦੀਨੋ ਭੇਦ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
295.t: asaT leek kar kai ganee dheeno bhedh batai ||48||
295.e: Then the sage Narada came to Kansa and drawing eight lines before him, he told him some mysterious things.48.

295.g: ਅਥ ਭ੍ਰਿਤਨ ਸੌ ਕੰਸ ਬਾਚ ॥
295.t: ath bhiratan sau ka(n)s baach ||
295.e: Speech of Kansa address to his servants:

295.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
295.t: savaiyaa ||
295.e: SWAYYA

295.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਜਬ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: baat sunee jab naaradh kee ieh to nirap ke man maeh bhiee hai ||

295.g: ਮਾਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਇਸੈ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਿਤਨ ਨੈਨ ਕੀ ਸੈਨ ਦਈ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: maarahu jai isai ab hee kar bhiratan nain kee sain dhiee hai ||
295.e: When the king listened to the speech of Narada, it went deeper into his mind  he told his servants with signs to kill the infant immediately

295.g: ਦਉਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਿਹ ਆਇਸੁ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਬਾਤ ਇਹੈ ਚਲਿ ਲੋਗ ਗਈ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: dhaur ge teh aais maan kai baat ihai chal log giee hai ||

295.g: ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਕੈ ਘਨ ਜਿਉ ਬਪੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਲਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੯॥
295.t: paathar pai han kai ghan jiau bap jeeveh te kar bhi(n)n liee hai ||49||
295.e: Receiving his order all (the servants) ran away and they dashed the baby against a store like a hammer, separated the soul from the body.49.

295.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਬਧਹਿ ॥
295.t: piratham putr badheh ||
295.e: Killing of the first son

295.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
295.t: savaiyaa ||
295.e: SWAYYA

295.g: ਅਉਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਤ ਜੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਸ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨੋ ॥
295.t: aaur bhayo sut jo teh ke gireh tau nirap ka(n)s mahaa mat heeno ||

295.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਭੇਜ ਦਏ ਤਿਨ ਲਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
295.t: sevak bhej dhe tin liaai kai paathar pai han kai fun dheeno ||
295.e: Another son who was born to Devaki and Vasudev, who was also killed on the orders of Kans of vicious intellenct, by his servants by dashing him on the store  the dead body was given back to the parents

295.g: ਸੋਰ ਪਰਿਯੋ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਪੁਰ ਮੈ ਕਬਿ ਨੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਇਉ ਲਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
295.t: sor pariyo sab hee pur mai kab nai teh ko jas iau lakh leeno ||

295.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੂਓ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਰਨ ਮੈ ਮਿਲ ਕੈ ਸੁਰ ਮੰਡਲ ਰੋਦਨ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੫੦॥
295.t: ei(n)dhr mooo sun kai ran mai mil kai sur ma(n)ddal rodhan keeno ||50||
295.e: Hearing about this heinous crime, there was great uproar in the whole city and this tumult appeared to the poet like the cries of gods on the death of Indra.50.

295.g: ਅਉਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਤ ਜੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੂੰ ਜੈ ॥
295.t: aaur bhayo sut jo teh ke gireh naam dhario teh ko tin hoo(n) jai ||

295.g: ਮਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਸ ਸੁ ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਖੂੰਜੈ ॥
295.t: maar dhayo sun kai nirap ka(n)s su paathar pai han ddaario khoo(n)jai ||
295.e: Another son was born in their house who was named Jaya, but he was also dashed against the stone by the king Kansa

295.g: ਸੀਸ ਕੇ ਬਾਰ ਉਖਾਰਤ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਰੋਦਨ ਚੋਰਨ ਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਗੂੰਜੈ ॥
295.t: sees ke baar ukhaarat dhevakee rodhan choran tai ghar goo(n)jai ||

295.g: ਜਿਉ ਰੁਤਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ ਨਭਿ ਕੋ ਜਿਮ ਜਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਕੂੰਜੈ ॥੫੧॥
295.t: jiau rut a(n)t basa(n)t samai nabh ko jim jaat pukaarat koo(n)jai ||51||
295.e: Devaki began to pull out the hair of her head and began to cry like the bird called Karauncha in the sky in the spring season.51.

295.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
295.t: kabit ||
295.e: KABIT

295.g: ਚਉਥੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਾਰ ਦਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੋਕ ਬੜਵਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਜਗਤ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: chautho putr bhio so bhee ka(n)s maar dhio teh sok baRavaa kee laaTai man mai jagat hai ||
295.e: The fourth son was born and he was also killed by Kansa  the flames of sorrow blazed in the hearts of Devaki and Vasudev

295.g: ਪਰੀ ਹੈਗੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬੀਚ ਗਈ ਮਿਟ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੀ ਪਗਤ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: paree haigee dhaasee mahaa moh hoo(n) kee faasee beech giee miT sobhaa pai udhaasee hee pagat hai ||
295.e: All the beauty of Devaki was finished by the noose of great attachment around her neck and she was drowned in great anguish

295.g: ਕੈਧੋ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਥ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਨਾਥ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਪੈ ਹੂੰਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਔਰ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: kaidho tum naath havai sanaath ham hoo(n) pai hoo(n)jai pat kee na gat aauar tan kee na gat hai ||
295.e: She says, “O my God! what type of Lord Thou art and what type of protected people we are? We have neither received any honour nor have got any physical protection

295.g: ਭਈ ਉਪਹਾਸੀ ਦੇਹ ਪੂਤਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਾਸੀ ਨ ਹਮੈ ਗਾਸੀ ਸੀ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨॥
295.t: bhiee upahaasee dheh pootan binaasee abinaasee teree haasee na hamai gaasee see lagat hai ||52||
295.e: Because of the death of our son, we are also being ridiculed, O Immortal Lord! such a cruel joke by you is sharply stinging us like an arrow.”52.

295.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
295.t: savaiyaa ||
295.e: SWAYYA

295.g: ਪਾਚਵੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੰਸ ਸੁ ਪਾਥਰ ਸੋ ਹਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਦਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: paachavo putr bhayo sun ka(n)s su paathar so han maar dhayo hai ||

295.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਗਯੋ ਨਭਿ ਕੇ ਮਗ ਮੈ ਤਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਧੌ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਮੈ ਗਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: savaiaas gayo nabh ke mag mai tan taa ko kidhau jamunaa mai gayo hai ||
295.e: Hearing about the birth of fifth son, Kansa also killed him by dashing him against the store  the soul of the infant went to heaven and his body was merged in the flowing current

295.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਨਨ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਸੋਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਸ ਉਸਾਸ ਲਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
295.t: so sun kai pun sronan dhevakee sok so saas usaas layo hai ||

295.g: ਮੋਹ ਭਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਮੈ ਮਨੋ ਯਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਭਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੫੩॥
295.t: moh bhayo at taa dhin mai mano yaahee te moh prakaas bhayo hai ||53||
295.e: Hearing this, Devaki began to sigh and because of the attachment she experienced such a great anguish that she appeared to have given birth to the attachment itself.53.

295.g: ਦੇਵਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
295.t: dhevakee benatee baach ||
295.e: Speech regarding the supplication of Devaki:

295.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
295.t: kabit ||
295.e: KABIT

295.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ ਛਠੋ ਬੰਸ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੰਸ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਥ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
295.t: putr bhio chhaTho ba(n)s so bhee maar ddaario ka(n)s dhevakee pukaaree naath baat sun leejeeaai ||

295.g: ਕੀਜੀਐ ਅਨਾਥ ਨ ਸਨਾਥ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨਾਨਾਥ ਹਮੈ ਮਾਰ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਕਿ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਰ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥
295.t: keejeeaai anaath na sanaath mere dheenaanaath hamai maar dheejeeaai k yaa ko maar dheejeeaai ||
295.e: When the sixth son was also killed by Kansa, Devaki prayed thus to God, “O Master of the lowly! either kill us or kill Kansa

295.g: ਕੰਸ ਬਡੋ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲੋਭ ਭਯੋ ਜਾਪੀ ਸੋਈ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਦਸਾ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
295.t: ka(n)s baddo paapee jaa ko lobh bhayo jaapee soiee keejeeaai hamaaree dhasaa jaa te sukhee jeejeeaai ||

295.g: ਸ੍ਰੋਨਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ਗਜ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਰੋ ਲਾਈਐ ਨ ਢੀਲ ਅਬ ਦੋ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥੫੪॥
295.t: sronan mai sun asavaaree gaj vaaree karo laieeaai na ddeel ab dho mai ek keejeeaai ||54||
295.e: “Kansa is a great sinner, whom the people consider as their king and whom they remember  O Lord! Put him in the same condition as Thou hast put us   I have heard that Thou didst save the life of the elephant    do not delay now, be kind to do any one of t

295.g: ਇਤਿ ਛਠਵੋਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਬਧਹ ॥
295.t: eit chhaThavo(n) putr badheh ||
295.e: End of the description regarding the killing of the sixth son.

296.g: ਅਥ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰ ਜਨਮ ॥
296.t: ath balabhadhr janam ||
296.e: Now begins the description about the Birth of Balbhadra

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.t: savaiyaa ||
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਜੋ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰ ਭਯੋ ਗਰਭਾਤਰ ਤੌ ਦੁਹੰ ਬੈਠਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
296.t: jo balabhadhr bhayo garabhaatar tau dhuha(n) baiTh kai ma(n)tr kario hai ||

296.g: ਤਾ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਜੋਰ ਸੋ ਕਾਢਿ ਕੈ ਰੋਹਿਨੀ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਬੀਚ ਧਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
296.t: taa hee te ma(n)tr ke jor so kaadd kai rohinee ke ur beech dhario hai ||
296.e: When balbhadra was conceived, Devaki and Vasudev sat to hold consultations and with the power of mantras, he was transferred from the womb of Devaki to the womb of Rohini

296.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਦਾਚ ਹਨੇ ਸਿਸੁ ਕੋ ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਡਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
296.t: ka(n)s kadhaach hane sis ko teh te man mai basudhev ddario hai ||

296.g: ਸੇਖ ਮਨੋ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰ ਰੂਪ ਨਵੀਨ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੫॥
296.t: sekh mano jag dhekhan ko jag bheetar roop naveen kario hai ||55||
296.e: Thinking that Kansa may also kill him, Vasudev was frightened. It seemed that Sheshanaga had assumed a new form in order to see the world.55.

296.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
296.t: dhoharaa ||
296.e: DOHRA

296.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਦੋ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਕਿਸਨ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
296.t: kirasan kirasan kar saadh dho bisan kisan pat jaas ||

296.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਤਰਬੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਤਨ ਮੈ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੫੬॥
296.t: kirasan bisavai tarabe nimit tan mai kariyo prakaas ||56||
296.e: Both Devaki and Vasudev, began to remember Vishnu, the lord of Lakshmi with extreme saintliness and here Vishnu entered and enlightened the body of Devaki in order to redeem the world darkened by vices.56.

296.g: ਅਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜਨਮ ॥
296.t: ath kirasan janam ||
296.e: Now begins the description about the Birth of Krishna

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.t: savaiyaa ||
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਸੰਖ ਗਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਉਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਧਰੇ ਤਨਿ ਕਉਚ ਬਡੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
296.t: sa(n)kh gadhaa kar aaur tirasool dhare tan kauch badde baddabhaagee ||

296.g: ਨੰਦ ਗਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਪੀਤ ਧਰੈ ਪਟ ਪੈ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੀ ॥
